jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

To support our growth plans, we’re looking for a Steam Turbine Technical Field Authority who will play a critical, high‑impact role in developing, delivering, and shaping our steam turbine offering across Sulzer’s UK Service Network. If you want to grow your career, take on complex turbine challenges, and be backed by real investment and real capability, this is where you’ll thrive.

At Sulzer, you’ll be part of a team with one of the UK’s most advanced high‑speed balancing capabilities, handling rotors up to 50 tonnes, supported by 14 specialist Service Centres equipped with cutting‑edge rotating equipment expertise.
About the Role

This is not just another field role. This is a key technical authority position at the centre of Sulzer’s expanding Steam Turbine capability, working directly with customers, influencing project scope, and supporting major steam turbine overhauls, upgrades, repairs, and field service mobilisation.
You’ll be the technical expert our teams rely on. The person customers trust. And the driving force behind the success of UK-wide steam turbine projects.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Scope and evaluate work at customer sites across the UK, acting as the technical lead for inspections, diagnosis, and repair recommendations.

• Provide expert technical guidance to Sulzer Service Centres nationwide, ensuring alignment on engineering standards and steam turbine best practice.

• Support delivery of complex projects, from major overhauls to precision balancing, rotor assessments, troubleshooting, performance improvements, and outage support.

• Interface directly with customers, advising on condition, risk, repair options and project planning.

• Drive continuous improvement, working with engineering, operations, and field service teams to enhance our turbine offering and market competitiveness.

What We’re Looking For

• Strong background in Steam Turbine engineering, ideally within field service, overhauls, or rotating equipment environments.

• Proven experience in site-based inspections, fault-finding, and technical assessment.

• Confidence working directly with customers to scope, advise, and lead on technical solutions.

• The ability to act as a “go‑to” authority for steam turbine matters across multiple teams.

• A passion for engineering excellence, problem‑solving, and continuous improvement.

• Willingness to travel UK-wide as required.

What we offer you

• This is a fully remote, home‑based role that gives you full autonomy over your diary and time, with travel across the UK as required.

A competitive basic salary

• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance

• The option of a car/allowance (EV options are available)

• Private Medical Insurance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• Were proud to support those whove served. Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoDs Defence Employer Recognition Scheme meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us.

.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un orgoglioso patrimonio di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per far crescere la tua esperienza e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Per supportare i nostri piani di crescita, stiamo cercando un'autorità tecnica del campo di Turbina di vapore che svolgerà un ruolo critico e di alto impatto nello sviluppo, fornitura e modellazione della nostra offerta di turbine a vapore attraverso Sulzer. UK Service Network. Se si desidera aumentare la vostra carriera, affrontare complesse sfide delle turbine, e essere supportati da investimenti reali e capacità reali, questo è dove si.ll prosperare.

Su Sulzer, farai parte di un team con una delle più avanzate capacità di bilanciamento ad alta velocità del Regno Unito, che gestisce rotori fino a 50 tonnellate, supportati da 14 Centri Assistenza specializzati dotati di attrezzature rotanti all'avanguardia.

Questo non è solo un altro ruolo sul campo. Questa è una posizione chiave dell'autorità tecnica al centro di Sulzer.S espansione della capacità di Turbina di vapore, lavorando direttamente con i clienti, influenzando la portata del progetto, e supportando importanti revisioni delle turbine a vapore, aggiornamenti, riparazioni e mobilitazione dei servizi sul campo.

Sarai l'esperto tecnico su cui i nostri team si affidano.La persona su cui i clienti si fidano.E la forza trainante del successo dei progetti di turbine a vapore in tutto il Regno Unito.

Cosa farai?

- Scope and expert technical guideing to Sulzer Service Centres a livello nazionale, garantendo l'allineamento agli standard di ingegneria e alle migliori pratiche delle turbine a vapore. - Supporto alla fornitura di progetti complessi, dalle importanti revisioni al bilanciamento di precisione, alle valutazioni dei rotori, alla risoluzione dei problemi, ai miglioramenti delle prestazioni e al supporto di interruzione. - Interfaccia direttamente con i clienti, consulenza su condizioni, rischi, opzioni di riparazione e pianificazione dei progetti.

- Guidare il miglioramento continuo, lavorando con ingegneria, operazioni e team di assistenza sul campo per migliorare la nostra offerta di turbine e competitività sul mercato.

Cosa stavamo cercando?

- Forte esperienza nell'ingegneria della turbina a vapore, idealmente all'interno di ambienti di servizio sul campo, di revisione o di apparecchiature rotanti. - Esperienza professionale in ispezioni in loco, rilevazioni di guasti e valutazione tecnica. - Fiducia nel lavorare direttamente con i clienti per esaminare, consigliare e condurre soluzioni tecniche. - La capacità di agire come autorità per le turbine a vapore è importante in più team. - Una passione per l'eccellenza ingegneristica, la risoluzione dei problemi e il miglioramento continuo. - La volontà di viaggiare in tutto il Regno Unito come richiesto.

Cosa ti offriamo

- Questo è un ruolo completamente remoto, basato sulla casa che ti dà piena autonomia sul tuo diario e tempo, con viaggi attraverso il Regno Unito come richiesto. - Un salario base competitivo - Programma di bonus personali annuali basati sulla società e le prestazioni personali - L'opzione di un auto / indennità (sono disponibili opzioni EV) - Assicurazione medica privata - 33 giorni di congedo annuale. - Contributi pensionistici definiti. - L'accesso a Medicash aiuta a coprire i costi sanitari quotidiani come ottica dentale e fisioterapia più una serie di benefici benessere. - Assistenza riservata attraverso i programmi di assistenza ai dipendenti.

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Innovationserbe. Steigern Sie mit unserem globalen Team Ihre Expertise aus und entwickeln Sie innovative Lösungen, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Um unsere Wachstumspläne zu unterstützen, suchen wir eine technische Feldbehörde für Dampfturbinen, die eine kritische, hochwirksame Rolle bei der Entwicklung, Lieferung und Gestaltung unseres Dampfturbinenangebots in Sulzer, dem britischen Servicenetzwerk, spielen wird. Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un riche héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Pour soutenir nos plans de croissance, nous cherchons une Autorité de terrain technique de la turbine à vapeur qui jouera un rôle critique et à fort impact dans le développement, la livraison et la mise en forme de notre offre de turbine à vapeur dans l'ensemble de Sulzer, le réseau de services du Royaume-Uni. Si vous voulez développer votre carrière, relever des défis complexes en turbine, et être soutenu par un investissement réel et une capacité réelle, c'est là que vous allez prospérer.

À propos du rôle

Il s'agit d'un poste d'autorité technique clé au centre de Sulzer, qui élargit la capacité de la turbine à vapeur, travaille directement avec les clients, influe sur la portée du projet et soutient les révisions majeures des turbines à vapeur, les mises à niveau, les réparations et la mobilisation des services sur le terrain.

Vous serez l'expert technique sur lequel nos équipes comptent. La personne en qui les clients font confiance. Et la force motrice du succès des projets de turbine à vapeur à l'échelle du Royaume-Uni.

Ce que tu feras

- Fournir des conseils techniques spécialisés aux centres de service Sulzer dans tout le pays, en assurant l'alignement sur les normes techniques et les meilleures pratiques en matière de turbine à vapeur. - Soutenir la réalisation de projets complexes, depuis les révisions majeures jusqu'à l'équilibrage de précision, l'évaluation du rotor, le dépannage, l'amélioration des performances et l'assistance aux pannes. - Interagir directement avec les clients, conseiller sur l'état, les risques, les options de réparation et la planification du projet.

- Favoriser l'amélioration continue, en travaillant avec les équipes d'ingénierie, d'exploitation et de service sur le terrain pour améliorer notre offre de turbine et notre compétitivité sur le marché.

Ce que nous, sommes à la recherche

- Expérience éprouvée en matière d'inspections sur place, de recherche de failles et d'évaluation technique. - Confiance en travaillant directement avec les clients pour élargir, conseiller et diriger les solutions techniques. - Capacité d'agir comme un,go-to, autorité pour les questions de turbine à vapeur dans plusieurs équipes. - Passion d'excellence en ingénierie, de résolution de problèmes et d'amélioration continue. - Volonté de voyager à l'échelle du Royaume-Uni au besoin.

Ce que nous vous offrons

jobs.title: Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lead Machine Operator is responsible for overseeing the operation of machinery and equipment on the production floor, ensuring optimal performance and adherence to safety and quality standards. This role provides guidance to other machine operators and supports troubleshooting and maintenance activities.
This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations. Machinist

Company: Sulzer Pump Services (US) Inc.

Job Summary

Sulzer Pump Services (US) Inc. is seeking a skilled Machinist to operate and maintain various machine tools, producing precision components and parts for our industrial pump systems. This role is crucial for ensuring the quality and timely delivery of our products.

Job Responsibilities

* Set up, operate, and maintain a variety of machine tools such as lathes, milling machines, grinders, and drill presses to fabricate or repair metallic and non-metallic parts.
* Read and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and engineering specifications to determine machining operations, sequences, and dimensions.
* Select appropriate tools, cutting speeds, and feed rates based on material type and part specifications.
* Inspect finished products for conformance to specifications using precision measuring instruments such as micrometers, calipers, and gauges.
* Perform routine maintenance on machinery and equipment to ensure optimal performance and longevity.
* Identify and troubleshoot issues with machinery or parts, making necessary adjustments or repairs.
* Maintain a clean and organized work area, adhering to all safety regulations and company policies.
* Collaborate with engineers and other team members to optimize machining processes and improve product quality.
* Document work performed, including measurements, materials used, and any issues encountered.

Job Qualifications

* High school diploma or equivalent; completion of a vocational program or apprenticeship in machining is highly preferred.
* Proven experience as a Machinist, with a strong understanding of various machine tools and machining principles.
* Proficiency in reading and interpreting blueprints, technical drawings, and schematics.
* Strong knowledge of various materials (e.g., steel, aluminum, brass, plastics) and their machining properties.
* Expertise in using precision measuring instruments (micrometers, calipers, depth gauges, etc.) and maintaining tight tolerances.
* Ability to perform mathematical calculations relevant to machining operations.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong commitment to safety protocols and procedures.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Physical ability to lift and move heavy objects, stand for extended periods, and perform repetitive tasks.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Manual Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Sets up and operates machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
• Performs layouts, sets up, and operates conventional machine tools as required
• Reads and interprets all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing
• Designs setups and methods where none exist
• Instructs other shop personnel in proper machining techniques
• Continually improving methods to deliver higher quality with improved costs

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED:
• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training
• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections
• Ability to setup machine tools: ID / OD Grinders, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, Radial Drill, Planer Mill
• Four years of experience in machine shop operations
• Willingness to work in a team environment
• Openness to working overtime as required

QUALIFICATIONS:
• High School diploma or equivalent
• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training
• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections
• Demonstrated ability to effectively set up all, or at least most, of the following machines: I.D./O.D. Grinder, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Knee Mill, Radial Drill, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, and Planer Mill
• Ability to perform with a minimum of direct supervision
• Working knowledge of tool geometry and application
• Working knowledge of effects of feeds and speeds
• 4 years experience in machine shops on the above equipment
• Willingness to work in a team environment
• Ability to work overtime as required

What we offer you

Paid parental leave
Parental leave
Health insurance
401(k) matching
Paid time off

Dental insurance

Disability insurance

Job Summary
The Design Engineer is responsible for the design, construction, maintenance, and repair of plant buildings and machinery. This includes establishing standards for pollution control, testing, and maintenance, and recommending new equipment and systems.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member.

jobs.title: TS Field Service Engineer

titleByLocale.it: Ingegnere di assistenza sul campo TS
titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur de maintenance sur site TS

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Responsible for pre-commissioning, commissioning, troubleshooting, start-up, and testing of rotating equipment and related mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation systems; supervising DIRA activities; monitoring field operations and reporting findings; acting as company representative in customer communications; ensuring compliance with ISO, HSE, and company regulations; promoting workplace safety through inspections and Stop Work Authority; and coordinating with Project, Sales, Engineering, and Workshop teams to ensure successful project execution.
Main tasks and responsibilities

• Pre-commissioning and commissioning of installed, repaired or overhauled rotating equipment.

• If required supervise and assist with the DIRA of rotating equipment and associated auxiliary equipment according to technical drawings and specifications.

• Systematic trouble shooting, root cause analysis and rectification on mechanical, electrical and instrumentation component and systems with consideration on quality, time and cost.

• Lead for start up and testing of new installations/erections or overhauled units of rotating equipment including mechanical part, electrical part, instruments and control system

• Monitor field sequence activities based on agreed scope and schedule and report regularly to office.

• Ensure that all findings and work is clearly reported in writing.

• Work assignment could be at shop or field service depends on customer projects request

• Communicate with customer or third party on site as RES representative

• Ensures that all works and activities are done in line with the ISO procedures, as well as the HSE and company regulations.

• Preventing accident, conduct walk thru and observation.

• Campaign using Stop Work Authority to their subordinate when any unsafe Act and condition then record by using observation card.

• Review HIRADC effectiveness. Ensure working area safe for everyone.

• Coordinate with Project OPC, Sales, Engineering and workshop

Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?)

• Team player

• Well organized and structured

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Pro-active and self-motivated minset

• Multi-tasking

• Must have experience in installation, maintenance and troubleshooting of rotating equipment

• Willingness to travel and work on project sites.

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering

• Preferably with minimum 5 years experience working on repairing rotating equipment

• Have experience in the OEM will be an advantage

• Have knowledge on repair or overhaul turbine generators

• Fluent in English

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un orgoglioso patrimonio di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per far crescere la tua esperienza e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Responsabile della pre-commissioning, messa in servizio, risoluzione dei problemi, avvio e collaudo di apparecchiature rotanti e relativi sistemi meccanici, elettrici e di strumentazione; supervisione delle attività DIRA; monitoraggio delle operazioni sul campo e dei risultati di reporting; funzione di rappresentante aziendale nelle comunicazioni dei clienti; garanzia della conformità alle norme ISO, HSE e aziendali; promozione della sicurezza sul lavoro attraverso ispezioni e autorità di arresto del lavoro; coordinamento con i team di progetto, vendite, ingegneria e workshop per garantire l'esecuzione di progetti di successo.

Principali compiti e responsabilità

- Pre-commissioning e messa in servizio di attrezzature rotanti installate, riparate o revisionate. - Se necessario supervisionare e assistere con il DIRA di attrezzature rotanti e apparecchiature ausiliarie associate secondo disegni e specifiche tecniche. - Problema sistematico tiro, causa radice analisi e rettifica su componenti e sistemi meccanici, elettrici e strumentazione con riguardo alla qualità, tempo e costi.

- Lead for start up and testing of new installations/erections or revisioned units of rotating equipment including mechanical part, electric part, instruments and control system - Monitor field sequence activities based on consensed space and schedule and report regolarmente to office. - Assicuratevi che tutti i risultati e i lavori siano chiaramente riportati per iscritto.

- L'assegnazione del lavoro potrebbe essere al negozio o servizio sul campo dipende dalla richiesta di progetti del cliente - Comunicare con il cliente o terze parti sul sito come rappresentante RES - Assicurare che tutte le opere e le attività sono effettuate in linea con le procedure ISO, così come la HSE e la normativa aziendale. - Prevenire incidenti, condurre a piedi attraverso e osservazione. - Campagna utilizzando l'autorità di lavoro Stop per i loro subordinati quando qualsiasi legge e condizione non sicuri poi registrare utilizzando carta di osservazione. - Verificare l'efficacia HIRADC. Garantire l'area di lavoro sicuro per tutti.

- Coordinare con il progetto OPC, Vendite, Ingegneria e workshop

Competenze e comportamenti richiesti (Quali sono i punti di forza necessari?)

- Giocatore di squadra - Ben organizzato e strutturato - Ottima comunicazione e capacità interpersonali - Minset proattivo e auto-YYYYY - Multi-tasking - Deve avere esperienza in installazione, manutenzione e risoluzione dei problemi di attrezzature rotanti - Volontà di viaggiare e lavorare sui siti di progetto.

Qualifica/esperienza e conoscenza richieste

- Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica - Preferibilmente con minimo 5 anni di esperienza nel lavoro di riparazione di macchine rotanti - Avere esperienza nell'OEM sarà un vantaggio - Avere conoscenze sulla riparazione o revisione di generatori di turbine - Fluente in inglese

Cosa ti offriamo

Sulzer è un datore di lavoro per pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Innovationserbe. Steigern Sie mit unserem globalen Team Ihre Expertise aus und entwickeln Sie innovative Lösungen, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Verantwortlich für die Vorab- und Inbetriebnahme, die Inbetriebnahme, die Fehlersuche, die Inbetriebnahme und die Prüfung rotierender Geräte sowie zugehöriger mechanischer, elektrischer und Instrumentierungssysteme; Überwachung der DIRA-Aktivitäten; Überwachung der Feldbetriebsvorgänge und der Berichterstattung; als Unternehmensvertreter in der Kundenkommunikation; Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der ISO-, HSE- und Unternehmensvorschriften; Förderung der Sicherheit am Arbeitsplatz durch Inspektionen und die Überwachung der Arbeitsbehörde; Koordinierung mit den Teams von Projekt, Vertrieb, Engineering und Workshop, um eine erfolgreiche Projektausführung zu gewährleisten.

Hauptaufgaben und Zuständigkeiten

- Vor-Besetzung und Inbetriebnahme der installierten, reparierten oder überholten rotierenden Ausrüstung. - Bei Bedarf überwachen und unterstützen Sie mit der DIRA von rotierenden Geräten und zugehörige Hilfsausrüstung nach technischen Zeichnungen und Spezifikationen. - Systematische Fehlersuche, Wurzel Ursache Analyse und Korrektur auf mechanische, elektrische und Instrumentierungskomponenten und Systeme mit Rücksicht auf Qualität, Zeit und Kosten.

- Blei für die Inbetriebnahme und Prüfung neuer Anlagen/Erektionen oder überholter Einheiten rotierender Ausrüstung einschließlich mechanischer Teile, elektrischer Teile, Instrumente und Kontrollsystem - Überwachung der Feldsequenzaktivitäten auf der Grundlage des vereinbarten Umfangs und Zeitplans und Bericht regelmäßig an das Büro. - Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Ergebnisse und Arbeiten klar schriftlich gemeldet.

- Die Arbeit kann in Laden oder im Außendienst sein abhängig von Kundenprojekten Anfrage - Kommunikation mit Kunden oder Dritten vor Ort als RES-Vertreter - stellt sicher, dass alle Arbeiten und Aktivitäten werden in Übereinstimmung mit den ISO-Verfahren, sowie die HSE und Unternehmensvorschriften durchgeführt. - Unfallverhütung, Durchführung von Fuß durch und Beobachtung. - Kampagne mit Stop Work Authority zu ihren untergeordneten, wenn jedes unsichere Gesetz und Zustand dann mit Hilfe von Beobachtungskarte zu erfassen. - Überprüfung HIRADC Wirksamkeit. Sichere Arbeitsbereich für alle.

- Koordination mit Projekt OPC, Vertrieb, Engineering und Werkstatt

Kompetenzen und Verhalten erforderlich (Welche Stärken sind erforderlich?)

- Teamplayer - Gut organisiert und strukturiert - Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten - Proaktive und selbst-bewegte Minset - Multi-Tasking - Muss Erfahrung in der Installation, Wartung und Fehlerbehebung von rotierenden Geräten haben - Bereitschaft zu reisen und auf Projekt-Websites zu arbeiten.

Qualifikationen/Erfahrung und Wissen erforderlich

- Bachelor, s Diplom in Maschinenbau - Vorzugsweise mit mindestens 5 Jahren Erfahrung bei der Reparatur rotierender Geräte - Haben Sie Erfahrung im OEM wird ein Vorteil sein - Wissen über Reparatur oder Überholung Turbinengeneratoren - Fluent in Englisch

Was wir Ihnen anbieten

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber mit gleicher Chancenstellung. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und sind bestrebt, ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld zu bieten.

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Arbeitgeber 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA ausgezeichnet zu werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un riche héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Responsable de la mise en service, de la mise en service, du dépannage, du démarrage et de l'essai des équipements rotatifs et des systèmes mécaniques, électriques et d'instrumentation connexes; de la supervision des activités de l'AID; du suivi des opérations sur le terrain et des conclusions de rapports; de la représentation de l'entreprise dans les communications avec les clients; de la conformité aux normes ISO, HSE et de l'entreprise; de la promotion de la sécurité au travail par le biais des inspections et de l'arrêt de travail; et de la coordination avec les équipes de projet, de vente, d'ingénierie et d'atelier pour assurer la réussite de l'exécution des projets.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

- Pré-démarrage et mise en service d'équipements rotatifs installés, réparés ou revus. - Au besoin, superviser et assister l'AIR de l'équipement rotatif et de l'équipement auxiliaire associé selon les dessins et spécifications techniques. - Prise de vues systématique, analyse des causes profondes et des systèmes et composants mécaniques, électriques et instrumentaux avec considération de la qualité, du temps et des coûts.

- Le plomb pour le démarrage et l'essai de nouvelles installations/érections ou unités de rotation révisées, y compris les pièces mécaniques, les pièces électriques, les instruments et le système de contrôle. - Surveiller les activités de séquence sur le terrain en fonction de la portée et du calendrier convenus et faire rapport régulièrement au bureau.

- L'affectation des travaux peut être effectuée en magasin ou sur le terrain selon la demande de projet de la clientèle - Communiquer avec le client ou un tiers sur place en tant que représentant du RES - S'assurer que tous les travaux et activités sont effectués conformément aux procédures ISO, ainsi qu'aux règlements de la HSE et de l'entreprise. - Prévenir les accidents, effectuer des déplacements et observer. - Campagne en utilisant l'autorité de travail de stop à son subordonné lorsque toute loi et condition dangereuses enregistrent alors en utilisant la carte d'observation. - Examiner l'efficacité du HIRAD.

- Coordonner avec le CPVP, les ventes, l'ingénierie et l'atelier

Compétences et comportement requis (Quels sont les points forts requis?)

- Joueur d'équipe - Bien organisé et structuré - Excellente communication et aptitudes interpersonnelles - Minset proactif et automotivé - Multitâche - Doit avoir de l'expérience dans l'installation, l'entretien et le dépannage de l'équipement rotatif - Volonté de voyager et de travailler sur les sites de projet.

Qualifications/expérience et connaissances requises

- Baccalauréat en génie mécanique - De préférence avec au moins 5 ans d'expérience de travail sur la réparation de l'équipement rotatif - Avoir de l'expérience dans l'OEM sera un avantage - Avoir des connaissances sur la réparation ou la révision des générateurs de turbine - Fluent en anglais

Ce que nous vous offrons

Nous croyons en la force d'une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée et nous sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif.

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme un employeur de premier plan 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.title: Siemens V84 Specialist Superintendent EG
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The SGTS Superintendent oversees the daily operations of the SGTS GT Division with a focus on safety, quality, and efficiency. They cultivate a positive work environment, drive technical advancement, and ensure effective collaboration with customers and stakeholders. This role also involves optimizing processes, managing budgets, and leading Health and Safety initiatives to promote a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. Responsibilities

• Manage day-to-day operations, prioritizing safety, environmental compliance, and adherence to quality standards.

• Manage the Profit and Loss (P&L) of the division, ensuring financial targets are met or exceeded by effectively managing costs, maximizing revenue streams, and implementing strategies to enhance profitability.

• Cultivate a positive work environment by actively engaging with employees, setting clear expectations, and promoting teamwork.

• Drive technical advancement within the division by staying abreast of industry trends and continuously improving coating solutions.

• Optimize work processes to enhance efficiency and profitability, ensuring alignment with monthly budgets.

• Collaborate with customers, Sales Department, and vendors to meet project requirements and maintain strong relationships.

• Coordinate scheduling and project timelines, regularly updating task status and completion dates for effective project management.

• Conduct performance evaluations for Direct Reports and manage salary adjustments in line with company policies.
Qualifications:
The ideal candidate will possess the following:

• 15-20 plus years of Siemens V84 gas turbine field technical execution experience in project management and/or technical direction

• BS in Mechanical Engineering a plus

• Ability to manage a team of Siemens Technical specialists to execute all levels of scheduled and non-scheduled outage activities

• Travel required to quote pending or executing projects

• Sulzer in person office interface required on a balanced basis

• Additional Siemens gas turbine experience a plus

• Strong communication and leadership skills imperative

• Fluent in business and project relative software’s

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Production Worker / Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Worker / Technician is responsible for assembling, testing, and inspecting products to ensure they meet quality and safety standards. This role supports the manufacturing process by identifying defects, maintaining equipment, and following production protocols.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously.
SUMMARY:
Performs sandblast and paint application tasks in accordance with SPSI standard procedure processes as well as specific customer requirements.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: % OF TIME

 Operates sandblast equipment to provide required surface preparation 35%

 Performs mixing of various types of paint materials. 5%
 Operates conventional spray equipment, including brush to provide a high quality industrial finish to parts and components 35%
 Moves parts and components as needed with forklift or overhead pendant crane 5%
 Dispose of paint waste materials as required by company, state and federal regulations 5%

 Adheres to Safety and Take 5 culture 5%
 Supports and cooperates with Four Principles 5%
SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
 Other duties as assigned 5%

TOTAL PERCENT OF TIME: 100%
QUALIFICATIONS:
 High School graduate or equivalent
 Minimum of 1 year experience operating sandblast equipment
 Minimum of 2 years of experience operating conventional spray equipment
 Forklift and pendant crane experience is helpful
 Minimum 1 year of experience mixing and applying epoxies, polyurethane, inorganic zinc and alkyd enamel paints.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Quality Engineer is responsible for managing quality engineering processes and supporting manufacturing operations to ensure product compliance. This includes defining quality standards, auditing outputs, and resolving defects.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area.
Principais Responsabilidades

• Gerenciar, acompanhar e executar projetos e atividades de alta complexidade relacionados à área de Qualidade;

• Desenvolver, implementar e controlar programas e sistemas de gestão, garantia e controle da qualidade;

• Conduzir análises, pesquisas e melhorias contínuas em métodos, processos, formulações e padrões de qualidade;

• Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a modificação de metodologias relacionadas à confiabilidade, ensaios e processos produtivos;

jobs.title: Receptionist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Administrator is responsible for providing basic administrative support by following established procedures. This role works under close supervision and handles routine tasks to support office operations.

Will answer phones, greet and check in all visitors.

This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and work under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. SC: Phoenix, Arizona

PRIMARY FUNCTIONS:

• Upon arriving make sure necessary lights are on and the TV with the safety message is turned on

• Answer / screen / forward incoming phone calls using a multi-line telephone system

• Personably greet and welcome walk-in customers / visitors; ensure they are signed in accordingly then direct them to the appropriate staff member

• Direct visitors to the appropriate person and office

• Ensure reception desk is manned and the main telephone line has coverage at all times during business hours

• Perform brief safety orientation accordingly with customers / visitors entering the premises, where applicable

• Manage inventory and purchase office supplies

• Create and maintain inventory spreadsheet for admin and sales supplies

• Manage and update the conference room calendar as needed

• Organize, set-up, break down and maintain conference room for all operations and executive meetings

• Organize and order lunch on an as needed basis

• Oversee sorting and distribution of mail to both the administration and shop buildings

• Prepare outgoing mail / UPS / FedEx (envelopes, packages, etc.)

• Perform other clerical receptionist duties such a filing, photocopying, data entry, etc.

• Keep common area clean and organized

• Provide assistance to other departments as needed and per supervisor approval

EXPERIENCE/SKILLS:

• Knowledge and proficient use of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Power Point

• Maintain a professional attitude and appearance

• Excellent communication and organizational skills

• Customer service quality

• Independently perform substantial clerical and office work

• The ability to proficiently use a multi-line telephone system, computer, copier and other office equipment

• Be a self-motivated individual with initiative and the ability to multi-task

• Team oriented and able to interact with multiple departments

• Bilingual is required (English & Spanish)

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

• Office environment

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• May occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds

What we offer you

Paid parental leave
Parental leave
Health insurance
401(k) matching
Paid time off
Vision insurance
Health savings account
Dental insurance
Gym membership
Employee assistance program
Disability insurance
401(k) 6% Match
Paid holidays
Wellness program

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Manager is responsible for managing a team of sales representatives, setting sales goals, and ensuring the team meets performance targets. This role supports the execution of sales strategies and provides coaching and development to team members.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ experienced to senior expert-level employees.
Key Responsibilities
Supervise and support the sales team in achieving targets.
Set sales goals and monitor performance metrics.
Train and mentor sales representatives.
Develop and implement sales plans and strategies.
Handle key customer accounts and resolve escalations.
Collaborate with marketing and operations teams.
Report sales performance to senior leadership.
Skills & Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and 9+ years of relevant work experienceare minimally required to be able to manage and coordinate one or more expert-level teams.
Experience in sales team management.
Strong leadership and coaching skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
Proficiency in CRM systems and reporting tools.
Ability to analyze data and drive performance.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

jobs.title: Field Service Supervisor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Field) Service Machinist Supervisor is responsible for managing on-site machining operations in demanding industrial environments. This role is responsible for supervising field personnel, ensuring precision machining work meets strict tolerances, and delivering projects safely, on time, and within budget. The ideal candidate combines strong technical machining expertise with proven leadership and customer-facing skills. Key Responsibilities
Set up and operate portable machining equipment lathes, line boring, flange facing, milling, drilling, and tapping.
Interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and specifications.
Measure and inspect components using, calipers, dial indicators, etc.
Ensure proper alignment and tolerances are achieved.
Maintain field equipment and tooling.
Communicate with clients and supervisors regarding job progress and issues.

Skills & Qualifications
High school diploma or equivalent technical training.
Proven experience as a machinist, preferably in field or industrial environment.
Ability to read and interpret blueprints and schematics.
Mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Willingness to travel frequently and work in varying conditions outdoors, confined spaces, and heights.
Physical ability to lift heavy equipment and stand for long periods.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Air Compressor Maintenance Technician

titleByLocale.it: Tecnologia di manutenzione del compressore d'aria

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Air Compressor Maintenance Technician is responsible for the installation, inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of air compressors and related systems. This role ensures equipment operates safely, reliably, and efficiently while meeting company, customer, and regulatory standards. Responsibilities

• Install, maintain, inspect, and repair industrial air compressors and auxiliary equipment

• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance to minimize downtime

• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic issues and recommend repairs

• Conduct routine inspections and performance testing of compressor systems

• Replace worn or defective parts, including motors, valves, seals, belts, and filters

• Read and interpret technical manuals, schematics, and work orders

• Ensure compliance with safety policies, procedures, and industry regulations

• Document maintenance activities, inspections, and repairs accurately

• Support equipment upgrades, modifications, and system improvements

• Coordinate with operations, engineering, and management teams as needed

• Always maintain a clean and safe work environment

• Assist other trades and perform additional duties or work assignments as directed by the management team
Qualifications:
The i d eal ca nd i d ate will p o sse s s t h e f o l l o win g :

• High school diploma or GED required, technical certification or trade school preferred

• 3+ years of experience maintaining or repairing industrial air compressors or rotating equipment

• Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills

• Experience with reciprocating, centrifugal, or rotary screw compressors preferred

• Ability to read technical drawings and service manuals

• Familiarity with safety standards and lockout/tagout procedures

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team

• HVAC or refrigeration experience is a plus

• Must provide own personal tools

• Required to supply personal hand tools appropriate for the role

• Worked on following equipment, Quincy, Kaeser, Sullair.

Physical & Work Requirements

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs

• Ability to stand, bend, kneel, and work in industrial environments

• Willingness to work overtime, weekends, or on-call as required

• Ability to work in shop and field environments

Preferred Skills

• Experience in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, or Power Generation industries

• Knowledge of vibration monitoring, alignment, and lubrication practices

• Strong attention to detail and safety awareness

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

jobs.title: Clean Line Operatives
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer GT Aero, we specialize in the repair, overhaul, and field service of industrial, marine, and power gas turbines. With over two decades of expertise, our team delivers tailored solutions to clients worldwide, ensuring reliability, performance, and rapid turnaround. From spare parts and consultancy to full turbine refurbishment, we’re the trusted partner for critical rotating equipment.

This role is based at our Netherley facility near Stonehaven in Aberdeenshire, a key hub for our turbine operations and customer support.

As a Process / Clean Line Operative, you’ll be responsible for preparing and cleaning turbine components to the highest standards, supporting the delivery of world-class engineering services. Job Responsibilities

• Clean and process turbine components using chemical tanks, grit blasting, vapour blasting, and hand cleaning.

• Operate specialist equipment such as ball burnishing machines.

• Maintain high standards of quality and safety in all tasks.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives within the workshop.

• Follow all health, safety, and environmental procedures.

Job Qualifications

• A flexible, team-oriented approach with the ability to work independently.

• Ability to follow technical instructions and safe working practices.

• Previous experience in a cleanline or workshop environment is preferred, but full training will be provided.

What we offer you

• A competitive hourly rate

• Paid overtime opportunities

• 9-day fortnight working pattern (every other Friday off)

• 33 days of annual leave

• Access to retail and entertainment discounts — including Costco membership

• Discounted personal car leasing for employees, family, and friends

• Confidential support via our Employee Assistance Programme

• Ongoing learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Expert is responsible for leading the design, development, and optimization of mechanical systems and components. The expert collaborates across departments to drive innovation and resolve complex engineering challenges.

jobs.title: Master Planner
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Planner is responsible for scheduling and coordinating production activities to ensure timely delivery of products. This role works closely with procurement, manufacturing, and logistics to align production plans with demand forecasts and resource availability.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key Responsivities:

• Develop and maintain master production schedules based on sales targets, customer orders, and forecast demand.

• Analyze manufacturing capacity, workload, and resource utilization(labor, equipment) to identify constraints and bottlenecks.

• Collaborate with production, engineering and procurement teams to resolve scheduling conflicts and implement corrective actions.

• Monitor master schedule progress and adjust plans proactively to achieve sales target.

• Maintain accurate planning data, documentation, and generate regular performance reports(e.g., schedule adherence, capacity utilization).

• Continuously improve scheduling processes to increase efficiency, reduce lead times, and support lean manufacturing initiatives.

Skills & Qualifications:
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least of 3-4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.
Strong analytical and organizational skills. Experience with ERP/MRP systems. Knowledge of master planning and scheduling. Effective communication and collaboration abilities. Ability to manage multiple priorities.

What we offer you

target bonus: 16.67% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Journey Level Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Set up and operate machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision. ​

• Performs layouts, sets up, and operates machines.

• Read and interpret procedures, work orders, and technical drawings to meet specifications.

• Apply knowledge of metals and alloys, including stainless and carbon steels.

• Improves set ups and methods for higher quality and improved cost.

• Operate overhead crane and forklifts safely as directed by Supervisor. Perform other duties as necessary.

• Maintain regular and reliable attendance.

• Maintains a safe, neat, and orderly workstation

• Assists in the disassembly, inspection, and re-assembly of pump equipment when required

• Communicate effectively to ensure smooth workflow transitions between team members.

• Support and assist coworkers, including training and collaboration.

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide safety program which includes following all safety policies and procedures

• Supports and cooperates in Sulzer Nuclear Quality Program

• Performs other duties as assigned

• Works overtime as requested

• Operates forklifts, overhead cranes, man lifts, and scissor lifts

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training.

• Minimum of five (5) years of experience in machining.

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspection.

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.

• Basic math skills.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

The Sr. Tendering Lead is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting detailed analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing. jobs.title: Lead Piping Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Supervisor is responsible for supervising a team of mechanical engineers and support staff engaged in the design, development, and testing of mechanical systems and components. This role ensures that engineering projects are executed efficiently, meet technical and quality standards, and align with organizational goals. The supervisor also plays a key role in mentoring junior engineers, managing project timelines, and fostering innovation in mechanical design and manufacturing processes.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ junior to experienced expert-level roles. 设置该岗位的目的:
Purpose of the Job:

As a Principal Piping Engineer, you will participate in Sulzer projects at all execution stages (Conceptual design, Skid and Modular design, DD, Procurement / Construction / Commissioning support etc.).
Principal Piping Engineer reports to the Chief Piping Engineer and/or Engineering Manager.
主要任务与职责:
Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Take lead in overall piping design of skid

• Act as overall mechanical engineering IC in skid projects

• Train and guide piping engineers

• Design, 3D modeling and review of main metal structures of skids and modules

• Piping stress analysis

• Development of the drawings and other design documents within discipline

• Material selection within discipline

• Value engineering within discipline

• Interface management

• Participate in the development of technical specifications for design, technical requirements for supply, etc.

• Supervision and support of subcontractors' activities

• Checking and approval documentation from subcontractors.

• Participation in the development of design philosophy and internal standards within the discipline

• Participation in the project meetings, 3D models review etc.

• Contribute to development of the overall project schedule.

• Tracking and managing changes within discipline

• Participation in the project progress report development.

职位要求：
Qualifications:
Education and Experience

• Bachelor in Mechanical Engineering

• 10 years’ experience in the oil and gas industries.

• Good knowledge of applicable industrial standards and best practices. (China & International)

• Good knowledge of designing methods and economic analysis.

• Extensive experience in skid and modular design

• General knowledge of oil and gas plant construction.

Language

• Fluent in Mandarin and English

Others

• Ability to work under tight deadlines with multiple tasks.

• Ability to work in multiple projects.

• Ability to travel on business trips including lengthy business trips to site during construction and commissioning.

What we offer you

target bonus：18.33% of annual income

jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Management & Purchasing Engineer

titleByLocale.it: Senior Supply Chain Management & Purchasing Ingegnere
titleByLocale.en: Senior Supply Chain Management & Purchasing Engineer
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Chaîne d'approvisionnement Management & Purchasing Ingénieur

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Procurement Supervisor is responsible for supervising procurement professionals and ensuring the effective sourcing and acquisition of goods and services. This includes managing supplier relationships and ensuring compliance with procurement policies.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ junior to experienced expert-level roles. The Senior Supply Chain Management & Purchasing Engineer is responsible for driving strategic sourcing while applying procurement engineering expertise in Supply Chain Management. The role focuses on identifying and securing cost‑optimized products and services required for Process Solutions’ own production and project execution.

Depending on workload, this position will be assigned to functions in the Strategic Sourcing, Vendor Management and Advanced Procurement function. The role works closely with all cross‑functional teams across the organization, supporting their sourcing needs to ensure timely, cost‑effective, and quality‑compliant delivery aligned with project and business objectives.

A background in EPC environments is an advantage, along with experience in site procurement, construction, or working within an engineering‑driven setting. Exposure to international procurement is also a plus.

设置该岗位的目的:

The Senior SCM & Purchasing Engineer is responsible for driving strategic sourcing while applying procurement engineering expertise in Supply Chain Management. The role focuses on identifying and securing cost‑optimized products and services required for Process Solutions’ own production and project execution.

主要任务与职责:
Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Identify and develop qualified best-fit suppliers for various demands of engineered equipment, materials, subcontracting need for Sulzer packages

• Conduct market research, TCO analysis (within Sulzer Scope coverage), and supply chain risk assessments.

• Support sourcing initiatives on product line development and source for the most cost‑effective sources.

• Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of industry trends, technologies, and supplier capabilities, lesson learns to support team innovation

• Vendor Management

• Evaluate, qualify, and assess suppliers' technical capability, quality standards, and capacity Manage supplier performance, conduct audits, and drive corrective actions where needed. Maintain accurate supplier records (credentials, ISO, Financial, audit records, performance in Sulzer digital dashboard, and other files. Support Quality team in the corrective actions for in case of NCR and tracking of COPQ

• Project Procurement Support (when activated)

• Will be working in Advanced Procurement team while collaborate with Engineering, Quality, Project Management, Workshop to meet project procurement needs and timelines. Provide regular procurement status reports, risk assessments, and mitigation plans. Manage end-to-end procurement cycle including RFQ’s, commercial bid evaluations. Lead negotiations to achieve competitive pricing, favorable terms, while aligned to the total cost of ownership (within Sulzer scope). Issue purchase orders, monitor order progress for buy outs, work with Quality and Project Manag

jobs.title: ESH Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The ESH Engineer is responsible for supporting basic environmental, safety, and health activities, including inspections, data collection, and compliance monitoring. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Main tasks and responsibilities:
- Implement applicable national workplace safety laws and regulations, standards and specifications, and the company’s safety management system; implement the safety production responsibility system.
- Conduct daily on-site safety inspections and hazard identification and rectification. Focus on high-risk activities such as machinery operations, welding, chemical use, dust-related work, working at height, hot work, temporary electrical work, and heavy lifting/handling.
- Supervise workers correct wearing and use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and promptly stop the “three violations” (unauthorized command, unsafe/unauthorized operation, and violation of work discipline).
- Organize three-level safety induction training for new employees, pre-job/toolbox safety briefings, special safety training, and emergency drills to enhance safety awareness and emergency response capability.
- Participate in permit-to-work approvals and on-site monitoring for hazardous operations; verify work conditions, control measures, and personnel qualifications to ensure compliant execution.
- Conduct periodic inspection, maintenance, and management of fire-fighting facilities, emergency equipment, and protective supplies to ensure they are in good condition and effective.
- Improve safety signs, warning boards, and safety communication materials, and promote on-site safety culture.
- Participate in the investigation and handling of safety incidents/accidents; perform root-cause analysis, record and report findings, and track implementation of corrective actions.
- Establish and maintain safety records, inspection logs, training files, and hazard rectification closure records to ensure they are standardized and complete.
- Complete other workplace safety management tasks assigned by supervisors.

What we offer you

target bonus：15% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role Job Summary The ESH Engineer is responsible for supporting basic environmental, safety, and health activities, including inspections, data collection, and compliance monitoring. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Main tasks and responsibilities: - Implement applicable national workplace safety laws and regulations, standards and specifications, and the company’s safety management system; implement the safety production responsibility system. - Conduct daily on-site safety inspections and hazard identification and rectification. Focus on high-risk activities such as machinery operations, welding, chemical use, dust-related work, working at height, hot work, temporary electrical work, and heavy lifting/handling. - Supervise workers correct wearing and use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and promptly stop the “three violations” (unauthorized command, unsafe/unauthorized operation, and violation of work discipline). - Organize three-level safety induction training for new employees, pre-job/toolbox safety briefings, special safety training, and emergency drills to enhance safety awareness and emergency response capability. - Participate in permit-to-work approvals and on-site monitoring for hazardous operations; verify work conditions, control measures, and personnel qualifications to ensure compliant execution. - Conduct periodic inspection, maintenance, and management of fire-fighting facilities, emergency equipment, and protective supplies to ensure they are in good condition and effective. - Improve safety signs, warning boards, and safety communication materials, and promote on-site safety culture. - Participate in the investigation and handling of safety incidents/accidents; perform root-cause analysis, record and report findings, and track implementation of corrective actions. - Establish and maintain safety records, inspection logs, training files, and hazard rectification closure records to ensure they are standardized and complete. - Complete other workplace safety management tasks assigned by supervisors.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting the sales process by providing technical expertise, assisting with product demonstrations, and preparing proposals. This role works closely with senior engineers and sales teams to ensure customer requirements are met.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Main tasks and responsibilities

• Deliver annual Order Intake targets, ensuring both revenue and expected margin objectives are met.

• To plan and undertake regular customer visits, maximizing enquiry generation and driving order intake to deliver the growth plan.

• Prepare, submit and follow up all enquiries to customers in a timely and professionally manner.

• Ensure that defined long-term and short-term objectives, strategies and plans are achieved.

• Follow-up regularly on submitted proposals and to update in Sulzer Customer Relationship Management system.

• Co-ordinate projects with Head Office, Regional Offices and Agents, as applicable.

• Provide regular reporting on market, projects, market analysis and sales forecasts.

• Ensure that all business activities conform to local laws and regulations and are following company policies and procedures.

• Any other duties that are assigned by superiors.

Competencies and behaviour required

• Frequent travel to domestic customers

• Fluent in written & spoken English in addition to local language

• Excellent interpersonal skills, initiative and proactive.

• Good communicator and good leadership skills.

• · Good negotiation, planning, coordination & monitoring skills.

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Bachelor degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent from reputable university.

• Minimum 5 years process equipment selling in Oil & Gas / Oleochemical Industry.

• Proven track record in achieving YoY (Year on Year) sales growth with strong penetration and success in Indonesia Oil & Gas, Petrochemicals & Oleochemical segment.

• Strong network of established contacts with decision makers / influencers in end user and engineering companies from Oil & Gas, Petrochemicals & Oleochemical market will be advantageous.

• Experience working with international, multi-ethnic and cultural teams.

What we offer you

Career Opportunities

Medical Benefit

jobs.title: Senior QC Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Ensures quality and technical compliance in servicing rotating equipment, including pumps, turbines, and compressors. Ensures adherence to Sulzer OEM, customer, and international standards, while supporting inspections, repair solutions, and quality procedures. Provides technical feedback, prepares inspection reports, and develops and implements required standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct incoming, in-process, and final inspections of rotating equipment and components.

• Prepare and review overhaul reports with technical recommendations.

• Develop work instructions, drawings, and repair methods based on findings.

• Maintain job packs, checklists, inspection records, and SOPs.

jobs.title: Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Safely and efficiently disassemble, thoroughly inspect, and precisely build rotating equipment such as steam turbines, gas turbines, compressors, hot gas expanders, gear boxes and other machinery according to Sulzer’s established guidelines and safety protocols. Assembly Mechanic

Sulzer offers you a wealth of opportunities to drive your career into the direction that you want, depending on your skills and interests. We've been awarded a top employer nationwide for the past 3 years. We invite you to apply if you are ready to take the next step!

We are looking for Assembly Mechanics to join our Core team in La Porte.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Safely and efficiently disassemble, thoroughly inspect, and precisely build rotating equipment such as steam turbines, gas turbines, compressors, hot gas expanders, gear boxes and other machinery according to Sulzer’s established guidelines and safety protocols.

• Conduct thorough visual inspections of disassembled components, identifying wear, damage, or abnormalities that may affect equipment performance.

• Utilize precision measuring instruments, such as micrometers, dial indicators, and bore gauges, to take accurate measurements and assess dimensional integrity of parts.

• Operate overhead cranes, torches, grinders, and forklifts when required.

• Prepare detailed inspection reports documenting findings and measurements.

• Execute unit assembly of repaired or replaced components, following technical specifications and quality standards.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• 3 years of hands-on, shop oriented experience turbomachinery repair preferred.

• High mechanical aptitude and experience in detailed mechanic industries (turbines, compressors, rotating equipment)

• Willingness to work overtime when necessary.

• Must be able to use precision measuring instruments.

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• Bonus Programs

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Repair various kinds of electro-mechanical equipment. PHOENIX, ARIZONA, USA

RESPONSIBILTIES

• Read job cards to determine; job status, work authorization/limitations, estimate, description of problems and/or expected serviceability.

• Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).

• Disassemble electro-mechanical equipment noting parts identifications, configuration and condition.

• Clean electro-mechanical equipment assemblies as needed using various methods and steps, including but not limited to: parts washer/steamers, caustic tanks, glass beaders, etc.

• Measure for or note proper replacement parts. Correctly requisition needed items from storekeeper, as approved by supervisor.

• Replace or repair worn or defective mechanical or electro-mechanical assemblies, including but not limited to: bearings, brushes, brush holders, motors leads gears seals, impellers, mechanical switches, brakes clutches, clutch rotors, tachs, fans, end shield,, etc.

• Retest reassembled electro-mechanical equipment for proper output and operation.

• Complete required paperwork for each job accurately and on a timely basis.

• Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed

• Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).

• Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.

• Keep work area neat and clean as directed by supervisor.

• Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.

• Perform other skilled or not-skilled duties as directed by supervisor

QUALIFICATIONS

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Basic mechanical aptitude

• Ability to understand, perform and retain various skill related training and operational and safety procedures demonstrated by supervisor.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

The above is intended to describe the general content of, and requirements for, the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements.

What we offer you

Health insurance
Health savings account
Flexible spending account
Vision insurance
Dental insurance
401(k) 6% match
Paid time off
Paid parental leave
Gym membership
Employee assistance program
Disability insurance
Paid holidays
Wellness program

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• High school diploma or equivalent
• Basic mechanical aptitude
