jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

In dieser Schlüsselrolle verantworten Sie den Vertrieb technisch anspruchsvoller Lösungen im deutschen Markt. Sie betreuen bestehende Kunden, identifizieren neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und begleiten Projekte von der ersten Kundenansprache bis zum Vertragsabschluss. Ihre Aufgaben:

• Verantwortung für den Vertrieb technisch anspruchsvoller Lösungen im deutschen Markt

• Betreuung und Ausbau bestehender Kundenbeziehungen sowie aktive Neukundengewinnung

• Steuerung des gesamten Vertriebsprozesses von der Erstansprache bis zum Vertragsabschluss

• Aufbau und Pflege einer belastbaren Sales-Pipeline inklusive Forecasting und CRM-Management

• Technische und kaufmännische Beratung von Kunden sowie Übersetzung von Anforderungen in passgenaue Lösungen

• Durchführung von Kundenbesuchen, Präsentationen und Produkt- bzw. Lösungsdemonstrationen

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-, Service-, Projektmanagement- und Produktteams

• Unterstützung bei Angebotskalkulationen, technischen Konzepten und Ausschreibungen

• Analyse von Markt‑, Wettbewerbs- und Technologietrends sowie Einbringen von Marktfeedback

• Mitwirkung an Vertriebsplanung, Zieldefinition und strategischen Vertriebsthemen

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (z. B. Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen) oder kaufmännischer Hintergrund mit starker technischer Expertise

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im technischen Vertrieb, idealerweise in Energie, Schwerindustrie, Oil & Gas oder Power Generation

• Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis und Erfahrung im Umgang mit technischen Spezifikationen

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations‑ und Verhandlungsstärke sowie hohe Kundenorientierung

• Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und starke Abschlussorientierung

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

• Hohe Reisebereitschaft innerhalb des Vertriebsgebiets sowie gelegentlich international

What we offer you

• Mitarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld mit enger Zusammenarbeit mit Technik und Engineering

• Attraktives Gesamtpaket mit fixem Gehalt und leistungsbezogenen Bonusanteilen

• Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen Weiterentwicklung und zum Ausbau der eigenen Vertriebsexpertise

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: TSF Supervisor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lead Production Worker / Technician is responsible for coordinating daily production activities, ensuring adherence to safety and quality standards, and supporting the team in achieving operational goals. This role provides technical guidance and hands-on support to production staff while promoting continuous improvement.
This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations. Production Supervisor: TSF Job Description

Location: Margate, FL
Department: Services_AME
Position: Production Supervisor

Company Overview:
Sulzer Rotating Equipment Services (SRES) is an independent provider of services and equipment repairs for the turbomachinery industry. SRES specializes in the repair, overhaul and parts sales of Heavy Industrial Turbines, Aero Gas Turbines, Steam Turbines, Compressors, Pumps, and electromechanical equipment for the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical and Power Generation industries.

Position Summary (TSF)
The Production Supervisor is responsible for overseeing daily shop floor operations to ensure work is performed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with approved scopes, procedures, and quality standards. This role leads technicians and shop personnel, manages production schedules, and ensures all work is completed accurately and on time. The Production Supervisor works closely with Operations, Project Management, and Inventory teams to support execution, safety, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Responsibilities

• Lead and supervise shop employees, ensuring work is performed in compliance with safety policies, SOPs, and quality requirements

• Manage daily shop scheduling, issue work scopes and packets, and ensure all released work is completed per approved scope

• Inspect all work performed and review signoffs, documentation, and assembly records for completeness and accuracy

• Assist in the development and execution of production timelines, supporting delivery commitments and operational priorities

• Coordinate and manage shop resources, including routers, cranes, hoists, equipment, and general housekeeping

• Inspect and manage issued parts, request required materials, and ensure parts are allocated to the correct projects

• Manage employee time, PTO, overtime planning, training needs, and reporting of safety incidents or near misses

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in operations, engineering, business, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered

• 5+ years of progressive experience in operations management, manufacturing, or industrial production environments

• Strong leadership, planning, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities across departments

• Proficiency with ERP systems, reporting tools, and Microsoft Office; experience with quality or safety systems preferred

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Credit and Collection Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Order to Cash (OTC) Credit & Collections Coordinator is responsible for assessing the creditworthiness of current and potential customers and advice on the setup of new customers, managing credit risk, and supporting the overall OTC process in close collaboration with the country Project Managers and Credit Control Managers. Moreover, the professional is responsible for managing and executing the collections process to ensure timely payments from customers, maintaining healthy cash flow and minimizing risk of bad debts. The Credit & Collections Accountant will play a crucial role in maintaining financial stability of the organization by ensuring that receivables are collected in a timely manner.

Key Responsibilities:

• Evaluate customer credit applications using credit scoring models and financial analysis to determine the degree of risk involved in extending the credit

• Analyze new customer and advise on the acceptance/rejection for the setup in the Master Data

• Conduct thorough financial analysis, including reviewing financial statements, credit reports and payment history to set and adjust credit limits

• Monitor and analyze customers’ credit exposures and make recommendations to minimize risk and optimize accounts receivables

• Collaborate closely with the Senior Credit & Collection Accountants, local Project Managers, sales and customer service teams to resolve credit issues and support business growth while managing credit risk as well as to address any disputes or issues that delay payments

• Execute collections strategies to reduce Days of Sales Outstanding (DSO) and improve cash flow

• Engage with customers via phone, email or other communication channels to negotiate timely payments and resolve outstanding receivables

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all credit & collections-related activities, including credit review, limits and terms

• Communicate credit policies and procedures to relevant stakeholders within the organization

• Support the collections process, ensuring timely payments from customers

• Prepare credit & collections reports and risk assessments for management, highlighting trends, potential risks and opportunities for improvement

• Support the OTC and Reporting & Analytics team with the month-end closing activities, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting related to credit and accounts receivable

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance credit processes and systems

• Ensure OTC internal controls are in place in the CoE and followed for the processes performed by this role

Minimum Job Requirements/Skillset:

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in OTC, credit analysis, risk assessment or a similar role

• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is preferred

• Strong understanding of financial analysis, credit scoring, and risk management principles as well as the collection processes

• Proficiency in financial statement analysis and interpreting credit reports

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills

• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala )

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus

What we offer you

• 30 days Christmas Bonus ( Aguinaldo )

• Savings Fund: 8% monthly matching

• Pension Plan & Seniority Recognition

• Major Medical Insurance (Individual)

• Life, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• 12 days of vacation to start with a 50% vacation premium

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offerin

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Il Coordinatore Credit & Collections Order to Cash (OTC) Ã ̈ responsabile della valutazione dell'affidabilitÃ creditizia dei clienti attuali e potenziali e della consulenza sulla configurazione dei nuovi clienti, sulla gestione del rischio di credito e sul supporto del processo OTC complessivo in stretta collaborazione con i Project Manager del paese e i Credit Control Manager. Inoltre, il professionista è responsabile della gestione e dell'esecuzione del processo di raccolta per garantire pagamenti tempestivi da parte dei clienti, mantenendo un flusso di cassa sano e riducendo al minimo il rischio di debiti cattivi. Il Credit & Collections Accountant svolgerà un ruolo cruciale nel mantenere la stabilità finanziaria dell'organizzazione assicurando che i crediti siano raccolti in modo tempestivo.

Responsabilità chiave:

• Valutare le applicazioni di credito del cliente utilizzando modelli di punteggio di credito e analisi finanziaria per determinare il grado di rischio coinvolto nell'estensione del credito

• Analizzare nuovi clienti e consigliare l'accettazione/rigetto per l'installazione nei Dati Master

• Condurre analisi finanziarie approfondite, tra cui la revisione dei bilanci, i rapporti di credito e la cronologia dei pagamenti per impostare e regolare i limiti di credito

• Monitorare e analizzare le esposizioni di credito dei clienti e fare raccomandazioni per minimizzare il rischio e ottimizzare i crediti dei conti

• Collabora a stretto contatto con gli Accountants Senior Credit & Collection, i Project Manager locali, i team di vendita e assistenza clienti per risolvere i problemi di credito e sostenere la crescita aziendale, gestendo i rischi di credito e per affrontare eventuali controversie o problemi che ritardano i pagamenti

• Eseguire le strategie di raccolta per ridurre i giorni di vendite eccezionale (DSO) e migliorare il flusso di cassa

• Impegnarsi con i clienti tramite telefono, e-mail o altri canali di comunicazione per negoziare pagamenti tempestivi e risolvere i crediti in sospeso

• Mantenere registri accurati e aggiornati di tutte le attività relative al credito e alle collezioni, tra cui la revisione del credito, i limiti e i termini

• Comunicare le politiche e le procedure di credito alle parti interessate pertinenti all'interno dell'organizzazione

• Supporta il processo delle collezioni, assicurando pagamenti tempestivi da parte dei clienti

• Preparare rapporti di credito e collezioni e valutazioni dei rischi per la gestione, evidenziando tendenze, potenziali rischi e opportunità di miglioramento

• Sostenere il team OTC e Reporting & Analytics con le attività di chiusura di fine mese, assicurando una reportistica finanziaria accurata e tempestiva relativa al credito e ai conti crediti

• Partecipa a iniziative di miglioramento continuo per migliorare i processi e i sistemi di credito

• Assicurarsi che i controlli interni OTC siano in vigore nel CoE e seguiti per i processi eseguiti da questo ruolo

Requisiti minimi di lavoro/Skillset:

• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale o campo relativo

• Minimo 1-2 anni di esperienza in OTC, analisi del credito, valutazione del rischio o un ruolo simile

• L'esperienza nel settore manifatturiero o industriale è preferita

• Forte comprensione dei principi di analisi finanziaria, di valutazione dei crediti e di gestione dei rischi e dei processi di raccolta

• Competenza nell'analisi del bilancio e nell'interpretazione dei rapporti di credito

• Eccellente analitica, problem solving e competenze decisionali

• Proficiente nei sistemi ERP (rilevante all'unità aziendale; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 o iScala)

• Forte MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) competenze

• Esperienza con Tagetik e Qlik Sense è un plus

Cosa ti offriamo

• 30 giorni Bonus di Natale (Aguinaldo)

• Fondo di risparmio: 8% corrispondenza mensile

• Piano pensione e riconoscimento degli anziani

• Maggiore assicurazione medica (individuo)

• Assicurazione vita, dentale e visione

• 12 giorni di vacanza per iniziare con un premio di vacanza del 50%

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Der Order to Cash (OTC) Credit & Collections Coordinator ist verantwortlich für die Bewertung der Kreditwürdigkeit aktueller und potenzieller Kunden und die Beratung bei der Einrichtung neuer Kunden, dem Management des Kreditrisikos und der Unterstützung des gesamten OTC-Prozesses in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Projektmanagern und Credit Control Managern des Landes. Darüber hinaus ist der Fachmann für die Verwaltung und Durchführung des Inkassoprozesses verantwortlich, um rechtzeitige Zahlungen von Kunden zu gewährleisten, einen gesunden Cashflow aufrechtzuerhalten und das Risiko von Fehlschulden zu minimieren. Der Credit & Collections Accountant wird eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Aufrechterhaltung der finanziellen Stabilität der Organisation spielen, indem er sicherstellt, dass Forderungen rechtzeitig erhoben werden.

Wichtigste Aufgaben:

• Bewerten Sie Kundenkreditanträge mit Kredit-Scoring-Modellen und Finanzanalysen, um den Grad des Risikos bei der Kreditverlängerung zu bestimmen

• Analysieren Sie neue Kunden und beraten Sie bei der Annahme/Ablehnung für die Einrichtung in den Stammdaten

• Durchführung einer gründlichen Finanzanalyse, einschließlich der Überprüfung von Abschlüssen, Kreditberichten und Zahlungshistorie, um Kreditlimits festzulegen und anzupassen

• Überwachen und analysieren Sie die Kreditrisikopositionen von Kunden und geben Sie Empfehlungen zur Minimierung des Risikos und zur Optimierung der Forderungen

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Senior Credit & Collection Accountants, lokalen Projektmanagern, Vertriebs- und Kundenserviceteams, um Kreditprobleme zu lösen und das Geschäftswachstum bei der Verwaltung des Kreditrisikos zu unterstützen sowie Streitigkeiten oder Probleme anzugehen, die Zahlungen verzögern

• Führen Sie Inkassostrategien aus, um Days of Sales Outstanding (DSO) zu reduzieren und den Cashflow zu verbessern

• Engagieren Sie sich mit Kunden über Telefon, E-Mail oder andere Kommunikationskanäle, um rechtzeitige Zahlungen auszuhandeln und offene Forderungen zu lösen

• Pflegen Sie genaue und aktuelle Aufzeichnungen aller Kredit- und Inkassoaktivitäten, einschließlich Kreditprüfung, Limits und Bedingungen

• Kommunikation von Kreditrichtlinien und -verfahren an relevante Stakeholder innerhalb der Organisation

• Unterstützen Sie den Inkassoprozess und gewährleisten Sie rechtzeitige Zahlungen von Kunden

• Erstellung von Kredit- und Inkassoberichten und Risikobewertungen für das Management, wobei Trends, potenzielle Risiken und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten hervorgehoben werden

• Unterstützen Sie das OTC- und Reporting & Analytics-Team bei den Abschlussaktivitäten zum Monatsende und gewährleisten Sie eine genaue und zeitnahe Finanzberichterstattung in Bezug auf Kredit- und Debitorenkonten

• Teilnahme an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen zur Verbesserung der Kreditprozesse und -systeme

• Sicherstellen, dass interne OTC-Kontrollen im CoE vorhanden sind und für die von dieser Rolle durchgeführten Prozesse befolgt werden

Mindestanforderungen an den Arbeitsplatz/Skillset:

• Universitätsabschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Betriebswirtschaft oder verwandten Bereichen

• Mindestens 1-2 Jahre Erfahrung in OTC, Kreditanalyse, Risikobewertung oder einer ähnlichen Rolle

• Erfahrung in der Fertigung oder Industrie wird bevorzugt

• Starkes Verständnis von Finanzanalysen, Kredit-Scoring und Risikomanagement-Prinzipien sowie der Inkassoprozesse

• Kenntnisse in der Bilanzanalyse und Interpretation von Kreditberichten

• Ausgezeichnete analytische, Problemlösungs- und Entscheidungsfähigkeiten

• Proficient in ERP-Systemen (relevant für Ihre Business Unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 oder iScala)

• Starke MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) Fähigkeiten

• Erfahrung mit Tagetik und Qlik Sense ist ein Plus

Was wir Ihnen bieten

• 30 Tage Weihnachtsbonus ( Aguinaldo)

• Sparkasse: 8% monatliches Matching

• Pensionsplan und Altersanerkennung

• Hauptkrankenversicherung (einzeln)

• Life, Dental und Vision Versicherung

• 12 Tage Urlaub, um mit einer 50% Urlaubsprämie zu beginnen

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und engagieren uns für das Angebot
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Le coordonnateur du crédit et des recouvrements de l'Ordre d'encaissement est chargé d'évaluer la solvabilité des clients actuels et potentiels et de fournir des conseils sur la configuration des nouveaux clients, la gestion du risque de crédit et l'appui au processus global de l'OTC en étroite collaboration avec les gestionnaires de projet et de contrôle du crédit du pays. De plus, le professionnel est responsable de la gestion et de l'exécution du processus de recouvrement afin d'assurer le paiement en temps opportun des clients, de maintenir des flux de trésorerie sains et de réduire le risque de créances douteuses. Le comptable des créances et recouvrements jouera un rôle crucial dans le maintien de la stabilité financière de l'organisation en veillant à ce que les créances soient perçues en temps opportun.

Principales responsabilités :

• Évaluer les demandes de crédit à la clientèle à l'aide de modèles de notation et d'analyse financière pour déterminer le degré de risque associé à l'extension du crédit

• Analyser le nouveau client et conseiller sur l'acceptation/rejection de l'installation dans le Master Data

• Effectuer une analyse financière approfondie, notamment en examinant les états financiers, les rapports de crédit et les antécédents de paiement afin de fixer et d'ajuster les limites de crédit

• Surveiller et analyser les expositions de crédit des clients et faire des recommandations pour minimiser les risques et optimiser les comptes débiteurs

• Collaborer étroitement avec les comptables principaux du crédit et de la perception, les gestionnaires de projet locaux, les équipes de vente et de service à la clientèle pour résoudre les problèmes de crédit et soutenir la croissance des entreprises tout en gérant le risque de crédit ainsi que pour régler les différends ou les problèmes qui retardent les paiements

• Exécuter des stratégies de recouvrement pour réduire les jours de vente en circulation et améliorer les flux de trésorerie

• Faire appel aux clients par téléphone, par courriel ou par d'autres moyens de communication pour négocier les paiements en temps opportun et régler les créances impayées

• Tenir des registres précis et à jour de toutes les activités liées au crédit et aux recouvrements, y compris l'examen du crédit, les limites et les modalités

• Communiquer les politiques et les procédures de crédit aux intervenants pertinents de l'organisation

• Soutenir le processus de collecte, en assurant le paiement en temps opportun des clients

• Préparer des rapports de crédit et de recouvrement et des évaluations des risques pour la gestion, en mettant en évidence les tendances, les risques potentiels et les possibilités d'amélioration

• Appuyer l'équipe du CTO et de l'analyse et des rapports dans les activités de clôture de fin de mois, en veillant à ce que les rapports financiers relatifs au crédit et aux comptes débiteurs soient exacts et opportuns

• Participer à des initiatives d'amélioration continue pour améliorer les processus et les systèmes de crédit

• S'assurer que les contrôles internes de l'OTC sont en place dans le Conseil de l'Europe et suivis pour les processus exécutés par ce rôle

Exigences et compétences minimales en matière d'emploi :

• Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe

• Minimum de 1 à 2 ans d'expérience en CTO, en analyse de crédit, en évaluation des risques ou dans un rôle similaire

• L'expérience dans les secteurs manufacturier ou industriel est privilégiée

• Connaissance approfondie des principes d'analyse financière, de notation et de gestion du risque ainsi que des processus de collecte

• Compétence en analyse des états financiers et en interprétation des rapports de crédit

• Excellente capacité d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et de prise de décisions

• Compétence en systèmes ERP (pertinents pour votre unité commerciale; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 ou iScala)

• Fortes compétences de MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint)

• Expérience avec Tagetik et Qlik Sense est un plus

Ce que nous vous offrons

• 30 jours Bonus de Noël ( Aguinaldo )

• Caisse d'épargne : 8 % par mois

• Reconnaissance du régime de retraite et de l'ancienneté

• Assurance maladie majeure (individuelle)

• Assurance vie, soins dentaires et assurance vision

• 12 jours de vacances pour commencer avec une prime de 50 %

Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'une main-d'œuvre diversifiée et sommes résolus à offrir

jobs.title: AP Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a dynamic Accounts Payable Coordinator to join our Finance & Accounting team in Polanco, Mexico. This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with international and external stakeholders, leverage your expertise in accounts payable. If you enjoy creating impact and eager to advance your career within a global and mission-led organization, we want to hear from you! In this position you will be a member of our Accounts Payable Controls team based in our Mexico office. You will work together with an external shared service center who is responsible for master data, invoice processing and payments. Furthermore, you will closely work other country Finance functions, Procurement, and external vendors.

Key Responsibilities

• Independently manage the daily business in accounts payable, in collaboration with the country’s Finance team and the external Shared Service Center

• Manage escalations in incoming accounts payable related queries from suppliers SULZER CONFIDENTIAL

• Review payment proposals and ensure a complete alignment with the country’s compliance requirements.

• Monitor and control accounts payable aging.

• Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements according to IFRS.

• Drive process standardization and reduce inefficiencies, acting as a guide for the shared services teams.

• Actively support various projects, such as system implementations and process optimizations.

Skills & Qualifications

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields

• 4 years of experience in Accounts Payable

• Very good written and verbal communication skills

• Knowledge of ERP systems (preferable SAP or D365)

• Fluent English skills

• Analytical and problem-solving skills

What we offer you

• 30 days Christmas Bonus ( Aguinaldo )

• Savings Fund: 8% monthly matching

• Pension Plan & Seniority Recognition

• Major Medical Insurance (Individual)

• Life, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• 12 days of vacation to start with a 50% vacation premium

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Lead Repair Engineer
Business Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Controller is responsible for supporting the financial integrity of the organization through accurate reporting, compliance, and internal controls. This role involves preparing financial statements, assisting with audits, and ensuring adherence to accounting standards and policies.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. The Business Controller will serve as the primary financial liaison between local manufacturing operations and the Center of Excellence (CoE), ensuring seamless coordination and effective execution of key
financial and project management activities. Also ensure seamless coordination and effective execution of key financial processes.

Key responsibilities:

• Ensure accurate tracking and management of sales and backlogs

• Monitor customer order contract profitability and utilization metrics

• Link strategic plans to operational and financial drivers, aligning sales and operations planning, resource management, capital projects, other expenses, and working capital planning.

• Generate, model, and execute action plans to address performance gaps and improve overall site performance

• Provide business planning, forecasting, and budgeting know how and support to the relevant stakeholders

• Supervision and coordination of tasks with the Coe & BPO team.

• Variance analysis

• Responsible for managing internal reports.

• Support to the Head Office on financial matters.

What you need you to succeed:

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in Controlling

• Proven track record in inventory management, cost control, and project management

• Experience within the manufacturing sectors is preferred

• Strong Knowledge of cost controlling, budgeting, and financial planning

• Excellent communication skills to liaise between local operations, BPO and CoE

• Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams

• Capacity to remain flexible and effective when facing challenges

• Continuous improvement mindset

• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Understanding of integrated ERP systems is a plus

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Used to work with databases and reporting tools

• Proficiency in English (C1)

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package (e.g. health insurance, transport, childcare)

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A Good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.

• Offices location: Rivas (Madrid)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Record to Report accountant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. This role ensures accuracy in financial records and supports compliance with accounting standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. The RTR Senior Accountant in the Center of Excellence (CoE) works in a RTR team assigned to multiple countries, supporting the Record to Report (RTR) teams for example with various ad hoc tasks, complex bookings, or the maintenance of the chart of accounts.

Key responsibilities

• Serve as a member of the RTR team in the CoE, providing support on ad hoc topics and accounting issues

• Support with financial booking activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations

• Manage clearing, including reconciliations and adjustments, to maintain accurate financial records

• Utilize advanced knowledge of ERP systems to streamline accounting processes

• Support the Global Process Owner (GPO) with system implementations

• Maintain and update the chart of accounts and hierarchies, ensuring it reflects the current business structure and reporting requirements

• Collaborate closely with local Finance Teams in countries and Finance Shared Services teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider

• Coordinate with other departments and the Finance Shared Services teams to ensure all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger

• Supports the period end close, including closing the accounts receivable/payable subledger and reconcile with the general ledger; close general ledger, open new financial period, close Asset Accounting (AA)

• Support with the preparation of journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the RTR process, leveraging technology and best practices; maintain policies, procedures and templates

• Ensure financial internal controls are in place and followed for the processes performed by this role

• Do all technical Year End Closing activities such as balance carry forward, number range creations, close of AA

• Support Intercompany reconciliation process in Coprocess and Tagetik (fix variances)

Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in Accounting with a strong focus on general ledger and financial reporting

• CPA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent certification preferred

Critical success factors

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and management skills

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and integrity in financial reporting

• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment

• Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to senior leadership

Technical & language skills

• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala) and accounting software

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Experience with Tagetik, Coprocess and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Proficiency in English

Interfaces with

• Accounting teams

• Reporting & Analytics team

• Local Accounting Managers

• Country Finance Heads

• RTR GPO

• External stakeholders (i.e. auditors, tax authorities etc.)

What we offer you

Medical insurance for self and family
Company sponsored transportation facility during week days

jobs.title: ServiceNow Development Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de file du développement ServiceNow

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is transforming its IT operating model to better meet business needs and achieve operational excellence. The ServiceNow Development Lead is a key role within the IT Service Management function, responsible for the technical leadership, governance, and delivery of development activities on the ServiceNow platform.

The role ensures that ServiceNow solutions are designed and built in a scalable, secure, and upgrade‑safe manner, aligned with platform strategy, enterprise architecture, and business priorities. Acting as the technical lead for ServiceNow development, the incumbent provides hands‑on expertise, sets development standards, mentors internal developers, and ensures high‑quality delivery across ITSM and other ServiceNow capabilities. Main Tasks and Responsibilities

• Provide technical leadership and end to end ownership of ServiceNow development activities across the platform. ‑to‑end ownership of ServiceNow development activities across the platform.

• Translate functional and business requirements into robust technical designs, ensuring alignment with ServiceNow best practices and platform strategy.

• Define, implement, and enforce development standards, guidelines, and guardrails (coding standards, scoped applications, update set management, CI/CD, documentation).

• Lead solution design for ServiceNow customizations, configurations, integrations, and automation, ensuring upgrade safety and long-term maintainability. ‑term maintainability.

• Act as the technical authority for ServiceNow development, performing design and code reviews to ensure quality and consistency.

• Guide and mentor internal ServiceNow developers and administrators, supporting capability building and knowledge sharing.

• Coordinate and oversee development work delivered by external partners, ensuring adherence to Sulzer standards and quality expectations.

• Collaborate closely with ServiceNow platform owners, product owners, process owners, architects, and ITSM stakeholders.

• Ensure effective use of ServiceNow platform capabilities, promoting “configuration over customization” and reuse of standard functionality.

• Own the technical lifecycle of developments across environments (development, test, production), supporting release and deployment activities.

• Support integration design and implementation (REST, APIs, middleware, MID Server), ensuring reliable and secure data exchange.

• Monitor and continuously improve platform performance, stability, and technical debt.

• Maintain technical documentation, design artefacts, and development of runbooks.

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, automation, and innovation across IT Service Management and adjacent domains.

To Succeed in This Role, You Will Need:

• 5+ years of hands-on experience with ServiceNow development in large, complex enterprise environments. ‑on experience with ServiceNow development in large, complex enterprise environments.

• ServiceNow certifications (e.g., Certified System Administrator, Certified Application Developer, CIS certifications).

• Proven experience in a technical lead or senior developer role, guiding development teams and delivery (internal and external).

• Strong expertise in ServiceNow development and configuration, including:

• JavaScript (server‑side and client‑side)

• Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, Client Scripts

• Flow Designer and IntegrationHub

• Service Portal / UI Builder

• ACLs, data policies, and security model

• PowerShell scripting

• Solid experience with ServiceNow ITSM, CSM, SPM; exposure to additional modules (ITOM, ITAM, HRSD) is an advantage.

• Experience designing and managing integrations using REST/SOAP APIs and MID Servers.

• Strong understanding of Servi

jobs.description:

About the role

The IT Jr. Support is responsible for performing basic IT support tasks such as setting up equipment, assisting users, and following standard procedures. This role works under supervision and supports routine IT operations. This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration.
Key Responsibilities

• Assist with hardware and software setup and configuration.

• Provide basic technical support to users.

• Follow standard procedures for troubleshooting and issue resolution.

• Maintain IT equipment and workspace organization.

• Escalate issues to senior support staff as needed.

• Skills & Qualifications

• May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and the ability to carry out assigned tasks after initial instruction or demonstration.

Qualifications

• Basic understanding of IT hardware and software.

• Willingness to learn and follow instructions.

• Good communication and teamwork skills.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Office is a plus.

A requirement is that you will register yourself for the BBL program "ICT Support Technician" or "ICT system engineer" in Nijmegen (ROC), Arnhem (Rijn IJssel), or Breda (Curio). You attend school one day a week and work four days at our company.
Minimum B1 Dutch language level is required.

What we offer you

• 8% holiday allowance and up to 40 days of annual leave

• A solid pension scheme with attractive employer contribution

• Travel allowance for commuting (EUR 0.23/km, tax-free)

jobs.title: Field Service Technician Pumps (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As a Field Service Technician, you will be responsible for the installation, commissioning, maintenance and repair of pump systems both at customer sites and in the workshop. Working in a hands-on environment, you will ensure reliable operation of equipment, support troubleshooting activities and contribute to high service quality and customer satisfaction. This role requires a practical mindset, technical expertise and a strong commitment to safety, as well as the flexibility to work across different locations and applications.
Key Responsibilities

• Installation, commissioning, maintenance and repair of pumps and associated equipment at customer sites as well as in the workshop

• Disassembly, inspection and reassembly of machinery based on defined work scopes or independently in case of unplanned repairs or troubleshooting

• Execution of work in line with specified tolerances and manufacturer guidelines or established engineering standards

• Performing safety assessments at the worksite (e.g. when changing activities)

• On-site activities including coordination and supervision of customer-provided personnel when required

• Preparation of service and repair reports as well as required documentation after completion of work

• Ensuring compliance with health, safety and environmental standards – both internally and at customer sites

Your Profile

• Experience in installation, commissioning and maintenance of pumps and associated equipment

• Hands-on experience in assembly, repair and testing of machinery – ideally also in a workshop environment

• Good command of English and confident use of common IT tools

• Independent, structured and solution-oriented way of working

• Strong customer and service orientation

• Flexible and adaptable with willingness to travel

• Team player with good communication skills and a confident presence on site

• Ideally VCA certification and initial experience in supervising or guiding others

What we offer you

• 8% holiday allowance and up to 40 days of annual leave

• A solid pension scheme with attractive employer contribution

• Travel allowance for commuting (EUR 0.23/km, tax-free)

• Free coffee, tea and water , plus access to an on-site canteen with fresh and affordable meals

jobs.title: Senior Project Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Driven by growth in the FRC business, this role provides focused project delivery, improves cross-functional coordination, and protects margins across advanced turnkey projects ($1M–$5M) . Operating from our Cumming, GA facility, the Senior Project Engineer serves as the technical execution hub—collaborating with Mechanical Design, Electrical, and Project Engineering departments to combine resources and deliver complete industrial process systems on time and within budget .

Key Responsibilities:

• Synchronize workflows across mechanical design, electrical, and project engineering teams to efficiently output complex systems.

• Travel 30%–40% nationwide to supervise on-site installation work and assist with system commissioning and startup efforts.

• Review, interpret, and resolve discrepancies across technical specifications, customer layout drawings, orders, and P&IDs.

• Prepare engineering submittal documentation and directly address or rectify consulting engineer comments.

• Size, select, and generate purchase requisitions for system components including pumps, piping, tanks, and dosing equipment.

• Maintain sharp cost control, prepare project change orders, review vendor quotes, and negotiate with suppliers.

• Inspect fabricated equipment at manufacturing subcontractor facilities and record strict quality control documentation.

• Maintain close client communication regarding order status and support the sales process by answering technical engineering questions.

Skills & Qualifications
Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Process, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering (or 15 years of equivalent hands-on engineering experience).

• 6 to 10+ years of progressive project engineering and management experience, specifically within the industrial water and wastewater fields.

• High proficiency in reading P&IDs, checking layout drawings, and working within AutoCAD and standard office suites (Excel/Word).

• Legally authorized to work in the US with the flexibility to travel nationwide 30%–40% of the time

• Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects, make quick decisions under pressure, and manage costs against budgets.

Preferred Assets:

• Active PMP certification or Professional Engineer (PE) license.

• Prior experience with wastewater OEM technologies, industrial fluid handling, or onshore/offshore oil and gas process equipment.

• Familiarity with components like Dissolved Air Flotation (DAF) systems, mixers, biological systems, and valves.

• Existing OSHA 30 or OSHA 40 safety certifications (training provided as needed).

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanical Designer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Mechanical Designer - Full Time - Whitby, Canada

At Sulzer, you are empowered to deliver superior results. As a pioneer in industry, we have a proud heritage of innovation and continue to evolve for the future. Join our story and create your own impact by developing your expertise and building solutions that help make our lives safer, smarter and more sustainable.

Join our FRC team within the Sulzer Pumps division of Sulzer Canada as a Mechanical Designer to help us take FRC to the next level.

Job Description

In this role you will be accountable for:

• Modeling 3D layouts and creating drawing sets for installation and construction of our equipment and products using SolidWorks as well as AutoCAD

• Preparing design concepts, sketches, or models of our equipment for approval

• Consulting with engineers and production staff during manufacturing stage

• Assisting the Applications Team to generate sales equipment and layout drawings

• Preparing and interpreting engineering designs, drawings and specifications as they pertain to our equipment or layouts

• Other duties and special projects as assigned
​
To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Experience with SolidWorks, SolidWorks PDM or a related software package

• Knowledge of SolidWorks modeling, sheet metal design and pipe routing

• Familiarity with data management and revision control

• Proficiency in MS Office (formulas, formatting, Outlook)

• Experience in sheet metal design would be an asset

• Experience with welding would be an asset

• Experience using Autodesk Revit for draft and pre-construction drawings would be an asset

• Knowledge of waste management, or water treatment equipment/industry would be an asset

• Willingness to take occasional criminal record/drug tests for US clients

​If you possess a post-secondary degree or diploma in mechanical engineering, mechanical engineering technology/technician, drafting, mechanical design or similar discipline, take the next step and make the most of your design skills.

Location: We are based in Whitby, ON, with easy access to Highway 401.
Required: Valid Canadian passport and ability to travel to the US.

What we offer you

• Health and dental benefits

• Employee Assistance Program

• Defined contribution pension plan

• Vacation: 15 days upon completion of 1 year of service, increasing per vacation accrual schedule

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer, committed to the strength of a diverse workforce.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant RTR
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a/an Senior accountant (RTR) to join our Accounting team in Spain to help us take our Record to Report (RTR) area to the next level. As a Senior accountant, you will collaborate with multiple countries and engage with a diverse array of areas stakeholders, including Accounting, Reporting, Analytics, Country Finance Heads, Global Process Owners (GPOs), and external parties such as auditors and tax authorities. Key Responsabilities:

• Serve as a key member of the RTR team in the CoE, providing expert support on ad hoc topics and complex accounting issues

• Support with complicated financial booking activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations

• Manage complex clearing, including reconciliations and adjustments, to maintain accurate financial records

• Utilize advanced knowledge of ERP systems to streamline accounting processes and improve efficiency

• Support the Global Process Owner (GPO) with the definition of RTR processes and system implementation

• Oversees and governs the chart of accounts and hierarchies, ensuring it reflects the current business structure and reporting requirements

• Collaborate closely with local Finance Teams in countries and Finance Shared Services teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider

• Coordinate with other departments and the Finance Shared Services teams to ensure all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger

• Support where required with the period end close, including closing the accounts receivable/payable subledger and reconcile with the general ledger; close general ledger, open new financial period, close Asset Accounting (AA)

• Support with the preparation of complex journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis to solve discrepancies

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the RTR process, leveraging technology and best practices; maintain policies, procedures and templates

• Ensure financial internal controls are in place and followed for the processes performed by this role

• Provide documentation and explanations for internal and external audits

• Do all technical Year End Closing activities such as balance carry forward, number range creations, close of AA

• Support Intercompany reconciliation process in Coprocess and Tagetik (fix variances)

Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 4-5 years of experience in Accounting with a strong focus on general ledger and financial reporting

• CPA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent certification preferred

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and management skills

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and integrity in financial reporting

• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment

• Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to senior leadership

• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala) and accounting software

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Experience with Tagetik, Coprocess and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Proficiency in English. French is a big plus

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant tickets.

• Be part of an experienced, international team.

• A good vib

jobs.title: Master Scheduler
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer’s Leeds facility is a global centre of excellence for advanced design and manufacturing, delivering OEM pump technology and engineered solutions for critical industries including energy, water, chemicals and infrastructure. Following significant recent investment, the site is rapidly evolving, strengthening capabilities in advanced machining, digital engineering, testing and innovation—and serves as an end-to-end hub where new pumps are brought to life from concept and design through to manufacture, testing, delivery and full lifecycle support.. The Role

The Master Scheduler reports to the Planning & Scheduling Manager and is responsible for driving pre-production readiness across the Leeds site. You’ll own the master production schedule, coordinating materials, labour, subcontractors and capacity ahead of manufacturing to ensure everything is in place for efficient execution. Acting as the central link between engineering, procurement, project management and operations, you’ll ensure plans are realistic, aligned and deliverable, setting projects up for the successful delivery of complex, engineer-to-order pump packages.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop, maintain, and optimise the master production schedule across engineer-to-order pump packages

• Coordinate pre-production planning including materials, labour, subcontract services, and capacity

• Ensure alignment between demand, project timelines, and manufacturing capability

• Work closely with procurement to ensure material availability supports schedule requirements

• Identify and manage constraints, risks, and bottlenecks within the production plan

• Provide clear visibility of schedules, priorities, and delivery risks to stakeholders

• Monitor schedule adherence and drive continuous improvement in planning performance

• Support on-time, in-full delivery through effective cross-functional coordination

About You

• Proven experience in a master scheduling, production planning, or supply chain role within an engineering or manufacturing environment

• Strong understanding of MRP/ERP systems and scheduling best practices, with SAP experience preferred

• Experience working in a project-based or engineer-to-order environment is beneficial

• Ability to balance competing priorities and manage complex schedules

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• Proactive, analytical approach with strong problem-solving capability

• Experience within heavy engineering, rotating equipment, or similar industries is desirable

What we offer you

We’ve recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds facility — creating a brighter, more efficient, and more advanced workspace designed to support high‑quality work and a great employee experience. Alongside our upgraded facilities, you’ll benefit from:

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• A company-wide bonus scheme

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (covering everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services)

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & pr

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As an HR Specialist, you will be involved in employee lifecycle administration, HR compliance, recruitment, and broader HR initiatives. This is an excellent opportunity for an HR professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and is eager to contribute to a culture of excellence and engagement.

Key Responsibilities

• Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases, ensuring compliance with company policies and legal requirements.

• Support HR projects and initiatives, such as performance management cycles, training activities, and employee engagement programs.

• Ensure full compliance with French labor legislation and internal HR standards.

• Assist with end-to-end recruitment and onboarding, including posting job ads, screening CVs, coordinating interviews, and preparing new hire documentation.

• Respond to employee queries related to HR policies, procedures, and benefits.

• Prepare HR reports and analyze workforce data to identify trends and propose improvements.

• Assist with payroll preparation and related administrative processes.

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Minimum of 2 years’ experience in an HR generalist or specialist role, ideally within an industrial or manufacturing environment.

• Strong understanding of Moroccan labor law and HR best practices.

• Proficiency in HRIS systems (e.g., Workday) and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong interpersonal abilities.

• High level of professionalism and the ability to manage confidential information with discretion.

• Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

• Fluency in French and English is required.

What we offer you

• Collaborative and supportive work environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.

• Competitive salary package with attractive benefits: EID allowance (“prime mouton”), Meal allowance , Retirement contribution

• Healthcare coverage

• Exciting opportunities for professional growth and advancement in a dynamic and evolving industry.

• Potential to increase the contract to full time

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Electrical Engineer is responsible for designing and developing mechanical systems and components. This role applies engineering knowledge to support the planning, testing, and implementation of mechanical and electromechanical systems.The individual with this position will have to split their time in-between the engineering team objectives, field service, field service reports and shop engineering support. This engineering position will entail a dual role with hands-on-responsibilities along with other engineering tasks. It is expected that the individual will need training as part of on-boarding process and Sulzer will accommodate. Key Responsibilities

• Provide technical support and assistance on customer requests - on phone and on site.

• Carry out unplanned on-site services and troubleshooting on electrical installation incl. electrical rotating equipment (motors and generators).

• Prepare and perform planned preventive maintenance checks (PM) on electrical machines incl. AC/DC motors and generators, using applicable tools.

• Receive and study any relevant engineering documents related to a project to formulate project roadmaps.

• Observe, follow and support all Safety Policies, Environmental Policies and ISO Procedures

• Manages and oversees tasks as assigned by O.L.s.

• Responsible for developing innovative processes and procedures using the latest technologies to support business growth.

• Attend weekly production meetings.

• Help develop field service procedures for various fault case scenarios.

• Maintain accurate and up to date notes of the projects FSE is involved and furnish reports as required immediately after the conclusion of the project or as requested by the customer.

• Communicate with the O.L.s, and field service team members, as necessary regarding the progress of a project.

• Immediately follow up on customer requests by doing the need-full to resolve the issue in the most efficient way possible.

• Be part of the quick response team, to provide service/updates to the customers as soon as possible.

• Stay in constant communication with O.L. to be able to assist in shop projects as required .

• To learn repair procedures which may be task specific from the Senior Colleagues and implement and improve on it.

• To communicate to the team as required regarding customer specific directives on milestones to be achieved in a course of the project.

• Must be enthusiastic to cross the boundaries of current technical expertise to learn more.

• Role will involve travel to customer sites for diagnosis and repair.

Qualifications:

• 4 years' experience in the following field of electrical engineering.

• Electric motor, generators repairs and design.

• Transformer repair and design

• Switch gear design and diagnostics

• Power Semiconductors

• Proficient in basic power theory,

• Know how in the following topics

• Operations of induction motors

• Operations of synchronous motors

• Transformer principle

• Operation of semiconductors.

• Winding Insulation Tests

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sintesi del lavoro L'ingegnere elettrico è responsabile della progettazione e dello sviluppo di sistemi e componenti meccanici. Questo ruolo applica conoscenze ingegneristiche per supportare la pianificazione, il test e l'implementazione di sistemi meccanici ed elettromeccanici. L'individuo con questa posizione dovrà dividere il loro tempo tra gli obiettivi del team di ingegneria, il servizio sul campo, i rapporti di servizio sul campo e il supporto tecnico del negozio. Questa posizione ingegneristica comporterà un duplice ruolo con responsabilità pratiche e altri compiti di ingegneria. Si prevede che l'individuo avrà bisogno di formazione come parte del processo di on-boarding e Sulzer accoglierà. Principali responsabilità
• Fornire assistenza tecnica e assistenza sulle richieste dei clienti - al telefono e sul sito.
• Eseguire i servizi in loco non pianificati e la risoluzione dei problemi sull'installazione elettrica incl. apparecchiature elettriche rotanti (motori e generatori).
• Preparare ed eseguire controlli preventivi previsti (PM) sulle macchine elettriche incl. Motori e generatori AC/DC, utilizzando strumenti applicabili.
• Ricevere e studiare tutti i documenti di ingegneria rilevanti relativi a un progetto per formulare roadmap di progetto.
• Osservare, seguire e sostenere tutte le politiche di sicurezza, le politiche ambientali e le procedure ISO
• Gestisce e supervisiona le attività assegnate da O.L.s.
• Responsabile per lo sviluppo di processi e procedure innovative utilizzando le più recenti tecnologie per sostenere la crescita aziendale.
• Partecipare a riunioni settimanali di produzione.
• Aiutare a sviluppare procedure di servizio sul campo per vari scenari di caso di guasto.
• Mantenere note accurate e aggiornate dei progetti FSE è coinvolto e fornire report come richiesto subito dopo la conclusione del progetto o come richiesto dal cliente.
• Comunicare con gli O.L. e i membri del team di assistenza sul campo, se necessario per quanto riguarda il progresso di un progetto.
• Seguire immediatamente le richieste dei clienti facendo il necessario per risolvere il problema nel modo più efficiente possibile.
• Partecipa al team di risposta rapida, per fornire assistenza/aggiornamento ai clienti il prima possibile.
• Rimanere in costante comunicazione con O.L. per essere in grado di assistere in progetti di negozio come richiesto .
• Per imparare le procedure di riparazione che possono essere attività specifiche dai Colleghi Senior e implementare e migliorare su di esso.
• comunicare al team come richiesto per quanto riguarda le direttive specifiche del cliente sulle pietre miliari da raggiungere in un corso del progetto.
• Deve essere entusiasta di attraversare i confini delle attuali competenze tecniche per saperne di più.
• Role coinvolgerà il viaggio ai siti dei clienti per la diagnosi e la riparazione. Qualifiche:
• 4 anni di esperienza nel campo seguente dell'ingegneria elettrica.
• Motore elettrico, riparazioni di generatori e progettazione.
• riparazione e progettazione del trasformatore
• Progettazione e diagnostica di ingranaggi commutatori
• Semiconduttori di potenza
• Proficiente nella teoria del potere di base,
• Sapere come nei seguenti argomenti
• Operazioni di motori ad induzione
• Operazioni di motori sincroni
• Principio del trasformatore
• Operazione di semiconduttori.
• Test di isolamento dell'avvolgimento Cosa ti offriamo
• 15 giorni di riposo e 12 giorni festivi
• Piano 401k con partita del 6%
• Piano sanitario completo tra cui medico, dentale, visione, vita, disabilità a breve e a lungo termine
• Conto di risparmio sanitario corrispondente

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Stellenbeschreibung Der Elektroingenieur ist für das Entwerfen und Entwickeln mechanischer Systeme und Komponenten verantwortlich. Diese Rolle wendet Ingenieurwissen an, um die Planung, Erprobung und Implementierung mechanischer und elektromechanischer Systeme zu unterstützen. Die Person mit dieser Position muss ihre Zeit zwischen den Zielen des Ingenieurteams, dem Außendienst, den Außendienstberichten und dem Support für die Werkstatt aufteilen. Diese Engineering-Position wird eine Doppelrolle mit praktischen Verantwortlichkeiten zusammen mit anderen Engineering-Aufgaben beinhalten. Es wird erwartet, dass der Einzelne im Rahmen des On-Boarding-Prozesses eine Schulung benötigt und Sulzer wird dies berücksichtigen. Hauptzuständigkeiten
• Bieten Sie technischen Support und Unterstützung bei Kundenanfragen - telefonisch und vor Ort.
• Durchführung ungeplanter Vor-Ort-Services und Fehlerbehebung bei der Elektroinstallation inkl. elektrische Drehvorrichtungen (Motoren und Generatoren).
• Vorbereitung und Durchführung geplanter vorbeugender Wartungskontrollen (PM) an elektrischen Maschinen inkl. Wechselstrom-/Gleichstrommotoren und -generatoren unter Verwendung geeigneter Werkzeuge.
• Erhalten und studieren Sie alle relevanten technischen Dokumente im Zusammenhang mit einem Projekt, um Projekt-Roadmaps zu formulieren.
• Befolgen, Befolgen und Unterstützen aller Sicherheitsrichtlinien, Umweltrichtlinien und ISO-Verfahren
• Verwaltet und überwacht die von O.L.s. zugewiesenen Aufgaben.
• Verantwortlich für die Entwicklung innovativer Prozesse und Verfahren mit den neuesten Technologien zur Unterstützung des Geschäftswachstums.
• Nehmen Sie an wöchentlichen Produktionstreffen teil.
• Hilfe bei der Entwicklung von Felddienstverfahren für verschiedene Fehlerfallszenarien.
• Bewahren Sie genaue und aktuelle Notizen zu den Projekten auf, an denen FSE beteiligt ist, und erstellen Sie Berichte, die unmittelbar nach Abschluss des Projekts oder auf Wunsch des Kunden erforderlich sind.
• Kommunizieren Sie mit den O.L.s und den Mitgliedern des Außendienstes, wenn dies für den Fortschritt eines Projekts erforderlich ist.
• Folgen Sie sofort den Kundenanfragen, indem Sie das Bedürfnis erfüllen, um das Problem so effizient wie möglich zu lösen.
• Werden Sie Teil des Quick-Response-Teams, um den Kunden so schnell wie möglich Service / Updates zur Verfügung zu stellen.

Ce rôle s'appuie sur les connaissances techniques pour appuyer la planification, les essais et la mise en oeuvre de systèmes mécaniques et électromécaniques. La personne qui occupera ce poste devra répartir son temps entre les objectifs de l'équipe d'ingénierie, le service sur le terrain, les rapports de service sur le terrain et le soutien technique. Ce poste d'ingénieur aura un double rôle avec des responsabilités pratiques et d'autres tâches d'ingénieur. On s'attend à ce que la personne ait besoin d'une formation dans le cadre du processus d'embarquement et que Sulzer s'y accommode. Principales responsabilités
• Fournir un soutien technique et une assistance sur demande des clients - par téléphone et sur place.
• Effectuer des services non planifiés sur place et dépanner les installations électriques, y compris équipements rotatifs électriques (moteurs et génératrices).
• Préparer et effectuer les contrôles d'entretien préventifs prévus (PM) sur les machines électriques, y compris Moteurs et générateurs AC/DC, utilisant les outils applicables.
• Recevoir et étudier tout document d'ingénierie pertinent relatif à un projet pour formuler des feuilles de route du projet.
• Observer, suivre et soutenir toutes les politiques de sécurité, politiques environnementales et procédures ISO
• Gérer et superviser les tâches assignées par les O.L.
• Responsable du développement de processus et de procédures innovants utilisant les dernières technologies pour soutenir la croissance des entreprises.
• Assister à des réunions hebdomadaires de production.
• Aider à élaborer des procédures de service sur le terrain pour divers scénarios de défaillance.
• Tenir à jour des notes précises des projets et fournir les rapports requis immédiatement après la fin du projet ou à la demande du client.
• Communiquer avec les O.L. et les membres de l'équipe de service sur le terrain, au besoin, au sujet de l'avancement d'un projet.
• Suivi immédiat des demandes des clients en faisant le nécessaire pour résoudre le problème de la manière la plus efficace possible.
• Faites partie de l'équipe de réponse rapide, pour fournir le service/mise à jour aux clients dès que possible.
• Restez en communication constante avec O.L. pour être en mesure d'assister dans les projets de magasin au besoin.
• Apprendre les procédures de réparation qui peuvent être spécifiques à la tâche des collègues supérieurs et mettre en œuvre et améliorer celle-ci.
• Communiquer à l'équipe, selon les besoins, les directives spécifiques du client sur les étapes à franchir dans le cadre du projet.

• Fonctionnement des moteurs à induction
• Fonctionnement des moteurs synchrones

• Fonctionnement des semi-conducteurs.

jobs.title: Strategic Initiatives - Senior Executive
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Quality Specialist is responsible for managing quality-related projects and processes with limited supervision. This includes coaching junior professionals, conducting investigations, and ensuring compliance with quality standards.
This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Purpose of the job

To design, integrate, and sustain long‑term capability health across Sales and Operations by creating end‑to‑end capability systems that enable consistent performance, adaptability, and future growth.

This role is accountable for architecting (not just executing) frameworks for assessment, development, transition, and continuous improvement—grounded in real operational and commercial work and scalable across the region.

Main tasks and responsibilities
1. Capability Architecture & Design

• Design role‑based capability frameworks across Sales and Operations, including:
• Core capabilities

• Proficiency levels

• Observable behaviors and outcomes

• Ensure frameworks support progression and knowledge transfer over time.
2. Assessment & Diagnostic Frameworks

• Design practical, credible assessment approaches that reflect real job performance

• Ensure assessment outputs inform development priorities, role readiness, and transitions
3. Learning & Enablement Architecture

• Design learning journeys and enablement models that support capability progression, not just content delivery

• Define the right balance of on‑the‑job learning, coaching, and formal training
4. Transition & Progression Design
Design readiness and transition criteria for role changes, increased complexity, and leadership pathways.
5. Sales Excellence & Commercial Capability

• Apply capability design principles to Sales Excellence topics, including:
• Sales capability models aligned to growth vectors

• Enablement of value‑based and solution selling

• Sales manager coaching capability

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• BSc degree in Engineering, Technical Education, HR Development, or related field

• Having Minimum 5-8 years experience in technical training or competency development.

• Experience in implementing competency frameworks and managing trainer networks.

• Experience in consulting, business transformation, strategy

Competencies and Behavior required

• Performance management system operation

• Passion for workforce development and technical excellence.

• Analytical mindset with attention to detail in assessment and reporting.

• Ability to work across cultures and regions with adaptability.

• Familiarity with apprenticeship models and vocational education systems.

• Thinks in end‑to‑end systems, not isolated initiatives

• Comfortable designing frameworks that evolve over time Stakeholder management

What we offer you

.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
