jobs.title: Tendering Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility:

• Overall responsibility to ensure that initiated projects meet company requirements in terms of selection, pricing, terms and conditions and lead time. Ensure application of Sulzer tools and policies, procedures, codes of conduct and best practice guidelines

• Review inquiry documents/specifications and prepares quality quotations on time for Sulzer Pumps' products using current tendering tools & procedures independently or with guidance

• Analyzing customer requirements, particularly of complex applications and products for relevant market / application

• Independent development of suitable technical solutions with the involvement of specialist departments

• Consulting customers and the sales team on possible pump applications and in preparation of specifications, Configuration of pumps and accessories

• Enquiry and evaluation of subcontractor offers as well as corresponding expediting

• Co-operation with the plants in the Energy & Infrastructure Business Unit factory network

• Analysis and evaluation of commercial as well as technical risks of projects at the bidding stage, corresponding negotiations together with specialist departments as well as development of approaches to minimize risks in the event of an order

• Preparation and realization of presentations of technical offers

• Indirect management & co-ordination with multidisciplinary functions as part of the bid preparation

• Preparation of high-quality technical/commercial offers in line with market requirements

• Review quote received and challenge as necessary internal as well as external stakeholders to ensure a competitive proposal is submitted meeting Sales / market expectation

• Familiar with the risks and hazards within the activities and processes of the role and procedures, practices, and measures in place to mitigate the risks.

• Participation in sales negotiations, corresponding preparation, and follow-up in co-operation with sales department

• Attend clarification meetings with clients as required and provide all necessary support to Sales to ensure the offered solution meets specification/customer requirement while highlighting our competitive advantage

• Leading technical negotiations with subcontractors

• Ensuring a complete and successful order handover to project team

• Regular maintenance of our sales systems and the data contained therein

Work experience : >5 years
Expertise (e.g. professional, technical):

• Successfully completed technical studies (ideally mechanical engineering, industrial engineering or process engineering or equal)

• Structured way of working, ability to break down complex issues together with the bid team

• Experience in at least one of the following disciplines: pump design, international tender or sales, project management or equivalent

• Ideally intercultural competences

• Sound knowledge of pumps or rotating equipment and accessories

What we offer you

Medical insurance for self and family
Company sponsored transportation facility during week days

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Empl

Garantire l'applicazione degli strumenti e delle politiche del Sulzer, delle procedure, dei codici di condotta e delle linee guida sulle migliori pratiche - Rivedere documenti/specifiche di ricerca e preparare preventivi di qualità in tempo utile per i prodotti delle pompe del Sulzer utilizzando strumenti e procedure di gara in corso indipendentemente o con orientamento - Analisi delle esigenze dei clienti, in particolare delle applicazioni complesse e dei prodotti per il mercato/applicazione rilevanti - Sviluppo indipendente di soluzioni tecniche adeguate con il coinvolgimento di reparti specializzati - Cooperazione con gli impianti della rete di fabbrica Energy & Infrastructure Business Unit - Analisi e valutazione dei rischi commerciali e tecnici dei progetti in fase di offerta, corrispondenti trattative con i servizi specializzati e sviluppo di approcci per minimizzare i rischi in caso di ordine - Preparazione e realizzazione di presentazioni di offerte tecniche - Gestione indiretta e coordinamento con funzioni multidisciplinari nell'ambito della preparazione dell'offerta - Preparazione di offerte tecniche/commerciali di alta qualità in linea con le esigenze del mercato - Rivedere le quotazioni ricevute e sfidare, se necessario, sia gli stakeholder interni che esterni per garantire che una proposta competitiva sia presentata soddisfando le vendite/previsioni del mercato - Familiar con i rischi e i rischi all'interno delle attività e dei processi del ruolo e delle procedure, delle pratiche e delle misure in atto per mitigare i rischi. - Partecipazione a trattative commerciali, preparazione corrispondente e follow-up in collaborazione con il reparto vendite - incontri di chiarimento del campo di competenza con i clienti, se necessario, e fornire tutto il supporto necessario alle vendite per garantire che la soluzione offerta soddisfi le specifiche/il requisito del cliente, evidenziando il nostro vantaggio competitivo - Leading trattative tecniche con subappaltatori - Garantire un trasferimento di ordine completo e riuscito al team di progetto - Manutenzione regolare dei nostri sistemi di vendita e dei dati ivi contenuti. - Studi tecnici completati con successo (ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria industriale o di processo o di livello equivalente) - Modalità di lavoro strutturata, capacità di risolvere problemi complessi insieme al team di offerta - Esperienza in almeno una delle seguenti discipline: progettazione di pompe, gara internazionale o vendita, gestione di progetti o equivalente - Idealmente competenze interculturali - Conoscenza sana di pompe o attrezzature rotanti e accessori Co-Babeamo - Assicurazione medica per auto e famiglia - Struttura di trasporto sponsorizzata dall'azienda durante la settimana Days Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Empl

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join our Water & Industry Business Unit and be part of a global team delivering high-impact pumping and rotating equipment solutions. Purpose of the Role
We are seeking an experienced Sales Manager, Water and Wastewater to lead sales activities across Greece, Cyprus, and Israel for our Water and Industrial Business Uni . The role focuses on developing long-term customer relationships, identifying and converting commercial opportunities, and delivering tailored pumping and rotating equipment solutions within the water industry.
You will represent Sulzer in front of key customers, manage complex technical and commercial engagements, and consistently achieve agreed sales targets.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing customers across the assigned territories

• Develop and manage a robust sales pipeline and key account strategy

• Visit customers regularly, lead project discussions, and deliver technical presentations on the Sulzer Water portfolio

• Prepare technical and commercial quotations with support from tendering teams

• Negotiate contracts and support project order wins

• Work closely with engineering, procurement, manufacturing, project management, and global Sulzer WIBU offices

• Coordinate with local agents in Greece, Cyprus, and Israel

• Prepare structured handover documentation to Project Management and support delivery through to contractual completion

Requirements:

• Strong technical and commercial acumen within the water industry

• B.E / B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering

• 10+ years’ experience in the water industry , including 7+ years living and working in Greece

• Proven experience in technical sales, proposals, or tendering functions

• Strong ability to read engineering drawings, specifications, and tender documents

• Sulzer product knowledge is a strong advantage

• CRM experience (Salesforce preferred)

What we offer you

• Chance to make a meaningful impact by driving growth across the Sales organisation within our Water & Industrial business, with sustainability at the heart of our strategy.

• Collaborative and supportive work environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.

• Exciting opportunities for professional growth and advancement in a dynamic and evolving industry in a global environment

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer søker nå etter en fagsterk og kundeorientert serviceleder. Du kommer til å være lokalisert ved vårt verksted på hovedkontoret i Asker, og også ha personalansvar for teknikerne på flere lokasjoner. Har du dokumenterte erfaringer med å skape, lede, og utvikle effektive team, håper vi at nettopp du ønsker å være med på denne reisen med oss!

Stillingen inneholder blant annet:

• Du vil være en del av et team med 2 serviceledere, som tilsammen har personalansvar for alle teknikerne.

• Du vil være ansvarlig for salg av servicetjenester, driften av og effektiv bruk av ressursene, både menneskelige og materielle. Sulzer har stort fokus på kontinuerlig forbedring, utvikling, og vekst.

• Vi ønsker at du er en rollemodell, at du viser engasjement og felles retning.

• Sørge for at de ansatte får et tett og effektivt samarbeid, slik at de blir inspirert til å oppnå felles suksess.

• Sikre at teknikerne har riktig kompetanse for å utføre avdelingens arbeid, gjennom kompetanseutvikling og ansettelser, i samråd med serviceleder i Norge.

• I og med at våre serviceteknikere jobber med tungt maskineri og med arbeid som kan være risikopreget, er det svært viktig at leder har stort fokus på å drifte på en sikker og helsefremmende måte, og sikrer HMS og kvalitet i alle ledd.

• Dette er en operativ rolle, som består av både ledelse og salg, samt administrative oppgaver som bidrar til å holde hjulene i gang.

Hovedoppgaver
Arbeidsoppgavene inkluderer, men er ikke begrenset til:

• HMS ansvar for teknikerne og verkstedene.

• Personalansvar for teknikerne

• Kundekontakt og befaringer

• Salgsrelaterte oppgaver på serviceområdet

• Ansvar for servicebiler/flåtestyring lokalt

• Det er behov for en del reising i stillingen, for å vise tilstedeværelse på flere lokasjoner.

Rapporterer til: Serviceleder Norge

Ønsket erfaring og formell utdanning

• Gjerne utdanning på BSc- nivå, eller teknisk utdannelse

• Operativ ledelseserfaring, gjerne fra bransje med serviceteknikere i felt eller lignende

• Erfaring innen vedlikehold av prosessutstyr eller annet mekanisk utstyr

• Det er en fordel å kjenne til vann- og avløpsbransjen.

• Kompetanse innen HMS for arbeid i felt

• Kompetanse eller interesse for tilstøtende fagdisipliner; mekaniske, elektro, automasjon og bygg & anlegg

• Gode kommunikasjonsevner på både norsk og engelsk

• Førerkort klasse B, fordel med BE (henger)

• Gode kunnskaper innen IT

Personlige styrker

• Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner

• Komfortabel med elektroniske verktøy og systemer

• Gode mellommenneskelige egenskaper, og evne til å skape og lede et team

• Kundeorientert

• Teknisk nysgjerrighet

What we offer you

Hvem er vi tenker du? Og hva kan vi tilby akkurat deg?
Sulzer er en stor og stabil arbeidsgiver, og samtidig har vi et lokalt miljø som er liten og dynamisk.
Sulzer er kjent for produkter med høy kvalitet, har en solid ordrereserve, egne fabrikker, og er en ledende aktør i en bærekraftig og livsnødvendig industri.

Ansatte hos oss har stor påvirkningskraft på egen hverdag og bedriftens retning. Sulzer tilbyr et hyggelig miljø med høy yrkesstolthet og faglig tyngde. Vi har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, og fleksible arbeidstidsordninger, og ikke minst gode muligheter for videreutvikling internt og eksternt

jobs.title: Project Scheduler
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Our newly refurbished Leeds facility our Advanced Pump Design and Manufacturing Centre of Excellence, where highly engineered, bespoke pumping solutions are designed, built and delivered for some of the world’s most demanding applications. Our pumps operate in environments where failure isn’t an option — from energy, oil & gas, chemicals, water, nuclear and heavy industry, serving global customers who expect absolute precision, reliability and performance.

We’re looking for an experienced Project Scheduler to take ownership of planning and scheduling across large, complex engineering projects — the kind with long lead times, multiple workstreams and a lot of moving parts. You’ll be at the heart of the project lifecycle, building and maintaining detailed schedules that align engineering, procurement, manufacturing, testing and delivery. This is a role for someone who enjoys turning complexity into clarity.

What you’ll be doing

• Developing, maintaining and controlling end‑to‑end project schedules using MS Project

• Working closely with Project Managers, Engineering, Supply Chain and Manufacturing to ensure plans are realistic, integrated and achievable

• Managing schedule risk, critical paths and dependencies across complex, multi‑discipline projects

• Using SAP to track progress, materials, production milestones and performance

• Providing clear schedule reporting, forecasts and insights to support decision‑making

• Driving continuous improvement in planning standards, tools and processes

What we’re looking for

• Proven experience as a Project Scheduler / Planner within large, complex engineering or manufacturing projects

• Strong, hands‑on experience with MS Project

• Working knowledge of SAP within a project or manufacturing environment

• Comfortable managing projects with many interdependencies, long lead items and competing priorities

• Confident communicator who can challenge constructively and influence stakeholders

• A structured, detail‑driven mindset with the ability to see the bigger picture

What we offer you

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• A company-wide bonus scheme

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (covering everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services)

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

Our newly refurbished Leeds facility our Advanced Pump Design and Manufacturing Centre of Excellence, where highly engineered, bespoke pumping solutions are designed, built and delivered for some of the world’s most demanding applications. Our pumps operate in environments where failure isn’t an option — from energy, oil & gas, chemicals, water, nuclear and heavy industry, serving global customers who expect absolute precision, reliability and performance.

We’re looking for an experienced Project Scheduler to take ownership of planning and scheduling across large, complex engineering projects — the kind with long lead times, multiple workstreams and a lot of moving parts. You’ll be at the heart of the project lifecycle, building and maintaining detailed schedules that align engineering, procurement, manufacturing, testing and delivery. This is a role for someone who enjoys turning complexity into clarity.

What you’ll be doing

• Developing, maintaining and controlling end‑to‑end project schedules using MS Project

• Working closely with Project Managers, Engineering, Supply Chain and Manufacturing to ensure plans are realistic, integrated and achievable

• Managing schedule risk, critical paths and dependencies across complex, multi‑discipline projects

• Using SAP to track progress, materials, production milestones and performance

• Providing clear schedule reporting, forecasts and insights to support decision‑making

• Driving continuous improvement in planning standards, tools and processes

What we’re looking for

• Proven experience as a Project Scheduler / Planner within large, complex engineering or manufacturing projects

• Strong, hands‑on experience with MS Project

• Working knowledge of SAP within a project or manufacturing environment

• Comfortable managing projects with many interdependencies, long lead items and competing priorities

• Confident communicator who can challenge constructively and influence stakeholders

• A structured, detail‑driven mindset with the ability to see the bigger picture

jobs.title: Order to Cash Billing Accountant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. This role ensures accuracy in financial records and supports compliance with accounting standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. The Order to Cash (OTC) Billing Accountant is responsible for overseeing the billing process, ensuring the accuracy of invoices and managing the accounts receivable ledger.

Key responsibilities

• Prepare and issue invoices to customers based on service agreements and purchase orders, ensuring accuracy in billing details and compliance with contractual terms

• Closely collaborate with the local Project Manager

• Review and reconcile billing data for completeness and accuracy, making necessary adjustments or corrections

• Collaborate with sales, customer service, and project management teams to gather necessary information for billing and to resolve any billing-related issues

• Maintain and update customer billing information and records in the billing system

• Monitor customer account details for non-payments, delayed payments, and other irregularities, and follow up as needed; perform dunning activities where required

• Assist with the accounts receivable process, including recording payments and updating customer ledgers

• Perform AR, Revenue & Aging analysis

• Support the month-end and year-end close processes, including preparing journal entries and account reconciliations related to billing

• Generate and analyze billing reports, providing insights and recommendations to improve the billing process and reduce errors. Closely collaborate with the Reporting & Analytics team on this

• Ensure compliance with OTC internal controls, accounting policies, and regulatory requirements related to billing operations

• Participate in the implementation and improvement of billing systems and procedures to enhance efficiency and accuracy

• Provide support during internal and external audits by preparing required documentation and addressing auditor inquiries related to billing

Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in OTC, billing or a similar role

• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is preferred

Critical success factors

• Strong understanding of accounting principles, revenue recognition and billing process

• Proficiency in interpreting billing reports

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills

• Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to i.e. Senior Billing Accountants, CoE Accounting Manager, Reporting & Analytics team and Country Finance Heads

Technical & language skills

• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala)

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Proficiency in billing software; experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Proficiency in English

Interfaces with

• OTC Accountants

• Reporting & Analytics team

• Country Finance Heads

Medical insurance for the self and family.
Free transportation facility

jobs.title: Senior FP&A Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Controller Specialist is responsible for executing core financial control activities, including the preparation of financial reports, account reconciliations, and compliance with internal controls. This role supports the accuracy and integrity of financial data and contributes to the organization’s financial planning and reporting processes.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals.
• Key Responsibilities

• Prepare and consolidate the annual budget

• Refresh predictive financial forecasts periodically

• Conduct profitability and performance reporting

• Perform plan analytics and risk management, managing and continuously improving the financial planning and analysis processes

• Provide recommendation to the business based on in depth financial analysis

• Manage collections reporting and analytics, ensuring accurate and timely information to support decision-making

• Provide comprehensive reporting and analytics on procurement activities, contributing to informed purchasing decisions

• Oversee the period end close processes, generating accurate and insightful period end financial reports and analytics to ensure financial integrity

• Handle period end closing, and related analytics, ensuring thorough and precise financial tracking and reporting for projects

• Oversee CAPEX planning, forecasting, investment strategy, period-end close activities and reporting

• Ensure all financial reporting and processes comply with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS)

• Ensure internal controls are in place for the processes performed by this role

• Comply with relevant QESH regulations
Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 5 -7 years of experience in financial planning and analysis or related finance roles

• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is preferred
Critical success factors

• Proficiency in financial modelling and forecasting, advanced skills in data analytics and financial software

• Strong understanding of global financial processes and standards

• Strong financial acumen

• Excellent communication skills for delivering key insights to leadership

• Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively with other stakeholders
Technical & language skills

• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Understanding of integrated ERP systems is a plus

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Proficiency in English

What we offer you

Medical insurance for self and family
Company sponsored transportation facility during week days

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Le Sr. Application Engineer développe des propositions techniques de projets, y compris des modifications à la conception standard et configure les outils de conception et d'établissement des coûts. Fonctionne indépendamment et développe des réponses techniques au client. Fonctions essentielles :
• Applique une connaissance approfondie du domaine d'emploi généralement obtenue grâce à l'enseignement supérieur et à l'expérience de travail.
• Les demandes de renseignements du client pour s'assurer qu'ils contiennent toutes les informations nécessaires pour soumettre un devis.
• Liaison avec les vendeurs/clients pour obtenir toute information manquante.
• Recueille, comprend et interprète les exigences du client pour les données nouvelles et/ou opérationnelles des systèmes existants du client.
• Élaboration de la proposition technique/du devis, y compris la description et les spécifications de l'équipement, et examen et négociation des révisions techniques nécessaires avec le client.
• Répond aux questions et aux demandes de renseignements du client au sujet des problèmes et des problèmes techniques qui se posent et fournit en temps opportun un soutien ou une assistance technique connexe.
• Sur commande, avis/approbation de la portée de l'offre et création de fichier d'emploi selon les spécifications de Sulzer.
• Comprendre et apporter des solutions à des problèmes importants et/ou complexes
• Exige un jugement indépendant, une initiative et une prise de décisions judicieuses Fonctions secondaires:
• Rencontre avec les clients sur place, au besoin, pour examiner les spécifications et les exigences, présenter et discuter la proposition de l'entreprise et participer au lancement du projet au besoin. Qualifications
• Licence en génie chimique
• 3+ ans d'expérience dans la conception de systèmes biologiques de traitement des eaux usées
• 2+ ans d'expérience en ventes techniques avec une compréhension de la façon d'interpréter les exigences techniques du client
• Connaissance de base des opérations des unités et de l'analyse des eaux usées
• Aptitude au système conceptuel
• Excellentes compétences en communication
• Automotivé et prend des initiatives
• Fortes compétences en planification et en organisation
• Ouvert à l'apprentissage Voyages : Ce poste ne nécessitera pas de voyages d'affaires réguliers, mais il pourrait être nécessaire de visiter les clients sur place au besoin pour des études pilotes. Ce que nous vous offrons
• 15 jours de congé payé et 12 jours fériés payés par l'entreprise
• Plan 401k avec un match de 6%
• Plan de santé global incluant les soins médicaux, dentaires, la vision, la vie, l'invalidité de courte et de longue durée
• Programme de bien-être
• Programme d'aide aux employés
• Congé parental payé
• Remboursement de gymnastique Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.title: FP&A Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The FP&A Specialist is responsible for supporting financial planning and analysis activities, including budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting. This role applies advanced knowledge to deliver financial insights that support strategic and operational decisions.

This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower-level professionals. Job Responsibilities

• Support the preparation of annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, and long-term plans.

• Perform variance analysis between actual and budgeted/forecasted results, identifying causes and their implications.

• Collaborate in the preparation of periodic financial reports for local and corporate management.

• Assist in the development and maintenance of financial models to support various business initiatives.

• Participate in process improvement projects within the finance department.

• Collect and analyze financial data from various sources to identify trends and opportunities.

• Maintain the integrity and accuracy of financial data used in analyses.

• Support the preparation of financial presentations for different audiences.

Job Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

• 2–4 years of previous experience in a similar FP&A, financial analysis, or accounting role.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, complex formulas, financial modeling).

• Knowledge of ERP systems (SAP preferred) and Business Intelligence (BI) tools.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret complex financial data.

• Attention to detail and high level of precision in work.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a dynamic environment.

jobs.title: Lean/Industrial Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced Lean/Industrial Manufacturing Engineer to lead process optimization, waste reduction, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role requires expertise in Lean Manufacturing principles, Industrial Engineering methods, and operational analytics to drive measurable improvements in efficiency, quality, and throughput across our service offerings.

The ideal candidate will possess strong technical skills, a strategic mindset, and the ability to collaborate across teams to implement solutions that support our business objectives.
Key Responsibilities

• Analyze current manufacturing processes to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and areas for improvement.

• Apply Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen, 5S, Value Stream Mapping , and other methodologies to enhance operational performance.

• Design, implement, and optimize production workflows, material flows, and plant layouts to minimize waste and reduce lead times.

• Utilize data-driven approaches for capacity analysis, root cause problem-solving, and performance measurement .

• Facilitate continuous improvement initiatives, Kaizen events, and cross-functional workshops.

• Develop and maintain standard work documentation, operating procedures, and training materials .

• Monitor KPIs and provide actionable reports to management with recommendations for improvement.

• Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, quality assurance, supply chain, and maintenance teams.

• Conduct ergonomic and safety analysis to reduce risks and optimize human-centered processes.

• Support new product launches by designing process flows, labor standards, and material handling layouts.

• Participate in cost evaluation, ROI analysis, and capital project justification for process and productivity improvements.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering , or related field.

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in manufacturing or industrial engineering , with hands-on experience in Lean Manufacturing and process improvement initiatives.

• Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification preferred.

• Proficiency in industrial engineering tools such as AutoCAD similar software .

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills .

• Ability to train, mentor, and lead cross-functional teams.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Knowledge of manufacturing systems, quality standards, safety protocols, and continuous improvement metrics .

• Experience with ERP systems, Microsoft Office Suite, and statistical analysis tools.

• Knowledge of material planning and warehouse layout optimization.

• Strong leadership capability with a track record of successful Lean initiative deployment.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced Lean/Industrial Manufacturing Engineer to lead process optimization, waste reduction, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role requires expertise in Lean Manufacturing principles, Industrial Engineering methods, and operational analytics to drive measurable improvements in efficiency, quality, and throughput across our service offerings.

The ideal candidate will possess strong technical skills, a strategic mindset, and the ability to collaborate across teams to implement solutions that support our business objectives.
Key Responsibilities

• Analyze current manufacturing processes to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and areas for improvement.

• Apply Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen, 5S, Value Stream Mapping , and other methodologies to enhance operational performance.

• Design, implement, and optimize production workflows, material flows, and plant layouts to minimize waste and reduce lead times.

• Utilize data-driven approaches for capacity analysis, root cause problem-solving, and performance measurement .

• Facilitate continuous improvement initiatives, Kaizen events, and cross-functional workshops.

• Develop and maintain standard work documentation, operating procedures, and training materials .

• Monitor KPIs and provide actionable reports to management with recommendations for improvement.

• Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, quality assurance, supply chain, and maintenance teams.

• Conduct ergonomic and safety analysis to reduce risks and optimize human-centered processes.

• Support new product launches by designing process flows, labor standards, and material handling layouts.

• Participate in cost evaluation, ROI analysis, and capital project justification for process and productivity improvements.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering , or related field.

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in manufacturing or industrial engineering , with hands-on experience in Lean Manufacturing and process improvement initiatives.

• Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification preferred.

• Proficiency in industrial engineering tools such as AutoCAD similar software .

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills .

• Ability to train, mentor, and lead cross-functional teams.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Knowledge of manufacturing systems, quality standards, safety protocols, and continuous improvement metrics .

• Experience with ERP systems, Microsoft Office Suite, and statistical analysis tools.

• Knowledge of material planning and warehouse layout optimization.

• Strong leadership capability with a track record of successful Lean initiative deployment.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Servicetekniker til bærekraftig industri

Dette er til deg som ønsker en jobb med mening
Kunne du tenkt deg å jobbe med bransjeledende produkter og kompetanserike kollegaer? Med fokus på bærekraft og en fremtidsrettet visjon, søker vi kollegaer som med sin kompetanse og sitt fokus på en trygg og inkluderende arbeidshverdag, kan være med og forme veien videre sammen med oss. Våre produkter er av høyeste kvalitet, og er lett å være stolte over.
Vi søker deg som er en dyktig tekniker med erfaring/kompetanse innen pumpeteknikk, industrimekanikk, industrirørlegging, VVS eller lignende.
Relevant erfaring og allsidighet kan gjøre opp for manglende formell utdannelse.

Hvem er vi tenker du? Og hva kan vi tilby akkurat deg?
Vi er et sterkt, men ungt og uformelt fagmiljø, med gode karrieremuligheter. Vi har en solid ordrereserve, egen produksjon, og er en aktør i en livsnødvendig industri.
Alle ansatte har stor påvirkningskraft på egen hverdag og bedriftens retning. Vi har gode pensjonsordninger, helseforsikring, og fleksible arbeidstidsordninger.
Som servicetekniker hos oss, foregår det meste av arbeidet ute hos kunde. Kundegruppen vår strekker seg fra industri til privatpersoner, og kommuner over hele landet. Denne stillingen er tilknyttet servicesenteret vårt i Kristiansand, og ditt nedslagsfelt vil primært være Agder, men en del reising utenfor fylket vil også være aktuelt.
Vi har ca 18 serviceteknikere i divisjonen vår i Sulzer Norge, og disse er fordelt på lokasjonene i Kristiansand, Trondheim, Bergen, Fredrikstad og Asker. Vi vektlegger samarbeid på tvers av lokasjoner.

Stillingen har søknadsfrist mandag 10. august 2026 , men vi vurdererer alle søkere fortløpende!

Vi ser etter deg som:

• Ønsker å arbeide selvstendig og er løsningsorientert

• Er nøyaktig og verdsetter kvalitet i arbeidet

• Anser digitale verktøy som hjelpemidler og ikke en belastning

• Er positiv, lærevillig, og liker å dele kunnskapen din

• Har generelt god fysisk form, og fokus på HMS

Kvalifikasjoner :

• Fortrinnsvis fagbrev innen tekniske fag, men har du relevant erfaring blir du vurdert

• Førerkort klasse B (om du har kl. BE, og/eller traverskran er det en fordel)

• Gode norskkunnskaper, samt lese og forstå Engelsk

What we offer you

Vi tilbyr:

• Sulzer tilbyr et hyggelig miljø med høy yrkesstolthet og faglig tyngde

• En sikker og trygg arbeidsplass i vekst, som opererer i flere stabile markeder

• Gode arbeidsforhold med vekt på sikkerhet, opplæring og kvalitet

• Servicebilordning

• Vår helseforsikring sørger for at alle ansatte får rask hjelp til å løse sine plager

• En av markedets beste pensjonsbetingelser

• Ferie og fritidsforsikring for hele familien

• Ulykkesforsikring for hele familien

• God opplæring, og mulighet for videreutvikling internt og eksternt i Sulzer systemet

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

El/La Sales Engineer (Industrial) da soporte al proceso comercial aportando conocimiento técnico, participando en la preparación de propuestas y colaborando en la definición de soluciones adaptadas a las necesidades del cliente.

Esta posición está orientada a profesionales en etapas iniciales de su carrera, que combinan interés por la ingeniería y las ventas, analizan requisitos técnicos y contribuyen al desarrollo de oportunidades comerciales, trabajando en coordinación con equipos senior y otras áreas.

Ámbito de actuación: España y Portugal. Responsabilidades principales

• Apoyar en la preparación y presentación de propuestas técnico-comerciales

• Colaborar en el diseño de soluciones adaptadas a las necesidades del cliente

• Dar soporte en reuniones y visitas comerciales con clientes

• Responder a consultas técnicas y comerciales, actuando como interlocutor de soporte

• Coordinarse con equipos de ingeniería y operaciones para asegurar la viabilidad de las propuestas

• Realizar seguimiento de ofertas y oportunidades comerciales

• Mantener actualizada la información de clientes y actividad comercial en el CRM

• Analizar el mercado y la competencia para identificar oportunidades de negocio

• Contribuir a la implementación de la estrategia comercial en el área asignada

Requisitos

• Grado universitario en Ingeniería (Industrial o similar) o formación equivalente

• Hasta 2 años de experiencia en entornos técnicos o comerciales

• Interés por el ámbito técnico-comercial en sector industrial

• Manejo de herramientas Microsoft Office y CRM (valorable Salesforce)

• Disponibilidad para viajar dentro de España y Portugal

Competencias

• Orientación al cliente y buenas habilidades de comunicación

• Capacidad analítica y de comprensión técnica

• Proactividad, iniciativa y actitud de aprendizaje

• Habilidades de organización y seguimiento

• Capacidad de trabajo en equipo y colaboración transversal

• Flexibilidad y adaptación a entornos dinámicos

Idiomas

• Inglés: nivel B2 (intermedio-alto)

What we offer you

• Contrato indefinido.

• Salario competitivo y participación en el sistema de remuneración variable basado en objetivos personales y corporativos.

• Ticket restaurantes.

• Acceso a un plan de retribución flexible voluntario que permite optimizar el paquete salarial (por ejemplo, seguro médico, transporte, guardería).

• Formar parte de un equipo experimentado e internacional.

• Buen ambiente de trabajo.

• Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional dentro de una empresa internacional sólida y con fuerte presencia global.

• Formar parte de una organización dinámica en constante transformación y mejora.

• Ubicación de la oficina: RIVAS (MADRID)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Für den Ausbildungsbeginn 01. September 2027 suchen wir am Standort Bruchsal einen
Auszubildenden Zerspanungsmechaniker (m/w/d).
Deine Aufgaben:
Unsere Auszubildenden im Ausbildungsberuf Zerspanungsmechaniker werden gezielt auf spannende Tätigkeiten im Unternehmen vorbereitet. Zu den Ausbildungsinhalten zählen unter anderem:

• verschiedene Fertigungstechnologien auf konventionellen- oder CNC gesteuerten Werkzeugmaschinen.

• Die Erstellung von CNC-Programme mittels technischer Unterlagen

• Die Planung von Fertigungsprozessen

• Die Einrichtung der Fertigungsmaschinen in unserem modernen Maschinenpark

Alle Auszubildenden sind fest in unsere Ausbildungswerkstatt sowie das Produktionsteam integriert und lernen so auch interne Abläufe aus verschiedenen Blickwinkeln kennen.
Ziel der Ausbildung ist die anschließende Weiterbeschäftigung, z.B. im Bereich Mechanische Fertigung oder Kunden-Service. Der theoretische Teil der Ausbildung findet in der beruflichen Schule in Bretten statt.

Dein Profil:
Von unseren zukünftigen Auszubildenden erwarten wir einen guten Hauptschul- oder Realschulabschluss, besonders in naturwissenschaftlichen bzw. technischen Fächern. Handwerkliches Geschick und technisches Interesse sind wichtige Erfolgsfaktoren für die Ausbildung in unserem Haus. Nicht zuletzt legen wir Wert auf Engagement, Flexibilität, Belastbarkeit und Teamfähigkeit.

What we offer you

Die Berufsausbildung bei Sulzer Pumpen ist ein Start in ein erfolgreiches Unternehmen mit hervorragenden Perspektiven. Unser Produktionsstandort und Hauptsitz in Bruchsal zählt zu den erfahrensten Ausbildungsbetrieben der Region. Die Auszubildenden profitieren von

• Moderner Technik

• Engagierten Ausbildern

• Professioneller Betreuung

• Motivierendem Arbeitsklima

• den individuellen Möglichkeiten nach erfolgreichem Abschluss der Ausbildung

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Service Engineer Portugal
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lead (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Position Objective: to ensure high-quality service in the maintenance and repair of equipment, both in the workshop and at customer sites, as well as to resolve technical issues in coordination with the Workshop Manager and the service center team.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Carry out the tasks assigned by the Team Leader, delivering high-quality service to company clients in both mechanical and electrical areas (commissioning, maintenance, repairs, and troubleshooting of electrical systems and automation). (Applicable to 1st and 2nd Level Technicians depending on complexity.)

• Assist the Workshop Manager or 1st Level Technicians in problem-solving tasks. (2nd Level Technician)

• Provide technical solutions to day-to-day issues in coordination with the Workshop Manager. (1st Level Technician)

• Supervise installations, assemblies, and commissioning works performed by Sulzer's external suppliers in the area, following instructions from the Workshop Manager. (1st Level Technician)

• Act as the liaison with the sales team in their area, supporting them when needed with technical site visits for measurements, assessments, studies, etc., especially when the complexity of the quote/project requires it. (1st Level Technician)

• Collaborate in the extraction and maintenance of drainage wells.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Minimum of 5 years of experience as an Electromechanical Technician in the industrial sector.

• Vocational Training (Intermediate or Higher Level) in Electromechanics or equivalent professional experience.

• Mechanical and electrical knowledge required.

• Hydraulic knowledge is a plus.

• Ability to interpret manuals, exploded views, and technical drawings.

• Familiarity with equipment, accessories, and assembly components for sales.

• User-level proficiency in MS Office environment.

• English knowledge is a plus.

• Valid driver’s license required.

What we offer you

• Permanent contract

• Initial adaptation period with technical and commercial training, followed by ongoing development programs

• Fixed salary + annual bonus linked to financial and individual performance goals

• Meal vouchers (€13/day)

• Life insurance

• Flexible compensation options, including private health insurance, childcare, transport, and pension savings plans

• Shorter working hours on Fridays and during the summer period

• Flexible working hours for start and end of the day.

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lead (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Position Objective: to ensure high-quality service in the maintenance and repair of equipment, both in the workshop and at customer sites, as well as to resolve technical issues in coordination with the Workshop Manager and the service center team.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Carry out the tasks assigned by the Team Leader, delivering high-quality service to company clients in both mechanical and electrical areas (commissioning, maintenance, repairs, and troubleshooting of electrical systems and automation). (Applicable to 1st and 2nd Level Technicians depending on complexity.)

• Assist the Workshop Manager or 1st Level Technicians in problem-solving tasks. (2nd Level Technician)

• Provide technical solutions to day-to-day issues in coordination with the Workshop Manager. (1st Level Technician)

• Supervise installations, assemblies, and commissioning works performed by Sulzer's external suppliers in the area, following instructions from the Workshop Manager. (1st Level Technician)

• Act as the liaison with the sales team in their area, supporting them when needed with technical site visits for measurements, assessments, studies, etc., especially when the complexity of the quote/project requires it. (1st Level Technician)

• Collaborate in the extraction and maintenance of drainage wells.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Minimum of 5 years of experience as an Electromechanical Technician in the industrial sector.

• Vocational Training (Intermediate or Higher Level) in Electromechanics or equivalent professional experience.

• Mechanical and electrical knowledge required.

• Hydraulic knowledge is a plus.

• Ability to interpret manuals, exploded views, and technical drawings.

• Familiarity with equipment, accessories, and assembly components for sales.

• User-level proficiency in MS Office environment.

• English knowledge is a plus.

• Valid driver’s license required.

What we offer you

• Permanent contract

• Initial adaptation period with technical and commercial training, followed by ongoing development programs

• Fixed salary + annual bonus linked to financial and individual performance goals

• Meal vouchers (€13/day)

• Life insurance

• Flexible compensation options, including private health insurance, childcare, transport, and pension savings plans

• Shorter working hours on Fridays and during the summer period

• Flexible working hours for start and end of the day.

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

Job Summary

Set up and operate machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision. Key Responsibilities

• Performs layouts, sets up, and operates conventional machine tools as required

• Reads and interprets all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing

• Designs setups and methods where none exist

• Instructs other shop personnel in proper machining techniques: set-ups, feeds and speeds for both carbide and high speed steel cutting tools, methods and standard operating procedures

• Improves methods for higher quality and improved costs.

• Assist maintenance in diagnosis, repair, and preventative maintenance

• Operate jib cranes and forklifts as directed by Area Superintendent

• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections

• Demonstrated ability to effectively set up all, or at least most, of the following machines: I.D./O.D. Grinder, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Knee Mill, Radial Drill, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, and Planer Mill

• Ability to perform with a minimum of direct supervision

• Working knowledge of tool geometry and application

• Working knowledge of effects of feeds and speeds

• 4 years experience in machine shops on the above equipment

• Willingness to work in a team environment

• Ability to work overtime as required

• 401k plan with a 6% match

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is a global leader in fluid engineering, specialising in the design and manufacture of pumps and associated equipment for some of the world’s most critical industries. Founded in 1834 and headquartered in Switzerland, we employ over 13,500 people worldwide, operating in more than 40 countries, generating annual sales of approximately CHF 3.6 billion. Our pumping technologies support customers across the energy, water and wastewater, chemicals, industrial manufacturing, life sciences and food markets, enabling safe, reliable and efficient fluid handling in demanding applications.

The Wexford site is a key contributor to Sulzer’s global pumping portfolio, with a strong focus on product development and engineering support for pumps and associated mechanical equipment. The team works closely with international stakeholders, supporting the design and development of products supplied to customers across global markets About the Role & Opportunity

We are seeking a Mechanical Design Technician to join our Product Development team in Wexford. This role plays an important part in supporting the design and development of engineered pump solutions and related equipment, working closely with experienced Project Manager's.

You will be involved throughout the design lifecycle, contributing to products that are used worldwide in process‑critical environments. This is a development‑focused role within a structured engineering organisation, offering long‑term technical growth and progression opportunities.

Key Duties

• Create and maintain 3D models and 2D engineering drawings for pumps and associated mechanical equipment

• Produce detailed manufacturing drawings, assemblies and bills of materials

• Support engineering change requests, design updates and product improvements

• Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, testing and quality teams

• Ensure compliance with engineering standards, procedures and documentation requirements

What We’re Looking For

• A qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Design or a related discipline

• Experience creating engineering drawings and CAD models within a mechanical or manufacturing environment

• Understanding of mechanical assemblies, components and technical documentation

• A structured, detail‑orientated approach with good communication skills

• Motivation to learn, develop and build a long‑term career within engineering

What we offer you

• Competitive base salary

• Annual Leave: Enjoy 26 days of holiday

• Flexibility: Flexible Working Arrangements

• Pension: Benefit from a Defined Contribution Pension Scheme

• On site parking

• Subsidised Canteen on site

• Maternity / Paternity Leave Top Up

• EV Charging on site (At a reduced rate)

• Long Service Award: We acknowledge and celebrate your dedicated years of service.

• Employee Assistance Programme: Prioritise well-being with confidential support and guidance.

• Professional Growth and Development Opportunities: Access to continuous learning and development programs, providing employees with valuable opportunities for skill enhancement and career progression.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is a global leader in fluid engineering, specialising in the design and manufacture of pumps and associated equipment for some of the world’s most critical industries. Founded in 1834 and headquartered in Switzerland, we employ over 13,500 people worldwide, operating in more than 40 countries, generating annual sales of approximately CHF 3.6 billion. Our pumping technologies support customers across the energy, water and wastewater, chemicals, industrial manufacturing, life sciences and food markets, enabling safe, reliable and efficient fluid handling in demanding applications.

The Wexford site is a key contributor to Sulzer’s global pumping portfolio, with a strong focus on product development and engineering support for pumps and associated mechanical equipment. The team works closely with international stakeholders, supporting the design and development of products supplied to customers across global markets About the Role & Opportunity

We are seeking a Mechanical Design Technician to join our Product Development team in Wexford. This role plays an important part in supporting the design and development of engineered pump solutions and related equipment, working closely with experienced Project Manager's.

You will be involved throughout the design lifecycle, contributing to products that are used worldwide in process‑critical environments. This is a development‑focused role within a structured engineering organisation, offering long‑term technical growth and progression opportunities.

Key Duties

• Create and maintain 3D models and 2D engineering drawings for pumps and associated mechanical equipment

• Produce detailed manufacturing drawings, assemblies and bills of materials

• Support engineering change requests, design updates and product improvements

• Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, testing and quality teams

• Ensure compliance with engineering standards, procedures and documentation requirements

What We’re Looking For

• A qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Design or a related discipline

• Experience creating engineering drawings and CAD models within a mechanical or manufacturing environment

• Understanding of mechanical assemblies, components and technical documentation

• A structured, detail‑orientated approach with good communication skills

• Motivation to learn, develop and build a long‑term career within engineering

What we offer you

• Competitive base salary

• Annual Leave: Enjoy 26 days of holiday

• Flexibility: Flexible Working Arrangements

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Design and develop new products, primarily submersible pumps and agitators — translating requirements into high‑performance, high‑reliability solutions.

• Oversee the build, test, and validation of prototypes, including detailed reporting, interpretation, and analysis of results.

• Support smooth introduction of new products into manufacturing and global markets.

• Act as the point of contact, collaborating with customers, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure engineering, quality, and commercial alignment.

• Someone able to translate requirements into practical, innovative product solutions

• A hands‑on problem solver with experience in testing, analysis, and validation

jobs.title: Embedded Electronic Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer Pump Solutions Ireland Ltd is part of our Water and Industry Business Unit which aspires to develop - among others - products and solutions that support water recycling in s sustainable energy efficient way. There are 270 people employed in the Sulzer Company based in Wexford.

This role requires the capabilities to design, develop, code, test and debug software of our embedded devices and systems. A key responsibility will be to recommend new approaches, advising on industry standards, and will work closely with hardware specialists and programming teams. We are looking for a/an Embedded Electronic Software Development Engineer to join our FE_Products, Technology and Digitalization team in Ireland. Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Technical responsibility for the design of our embedded software (firmware) for control, monitoring and connectivity solutions.

• Specify, design and document technical requirements, and define test plans as appropriate.

• Analyse and enhance efficiency, stability and scalability of our designs.

• Work closely with internal and external resources to ensure work is completed to specification.

• Evaluate and select software components that will be used in larger solutions.

• Manage technical updates to our existing product portfolio.

• Advise on opportunities to streamline our control, monitoring and connected solutions.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Honours Degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, or similar with 7+ years of experience in best practices software development, delivery, and deployment.

• In-depth knowledge of C programming languages.Experience in developing firmware for embedded applications.

• Knowledge of software architecture for connected industrial applications/solutions.

• Knowledge of embedded systems with IoT or M2M capability.

• Knowledge of industrial communications protocols (Modbus, CAN, OPC, DNP3,).

• Knowledge of Telecoms/Network communications protocols (TCP/IP, GPRS/3G/4G, Wireless, low energy protocols).

• Experience with version control software.

• Analytical skills for root cause determination.

• Experience of working in a multi-disciplinary and multinational team environment.

What we offer you

• Annual Leave - Enjoy 26 days of holiday.

• Pension - Benefit from a defined contribution pension scheme.

• Flextime - Work Life Balance

• Long Service Awards - We acknowledge and celebrate your dedicated years of service.

• Employee Assistance Programme - Prioritise well-being with confidential support and guidance.

• Professional Growth and Development Opportunities - Access to continuous learning and development programs, providing employees with valuable opportunities for skill enhancement and career progression.

• Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Credit & Collections Accountant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. This role ensures accuracy in financial records and supports compliance with accounting standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. The Order to Cash (OTC) Credit & Collections Accountant is responsible for assessing the creditworthiness of current and potential customers and advice on the setup of new customers, managing credit risk, and supporting the overall OTC process in close collaboration with the country Project Managers and Credit Control Managers. Moreover, the professional is responsible for managing and executing the collections process to ensure timely payments from customers, maintaining healthy cash flow and minimizing risk of bad debts. The Credit & Collections Accountant will play a crucial role in maintaining financial stability of the organization by ensuring that receivables are collected in a timely manner

Key responsibilities

• Evaluate customer credit applications using credit scoring models and financial analysis to determine the degree of risk involved in extending the credit

• Analyze new customer and advise on the acceptance/rejection for the setup in the Master Data

• Conduct thorough financial analysis, including reviewing financial statements, credit reports and payment history to set and adjust credit limits

• Monitor and analyze customers’ credit exposures and make recommendations to minimize risk and optimize accounts receivables

• Collaborate closely with the Senior Credit & Collection Accountants, local Project Managers, sales and customer service teams to resolve credit issues and support business growth while managing credit risk as well as to address any disputes or issues that delay payments

• Execute collections strategies to reduce Days of Sales Outstanding (DSO) and improve cash flow

• Engage with customers via phone, email or other communication channels to negotiate timely payments and resolve outstanding receivables

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all credit & collections-related activities, including credit review, limits and terms

• Communicate credit policies and procedures to relevant stakeholders within the organization

• Support the collections process, ensuring timely payments from customers

• Prepare credit & collections reports and risk assessments for management, highlighting trends, potential risks and opportunities for improvement

• Support the OTC and Reporting & Analytics team with the month-end closing activities, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting related to credit and accounts receivable

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance credit processes and systems

• Ensure OTC internal controls are in place in the CoE and followed for the processes performed by this role

Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in OTC, credit analysis, risk assessment or a similar role

• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is preferred

Critical success factors

• Strong understanding of financial analysis, credit scoring, and risk management principles as well as the collection processes

• Proficiency in financial statement analysis and interpreting credit reports

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills

• Excellent communication skills for delivering key insights to i.e. CoE Accounting Mana

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sintesi del lavoro L'Accounting Officer è responsabile del supporto alle operazioni contabili, tra cui l'ingresso dei dati, la riconciliazione e l'assistenza alla rendicontazione finanziaria. Questo ruolo garantisce l'accuratezza nei registri finanziari e supporta il rispetto degli standard contabili. Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a professionisti precoci che applicano una vasta conoscenza teorica e richiedono la capacità di indagare e analizzare i problemi. Le soluzioni sono tipicamente discusse/verificati con un membro più anziano. L'Accountant Order to Cash (OTC) Credit & Collections è responsabile della valutazione dell'affidabilità creditizia dei clienti attuali e potenziali e della consulenza sulla configurazione di nuovi clienti, sulla gestione del rischio di credito e sul supporto del processo OTC complessivo in stretta collaborazione con i Project Managers e i Credit Control Managers del paese. Inoltre, il professionista è responsabile della gestione e dell'esecuzione del processo di raccolta per garantire pagamenti tempestivi da parte dei clienti, mantenendo un flusso di cassa sano e riducendo al minimo il rischio di debiti cattivi. Il Credit & Collections Accountant svolgerà un ruolo cruciale nel mantenere la stabilità finanziaria dell'organizzazione assicurando che i crediti siano raccolti in modo tempestivo Responsabilità chiave
• Valutare le applicazioni di credito del cliente utilizzando modelli di punteggio di credito e analisi finanziaria per determinare il grado di rischio coinvolto nell'estensione del credito
• Analizzare nuovi clienti e consigliare l'accettazione/rigetto per l'installazione nei Dati Master
• Condurre analisi finanziarie approfondite, tra cui la revisione dei bilanci, i rapporti di credito e la cronologia dei pagamenti per impostare e regolare i limiti di credito
• Monitorare e analizzare le esposizioni di credito dei clienti e fare raccomandazioni per minimizzare il rischio e ottimizzare i crediti dei conti
• Collabora a stretto contatto con gli Accountants Senior Credit & Collection, i Project Manager locali, i team di vendita e assistenza clienti per risolvere i problemi di credito e sostenere la crescita aziendale, gestendo i rischi di credito e per affrontare eventuali controversie o problemi che ritardano i pagamenti
• Eseguire le strategie di raccolta per ridurre i giorni di vendite eccezionale (DSO) e migliorare il flusso di cassa
• Impegnarsi con i clienti tramite telefono, e-mail o altri canali di comunicazione per negoziare pagamenti tempestivi e risolvere i crediti in sospeso
• Mantenere registri accurati e aggiornati di tutte le attività relative al credito e alle collezioni, tra cui la revisione del credito, i limiti e i termini
• Comunicare le politiche e le procedure di credito alle parti interessate pertinenti all'interno dell'organizzazione
• Supporta il processo delle collezioni, assicurando pagamenti tempestivi da parte dei clienti
• Preparare rapporti di credito e collezioni e valutazioni dei rischi per la gestione, evidenziando tendenze, potenziali rischi e opportunità di miglioramento
• Sostenere il team OTC e Reporting & Analytics con le attività di chiusura di fine mese, assicurando una reportistica finanziaria accurata e tempestiva relativa al credito e ai conti crediti
• Partecipa a iniziative di miglioramento continuo per migliorare i processi e i sistemi di credito
• Assicurarsi che i controlli interni OTC siano in vigore nel CoE e seguiti per i processi eseguiti da questo ruolo Istruzione ed esperienza
• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale o campo relativo
• Minimo 1-2 anni di esperienza in OTC, analisi del credito, valutazione del rischio o un ruolo simile
• L'esperienza nel settore manifatturiero o industriale è preferita Fattori di successo critici
• Forte comprensione dei principi di analisi finanziaria, di valutazione dei crediti e di gestione dei rischi e dei processi di raccolta
• Competenza nell'analisi del bilancio e nell'interpretazione dei rapporti di credito
• Eccellente analitica, problem solving e competenze decisionali
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione per fornire informazioni chiave a CoE Accounting Mana

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Stellenbeschreibung Der Rechnungsführer ist verantwortlich für die Unterstützung von Buchhaltungsvorgängen, einschließlich Dateneingabe, Abstimmungen und Unterstützung bei der Finanzberichterstattung. Diese Rolle gewährleistet die Genauigkeit der Finanzunterlagen und unterstützt die Einhaltung der Rechnungslegungsstandards. Dieses Stellenprofil richtet sich an Berufseinsteiger, die ein breites theoretisches Wissen anwenden und die Fähigkeit benötigen, Probleme zu untersuchen und zu analysieren. Lösungen werden in der Regel mit einem älteren Mitglied diskutiert / verifiziert. Der Order to Cash (OTC) Credit & Collections Accountant ist verantwortlich für die Bewertung der Kreditwürdigkeit aktueller und potenzieller Kunden und die Beratung bei der Einrichtung neuer Kunden, dem Management des Kreditrisikos und der Unterstützung des gesamten OTC-Prozesses in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Projektmanagern und Credit Control Managern des Landes. Darüber hinaus ist der Fachmann für die Verwaltung und Durchführung des Inkassoprozesses verantwortlich, um rechtzeitige Zahlungen von Kunden zu gewährleisten, einen gesunden Cashflow aufrechtzuerhalten und das Risiko von Fehlschulden zu minimieren. Der Credit & Collections Accountant wird eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Aufrechterhaltung der finanziellen Stabilität der Organisation spielen, indem sichergestellt wird, dass Forderungen zeitnah erhoben werden Wesentliche Zuständigkeiten
• Bewerten Sie Kundenkreditanträge mit Kredit-Scoring-Modellen und Finanzanalysen, um den Grad des Risikos bei der Kreditverlängerung zu bestimmen
• Analysieren Sie neue Kunden und beraten Sie bei der Annahme/Ablehnung für die Einrichtung in den Stammdaten
• Durchführung einer gründlichen Finanzanalyse, einschließlich der Überprüfung von Abschlüssen, Kreditberichten und Zahlungshistorie, um Kreditlimits festzulegen und anzupassen
• Überwachen und analysieren Sie die Kreditrisikopositionen von Kunden und geben Sie Empfehlungen zur Minimierung des Risikos und zur Optimierung der Forderungen
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Senior Credit & Collection Accountants, lokalen Projektmanagern, Vertriebs- und Kundenserviceteams, um Kreditprobleme zu lösen und das Geschäftswachstum bei der Verwaltung des Kreditrisikos zu unterstützen sowie Streitigkeiten oder Probleme anzugehen, die Zahlungen verzögern
• Führen Sie Inkassostrategien aus, um Days of Sales Outstanding (DSO) zu reduzieren und den Cashflow zu verbessern
