descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Résumé de l'emploi Le comptable est chargé d'appuyer les opérations comptables, y compris la saisie des données, les rapprochements et l'établissement de rapports financiers. Ce rôle assure l'exactitude des documents financiers et appuie la conformité aux normes comptables. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels en début de carrière qui appliquent de vastes connaissances théoriques et qui ont besoin de la capacité d'étudier et d'analyser les problèmes. Les solutions sont généralement discutées/vérifiées avec un membre plus âgé. Le comptable de l'Ordre d'encaisser (OTC) est chargé d'évaluer la solvabilité des clients actuels et potentiels et de fournir des conseils sur la configuration de nouveaux clients, la gestion du risque de crédit et l'appui au processus global de l'OTC en étroite collaboration avec les gestionnaires de projet et de contrôle du crédit du pays. De plus, le professionnel est responsable de la gestion et de l'exécution du processus de recouvrement afin d'assurer le paiement en temps opportun des clients, de maintenir des flux de trésorerie sains et de réduire le risque de créances douteuses. Le comptable des créances et recouvrements jouera un rôle crucial dans le maintien de la stabilité financière de l'organisation en veillant à ce que les créances soient perçues en temps opportun. Principales responsabilités
• Évaluer les demandes de crédit à la clientèle à l'aide de modèles de notation et d'analyse financière pour déterminer le degré de risque associé à l'extension du crédit
• Analyser le nouveau client et conseiller sur l'acceptation/rejection de l'installation dans le Master Data
• Effectuer une analyse financière approfondie, notamment en examinant les états financiers, les rapports de crédit et les antécédents de paiement afin de fixer et d'ajuster les limites de crédit
• Surveiller et analyser les expositions de crédit des clients et faire des recommandations pour minimiser les risques et optimiser les comptes débiteurs
• Collaborer étroitement avec les comptables principaux du crédit et de la perception, les gestionnaires de projet locaux, les équipes de vente et de service à la clientèle pour résoudre les problèmes de crédit et soutenir la croissance des entreprises tout en gérant le risque de crédit ainsi que pour régler les différends ou les problèmes qui retardent les paiements
• Exécuter des stratégies de recouvrement pour réduire les jours de vente en circulation et améliorer les flux de trésorerie
• Faire appel aux clients par téléphone, par courriel ou par d'autres moyens de communication pour négocier les paiements en temps opportun et régler les créances impayées
• Tenir des registres précis et à jour de toutes les activités liées au crédit et aux recouvrements, y compris l'examen du crédit, les limites et les modalités
• Communiquer les politiques et les procédures de crédit aux intervenants pertinents de l'organisation
• Soutenir le processus de collecte, en assurant le paiement en temps opportun des clients
• Préparer des rapports de crédit et de recouvrement et des évaluations des risques pour la gestion, en mettant en évidence les tendances, les risques potentiels et les possibilités d'amélioration
• Appuyer l'équipe du CTO et de l'analyse et des rapports dans les activités de clôture de fin de mois, en veillant à ce que les rapports financiers relatifs au crédit et aux comptes débiteurs soient exacts et opportuns
• Participer à des initiatives d'amélioration continue pour améliorer les processus et les systèmes de crédit
• S'assurer que les contrôles internes de l'OTC sont en place dans le Conseil de l'Europe et suivis pour les processus exécutés par ce rôle Éducation et expérience
• Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe
• Minimum de 1 à 2 ans d'expérience en CTO, en analyse de crédit, en évaluation des risques ou dans un rôle similaire
• L'expérience dans les secteurs manufacturier ou industriel est privilégiée Facteurs de succès essentiels
• Connaissance approfondie des principes d'analyse financière, de notation et de gestion du risque ainsi que des processus de collecte
• Compétence en analyse des états financiers et en interprétation des rapports de crédit
• Excellente capacité d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et de prise de décisions
• Excellentes compétences en communication pour fournir des idées clés à Mana, la comptabilité du Conseil de l'Europe

jobs.title: IT Systemadministrator (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Als lokaler IT Spezialist sind Sie die zentrale Ansprechperson der regionalen IT an unserem Produktionsstandort in Essen. In dieser Rolle stellen Sie den stabilen, regelkonformen und praxisnahen IT-Betrieb vor Ort sicher und übernehmen zugleich eine wichtige Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen zentralen IT-Einheiten, Produktionsbereichen und lokalem Management.
Ihre Aufgaben
Sie bringen fundierte Erfahrung in mindestens zwei der folgenden Aufgabenfelder mit:

• Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der lokalen Hyper-V-Infrastruktur

• Sicherstellung der Backup-Compliance unter Berücksichtigung regulatorischer Anforderungen der chemischen Industrie, einschließlich Backup- und Restore-Verfahren, B2D und B2T

• Netzwerkadministration mit Schwerpunkt auf Cisco-Komponenten, VLAN-Management und strukturierter Verkabelung; idealerweise ergänzt um erste Erfahrung in der Integration von OT-Komponenten

• 2nd-Level-Support für Fachbereiche in Produktion und Verwaltung, insbesondere im Umfeld von Client- und Mobile-Device-Management

• Betreuung und Management von Drucklösungen, insbesondere Multifunktionsgeräten und Barcodedruckern

• Beschaffung, technische Bewertung und Integration von IT-Komponenten in das Unternehmensnetzwerk

Darüber hinaus wirken Sie regelmäßig an der lokalen Umsetzung konzernweiter IT-Projekte mit. Sie übersetzen zentrale Anforderungen in konkrete standortbezogene Arbeitspakete, koordinieren die technische Realisierung vor Ort und bewegen sich sicher in arbeitsteiligen Organisationsstrukturen.

Die Rolle erfordert neben technischem Know-how ein hohes Maß an Kommunikations- und Abstimmungsfähigkeit: Sie verstehen die Anforderungen des Produktionsumfelds ebenso wie die Erwartungen des Site Managements und agieren als verlässlicher Business Partner zwischen IT und operativem Geschäft.

Je nach Profil und Eignung ist zudem eine Mitarbeit in bereichsübergreifenden Teams möglich, beispielsweise in den Bereichen Client Management, Netzwerk, Rechenzentrum oder IT-Sicherheit.

Ihr Profil

• Berufserfahrung: ca. 3–5 Jahre in der IT-Systemadministration

• Ausbildung: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich (z. B. Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Expertise: Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Hyper-V, Windows Server, Client-Management und Netzwerktechnik (Cisco, VLAN)

• Zertifikate: Cisco- oder Microsoft-Zertifizierungen wünschenswert, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich

• Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch gut in Wort und Schrift, zusätzliche Sprachkenntnisse (Spanisch oder Finnisch) von Vorteil

What we offer you

• Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Top ausgestattete Arbeitsplätze, kostenlose Parkplätze sowie Kaffee und Wasser.

• Flexibilität für Ihre Work-Life-Balance: Gleitzeitsystem und flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine optimale Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben.

• Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: JobRad-Leasing, Corporate Benefits, Betriebsrente und weitere Vergünstigungen für Mitarbeitende.

• Globale Perspektive & Zusammenarbeit: Enge Kooperation mit der zentralen IT und Anbindung an internationale Konzernstrukturen.

• Wir bieten darüber hinaus: Verantwortungsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem internationalen Umfeld, Zusammenarbeit mit einem engagierten Team und modernen Technologien, Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Entwicklungsperspektiven sowie eine attraktive Vergütung und Sozialleistungen.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Machinery Mechanic is responsible for performing routine maintenance and minor repairs on industrial machinery to ensure smooth and safe operations. This role supports the maintenance team by identifying mechanical issues and assisting in equipment upkeep.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. DUTIES

• Read job cards to determine; job status, work authorization/limitations, estimate, description of problems and/or expected serviceability.

• Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).

• Disassemble electro-mechanical equipment noting parts identifications, configuration and condition.

• Clean electro-mechanical equipment assemblies as needed using various methods and steps, including but not limited to: parts washer/steamers, caustic tanks, glass beaders, etc.

• Measure for or note proper replacement parts. Correctly requisition needed items from storekeeper, as approved by supervisor.

• Replace or repair worn or defective mechanical or electro-mechanical assemblies, including but not limited to: bearings, brushes, brush holders, motors leads gears seals, impellers, mechanical switches, brakes clutches, clutch rotors, tachs, fans, end shield,, etc.

• Retest reassembled electro-mechanical equipment for proper output and operation.

• Complete required paperwork for each job accurately and on a timely basis.

• Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed

• Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).

• Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.

• Keep work area neat and clean as directed by supervisor.

• Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.

• Perform other skilled or not-skilled duties as directed by supervisor

QUALIFICATIONS

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Basic mechanical aptitude

• Ability to understand, perform and retain various skill related training and operational and safety procedures demonstrated by supervisor.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

What we offer you

• Paid parental leave

• Paid time off

• Vision insurance

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Sollevare, stringere, regolare e/o fissare oggetti pesanti al fine di svolgere compiti di lavoro.
• Mantenere l'area di lavoro pulita e pulita come indicato dal supervisore.
• Assistito ad altri meccanici o ad altri agenti del negozio in mansioni qualificate o non qualificate, come diretto da supervisore o direttore del negozio.
• Esegui altri compiti qualificati o non qualificati, diretti dal supervisore QUALIFICA
• Diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente
• Aptitude meccanica di base
• Capacità di comprendere, eseguire e mantenere varie competenze relative alla formazione e alle procedure operative e di sicurezza dimostrate dal supervisore. DEMANAZIONI PHYSICHE
• Durante l'esecuzione dei compiti di questo lavoro, a volte sarebbe richiesto di stare in piedi, camminare, sedersi, raggiungere con mani e braccia, salire o equilibrio, stoop o ginocchio, parlare e sentire, e utilizzare le dita e le mani per sentire oggetti.

jobs.title: Final Inspection Lead
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we don't just manufacture pumps—we engineer and build critical equipment that keeps vital industries moving across the globe. From power generation and water infrastructure to energy, chemicals and industrial processing, our pumps are trusted in some of the world's most demanding applications. Our Leeds facility is one of Sulzer's flagship pump manufacturing centres, combining decades of engineering expertise with modern manufacturing technology following significant investment and refurbishment.

We're looking for an experienced Final Inspection Lead to join our recently refurbished, state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Leeds, where you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring every pump package leaves our site meeting the highest standards of quality, safety and customer satisfaction. This is not a typical inspection role. You'll be working alongside teams who design, manufacture, assemble and test some of the largest and most technically advanced pumps in the industry. Some of our products weigh up to 150 tonnes, requiring exceptional coordination, precision and engineering excellence to take them from concept to customer delivery. What You'll Be Doing

• Leading final inspection activities for complete pump packages and rotating equipment.

• Coordinating the final assembly verification process before customer dispatch.

• Reviewing and approving final manufacturing records and quality documentation.

• Ensuring products comply with ISO 9001 standards and internal quality requirements.

• Verifying that all customer specifications, technical requirements and contractual obligations have been fulfilled.

• Overseeing and signing off complete pump packages and bareshaft assemblies.

• Working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Project Management and Quality teams to resolve issues and ensure on-time delivery.

• Supporting customer inspections and witness activities where required.

• Driving a culture of quality, accountability and continuous improvement across the operation.

What We're Looking For

• Experience within heavy engineering, rotating equipment, pumps, turbines, motors or similar manufacturing environments.

• Strong understanding of final inspection, quality assurance and documentation control processes.

• Knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management systems.

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications and manufacturing documentation.

• Experience coordinating inspections involving large, complex engineered products.

• Excellent communication and organisational skills.

• A proactive approach with the confidence to make critical quality decisions.

What we offer you

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• A company wide bonus scheme

• 33 days’ holiday

• You will be eligible to join the Company’s Medicash health cash plan, which allows you to claim back the cost of everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services.

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Community & Wellbeing

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

Dalla produzione di energia e dalle infrastrutture idriche all'energia, ai prodotti chimici e alla lavorazione industriale, le nostre pompe sono affidabili in alcune delle applicazioni più esigenti del mondo. Siamo alla ricerca di un'esperta struttura di produzione di Leeds, dove potrai svolgere un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire che ogni pacchetto di pompe lasci il nostro sito rispettando i più elevati standard di qualità, sicurezza e soddisfazione del cliente. jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for achieving revenue (new unit & service) and pricing quality objectives for a given territory on a quarterly basis through strategic and tactical management of the representative/distribution firms within the given geography, through active management of existing partners and upgrading to new partners, when appropriate. The strategy must address the motivation factors, investment (staffing & activity level versus other lines) and competency (training and willingness) of the representative firms. The tactical aspect of the position includes directing and attending field appointments at wastewater plants and engineering firms, hosting regional training/sales meetings and understanding requirements to win opportunities. This person must be respected as a peer-level by representative firms’ principles and seen as adding value when in the field. Principle Duties and Responsibilities:

• Positively impact representative behavior and hold themselves and the representative firm accountable to the agreed upon forecast.

• Develop internal and external relationships to create an atmosphere of comradery, influence and accountability.

• Hold strategic monthly meetings with the principles of the representative firms to discuss MTD and YTD performance, as well as expected performance for the coming months. Document meetings and develop action plans, where appropriate. Follow-up on action items and counsel firms, where appropriate.

• Develop budgets and strategic plans with the representative firms to achieve objectives

• Develop a pipeline of prospects large enough to support revenue expectations. Directs representative firms’ activity and supports accordingly through internal resources.

• Assess market trends that affect JWC’s current products or future opportunities in order to drive innovation

• Thoroughly understands all of JWC’s products and is seen as an expert

• Provides timely feedback to senior management regarding market performance, representative firm performance and potential opportunities or threats during the weekly sales meetings and updates the CRM accordingly

• Coordinate complete resolution of customer service issues that rise to the level of this position because of size, pervasiveness or egregiousness

• Represent the Company at selected regional and national trade shows and conferences by driving leads

• Maintain a professional image as a representative of the Company

• Performs other duties and special projects as assigned.

Experience, Education & Skills:

• Bachelor’s Degree

• History of consistently achieving revenue targets through representative and distribution firms

• 5+ years of experience in municipal wastewater equipment sales

• Ability to speak intelligently about JWC products, services and company

• Must be able to travel 50%-75% of the time

• Ability to hold monthly performance meetings and hold under-performers accountable

• Strong interpersonal personal skills

• High degree of likeability to drive rep firm openness and partnering

• Expert organizational and time management skills

• Ability to use technology and analysis tools (CRM, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, etc.),

• Self-driven and entrepreneurial with a high sense of urgency and responsiveness

• Ability to be able to work out of a home satellite office effectively

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Responsabile del raggiungimento dei ricavi (nuove unità e servizi) e degli obiettivi di qualità dei prezzi per un determinato territorio su base trimestrale attraverso la gestione strategica e tattica delle imprese rappresentative/distribuzioni all'interno della data geografia, attraverso la gestione attiva dei partner esistenti e l'aggiornamento a nuovi partner, se del caso. La strategia deve affrontare i fattori di motivazione, gli investimenti (livello di lavoro e di attività rispetto ad altre linee) e la competenza (formazione e disponibilità) delle imprese rappresentative. L'aspetto tattico della posizione comprende la regia e la presenza di appuntamenti sul campo presso impianti di acque reflue e aziende di ingegneria, ospitando incontri di formazione/vendita regionali e requisiti di comprensione per vincere opportunità. Questa persona deve essere rispettata come un livello paritario dai principi delle imprese rappresentative e vista come valore aggiunto quando nel settore. Duties e responsabilità del principio:

• Positivamente impatto comportamento rappresentativo e tenere se stessi e l'azienda rappresentativa responsabile per le previsioni concordate.

• Sviluppare relazioni interne ed esterne per creare un'atmosfera di compagni, influenza e responsabilità.

• Tenere riunioni mensili strategiche con i principi delle aziende rappresentative per discutere le prestazioni MTD e YTD, così come le prestazioni previste per i prossimi mesi. Riunioni di documenti e piani d'azione, se del caso. Seguire le attività e le società di consulenza, se del caso.

• Sviluppi e piani strategici con le imprese rappresentative per raggiungere gli obiettivi

• Sviluppare una pipeline di prospettive abbastanza grande da sostenere le aspettative dei ricavi. Dirige l’attività delle imprese rappresentative e sostiene di conseguenza attraverso le risorse interne.

• Valuta le tendenze del mercato che influiscono sui prodotti attuali di JWC o sulle opportunità future per guidare l'innovazione

• Capisce bene tutti i prodotti di JWC ed è visto come un esperto

• Fornisce un feedback tempestivo alla gestione senior per quanto riguarda le prestazioni del mercato, le prestazioni aziendali rappresentative e le potenziali opportunità o minacce durante le riunioni di vendita settimanali e aggiorna il CRM di conseguenza

• Coordinate la risoluzione completa dei problemi del servizio clienti che si innalzano al livello di questa posizione a causa delle dimensioni, della pervasività o dell'egregiousness

• Rappresentare la Società in selezionati fiere e conferenze regionali e nazionali guidando

• Mantenere un'immagine professionale come rappresentante della Società

• Esegui altri compiti e progetti speciali assegnati.

Esperienza, Istruzione e competenze:

• Corso di laurea

• Storia del raggiungimento costante degli obiettivi di reddito attraverso aziende rappresentative e di distribuzione

• 5+ anni di esperienza nella vendita di attrezzature per le acque reflue comunali

• Capacità di parlare in modo intelligente di prodotti, servizi e società JWC

• Deve essere in grado di viaggiare 50%-75% del tempo

• Capacità di tenere riunioni mensili di performance e tenere sotto-performer responsabili

• Forti competenze personali interpersonali

• Alto grado di somiglianza per guidare l'apertura e la collaborazione di rep

• Competenze organizzative e di gestione del tempo

• Capacità di utilizzare strumenti di tecnologia e analisi (CRM, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, ecc.),

• Autodidatta e imprenditoriale con un elevato senso di urgenza e reattività

• Capacità di essere in grado di lavorare fuori di un ufficio satellitare di casa in modo efficace

Cosa ti offriamo

• 15 giorni di tempo libero e 12 giorni festivi

• 401k piano con una partita del 6%

• Piano sanitario completo tra cui medico, dentale, visione, vita, disabilità a breve e a lungo termine

• Conto di risparmio sanitario corrispondente

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Strategic Account Manager is responsible for managing and growing relationships with key clients across multiple lines of business. This role involves developing long-term account strategies, identifying growth opportunities, and ensuring high levels of client satisfaction.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Regional Sales Manager – Metals & Mining

Position Summary
The Regional Sales Manager is accountable for shaping and executing Sulzer Pumps’ channel strategy for the Metals & Mining market across North America. This role provides commercial leadership to drive profitable growth, deepen engagement with end users, EPCs, and channel partners, expand Sulzer’s installed base, and accelerate aftermarket revenue across the region.

Key Responsibilities
Strategic Growth Leadership: Lead regional growth initiatives by developing and executing a Metals & Mining strategy aligned with Sulzer Pumps’ commercial priorities and long-term objectives.
Channel Strategy & Performance: Establish, develop, and oversee channel partners to ensure market coverage, commercial effectiveness, and alignment with Sulzer’s go-to-market strategy.
Installed Base & Aftermarket Expansion: Advance new equipment sales to strengthen the installed base while driving sustainable aftermarket growth in parts, service, repairs, and upgrades.
Executive Customer Engagement: Build and strengthen strategic relationships with mining operators, processing facilities, and engineering firms to identify project opportunities and long-term account potential.
Technical & Commercial Value Selling: Provide consultative support that positions Sulzer solutions around reliability, lifecycle performance, and total cost of ownership.
Market Presence & Pipeline Development: Maintain a strong field presence through customer visits
and joint engagement with channel partners to expand pipeline and convert priority opportunities.
Capability Building: Strengthen partner and customer effectiveness through targeted product, application, and market training that reinforces Sulzer’s competitive position.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate closely with engineering, service, and operations teams to ensure disciplined execution, high customer satisfaction, and successful commercial outcomes.

Critical Success Factors
Deep understanding of pump applications within mining, mineral processing, and metals operations.
Demonstrated ability to deliver growth through both direct and channel-led commercial models.
Strong capability in strategic account development, executive relationship management, and opportunity capture.
Excellent communication, leadership, and execution skills, with the ability to influence across internal and external stakeholders.

Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related discipline preferred.
5–10 years of progressive experience in pump or rotating equipment sales within the Metals & Mining sector.
Demonstrated record of delivering profitable growth, leading channel partner performance, and applying the technical and commercial judgment required to support engineered pump

Travel Requirement
Travel up to 75% across the assigned territory is expected to support customer engagement, channel development, and business growth objectives

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K

Ce rôle fournit un leadership commercial pour stimuler la croissance rentable, approfondir l'engagement auprès des utilisateurs finaux, des EPC et des partenaires de canalisation, élargir la base installée de Sulzer et accélérer les revenus du marché secondaire dans toute la région. Principales responsabilités Leadership stratégique de la croissance : Diriger les initiatives de croissance régionale en élaborant et en exécutant une stratégie métallurgique et minière alignée sur les priorités commerciales et les objectifs à long terme de Sulzer Pumps. Stratégie et rendement du canal : Établir, développer et superviser des partenaires de canaux pour assurer la couverture du marché, l'efficacité commerciale et l'alignement avec la stratégie de mise en marché de Sulzer. Renforcement des capacités : Renforcer l'efficacité des partenaires et des clients grâce à une formation ciblée sur les produits, les applications et les marchés qui renforce la position concurrentielle de Sulzer. La capacité démontrée d'assurer la croissance par le biais de modèles commerciaux directs et dirigés par canal. jobs.title: Workplace AI Architect
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Define and govern the adoption of AI across Workplace and platform-based solutions, with a strong focus on out-of-the-box capabilities, integrations, and security. Act as the orchestration point across Software Development, Data & Analytics, business users, and platform owners, ensuring consistent routing of AI initiatives. Drive the transition from ad-hoc usage to controlled, scalable adoption through clear governance, measurement, and chargeback, positioning AI as an extension of existing platforms rather than a parallel capability. The role focuses on Workplace AI platforms and embedded capabilities such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI assistants, and collaboration tools.

Main accountabilities and tasks

• AI Roadmap & Out-of-the-Box Ownership: Own the AI roadmap for Workplace and platform-based AI capabilities and the adoption of out-of-the-box solutions; contribute to the cross-functional definition of AI architecture; establish AI as a coherent enterprise capability.

• Platform-First, Preview & Early-Access Ownership: Prioritise out-of-the-box capabilities over new builds; own the evaluation, piloting, and rollout of preview features and vendor early-access programmes; track and govern AI features increasingly embedded in existing enterprise services.

• Governance of Services, Integrations & Agents: Establish a single enterprise entry point and a risk-based approval process, supported by self-service guardrails and clear approval timelines so the front door enables rather than blocks; govern AI services, integrations, APIs, and the lifecycle of AI agents; ensure every AI asset is inventoried, owned, and operated within agreed controls.

• Routing of AI Initiatives Across Delivery Tracks: Define and govern how AI initiatives are routed across delivery tracks - out-of-the-box, preview, and early-access (this role); citizen development (business users, against standards set by this role); custom development and advanced integrations (Software Development); and analytics-driven solutions (Data & Analytics).

• Security, Risk & Compliance (with Infosec): Together with Infosec, define and enforce AI-specific controls under a clear split of accountability for who defines, approves, and enforces; ensure compliance with GDPR and the EU AI Act; govern third-party AI usage and minimise shadow-AI risk.

• AI Lifecycle Management: Govern the full lifecycle covering build, publish, operate, and retire; ensure ownership, inventory, and transparency for every AI solution; enforce environment-based controls across experiment, managed, and production.

• Business Value, Chargeback & Adoption: Define how AI business value is measured; build and operate a chargeback model so consumption is transparent and costs sit with the consuming business; drive adoption and track it against value realisation.

• User Support, Enablement & Training: Act as the primary point of contact for AI adoption; provide patterns, guardrails, and reusable templates so users can build safely; deliver training, documentation, and onboarding paths that build AI literacy across the organisation.

Desired experience and qualifications

• Work experience: 8-10+ years in enterprise IT, architecture, or transformation roles, with experience in governance, platform strategy, or large-scale adoption.

• Expertise: Senior expert / enterprise architect level. Strong understanding of enterprise AI platforms (e.g. Microsoft 365 Copilot) and assistant and agent-based tooling, and of GenAI / agent-based architectures; deep knowledge of platform vs. custom-development trade-offs and licensing models; experience defining operating models and governance standards.

• Governance & regulation: Proven experience defining and rolling out enterprise AI governance

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Define and govern the adoption of AI across Workplace and platform-based solutions, with a strong focus on out-of-the-box capabilities, integrations, and security. Act as the orchestration point across Software Development, Data & Analytics, business users, and platform owners, ensuring consistent routing of AI initiatives. Drive the transition from ad-hoc usage to controlled, scalable adoption through clear governance, measurement, and chargeback, positioning AI as an extension of existing platforms rather than a parallel capability. The role focuses on Workplace AI platforms and embedded capabilities such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI assistants, and collaboration tools.

Main accountabilities and tasks

• AI Roadmap & Out-of-the-Box Ownership: Own the AI roadmap for Workplace and platform-based AI capabilities and the adoption of out-of-the-box solutions; contribute to the cross-functional definition of AI architecture; establish AI as a coherent enterprise capability.

• Platform-First, Preview & Early-Access Ownership: Prioritise out-of-the-box capabilities over new builds; own the evaluation, piloting, and rollout of preview features and vendor early-access programmes; track and govern AI features increasingly embedded in existing enterprise services.

• Governance of Services, Integrations & Agents: Establish a single enterprise entry point and a risk-based approval process, supported by self-service guardrails and clear approval timelines so the front door enables rather than blocks; govern AI services, integrations, APIs, and the lifecycle of AI agents; ensure every AI asset is inventoried, owned, and operated within agreed controls.

• Routing of AI Initiatives Across Delivery Tracks: Define and govern how AI initiatives are routed across delivery tracks - out-of-the-box, preview, and early-access (this role); citizen development (business users, against standards set by this role); custom development and advanced integrations (Software Development); and analytics-driven solutions (Data & Analytics).

• Security, Risk & Compliance (with Infosec): Together with Infosec, define and enforce AI-specific controls under a clear split of accountability for who defines, approves, and enforces; ensure compliance with GDPR and the EU AI Act; govern third-party AI usage and minimise shadow-AI risk.

• AI Lifecycle Management: Govern the full lifecycle covering build, publish, operate, and retire; ensure ownership, inventory, and transparency for every AI solution; enforce environment-based controls across experiment, managed, and production.

• Business Value, Chargeback & Adoption: Define how AI business value is measured; build and operate a chargeback model so consumption is transparent and costs sit with the consuming business; drive adoption and track it against value realisation.

• User Support, Enablement & Training: Act as the primary point of contact for AI adoption; provide patterns, guardrails, and reusable templates so users can build safely; deliver training, documentation, and onboarding paths that build AI literacy across the organisation.

Desired experience and qualifications

• Work experience: 8-10+ years in enterprise IT, architecture, or transformation roles, with experience in governance, platform strategy, or large-scale adoption.

• Expertise: Senior expert / enterprise architect level. Strong understanding of enterprise AI platforms (e.g. Microsoft 365 Copilot) and assistant and agent-based tooling, and of GenAI / agent-based architectures; deep knowledge of platform vs. custom-development trade-offs and licensing models; experience defining operating models and governance standards.

• Governance & regulation: Proven experience defining and rolling out enterprise AI governance

Nell'ambito della nostra divisione Servizi, questa posizione supporta il responsabile delle vendite ENA Services e il responsabile delle vendite DACH con compiti amministrativi, operativi e di gestione aziendale di alta qualità. Compiti

- Supportare la gestione delle vendite coordinando le riunioni, inclusa la creazione dell'ordine del giorno, i verbali e il monitoraggio delle questioni aperte
- Mantenimento di calendari, organizzazione di viaggi e assunzione di compiti amministrativi nelle attività quotidiane
- Creazione, preparazione e compilazione di report, panoramiche e documenti di presentazione
- Garantire un'elevata qualità dei dati in Salesforce attraverso manutenzione, aggiornamenti e controlli di completezza per ENA e DACH
- Ottenimento, compilazione ed elaborazione strutturata delle informazioni dai team di vendita regionali e dai centri di assistenza
- Preparazione dei documenti della riunione e fornitura tempestiva di informazioni e materiali pertinenti
- Supportare la collaborazione tra vendite, centri di assistenza e altre interfacce interne

Requisiti

- almeno 3 anni di esperienza professionale pertinente in un ambiente commerciale, amministrativo o correlato alle vendite

- Formazione commerciale o laurea in ambito aziendale o amministrativo

- Modo di lavorare strutturato, indipendente e affidabile con elevate capacità organizzative e di definizione delle priorità
- Atteggiamento proattivo, elevato orientamento al servizio e aspetto professionale
- Comunicazione chiara e sicura ai vari livelli organizzativi
- Elevato livello di accuratezza, riservatezza e responsabilità
- Capacità di collaborare con team interfunzionali

Offriamo

- Approfondimenti su argomenti di business internazionali, reporting, cifre chiave e valutazioni di vendita
- Lavoro vario con una combinazione di supporto amministrativo, supporto aziendale e coordinamento dei processi

jobs.title: Service & Installationstekniker
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Service & Installationstekniker till Sulzer Pumps Sweden AB
Vi söker service och installations tekniker till Sulzers växande servicecenter i Veddesta och Malmö. Gillar du att arbeta i en varierande vardag med både arbete i verkstadsmiljö och ute hos kund? Då kan detta vara tjänsten för dig!

Om företaget

Sulzer är ett världsledande företag inom utveckling, tillverkning och service av pumpar, omrörare, luftarutrustning och blåsmaskiner. Våra kunder arbetar inom områden som olja, gas, vattenrening, gruvdrift och pappersindustri. Vi tillhandahåller en utmanande och givande arbetsmiljö där mångfald är värderad som nyckelfaktorn till framgång.

Huvudkontoret ligger i Vadstena och vi har kontor i Malmö, Göteborg, Norrköping och Stockholm. Våra servicecenter finner du i Vadstena, Göteborg,Veddesta,Årsta, Karlstad, Piteå och Arlöv. Läs gärna mer om oss på www.sulzer.com

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Sulzers servicecenter har framför allt kunder verksamma inom vatten- och avloppshantering. Din roll kommer i huvudsak bestå av montage, reparation och service av pumpar och pumpstationer. Arbetet utförs antingen i våra serviceverkstäder i Veddesta, Malmö eller direkt ute hos våra kunder, för att felsöka och åtgärda problem på plats. Som installations tekniker kommer du att jobba med ombyggnationer och nybyggnationer av pumpstationer, etc. Resor med övernattning kan förekomma samt även beredskap.

Administrativa uppgifter som ingår i tjänsten är bland annat handläggning av ordrar, skriva servicerapporter samt hantering av in- och ut leveranser.

Du blir en del av våra team som präglas av god stämning och sammanhållning. Vi ser fram emot att välkomna ytterligare en kollega.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som gillar att skruva, meka och lösa tekniska problem. Vi tror att du har läst ett tekniskt program på gymnasiet eller vidareutbildat dig inom området. Alternativt att du har erfarenhet av praktiskt verkstads- och fältarbete. Har du erfarenhete av svets arbeten och elinstallationer är det bra oxå. Du innehar körkortsbehörighet B och har ett genuint intresse för mekanik och teknik.

Det är meriterande om du har:

• Branschvana

• Erfarenhet av SAP eller liknande affärssystem

• Truckkort

• Certifikat i heta arbeten

• Kunskaper inom el samt styr- och reglerteknik

Som person ser vi att du är engagerad och driven. Du är praktiskt lagd och tycker det är roligt att hitta tekniska lösningar. För dig är det enkelt att prata med både kollegor och kunder samtidigt som du jobbar strukturerat.

På Sulzer finns goda möjligheter till att utvecklas och växa i rollen så tveka inte - det kan vara här som din resa startar!

Ansökningsförfarande

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på 100%, provanställning tillämpas. Vi tillämpar löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut. Missa inte chansen och ansök redan idag!

What we offer you

• Friskvårdsbidrag 3000kr/år (E-passi)

• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning

• Gratis kaffe och frukt

• Företagshälsovård med regelbundna hälsokontroller

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Våra kunder arbetar inom områden som olja, gas, vattenrening, gruvdrift och pappersindustri. Vi tillhandahåller en utmanande och givande arbetsmiljö där mångfald är värderad som nyckelfaktorn till framgång.

Huvudkontoret ligger i Vadstena och vi har kontor i Malmö, Göteborg, Norrköping och Stockholm. Våra servicecenter finner du i Vadstena, Göteborg,Veddesta,Årsta, Karlstad, Piteå och Arlöv. Läs gärna mer om oss på www.sulzer.com

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Sulzers servicecenter har framför allt kunder verksamma inom vatten- och avloppshantering. Din roll kommer i huvudsak bestå av montage, reparation och service av pumpar och pumpstationer. Arbetet utförs antingen i våra serviceverkstäder i Veddesta, Malmö eller direkt ute hos våra kunder, för att felsöka och åtgärda problem på plats. Som installations tekniker kommer du att jobba med ombyggnationer och nybyggnationer av pumpstationer, etc. Resor med övernattning kan förekomma samt även beredskap.

Administrativa uppgifter som ingår i tjänsten är bland annat handläggning av ordrar, skriva servicerapporter samt hantering av in- och ut leveranser.

Du blir en del av våra team som präglas av god stämning och sammanhållning. Vi ser fram emot att välkomna ytterligare en kollega.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som gillar att skruva, meka och lösa tekniska problem. Vi tror att du har läst ett tekniskt program på gymnasiet eller vidareutbildat dig inom området. Alternativt att du har erfarenhet av praktiskt verkstads- och fältarbete. Har du erfarenhete av svets arbeten och elinstallationer är det bra oxå. Du innehar körkortsbehörighet B och har ett genuint intresse för mekanik och teknik.

Det är meriterande om du har:

• Branschvana

• Erfarenhet av SAP eller liknande affärssystem

• Truckkort

• Certifikat i heta arbeten

• Kunskaper inom el samt styr- och reglerteknik

Som person ser vi att du är engagerad och driven. Du är praktiskt lagd och tycker det är roligt att hitta tekniska lösningar. För dig är det enkelt att prata med både kollegor och kunder samtidigt som du jobbar strukturerat.

På Sulzer finns goda möjligheter till att utvecklas och växa i rollen så tveka inte - det kan vara här som din resa startar!

Ansökningsförfarande

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på 100%, provanställning tillämpas. Vi tillämpar löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut. Missa inte chansen och ansök redan idag!

What we offer you

• Friskvårdsbidrag 3000kr/år (E-passi)

• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning

• Gratis kaffe och frukt

• Företagshälsovård med regelbundna hälsokontroller

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer Pumps Sweden AB söker rentaltekniker! Vi söker nu flera engagerad och lösningsorienterad Rentaltekniker till vårt team i Stockholm, Malmö och Göteborg – är det du?

Vi på Sulzer växer och satsar på framtiden, därför söker vi en eller flera engagerade och drivna Rentaltekniker med specialintresse för VA. Vill du arbeta i en varierad roll med Fältservice, Verkstadsreparationer, lagerarbete och teknisk problemlösning? Då kan det här vara jobbet för dig!

• Är serviceinriktad, noggrann och självgående.

• Det är meriterande om du har en elutbildning eller grundläggande elkunskaper.

• Har grundläggande datavana

• Gillar att arbeta under eget ansvar

• Vill bidra till gruppens & bolagets utveckling

• Är praktiskt & serviceinriktad lagd

• Gillar problemlösning

• Trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och i team

Krav:

• B-körkort

• Truckkort

• Har grundläggande kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift

• En arbetsplats med framåtanda och fokus på tillväxt & utveckling

• Ett fritt och omväxlande arbete med stor möjlighet att påverka din vardag

• Goda möjligheter till utbildning och personlig utveckling

• Kollektivavtal och bra villkor

jobs.title: Helper Mechanic - Night Shift
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
This position is responsible for assisting in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery under close supervision. This entry-level role supports senior mechanics in diagnosing issues, performing basic repairs, and ensuring equipment is safe and operational.

This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration. Helper Mechanic - Night Shift

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
· Primary Functions:
o Have and maintain ability to use and operate forklifts
o Observe Company Safety Policy and Procedures; follow and support all STS Safety Policies and ISO Procedures
o Be on the job site and in your assigned work area at the scheduled time
o Must be self-motivated and willing to learn
o Handle departments’ recycling and removing of all trash on a daily basis
o Assure all cables, shackles, straps and chains are put away daily
o Keep work area clean and well organized during all phases of the project
o Work closely and clearly communicate with the other departments, including all Supervisors, Managers, Leadmen
and hourly personnel
o General cleanup of departments change room / restroom facilities
o Provide assistance to Core departments as required
o Must follow the STS dress code and maintain a professional appearance at all times
o Maintain LEAN objections within the department
o Perform specialized task as required
o Maintain accurate time sheets on a daily basis
o Complete company-required training programs

· Secondary Functions/
• Requirements:
o Steam clean and wash parts in the Wash Bay
o Transport equipment and parts around department and between departments
o Use PPE as identified in risk assessments or other related safety documents
o Do not undertake activities that have not been risk assessed, or where an assessment is not available or
understood
o Report any instances of spillage, uncontrolled exposure or other related safety issues to their line manager
o Ensure the correct use of waste segregation facilities and the efficient use of natural resources and raw materials
o Must be able to work overtime when necessary

What we offer you

Paid parental leave
Parental leave
Health insurance
401(k) matching
Paid time off
Vision insurance
Health savings account
Dental insurance
Gym membership
Employee assistance program
Disability insurance
401(k) 6% Match
Paid holidays
Wellness program

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Project Buyer with Supply Chain mindset to Nordic Water Products AB

You are a proactive and self-driven purchasing professional with experience from project-driven manufacturing or industrial environments. You combine strong analytical skills with commercial awareness and technical understanding, enabling you to manage complex sourcing activities and support successful project execution.

You have experience in project purchasing, supplier negotiations, and supply chain management, and are comfortable working closely with project managers, engineering, production, and suppliers. You take ownership, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a role with a high degree of independence.

As a person, you are a collaborative team player who builds strong relationships, drives continuous improvement, and delivers results in a dynamic environment.

To succeed in this role, you have:

• Experience in project purchasing within manufacturing or industrial businesses

• Strong negotiation and supplier management skills

• An analytical and structured approach to problem-solving

• Technical understanding and commercial acumen

• Knowledge of industrial manufacturing processes, sheet metal fabrication and stainless-steel products is meritorious

• A proactive mindset, ability to work independently, and strong teamwork skills

• Fluent in Swedish and English, both spoken and written

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining commercial responsibility, technical challenges, and project-driven work in a dynamic international environment.

Place of employment: Helsingborg

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Daniel Bogren, Head of Procurement at Nordic Water on 070-403 25 26 or daniel.bogren@sulzer.com

Sounds interesting? Send your application via the link below. As the selection process will take place on an ongoing basis, we want your application as soon as possible.

• Wellnes Allowance 3000kr/year (E-passi)

• Collea – Free pension and insurance advice

• Free coffee and fruit

• Occupational health services with regular health check-ups

jobs.title: Junior Pump Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Under limited supervision, performs all necessary tasks in the repair and maintenance of Sulzer Pumps’ and all other manufacturers’ pumping equipment while strictly adhering to customer, OEM and industry standard specifications. Follows department policy and procedures manual. Key Responsibilities

• Assembling all types of pump equipment to customer, OEM and industry standard specifications

• Disassembling equipment to gain access remove, clean and inspect components

• Inspecting & recording component measurements using instruments, tools and gages and providing inspection report

• Investigating and determining root cause failure

• Determining proper materials for repairs as per BOM

• Contouring impellers and pump casings to meet hydraulic requirements

• Setting and operating dynamic balancing equipment

• Performing final testing and inspections

Qualifications / Requirements

• Analytical and interpersonal skills

• Attention to detail

• Extensive knowledge of and ability to use hand tools, precision measuring and testing equipment and machine shop equipment

• Ability to work with limited supervision

• Ability to travel to and work at customer sites

• Ability to work overtime

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holiday

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Gas Compressor Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we specialise in delivering top-tier service to our customers across the oil & gas, power generation, and renewable sectors. With our recent £1 million investment, our Ellon facility is now a Centre of Excellence, providing cutting-edge support for electric motors, pumps, gearboxes, and turbo-compressors. We are looking for a skilled Gas Compressor Technician to join our team.

As a Gas Compressor Technician, you will be working directly on the repair, overhaul, and maintenance of gas compressors. You will play a key role in ensuring that our customers' equipment is serviced to the highest standards, meeting industry specifications and maintaining operational efficiency Your Main Tasks and Responsibilities:

• Disassembling, inspecting, and rebuilding gas compressors and their components

• Diagnosing and repairing mechanical faults in a variety of compressor types

• Precision fitting, machining, and assembly work as required

• Performing dynamic and functional testing on overhauled equipment

• Collaborating with engineering and quality teams to ensure compliance with technical specifications

• Maintaining a clean and safe working environment in line with HSE requirements

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Experience in the overhaul and maintenance of gas compressors or similar rotating equipment

• Proficiency in mechanical fitting, assembly, and fault diagnosis

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical manuals

• Good communication skills and a proactive attitude to teamwork

• Awareness of Health, Safety, and Environmental regulations

What we offer you

• Competitive basic salary.

• 33 days of annual leave.

• Defined pension contribution.

• Confidential support and guidance through our Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to a wide range of discounts on everyday shopping, entertainment, and lifestyle.

• Discounted Personal Car Leasing - available for you, your family, and friends.

• Long Service Awards to celebrate your dedication.

• Ongoing learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• Free and secure onsite parking, with electric charging facilities.

• We're proud to support those who've served. Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoDs Defence Employer Recognition Scheme meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, innovation and excellence are at the heart of everything we do. Our Ellon Service Centre is one of Sulzer's flagship rotating equipment service facilities, providing world-class repair, maintenance and engineering solutions for critical turbomachinery and gas compression equipment across a wide range of industries.

As the Technical Focal Point for Gas Compression, you will serve as the first point of contact for technical guidance relating to gas compression equipment and workshop procedures. You will work closely with customers, workshop personnel, field service teams and engineering colleagues to deliver technically sound recommendations and exceptional customer support.

This is a highly visible role requiring strong technical knowledge, excellent communication skills and a customer-focused approach. Your Responsibilities

• Act as the primary technical focal point for gas compression activities within the service centre.

• Provide technical guidance to workshop teams regarding repair methods, procedures and best practices.

• Support the wider engineering team in determining the optimum approach to work execution.

• Provide troubleshooting expertise for complex repair and operational issues.

• Liaise closely with engineering colleagues and other technical specialists when required.

• Attend customer meetings as the technical representative for gas compression projects.

• Accompany customers during witness testing activities, providing technical advice and support.

• Present technical findings, recommendations and repair solutions to customers.

• Build strong customer relationships through professional technical support and expertise.

• Review workshop findings and provide recommendations for repair solutions.

• Participate in failure investigations within Sulzer service centres and at customer sites.

• Deliver technical advice, coaching and training to internal teams where required.

What You Bring

Qualifications

• HNC, HND or Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience & Technical Knowledge

• Significant experience with gas compression equipment.

• Previous engineering experience within rotating equipment, turbomachinery or related industries.

• Understanding of vibration analysis and machinery diagnostics.

• Experience preparing technical reports and presenting engineering recommendations.

• Knowledge of repair methodologies and failure investigation practices.

Skills & Behaviours

• Strong influencing and persuasion skills.

• Comfortable engaging with customers and presenting technical information.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to interact at all levels.

• Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Effective time management skills with flexibility to adapt to changing business demands.

• High attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams.

• Competent user of Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and Outlook.

• Committed to adhering to company standards, procedures and safety requirements.

Travel Requirements
The successful candidate must be willing to travel to customer sites and Sulzer locations as required, both within the UK and occasionally internationally.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Annual bonus scheme

• Car/Car Allowance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco member

• Esperienza significativa con apparecchiature di compressione del gas.

• Esperienza ingegneristica precedente all'interno di attrezzature rotanti, turbomacchine o industrie correlate.

• Comprensione dell'analisi delle vibrazioni e della diagnostica dei macchinari.

• Esperienza nella preparazione di relazioni tecniche e presentazione di raccomandazioni ingegneristiche.

jobs.title: Repair Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Acts as the liaison between the customer, sales, vendors, engineering, and production departments. Determines and provides detailed cost summaries and quotations for repair jobs in the service center. Coordinates repair by providing Work Instructions that include all pertinent information needed to process the repair through the service center meeting ISO requirements.
Key Responsibilities

• Reviews customer requirement for pump repair

• Analyzes inspection results, works with shop personnel and Area Superintendent to determine scope of work required for repairs

• Plans repairs (labor hours, purchase requirements, work instructions, and total cost)

• Generates repair quotes

• Completes disassembly, inspection, repair, and assembly work instruction packages, (work orders, prints, procedures, inspection forms).

• Make/ review sketches and drawings to ISO standard and in AutoCAD where required.

• Completes purchase requisitions. Consults with vendors to determine availability, quality, quantity, and best pricing of all materials relative to a given job.

• Evaluates supplier quotations and determines acceptable quality, quantity, and pricing requirements to meet commitments made to customers.

• When necessary, expedite parts and materials from suppliers to ensure delivery commitments are met.

• As applicable, prepare and facilitate all inbound/ outbound shipping related tasks required for the final transportation of repairs. This may include all shipping, import, and export documentation as required.

• Manage projects to meet tender and order cycle time objectives for the service center.

• To ensure compliance with customer commitments and overall master schedule communicates regularly with all departments to keep them abreast of coordination activities

• All work is performed by ISO and OSHAS requirements

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and EHS Management system which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Support and cooperate in company-wide improvement initiatives.

• Perform root cause analysis on pump failures

• Perform basic material selections for repair projects

• Perform engineering calculations per industry and Sulzer standards

• Performs other duties as assigned

Qualifications / Requirements

• Strong organizational, interpersonal and analytical skills.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills; including diplomacy and negotiation skills

• Solid knowledge of all manufacturing and shop processes related to repair of pumps and manufacturing of pump parts and or closely related equipment required

• Strong PC skills, with proficiency in Microsoft software

• Working experience and knowledge of ERP systems required. Previous SAP experience strongly desired but not critical.

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering is preferred

• Experience in closely related roles is preferred.

• Technical knowledge of pump design and repair, and fit form and functions of components is preferred.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Recensioni requisito del cliente per la riparazione della pompa
• Analizza i risultati dell'ispezione, lavora con il personale del negozio e il sovrintendente dell'area per determinare la portata del lavoro richiesto per le riparazioni
• Piani di riparazione (orario di lavoro, requisiti di acquisto, istruzioni di lavoro e costo totale)
• Genera le citazioni di riparazione

• Gestire i progetti per soddisfare gli obiettivi del ciclo di gara e di ordine per il centro di servizio.
• Per garantire la conformità con gli impegni del cliente e il programma generale di master comunica regolarmente con tutti i dipartimenti per tenerli al passo delle attività di coordinamento
• Tutto il lavoro è eseguito dai requisiti ISO e OSHAS
• Supporta, collabora e partecipa al sistema aziendale LEAN e EHS Management, che include tutte le politiche e procedure in materia di sicurezza, salute e ambiente. Sostegno e cooperazione in iniziative di miglioramento a livello aziendale.
• Eseguire l'analisi della causa radice sui guasti della pompa
• Eseguire le selezioni dei materiali di base per i progetti di riparazione
• Eseguire calcoli di ingegneria per l'industria e gli standard Sulzer
• Esegui altri compiti assegnati Qualifiche / Requisiti
• Forte capacità organizzative, interpersonali e analitiche.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta; tra cui la diplomazia e le competenze di negoziazione
• Conoscenza solida di tutti i processi produttivi e commerciali relativi alla riparazione di pompe e produzione di parti della pompa e o attrezzature strettamente correlate richieste
• Forte capacità del PC, con competenza nel software Microsoft
• Esperienza di lavoro e conoscenza dei sistemi ERP richiesti. Precedente esperienza SAP fortemente desiderato ma non critico.
• Laurea in ingegneria meccanica è preferito
• L'esperienza in ruoli strettamente correlati è preferito.
• La conoscenza tecnica della progettazione e riparazione della pompa, e la forma e le funzioni di componenti è preferita. Cosa ti offriamo

jobs.title: Manual Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As a Manual Machinist you will be responsible for setting up and operating machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore parts to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. You will interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and perform precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. You will measure components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Key Responsibilities

• Performing layouts, setting up and operating conventional machine tools as required

• Reading and interpreting all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing

• Designing setup methods where none exist

• Instructing other shop personnel on proper machining techniques

• Continually improving methods to deliver higher quality with improved costs

Qualifications / Requirements

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections

• Ability to set up machine tools: ID / OD Grinders, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, Radial Drill, Planer Mill

• Four years of experience in machine shop operations

• Willingness to work in a team environment

• Openness to working overtime as required

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
