jobs.title: Global BU Operations Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As Global BU Operations Controller , you will drive and coordinate operational controlling activities across our global manufacturing footprint, acting as a trusted business partner to Operations leadership. You will provide financial insights, performance analysis, and strategic guidance to support decision-making, while leading the Operations Controlling team and ensuring alignment with business objectives.

In this role you will:

• Drive operational and cost analysis for the BU at the Operations (factory) level (be responsible end-to-end for all controlling/business partnering aspects of the BU at Operations level); support cost accounting, assist in actuals and forecast analysis, develop and maintain the overall reporting framework for the BU at Operations level, support the resolution of complex issues, be ultimately responsible for the Controlling team for all factory LEs, support ERP system developments, and ensure compliance with global policies.

• Oversee and coordinate the planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes at Operations level.

• Deliver effective and timely communication to the BU FICO Head and other internal or external stakeholders.

• Create and monitor governance procedures to maintain a core set of management reports (e.g. DOA, control matrix, etc.).

• Be accountable for the production of core finance management reporting and analysis.

• Coordinate with Legal to ensure that risk management policies and procedures are implemented and managed appropriately.

• Identify and manage continuous improvement initiatives for the controlling function.

• Monitor and develop monthly reports for revenues and expenditures of a factory and all factory sites consolidated; manage and steer factory costs; assist in the analysis of NWC balances.

• Perform continuous project improvement analysis, new product development analysis, strategic sourcing analysis, and other ad-hoc analyses.

• Provide production and cost information required to perform the end-to-end financial close and internal reporting process.

• Provide inputs for the planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes for the Finance organization.

• Provide key operational decision-makers with accurate and timely financial information, leading to the minimization of costs and the maximization of profitability.

• Empower the Operations Team to manage the day-to-day aspects of the processes, providing operational steering.

• Liaise with Procurement regarding order intake.

• Allocate resources to the production process.

• Support the GPOs in establishing procedures for the Cost Accounting function, including the selection and implementation of relevant reporting and tools.

• Deliver effective and timely communication on all relevant issues to internal and external stakeholders.

• Identify and manage continuous improvement initiatives for the Cost Accounting function.

• Drive the implementation of DXC and Financial Services within Operational LEs.

To succeed you need:

Experience & Education

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Minimum of 9 years of relevant professional experience in Finance, Controlling, or Business Partnering roles.

• Previous management experience, with a proven ability to lead and develop high-performing teams.

• Prior experience in an Engineering and/or Manufacturing environment is essential.

• Fluent English language skills, both written and spoken.

Skills & Competencies

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels, both internally and externally.

• Strong negotiation, influencing, and presentation skills.

• Excellent analytical capabilities, combined with stron

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Come Global BU Operations Controller , guiderai e coordinerai le attività di controllo operativo attraverso la nostra impronta produttiva globale, agendo come partner commerciale di fiducia nella leadership Operazioni. Fornirai informazioni finanziarie, analisi delle prestazioni e guida strategica per supportare il processo decisionale, mentre guiderai il team Operations Controlling e garantirai l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali.

In questo ruolo sarete:

• Guidare l'analisi operativa e dei costi per la BU a livello Operazioni (fattoria) (essere responsabile end-to-end per tutti gli aspetti di controllo/business partnering della BU a livello Operazioni); sostenere la contabilità dei costi, assistere in effetti e analisi delle previsioni, sviluppare e mantenere il quadro generale di reporting per il BU a livello Operazioni, sostenere la risoluzione di problemi complessi, essere in ultima analisi responsabile per il team di controllo di tutte le LEs di fabbrica, sostenere gli sviluppi del sistema ERP e garantire la conformità a livello globale.

• Controllare e coordinare i processi di pianificazione, di bilancio e di previsione a livello Operazioni.

• Fornisci una comunicazione efficace e tempestiva al BU FICO Head e ad altri stakeholder interni o esterni.

• Creare e monitorare le procedure di governance per mantenere un insieme centrale di rapporti di gestione (ad esempio DOA, matrice di controllo, ecc.).

• Essere responsabile per la produzione di core finanza gestione reporting e analisi.

• Coordinamento con Legale per garantire che le politiche e le procedure di gestione dei rischi siano implementate e gestite in modo appropriato.

• Identificare e gestire iniziative di miglioramento continuo per la funzione di controllo.

• Monitorare e sviluppare relazioni mensili per le entrate e le spese di una fabbrica e di tutti i siti di fabbrica consolidati; gestire e sostenere i costi di fabbrica; assistere nell'analisi dei bilanci NWC.

• Eseguire l'analisi continua del miglioramento del progetto, la nuova analisi dello sviluppo del prodotto, l'analisi strategica di approvvigionamento e altre analisi ad-hoc.

• Fornire informazioni di produzione e di costo necessarie per eseguire il processo di reporting finanziario end-to-end chiuso e interno.

• Fornire input per la pianificazione, il bilancio e i processi di previsione per l'organizzazione Finance.

• Fornire i decisori operativi chiave con informazioni finanziarie accurate e tempestive, portando alla minimizzazione dei costi e alla massimizzazione della redditività.

• Favorire il Team Operazioni per gestire gli aspetti quotidiani dei processi, fornendo sterzo operativo.

• Liaise with Procurement about the order intake.

• Allocare le risorse al processo di produzione.

• Sostenere i GPO nell'elaborazione di procedure per la funzione Accounting Cost, compresa la selezione e l'implementazione di report e strumenti pertinenti.

• Fornisci una comunicazione efficace e tempestiva su tutte le questioni rilevanti per gli stakeholder interni ed esterni.

• Identificare e gestire iniziative di miglioramento continuo per la funzione Cost Accounting.

• Guidare l'implementazione di DXC e servizi finanziari all'interno di LE Operative.

Per avere successo è necessario:

Esperienza e istruzione

• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale, o un campo relativo.

• Minimo di 9 anni di esperienza professionale rilevante nei ruoli di finanza, controllo o Business Partnering.

• Esperienza di gestione precedente, con una comprovata capacità di guidare e sviluppare team di alto livello.

• L'esperienza prioritaria in un ambiente di Ingegneria e/o Produzione è essenziale.

• Capacità linguistiche fluenti, sia scritte che parlate.

Competenze e competenze

• Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali, con la capacità di impegnarsi efficacemente con gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli, sia internamente che esternamente.

• Forte negoziazione, influenza e capacità di presentazione.

• Eccellente capacità analitiche, combinato con stron

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Als Global BU Operations Controller werden Sie die operativen Controlling-Aktivitäten in unserer globalen Fertigung vorantreiben und koordinieren und als vertrauenswürdiger Geschäftspartner für die Unternehmensführung fungieren. Sie bieten finanzielle Einblicke, Leistungsanalysen und strategische Leitlinien zur Unterstützung der Entscheidungsfindung, während Sie das Operations Controlling-Team leiten und die Ausrichtung auf die Geschäftsziele sicherstellen.

In dieser Rolle werden Sie:

• Betriebs- und Kostenanalyse für die BU auf der Ebene des Betriebs (Fabrik) vorantreiben (Ende-zu-Ende für alle Controlling- / Business-Partnering-Aspekte der BU auf Betriebsebene verantwortlich sein); Kostenrechnung unterstützen, bei der Ist- und Prognoseanalyse unterstützen, den gesamten Berichtsrahmen für die BU auf Betriebsebene entwickeln und pflegen, die Lösung komplexer Probleme unterstützen, letztlich für das Controlling-Team für alle Werks-LEs verantwortlich sein, ERP-Systementwicklungen unterstützen und die Einhaltung globaler Richtlinien sicherstellen.

• Beaufsichtigen und koordinieren Sie die Planungs-, Budgetierungs- und Prognoseprozesse auf operativer Ebene.

• Liefern Sie effektive und zeitnahe Kommunikation an den BU FICO Head und andere interne oder externe Stakeholder.

• Erstellen und Überwachen von Governance-Verfahren, um einen Kernsatz von Managementberichten zu verwalten (z. B. DOA, Kontrollmatrix usw.).

• Seien Sie rechenschaftspflichtig für die Erstellung von Berichten und Analysen zum Kernfinanzmanagement.

• Koordination mit Legal, um sicherzustellen, dass Risikomanagementrichtlinien und -verfahren angemessen umgesetzt und verwaltet werden.

• Identifizieren und verwalten Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen für die Controlling-Funktion.

• Überwachung und Entwicklung monatlicher Berichte über Einnahmen und Ausgaben einer Fabrik und aller Fabrikstandorte konsolidiert; Verwaltung und Steuerung der Fabrikkosten; Unterstützung bei der Analyse der NWC-Salden.

• Führen Sie kontinuierliche Projektverbesserungsanalysen, neue Produktentwicklungsanalysen, strategische Beschaffungsanalysen und andere Ad-hoc-Analysen durch.

• Bereitstellung von Produktions- und Kosteninformationen, die für die Durchführung des End-to-End-Finanzabschlusses und des internen Berichterstattungsprozesses erforderlich sind.

• Geben Sie Inputs für die Planungs-, Budgetierungs- und Prognoseprozesse für die Finanzorganisation.

• Geben Sie wichtigen operativen Entscheidungsträgern genaue und zeitnahe Finanzinformationen, die zur Kostenminimierung und Maximierung der Rentabilität führen.

• Befähigen Sie das Operations-Team, die täglichen Aspekte der Prozesse zu verwalten und die operative Steuerung bereitzustellen.

• Verbindung mit der Beschaffung bezüglich des Auftragseingangs.

• Weisen Sie Ressourcen dem Produktionsprozess zu.

• Unterstützung der GPOs bei der Einrichtung von Verfahren für die Kostenrechnungsfunktion, einschließlich der Auswahl und Umsetzung einschlägiger Berichte und Tools.

• Bereitstellung einer effektiven und zeitnahen Kommunikation zu allen relevanten Themen für interne und externe Stakeholder.

• Identifizieren und verwalten Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen für die Kostenrechnungsfunktion.

• Fahren Sie die Implementierung von DXC und Financial Services innerhalb von Operational LEs.

Um erfolgreich zu sein, benötigen Sie:

Erfahrung & Bildung

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Mindestens 9 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung in Finanz-, Controlling- oder Geschäftspartnerrollen.

• Vorherige Managementerfahrung, mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, leistungsstarke Teams zu führen und zu entwickeln.

• Vorkenntnisse in einer Engineering- und / oder Fertigungsumgebung sind unerlässlich.

• Fließende Englischkenntnisse, sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen.

Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen

• Hervorragende Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, sich effektiv mit Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen zu beschäftigen, sowohl intern als auch extern.

• Starke Verhandlungs-, Einfluss- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten.

• Hervorragende analytische Fähigkeiten, kombiniert mit Stron
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

En tant que contrôleur d'exploitation BU mondial , vous piloterez et coordonnerez les activités de contrôle opérationnel sur notre empreinte de fabrication mondiale, agissant en tant que partenaire d'affaires de confiance pour le leadership des opérations. Vous fournirez des renseignements financiers, des analyses de rendement et des conseils stratégiques pour appuyer la prise de décisions, tout en dirigeant l'équipe de contrôle des opérations et en assurant l'alignement avec les objectifs opérationnels.

Dans ce rôle, vous:

• Diriger l'analyse opérationnelle et des coûts pour l'UB au niveau des opérations (usine) (être responsable de bout en bout de tous les aspects de contrôle/partenariat d'affaires de l'UB au niveau des opérations); appuyer la comptabilité des coûts, aider à l'analyse des résultats réels et des prévisions, élaborer et maintenir le cadre général de rapport pour l'UB au niveau des opérations, appuyer la résolution de problèmes complexes, être responsable en dernier ressort de l'équipe de contrôle de tous les LE des usines, appuyer l'élaboration du système de PGI et assurer le respect des politiques mondiales.

• Superviser et coordonner les processus de planification, de budgétisation et de prévision au niveau des opérations.

• Communiquer efficacement et en temps opportun avec le chef du BU FICO et d'autres intervenants internes ou externes.

• Créer et surveiller des procédures de gouvernance pour maintenir un ensemble de rapports de gestion de base (p. ex. DOA, matrice de contrôle, etc.).

• Être responsable de la production de rapports et d'analyses sur la gestion financière de base.

• Coordonner avec Legal pour s'assurer que les politiques et les procédures de gestion des risques sont mises en oeuvre et gérées de façon appropriée.

• Identifier et gérer les initiatives d'amélioration continue pour la fonction de contrôle.

• Surveiller et élaborer des rapports mensuels sur les recettes et les dépenses d'une usine et de tous les sites d'usine regroupés; gérer et orienter les coûts d'usine; aider à l'analyse des soldes des CDN.

• Effectuer une analyse continue de l'amélioration des projets, une analyse du développement de nouveaux produits, une analyse stratégique de l'approvisionnement et d'autres analyses ponctuelles.

• Fournir l'information sur la production et les coûts nécessaires pour effectuer le processus de clôture financière et de rapport interne de bout en bout.

• Fournir des contributions pour les processus de planification, de budgétisation et de prévision de l'organisation financière.

• Fournir aux principaux décideurs opérationnels des renseignements financiers exacts et opportuns, ce qui permettra de réduire au minimum les coûts et de maximiser la rentabilité.

• Autoriser l'équipe des opérations à gérer les aspects quotidiens des processus, en assurant la direction opérationnelle.

• Assurer la liaison avec l'approvisionnement concernant la réception des commandes.

• Attribuer des ressources au processus de production.

• Aider les administrateurs généraux à établir des procédures pour la fonction de comptabilité des coûts, y compris le choix et la mise en œuvre des rapports et des outils pertinents.

• Communiquer efficacement et en temps opportun toutes les questions pertinentes aux intervenants internes et externes.

• Déterminer et gérer les initiatives d'amélioration continue pour la fonction de comptabilité des coûts.

• Diriger la mise en oeuvre de DXC et de services financiers au sein des LE opérationnels.

Pour réussir, vous avez besoin :

Expérience et éducation

• Baccalauréat en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires, ou un domaine connexe.

• Au moins 9 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente en finance, en contrôle ou en partenariat d'affaires.

• Expérience de gestion antérieure, avec une capacité éprouvée de diriger et de développer des équipes hautement performantes.

• Une expérience préalable dans un environnement de génie et/ou de fabrication est essentielle.

• Compétences linguistiques en anglais, à la fois écrites et parlées.

Compétences

• Excellentes compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles, avec la capacité de dialoguer efficacement avec les intervenants à tous les niveaux, à l'interne et à l'externe.

• Forte capacité de négociation, d'influence et de présentation.

• Excellentes capacités analytiques, combinées avec du stron

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction.
This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Key
• Responsibilities

Provide technical support during the sales process.
Conduct product demonstrations and presentations.
Collaborate with engineering and product teams.
Customize solutions based on client requirements.
Assist in proposal development and contract negotiations.
Support post-sales implementation and troubleshooting.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of products and technologies.

Skills &
• Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least of 5-7 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

Technical background in engineering or related field.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Experience in solution selling.
Ability to translate technical features into business benefits.
Familiarity with CRM and technical documentation tools.

What we offer you

Hvem er vi tenker du? Og hva kan vi tilby akkurat deg?
Sulzer er en stor og stabil arbeidsgiver, og samtidig har vi et lokalt miljø som er liten og dynamisk.
Sulzer er kjent for produkter med høy kvalitet, har en solid ordrereserve, egne fabrikker, og er en ledende aktør i en bærekraftig og livsnødvendig industri.

Ansatte hos oss har stor påvirkningskraft på egen hverdag og bedriftens retning. Sulzer tilbyr et hyggelig miljø med høy yrkesstolthet og faglig tyngde. Vi har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, og fleksible arbeidstidsordninger, og ikke minst gode muligheter for videreutvikling internt og eksternt i Sulzer-systemet. jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join our Group Legal Team in Winterthur and contribute your expertise to a global, publicly listed industrial company. In this highly visible role, you will report directly to the Head Group Legal / Deputy General Counsel and act as a trusted legal advisor to senior leadership and key corporate functions across the Group.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead and coordinate the legal workstream of domestic and cross-border M&A transactions, including acquisitions, divestments, joint ventures and other strategic investments, working closely with internal stakeholders and external advisors

• Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of complex commercial agreements, including, joint venture arrangements, technology agreements, sales terms and conditions, and procurement and supply contracts

• Advise on financing transactions, including bond issuances, syndicated and bilateral credit facilities, and provide legal support to the Treasury function on a wide range of financing-related matters

• Oversee and coordinate litigation, arbitration and other dispute resolution matters across the Group, including the management of external counsel

• Oversee the preparation and execution of Annual General Meetings and contribute to the legal review of the Company's Annual Report and Non-Financial Report

• Support the Head Group Legal / Corporate Secretary in matters relating to the Board of Directors, its committees and the Executive Committee

Your profile:

• Master of Law degree and Swiss Bar admission

• Minimum of 5+ years of relevant post-qualification experience, ideally gained in a leading law firm and/or the legal department of an international industrial company

• Demonstrated experience in M&A and Swiss corporate law, ideally complemented by exposure to antitrust and sanction law as well as capital markets and stock exchange regulations

• Business-oriented legal professional with strong judgment, a pragmatic mindset and the ability to balance legal risks with commercial objectives

• Excellent project and stakeholder management skills, with experience interacting confidently with senior executives, Board members and key external stakeholders

• Digitally savvy, with a strong interest in technology, AI-enabled solutions and modern ways of working

What we offer you

• An innovative, vibrant and agile culture

• Excellent social benefits (holidays, pension fund etc.)

• Access to a wide range of discounts on Everyday Shopping, Entertainment and Lifestyle

• Central workplace, only 5 minutes from Winterthur train station

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Head of Product, Solution & Segment Marketing

titleByLocale.en: Head of Product, Solution & Segment Marketing

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join Sulzer’s global Marketing team and shape how a CHF 3.5 billion industrial leader positions its solutions across the world’s most critical markets.
We are seeking a senior and strategic Head of Product & Solution Marketing to lead how Sulzer’s portfolio of pumps, separation technologies, services and sustainability solutions is positioned and activated globally. This role will drive commercial growth by developing compelling value propositions, leading go-to-market strategy and enabling Sales across Flow, Services and Chemtech.

You will own the product marketing agenda — spanning portfolio positioning, solution launches, sales enablement and market intelligence — while building a high-performing team and embedding a customer-centric, insight-driven culture across the marketing function.
In this role you will be accountable for:

Product & Solution Marketing Strategy and Plan

• Define and own the global product and solution marketing strategy, aligned with Sulzer’s corporate strategy and divisional and BU priorities across Flow, Services and Chemtech

• Develop clear value propositions and positioning frameworks for core product lines including pumps, separation technologies, rotating equipment services, bioplastics (PLA) and digital monitoring

• Lead One Sulzer targeting for priority verticals: water/wastewater, oil & gas, chemical processing, energy, food & beverage, and green hydrogen

• Translate Sulzer’s sustainability narrative — decarbonisation, green hydrogen, CCUS, circular economy — into credible, differentiated market positioning

Marketing Execution

• Lead the marketing of solution launch plans for new products, technologies and market entries, coordinating across divisions, regions and functions

• Ensure consistent and compelling positioning across all customer-facing channels: digital, events, sales tools, technical literature and campaigns

• Partner with Sales and Commercial Excellence to develop sales enablement materials, competitive battlecards, customer case studies, ROI tools and technical value-selling content

• Drive differentiated messaging for Sulzer’s aftermarket and service offerings, leveraging the expanding global service network and long-term customer partnerships

• Define yearly marketing plans and lead execution of marketing campaigns in alignment w regional and digital marketing

Marketing Insights

• Work closely with Product Management to influence roadmap priorities based on market trends, customer needs and competitive dynamics

• Monitor developments in decarbonisation, industrial digitalisation and sustainable process technologies to identify positioning opportunities

Team Leadership & Capability Development

• Lead, inspire and develop a team of product and solution marketers across geographies, fostering a culture of commercial creativity, analytical rigour and customer centricity

• Set clear goals, KPIs and development plans for direct reports; build capability in product storytelling, digital marketing and data-driven decision-making

• Establish best-practice processes for product launch, content development and campaign execution across divisions

Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Act as the key marketing interface with Division Presidents, BU & Region Heads, VP Sales and Product Management leaders across Flow, Services and Chemtech

• Work closely with Corporate Communications to integrate product and solution narratives into employer brand, investor messaging and corporate reputation activities

• Collaborate with Digital Marketing and Regional marketing to ensure solution content is optimised for digital channels, SEO and lead generation; manage external agencies and specialist content partners

• Piombo Uno Sulzer mirante per i verticali prioritari: acqua/acqua, petrolio e gas, lavorazione chimica, energia, cibo e bevande, e idrogeno verde

• Tradurre la narrativa di sostenibilità di Sulzer — decarbonizzazione, idrogeno verde, CCUS, economia circolare — in posizione di mercato credibile e differenziato

Esecuzione del marketing

• Guidare la commercializzazione dei piani di lancio di soluzioni per nuovi prodotti, tecnologie e voci di mercato, coordinando tra divisioni, regioni e funzioni

• Partner con Vendite ed Eccellenza Commerciale per sviluppare materiali di abilitazione delle vendite, cartoline da battaglia competitive, studi sui casi dei clienti, strumenti ROI e contenuti tecnici di vendita del valore

• Guida messaggi differenziati per le offerte di post-vendita e servizi di Sulzer, sfruttando l'espansione della rete di servizi globale e partnership con clienti a lungo termine

• Definire piani di marketing annuali e condurre l'esecuzione di campagne di marketing in allineamento con il marketing regionale e digitale

Insights di marketing

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con la Product Management per influenzare le priorità della roadmap in base alle tendenze del mercato, alle esigenze dei clienti e alle dinamiche competitive

• Monitorare gli sviluppi della decarbonizzazione, della digitalizzazione industriale e delle tecnologie di processo sostenibili per individuare le opportunità di posizionamento

Leadership del team & Capability Development

• Leader, ispirare e sviluppare un team di marketing di prodotti e soluzioni attraverso geografie, promuovendo una cultura della creatività commerciale, rigore analitico e centricità dei clienti

• Impostare obiettivi chiari, KPI e piani di sviluppo per rapporti diretti; costruire capacità nella narrazione dei prodotti, nel marketing digitale e nel processo decisionale basato sui dati

• Stabilire processi best practice per il lancio del prodotto, lo sviluppo dei contenuti e l'esecuzione delle campagne attraverso le divisioni

Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Atto come l'interfaccia di marketing chiave con i presidenti di Divisione, i capi BU & Region, i leader VP Sales e Product Management di Flow, Services e Chemtech

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con Corporate Communications per integrare le narrazioni di prodotto e di soluzione nel marchio datore di lavoro, messaggistica degli investitori e attività di reputazione aziendale

• Collaborare con Digital Marketing e Regional Marketing per garantire che i contenuti delle soluzioni siano ottimizzati per i canali digitali, SEO e lead generation; gestire agenzie esterne e partner specializzati

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Position Summary

Sulzer is a non-OEM rotating equipment repair facility located in the Houston area. Sulzer is comprised of several divisions that include the Component Repair Division. Departments within the Component Repair division include Combustion, Stationary, Mechanical, Rotating, Fuel/Flow and Inspection departments. Each department is dedicated to refurbishment of gas turbine components and sub-assembly parts. The Gas Turbine Component Repair Project Engineer is responsible for developing inspection and repair workscopes for stationary and rotating gas turbine components and managing multiple repair projects from receipt through delivery. The engineer works closely with operations, sales and external vendors to define repair methods, generate purchase orders, control cost, and resolve technical issues throughout the repair cycle. Responsibilities

• Develop estimates for overhauls of gas turbine components.
· Generate repair quotations and work scopes using Dynamics 365(hours & material).
· Inspection and repair work scope development, review, evaluation, and periodic adjustment.
· Collaborate with the component engineering team and department supervisor to develop, refine, and optimize fixturing and tooling designs.
· Reverse engineering and part design improvement.
· Develop customer specific and driven scopes.
· Evaluate inspection results for rotating and stationary gas turbine components (e.g., buckets, nozzles, shrouds, casings)
· Creation of incoming and outgoing disposition reports ensuring technical accuracy.
· Creation and development of inspection and repair forms, repair specifications, written process specification, and component drawings (2D/3D prints and models).
· Work with department supervisor and shop technicians to ensure process, repair, and tooling viability. As well as to optimize, refine and streamline production workflow.

• Project Management: Manage multiple projects using Microsoft Project to meet departments monthly deliverables and budget targets.
· Order materials for jobs – Specify material from vendors – Write Purchase Orders.
· Develop industry knowledge about competition, vendors, and gas turbine advancements applicable to Sulzer’s business.
· Work with inside and outside sales representatives to provide technical support during customer meetings.
· Work with the component engineering group to develop and maintain drawings, inspection forms and prints.
· Work on and manage special projects per manager’s instructions.
· Develop tooling, processes, documentation, and specifications for flow testing IGT components.
· Help maintain and improve flow test equipment.
· Attend bid meetings / Interact with Customers.
· In-shop (and at times off-site) evaluation and reporting on components.
Qualifications:
The ideal candidate will possess the following:
· Bachelor's degree in engineering, Sciences, or related field / equivalent experience and training.
· Knowledge in rotating/stationary equipment repairs or similar machinery.

• Proficiency in all MS office software; particularly with Excel and Project.

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced shop environment.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
· Be knowledgeable of and enforce safety in all aspects and areas of the position, and with fellow co-workers throughout Sulzer’s various environments, includes those of our customers and vendors.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the streng

jobs.title: Senior Business Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Senior Business Controller services as the primary financial liasion between local manufacturing operations and the Center of Excellence (CoE), ensuring seamless coordination and effective execution of key financial and project management activities. This position has responsibility for all of Latin America. Key Responsibilities:

• Overseeing the accuracy and productivity of day-to-day activities for inventory management, backlog tracking, customer order profitability, and utilization metrics.

• Leading strategic planning to align sales and operations, large captial projects, and working capital planning.

• Managing and tracking capital and operating projects, including billing and revenue recognition to ensure financial objectives are met.

• Develop the annual budget and manage detailed financial planning for country-specific operations

• Refresh rolling forecasts to reflect changing business and economic conditions

• Perform plan analytics to identify risks and opportunitites, develop risk management strategies, and provide actionable insights to mitigate financial risks.

• Define costing outcomes, develop cost frameworks, and ensure accurate cost control with a focus on optimizing local operations.

What you bring:

• University degree in Finance or Accoutning

• Proven track record in inventory management, cost control, and project management

• At least 7 years of experience with Controlling in a manufacturing or industrial enviroment.

• Strong understanding of cost controlling, budgeting, and financial planning.

• Experience with SAP

• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus

jobs.title: Press Brake Operator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Fabricator / Press Brake Operator to join our manufacturing team. This position is primarily responsible for operating NC Press Brake to produce high-quality stainless-steel components according to engineering drawings and specifications. The ideal candidate will also assist with a variety of fabrication tasks, including operating a manual shear, rolling machine, drill press, and metal cutting saws. Key Responsibilities

• Set up and operate NC press brake equipment to form stainless steel sheet metal components.

• Read, interpret, and follow engineering drawings, blueprints, work instructions, and specifications.

• Measure, mark, and lay out cuts and bends on metal materials accurately.

• Operate a manual shear machine to cut metal to required dimensions.

• Use hand and power tools, including angle grinders and deburring tools, to finish fabricated parts.

• Operate fabrication equipment such as:
• Metal rolling machines

• Drill presses

• Large band saws and/or cold saws

• Other sheet metal fabrication equipment as needed

• Inspect finished parts to ensure they meet dimensional and quality requirements.

• Perform basic machine setup, tooling changes, and routine equipment maintenance.

• Maintain an organized and safe work area.

• Follow all company safety procedures and wear required PPE.

• Work collaboratively with supervisors and team members to meet production schedules and quality standards.
Qualifications
Required Skills and Experience

• Previous experience in metal fabrication, sheet metal manufacturing, or press brake operation.

• Ability to read and interpret blueprints, shop drawings, and work orders.

• Strong understanding of measurement tools, including tape measures, calipers, squares, and other precision measuring instruments.

• Experience measuring, marking, and laying out material for fabrication.

• Ability to safely operate fabrication and metalworking equipment.

• Experience using hand and power tools, including angle grinders.

• Basic mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with stainless steel sheet metal.

• Experience setting up and operating NC or CNC press brakes.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Sr. Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including journal entries, reconciliations, and financial reporting. This role ensures compliance with accounting standards and supports audits and month-end close activities. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Le comptable senior apporte son soutien à l'équipe financière dans le cadre de diverses tâches et responsabilités. Il est chargé de gérer la comptabilité de l'ensemble du processus « Record to Report » (RTR) au sein des sociétés du groupe en France, en veillant à l'exactitude des données et au respect des normes comptables ainsi que des règles internes de Sulzer. En outre, il apporte son soutien aux processus comptables généraux dans les domaines « Purchase to Pay » (PTP) et « Order to Cash » (OTC), lorsque cela est nécessaire.

Participer à la clôture de période, notamment en clôturant le grand livre auxiliaire des comptes clients et fournisseurs et en effectuant le rapprochement avec le grand livre général
Superviser les processus de clôture de fin de mois et de fin d’exercice ; participer à la préparation des écritures comptables, aux rapprochements du bilan et à l’analyse des écarts
Établir des états financiers précis et dans les délais, notamment les comptes de résultat, les bilans et les tableaux de flux de trésorerie
Participer à la saisie comptable des factures sans bon de commande
Assister l’équipe des services financiers partagés dans les activités liées à la gestion des immobilisations
Collaborer étroitement avec l’équipe Reporting & Analytics pour analyser les données financières et fournir des informations sur la performance financière, identifier les tendances et les écarts afin d’étayer les décisions opérationnelles
Assurer la coordination avec les autres services et les équipes des services financiers partagés afin de garantir que toutes les transactions financières sont correctement comptabilisées et reflétées dans le grand livre
Participer aux processus de budgétisation et de prévision, en apportant son expertise sur les aspects financiers et les projections ; collaborer étroitement avec le responsable financier national
Assurer la liaison avec les experts fiscaux afin de garantir l’exactitude et la ponctualité des déclarations fiscales et de la conformité
Suivre les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) afin d’évaluer l’efficacité des processus comptables et de mettre en œuvre des initiatives d’amélioration continue
Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus financiers, en tirant parti des technologies et des meilleures pratiques ; veiller au respect des politiques, procédures et modèles
Fournir des rapports financiers précis et en temps opportun à la direction générale et aux parties prenantes
Veiller à ce que tous les rapports et processus financiers soient conformes aux normes internationales d’information financière (IFRS) et à la réglementation de Sulzer
Assurer la liaison avec les auditeurs et veiller à ce que les audits soient menés à bien avec un minimum d’ajustements
Veiller à ce que des contrôles internes financiers soient en place et respectés pour les processus relevant de cette fonction
Assister le responsable national de la comptabilité dans la gestion des demandes des auditeurs internes et externes et s’assurer que l’équipe comptable fournit les informations requises

• Formation et expérience
Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, gestion d’entreprise ou dans un domaine connexe
Au moins 5 à 7 ans d’expérience en comptabilité, avec une spécialisation marquée dans la comptabilité générale et le reporting financier dans un environnement industrie

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Area Sales Manager (ASM) is the primary external representative of Sulzer to our clients. The ASM is assigned a geographic or product specific sales area and is financially responsible for the Order Intake (OI), Gross Profit Margin (GPM) and Operating Net Cash-Flow (ONCF) of the assigned areas budget for the company. The ASM finds and develops sales opportunities and engages with clients on these thru closure of orders, and until projects have been completed within Sulzer. The ASM will take direction from and meet or exceed sales targets set by the RSM. In this role, the ASM will properly and proactively represent Sulzer to our clients. ASMs engage clients and are expected to be role models for the company within our larger Sulzer community. The ASM will work closely with other Sulzer Turbo teams to include: Inside Sales, Business Process, Operations, Engineering, Finance, QC, Safety and HR to secure, ship and invoice profitable orders. As a Sales Leader, the ASM will also understand, engage with, promote and represent Sulzer’s RES businesses (Pumps and EMS) to provide a full complement of RES Services to the region. ASM Responsibilities

• Meet or exceed the Order Intake budget for the assigned area/product line

• Develop, sell and maintain all business responsibility for the assigned area/product line

• Develop and implement sales strategies consistent with the goals of Sulzer

• Plan, support and monitor sales activity within the area/product line

• Develop and deliver technically and commercially superior proposals to the client

• Support all business activities with the client thru closing and invoicing

• Develop, maintain and report accurate sales forecasts

• Review RFPs, contracts, POs and terms for all business opportunities

• Control all business expenses as if they were your own

• Be proficient with and maintain Salesforce: opportunities, outage tracking and market condition events, trip call reports and competition updates

• Coordinate, plan, attend and execute promotional trade shows events

• Participate in quarterly sales calls or meetings with the management team

• This position requires and expects frequent travel into the area assigned.

• Support Sulzer strategic initiatives on safety, business, ethics and quality.

• Present a positive, proactive, professional attitude and appearance at all times.

ASM Qualifications:

• High personal standards of character. Must have impeccable moral and ethical behavior.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or Business is preferred. In lieu of this, the candidate will have at least 5 years of industry knowledge and experience with Turbomachinery.

• Previously experience of pro-actively influencing or closing business with clients, co-workers and/or commercial peers.

• Commercial and technical knowledge and abilities to perform the external sales position.

• In-depth knowledge of turbomachinery and Sulzer’s complete product line

• Must be able to understand, interpret and discuss technical and commercial documents.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to read, write and discuss micro details and macro situations, as well as the inter-personal skills to interface with personnel from diverse backgrounds at all levels of our clients organization.

• A willingness to travel frequently and bring business back as a result.

• The ASM is a leadership position that requires strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously as well as the ability to willingly work with demanding deadlines

• This position requires and demands exceptional time management skills

• Understanding of basic financial statements

• Proficiency at or the ability to quickly learn how to u

jobs.title: Senior Warranty Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Oversee and resolve warranty claims for pumps, mechanical seals, drivers, and auxiliary systems through technical investigation, root cause analysis, and corrective actions to enhance reliability, reduce warranty costs, and improve customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

• Oversee the complete warranty claim lifecycle from receipt to closure.

• Evaluate warranty entitlement and determine liability based on contractual terms and technical findings.

• Lead claim investigations and Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA).

• Coordinate corrective and preventive actions with Engineering, QA/QC, Production, Procurement, Service, suppliers, and other stakeholders.

• Serve as the primary customer contact for warranty-related matters.

• Maintain clear communication with customers and provide regular claim status updates.

• Participate in customer meetings and present investigation findings and recommendations.

• Conduct site visits, inspections, and troubleshooting activities as required.

• Support field service teams during warranty investigations.

• Monitor warranty costs and support recovery from suppliers when applicable.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and promote lessons learned to prevent recurrence.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering.

• 5–10 years of experience in pumps, rotating equipment, field service, reliability, or warranty management.

• Knowledge of API 610, API686, API 682, and rotating equipment practices is preferred.

• Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCA/RCFA)

• Pump & Mechanical Seal Troubleshooting

• Vibration & operating Data Analysis

• Customer Relationship Management

• Technical Report Writing

• Problem Solving

• Communication & Presentation Skills

• Cross-Functional Collaboration

What we offer you

• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

• A great working environment.

• Work Location: Riyadh- Industrial Area 2

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: RTR Accountant (French Speaker)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a RTR Accountant to join our Accounting team in Spain to help us take our Record to Report (RTR) area to the next level. As an Accountant, you will collaborate with multiple countries and engage with a diverse array of areas stakeholders, including Accounting, Reporting, Analytics, Country Finance Heads, Global Process Owners (GPOs), and external parties such as auditors and tax authorities. Key responsabilities:

• Serve as a member of the RTR team in the CoE, providing support on ad hoc topics and accounting issues

• Support with financial booking activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations

• Manage clearing, including reconciliations and adjustments, to maintain accurate financial records

• Utilize advanced knowledge of ERP systems to streamline accounting processes

• Support the Global Process Owner (GPO) with system implementations

• Maintain and update the chart of accounts and hierarchies, ensuring it reflects the current business structure and reporting requirements

• Collaborate closely with local Finance Teams in countries and Finance Shared Services teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider

• Coordinate with other departments and the Finance Shared Services teams to ensure all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger

• Supports the period end close, including closing the accounts receivable/payable subledger and reconcile with the general ledger; close general ledger, open new financial period, close Asset Accounting (AA)

• Support with the preparation of journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the RTR process, leveraging technology and best practices; maintain policies, procedures and templates

• Ensure financial internal controls are in place and followed for the processes performed by this role

• Do all technical Year End Closing activities such as balance carry forward, number range creations, close of AA

• Support Intercompany reconciliation process in Coprocess and Tagetik (fix variances)

You need to succeed:

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in Accounting with a strong focus on general ledger and financial reporting

• CPA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent certification preferred

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and management skills

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and integrity in financial reporting

• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment

• Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to senior leadership

• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala) and accounting software

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Experience with Tagetik, Coprocess and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Proficiency in English and French

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant tickets.

• Be part of an experienced, international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios, making your work experience both comfortable and convenient.

• Other fringe benefits.

International applicants are welcome to apply. No visa or w

• Gérer la compensation, y compris les rapprochements et les ajustements, pour tenir des dossiers financiers exacts

• Utiliser les connaissances avancées des systèmes PGI pour rationaliser les processus comptables

jobs.title: Manager of Field Services
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Manager to build and oversee a Field Service team. The team will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment across multiple client sites. The ideal candidate will possess solid technical expertise and strong leadership abilities, managing a team of field technicians, optimizing service processes, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. This position requires frequent site visits, coordination with engineering and operations teams, and the ability to address complex technical and operational challenges efficiently.
Key Responsibilities

• Oversee profit and loss (P&L) responsibilities for the EMS field service operations, including budget management, cost control, and financial reporting.

• Collaborate with engineering, project management, and sales teams to support client projects and technical proposals.

• Serve as the primary technical escalation point for complex field service issues

• Lead, mentor, and manage a team of field service technicians specializing in electrical and mechanical equipment.

• Plan, assign, and optimize work orders, routes, and schedules to maximize efficiency and meet service deadlines.

• Coordinate installation, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of electrical and mechanical systems.

• Ensure compliance with safety regulations, company policies, and industry standards (OSHA, NEC, NFPA, etc.).

• Maintain accurate records of service activities, parts usage, and site documentation.

• Analyze performance metrics, including first-time fix rates, system uptime, and response times, and implement process improvements.

• Develop and maintain strong client relationships to ensure service satisfaction and promote additional service opportunities.

• Conduct site audits, field inspections, and on-the-job training for technicians.

• Develop and manage operational budgets, review cost efficiency, and ensure profitability of service operations.

Required Qualifications & Skills

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related technical field preferred. Equivalent experience in field services may be considered.

• Minimum of 5 to 7 years experience in field service management or equivalent technical supervision role supporting electrical and/or mechanical equipment.

• Strong technical knowledge of electrical systems, mechanical systems, PLCs, motor controls, power distribution, and industrial equipment.

• Proven experience in team leadership, performance management, and personnel development.

• Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills under pressure.

• Proficient in field service management software, CRM systems, and route optimization tools .

• Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to interact effectively with clients, team members, and management.

• Valid driver’s license with willingness to travel extensively to client sites.

• Familiarity with industry certifications (NICET, CET, Journeyman/Master Electrician, PMP / CSM certification a plus).

• Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage operations across multiple sites.

Preferred Skills

• Experience in project management , equipment commissioning, and technical training.

• Knowledge of regulatory compliance for industrial electrical and mechanical systems.

• Experience managing budgets, service KPIs, and operational performance analytics.

• Hands-on experience with

• Superare le responsabilità di profitti e perdite (P&L) per le operazioni di servizio sul campo dello SME, compresa la gestione del bilancio, il controllo dei costi e la rendicontazione finanziaria.
• Collabora con team di ingegneria, project management e vendita per supportare progetti e proposte tecniche dei clienti.
• Serve come punto di escalation tecnico primario per problemi complessi di servizio sul campo

• Sviluppare e mantenere forti relazioni con i clienti per garantire la soddisfazione del servizio e promuovere ulteriori opportunità di servizio.
• Condurre audit del sito, ispezioni sul campo e formazione sul lavoro per i tecnici.
• Sviluppare e gestire bilanci operativi, rivedere l'efficienza dei costi e garantire la redditività delle operazioni di servizio. Qualificazioni e competenze richieste
• Laurea in ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria industriale, o relativo campo tecnico preferito. L'esperienza equivalente nei servizi di campo può essere considerata.
• Minimo da 5 a 7 anni di esperienza nella gestione del servizio sul campo o equivalente ruolo di supervisione tecnica che supporta apparecchiature elettriche e/o meccaniche.
• Forte conoscenza tecnica di sistemi elettrici, sistemi meccanici, PLC, controlli motori, distribuzione di energia e attrezzature industriali.
• Esperienza dimostrata nella leadership del team, nella gestione delle prestazioni e nello sviluppo del personale.
• Eccellente problem solving e capacità decisionali sotto pressione.
• Proficiente nel software di gestione dei servizi di campo, sistemi CRM e strumenti di ottimizzazione dei percorsi.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta; capacità di interagire efficacemente con i clienti, i membri del team e la gestione.
• Licenza valida del conducente con la volontà di viaggiare estesamente ai siti dei clienti.
• Familiarità con certificazioni del settore (NICET, CET, Journeyman/Master Electrician, certificazione PMP / CSM a plus).
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, priorizzare le attività e gestire le operazioni su più siti. Competenze consigliate
• Esperienza nella gestione del progetto, messa in servizio di attrezzature e formazione tecnica.

• Vertrautheit mit Branchenzertifizierungen (NICET, CET, Journeyman/Master Electrician, PMP/CSM-Zertifizierung ein Plus).

jobs.description:

About the role

The Service Center Administrative Specialist plays a critical role in supporting daily operations within a fast-paced service environment. This position is responsible for coordinating purchase orders, managing logistics, supporting work order processes, and maintaining accurate system transactions across multiple platforms (Salesforce and SAP). The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable wearing many hats in an unstructured, dynamic setting. Key Responsibilities

• Order & Procurement Management
• Process and manage purchase orders (POs) in Salesforce and SAP

• Receive and review POs for direct materials

• Create, place, and receive POs for indirect materials

• Establish vendor terms and maintain supplier communications

• Logistics & Operations Coordination
• Arrange transportation and logistics for pumps and related equipment

• Track materials and ensure timely delivery to support operations

• Perform receipt transactions and maintain accurate inventory records

• Work Order & Job Coordination
• Release, track, and manage work orders throughout the lifecycle

• Book jobs and ensure accurate scheduling within system tools

• Maintain status management and provide updates on work order progress

• Customer & Vendor Interaction
• Greet and assist customers and vendors in a professional manner

• Serve as a key point of contact for inquiries related to orders and services

• Financial & System Transactions
• Process invoicing activities within SAP

• Ensure accurate data entry and documentation across all systems

• Support booking and job costing activities as needed

Qualifications

• Experience coordinating purchase orders and logistics in a service or industrial environment

• Familiarity with ERP/CRM systems such as SAP and Salesforce

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, unstructured environment

• Proactive mindset with strong attention to detail

• Excellent communication and customer service skills

Key Competencies

• Adaptability and flexibility (“wear many hats”)

• Strong problem-solving skills

• Time management and prioritization

• Attention to detail and accuracy

• Team-oriented with a customer-first approach

Work Environment

• Fast-paced, operations-focused service center

• Dynamic and evolving priorities

• Hands-on role requiring interaction across multiple functions

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Le Groupe Marketing & Communications Expert est responsable de la gestion de projets de communication et de marque à grande échelle dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Ce rôle assure l'uniformité des messages, appuie les communications des cadres et dirige les initiatives stratégiques dans les communications internes et externes.
Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux experts reconnus dans un domaine d'emploi. Requis pour gérer de grands projets ou processus avec une surveillance limitée de la part du gestionnaire. Les entraîneurs, les critiques et les délégués travaillent pour les professionnels de niveau inférieur. Rejoignez notre équipe de marketing Sulzer et aidez-nous à porter le marketing numérique au niveau supérieur.
Nous cherchons un responsable stratégique et pratique du marketing numérique pour diriger l'agenda mondial du marketing numérique de Sulzer de Madrid. Ce rôle favorisera la génération de la demande, la transformation numérique et l'engagement des clients dans l'ensemble du Canada.
plusieurs unités d'affaires et régions.

Vous posséderez l'écosystème numérique – le web, le marketing de performance, l'automatisation du marketing et l'analyse – tout en créant une équipe performante et en intégrant une culture axée sur les données.

Principales responsabilités :

Stratégie numérique et transformation

• Définir et exécuter une stratégie globale de marketing numérique alignée sur les priorités de croissance des entreprises (y compris la pleine propriété de l'exécution de campagne)

• Diriger les initiatives de transformation numérique à travers les canaux, les plateformes et les parcours clients

• Partenaire avec des équipes commerciales et de produits pour aligner les programmes numériques sur les objectifs de vente

Production de demande et marketing de performance

• Conduire un pipeline qualifié au moyen de campagnes intégrées (SEO/SEM, médias payants, ABM, tests A/B, courriel, social)

• Optimiser les entonnoirs de conversion et la gestion du cycle de vie

• Les propres KPI numériques: trafic, engagement, MQL, SQL, opportunités, contribution du pipeline OI, ROI

Expérience client et écosystème Web

• Superviser la stratégie globale du site Web, l'UX/UI, la personnalisation et la performance du contenu

• Assurer des expériences numériques cohérentes et de haute qualité à travers les points de contact

• Champion centreur client et optimisation du parcours

Technologie et données de commercialisation

• Propre et évoluer la pile Martech (par exemple, l'automatisation du marketing (Hubspot), les outils d'analyse (GA4, etc., les outils de génération de la demande, etc.)

• Tirer parti des données et des idées pour améliorer continuellement la performance de la campagne

• Mettre en place des cadres de suivi, d'attribution et de rapport évolutives

Leadership et gestion des intervenants

• Construire, diriger et développer une équipe mondiale de marketing numérique basée principalement à Madrid

• Collaborer avec les équipes régionales de marketing et l'équipe des gestionnaires de marketing de produits et des homologues commerciaux pour assurer l'alignement et l'excellence de l'exécution

• Gérer les organismes externes et les partenaires technologiques

Pour réussir vous avez besoin :

• Licence en affaires / marketing

• 10 ans et plus dans le marketing numérique, avec au moins 5 ans dans un rôle de leader

• Fort bilan en matière de production de demande et de transformation numérique

• Connaissance pratique de la mise en place de campagnes numériques / Martech, expérience de l'IA

• Expertise approfondie en marketing de performance, SEO/SEM et automatisation marketing

• Un état d'esprit analytique fort avec l'expérience de la prise de décision axée sur les données

• Expérience de gestion d'écosystèmes numériques complexes et multi-régions

• Familiarité avec les plateformes CRM (par exemple Salesforce) et les outils de marketing (par exemple HubSpot, Apollo, Cognism, Canva, etc.)

• Penseur stratégique avec une approche pratique

• Fortes compétences en gestion des parties prenantes et en communication

• Agent de changement ayant la capacité d'influencer une organisation matricielle

• Fluent en anglais

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable de l'application du traitement de l'eau

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Water Treatment Application Leader
Vill du leda ett högkompetent team och spela en nyckelroll i utvecklingen av innovativa vattenreningslösningar för kunder över hela världen?
Vi söker nu en Application Engineering and Tendering Leader som vill ta ett övergripande ansvar för vårt team inom applikationsteknik och anbud. I rollen kommer du att vara en strategisk och operativ ledare som stödjer vår globala säljorganisation med tekniskt avancerade och kommersiellt konkurrenskraftiga lösningar inom vattenrening.
Det här är en central roll där du får möjlighet att påverka både affärsutveckling och teknisk innovation genom att leda arbetet med komplexa anbud, kundprojekt och applikationslösningar i nära samarbete med kollegor och kunder världen över.
Dina ansvarsområden
Som Application Engineering & Tendering Leader kommer du att:

• Leda och utveckla teamet inom Application Engineering och Tendering som stödjer våra globala säljenheter.

• Driva utvecklingen av tekniska lösningar, processkoncept, layouter och systemkonfigurationer för kundspecifika applikationer.

• Ansvara för planering, koordinering och genomförande av anbudsarbete samt säkerställa leverans av högkvalitativa anbud inom uppsatta tidsramar.

• Utvärdera tekniska, kommersiella och avtalsrelaterade risker samt ge rekommendationer för affärsbeslut.

• Fungera som en central länk mellan försäljning, teknik, produktledning och andra viktiga intressenter.

• Prioritera resurser och aktiviteter för att säkerställa bästa möjliga stöd till verksamheten och våra kunder.

• Bidra till utvecklingen av framgångsrika tekniska och kommersiella strategier för strategiskt viktiga affärsmöjligheter.

• Följa marknadsutveckling, kundbehov och konkurrentaktiviteter för att stärka vår konkurrenskraft.

• Säkerställa efterlevnad av interna processer, kvalitetskrav och kundspecifikationer.

• Presentera lösningsstrategier, anbudsstatus och affärsinsikter för ledning och andra beslutsfattare.

Vem är du?
Vi söker dig som kombinerar teknisk expertis med ett tydligt ledarskap och ett starkt affärsdriv.
Du har:

• Akademisk examen inom kemiteknik, miljöteknik eller annat relevant tekniskt område.

• Gedigen erfarenhet av vattenreningsprocesser, applikationsteknik och anbudsarbete.

• Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda och utveckla team inom teknik, applikationer, anbud eller närliggande områden.

• Erfarenhet av komplexa tekniska offerter och kundanpassade lösningar.

• God förståelse för kommersiella och avtalsrelaterade risker.

• Stark förmåga att leda projekt, bygga relationer och hantera flera intressenter samtidigt.

• Erfarenhet av att arbeta i en internationell och tvärfunktionell organisation.

• Mycket goda kunskaper i engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt.
Som person är du strukturerad, lösningsorienterad och kundfokuserad. Du trivs i en ledande roll där du får kombinera strategiskt tänkande med operativt genomförande och har förmågan att skapa engagemang, samarbete och resultat även i komplexa situationer.

Vi erbjuder
Hos oss får du möjlighet att:

• Ta en strategiskt viktig ledarroll i en internationell och växande organisation.

• Bidra till utvecklingen av hållbara och innovativa lösningar inom vattenrening.

• Arbeta nära kunder och påverka affärskritiska projekt och investeringar.

• Delaktig i att utveckla organisationen, dess arbetssätt för att att driva effektiv och lönsam affär.

• Leda ett engagerat och kompetent team med stort tekniskt kunnande.

• Utvecklas vidare i en organisation som präglas av samarbete, innovation och entreprenörsanda.

• Vara med och göra verklig skillnad inom ett område som är avgörande för en hållbar framtid.

Placeringsort: Nordic Water – Center of Excellence, Mölndal (Göteborg), Sverige.

What we offer you

• Wellnes A

jobs.title: Service - Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for collecting outstanding receivables and maintaining accurate records of collection activities. The role involves interacting with customers, assessing account status, and supporting timely payments. The objective is to maintain cash flow, reduce DSO, resolve disputes, and coordinate with internal teams to address billing or service issues affecting payments.

Key Responsibilities

• Collection Efforts: Contact customers via phone and email to follow up on past-due invoices and secure payments.

• Account Reconciliation: Review accounts to ensure payments are applied correctly and resolve discrepancies.

• Negotiation: Develop payment plans with customers for outstanding debt.

• Reporting: Submit daily/weekly reports on aging accounts and high-risk customers to management.

• Process Improvement: Recommend adjustments to improve AR collection process.

• Documentation: Maintain meticulous records of collection activities and customer correspondence.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor: in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration.

• Previous experience in credit and collections or accounts receivable.

• Strong written/verbal communication, negotiation, and customer service skills.

• Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks, SAP, Oracle) and MS Excel.

• Languages: Arabic & English.

What we offer you

• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

• A great working environment.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled and results-driven Commercial Excellence Expert to lead and support initiatives aimed at improving the efficiency, effectiveness, and profitability of our sales organization. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in transactional sales processes, organizational optimization, and continuous improvement, with a proven track record of delivering cost-saving projects. A Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification is required. Key Responsibilities:

• This role requires a Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification.

• Analyze and optimize end-to-end sales processes , identifying inefficiencies and areas for improvement.

• Lead process improvement projects using Lean Six Sigma methodologies to enhance productivity and reduce waste.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Sales, Finance, Operations, IT) to implement best practices and standardize activities.

• Develop and monitor KPIs and performance dashboards to track progress and impact of commercial excellence initiatives.

• Identify and execute cost-saving opportunities across sales operations, including pricing, order management, customer service, and CRM usage.

• Support change management and training efforts to ensure adoption of new processes and tools.

• Drive organizational design improvements to align roles, responsibilities, and workflows with strategic goals.

• Act as a strategic partner to sales leadership in shaping commercial strategy and operational excellence.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, or related field.

• Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification is mandatory.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in commercial excellence , sales operations , or process improvement roles.

• Strong analytical skills and proficiency in tools such as Excel, Power BI, and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional projects and deliver measurable results.

• Experience in a sales-driven organization with a focus on transactional activities is highly preferred.

What we offer you

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Sulzer is offering a unique opportunity for early-career engineers to jumpstart their professional journey through a dynamic two-year rotational program. This immersive experience provides direct exposure across key departments within Sulzer’s Services Division, with the goal of permanent department placement upon program completion.

Position Summary: The Rotational Engineer program is a two-year rotational program designed to attract, develop, and retain high-potential, transformative engineers through best-in-industry rotational experience and professional development. This program supports the Services Division in the Americas by leading hands-on and strategic initiatives that enhance commercial and operational excellence. Acts as a bridge between engineering, commercial, and operations – designing and implementing shop-floor solutions, automation, supporting technical documentation, collaborating with vendors, and driving continuous improvement. Participants will rotate through four specialized areas, focusing on sales, operations, or engineering, each lasting six months:

• Steam Turbines and Compressor: Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, reverse engineering and parts manufacturing, performance rerates, performance qualification tests, custom engineering solutions, and field service

• Gas Turbine (Industrial and Aeroderivative): Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, metallurgical evaluations, performance testing, and field service

• Pumps: Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, reverse engineering and parts manufacturing, performance optimization, retrofits, hydraulic testing, and field service

• Electro-Mechanical Services: Overhauls and repairs of motors and generators, generator rewind, high voltage coil manufacturing, engineering services, and field services

Rotations I & II : Carefully selected to match your current skills and future ambitions, ensuring a personalized and enriching start to the program.

Rotations III & IV : You take the wheel—choose from a range of opportunities across departments to deepen expertise, explore new interests, and shape your unique path.

Candidates will be considered for all hiring Service Center locations which include but not limited to the following cities:

Houston, TX, Margate, FL, Chattanooga, TN, Barboursville, WV, Los Angeles, CA, Joliet, IL, Aurora, CO, Baton Rouge, LA, Piedmont, SC, Odessa, TX, Mobile, AL, Salt Lake City, UT, Phoenix, AZ, Gillette, WY, Colton, CA, and Orange, TX.

All candidates must be willing to relocate to any of these locations, or other Sulzer sites while in the program. Sulzer provides a locally adjusted housing allowance and mileage reimbursement to next rotation location, along with five business days of transfer time (excluding home-based placements).

Functions

• Participate or lead job tasks, production duties, and process improvement initiatives identified and assigned by Supervisor.

• Design, develop, implement, or upgrade drawings, work instructions, procedures, technical documentation, tooling and fixturing improvements.

• Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to source and qualify solutions.

• Balance immediate troubleshooting support with long-term strategic projects.
