jobs.title: Area Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Southern California Area Sales Manager (ASM) is the primary external representative of Sulzer’s Electro Mechanical Services (EMS) and is financially responsible for the Order Intake, Gross Profit Margin, and Operating Net Cash-Flow. You will engage clients and promote/represent Sulzer’s RES businesses (Pumps and Turbo) to provide full RES Services to Southern California. You will prospect new sales opportunities with clients from first contact to the closure of orders and/or until projects have been completed. You will work closely with other Sulzer teams including Inside Sales, Business Process, Operations, Engineering, Finance, QC, Safety, and HR to secure, ship, and invoice profitable orders. Responsibilities:

• Meet or exceed the Order Intake budget for the assigned area/product line

• Develop, sell and maintain all business responsibilities for the assigned area/product line

• Develop and implement sales strategies consistent with the goals of Sulzer

• Plan, support and monitor sales activity within the area/product line

• Develop and deliver technical and commercially superior proposals to the client

• Support all business activities with the client thru closing and invoicing

• Develop, maintain and report accurate sales forecasts

• Review of RFPs, contracts, POs and terms for all business opportunities

• Control all business expenses as if they were your own

• Be proficient with and maintain Salesforce: opportunities, outage tracking and market condition events, trip call reports and competition updates

• Coordinate, plan, attend and execute promotional trade shows events

• Participate in quarterly sales calls or meetings with the management team

• This position requires and expects frequent travel into the area assigned.

• Support Sulzer strategic initiatives on safety, business, ethics and quality.

• Present a positive, proactive, professional attitude and appearance at all times.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Business is preferred.

• 5+ years of industry knowledge and experience with Electric Motors and Generators.

• Previous experience of proactively influencing or closing business with clients, co-workers and/or commercial peers.

• In-depth knowledge of Motors, generators and learn Sulzer’s complete product line

• Must be able to understand, interpret and discuss technical and commercial documents.

• High personal standards of character. Must have impeccable moral and ethical behavior.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to read, write and discuss micro details and macro situations, as well as the inter-personal skills to interface with personnel from diverse backgrounds at all levels of our clients organization.

• Willing to travel frequently and bring business back as a result.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously as well as the ability to willingly work with demanding deadlines

• Understanding of basic financial statements

• Proficiency at or the ability to quickly learn how to use Salesforce.

• Proficient use of other Microsoft office applications such as WORD, EXCEL, POWER POINT, et al, to support selling activities

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days

• Car Allowance and company credit card

• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

• 401k with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• Bonus Programs. Based on company performance and individual performance.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer

jobs.title: Gas Turbine Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Heavy-Duty Gas Turbine FA will contribute to the management of site activities including planning, organizing, integrating and monitoring of resources such as labor, tools and technical assistants as required to complete the work scope according to contractual requirements. Will work within defined parameters to make decisions, apply concepts to issues of great complexity, and resolve issues through immediate action or short-term planning at customer power generating facilities. Will be responsible for the installation and maintenance of Gas Turbines.
Main tasks and responsibilities

• Manage, perform, coordinate the management of HD Gas Turbine site activities

• Perform on-site installation of systems and equipment and ongoing preventive maintenance, repair and calibration after installation

• Respond to requests for emergency repairs and services to troublesome equipment

• Provide technical instruction and assistance to customer representatives regarding installation, operation, calibration, repair and maintenance at customer's sites

• Perform administrative functions such as: writing technical reports, ordering materials, securing quotations, preparing job status reports, reports to customers, time sheet and expense sheets on a complete timely, and thorough basis

• Signs off on all changes implemented.

• Knowledge to troubleshoot and provide routine maintenance checkout for wide range of equipment vintage

• Coach, mentor and train other team members as required, to impart and perpetuate field engineering and/or product knowledge.

• Prepare timely and accurate technical reports for customer records and a reference for future outages

• Ensure all parts needed for the job are shipped to the site

• Perform walk-downs during installation to ensure that the customer’s contractors are working properly.

• Ability and willingness to work holidays, weekends and overtime as required by field assignments

• Extensive travel to and from projects and various field assignments will be required

• May be assigned other duties to help proactively drive our Sulzer vision and align with our organization’s core values.

Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?)

• Requirement: Min D3 engineering background: Mechanical.

• Possess General Knowledge of mechanical and overall Heavy Duty Gas Turbine maintenance. Familiar with tools, hand tools, and special tools.

• Familiar with technical drawing, symbols and legend, P&ID diagram.

• Familiar with safety code and procedure for startup and commissioning

• Behaviour requirement: Achievement Orientation, communication for result, teamwork, active learning, business awareness, problem solving and analytical thinking

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Relevant experience of minimum 15 years of working on Outage of Heavy-Duty Gas Turbine. Or came from customer power plant experience

• Proficient in English.

• Ability to read and comprehend engineering drawings and data

• Past worked in the OEM is preferable

• Solid understanding of Gas Turbine Operation & Controlling Parameters.

• Strong technical competence in reading and interpreting electrical/mechanical flow and instrument diagrams dial and laser alignment and thermal growth equipment

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Field Service Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Field) Service Sr. Coordinator is responsible for coordinating field service activities including installation, configuration, calibration, and repair of technical products and systems at customer locations. This role supports service delivery and may guide other professional-level staff in non-routine situations.
This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations.
The Field Service Supervisor plays a key role in ensuring that all services are executed with quality, efficiency, and safety. This role acts as a bridge between the customer and the national technical team, working closely with the Operations Director, the Operations Backoffice and the Workshop Coordinator. The supervisor is responsible for the end‑to‑end management of all field activities (maintenance, incidents, breakdowns, commissioning, and supervision).

Key Responsibilities

• Technical team coordination: Assign daily tasks to field technicians based on priorities and workload, ensuring efficient execution.

• Materials and resources control: Ensure that technicians have the necessary tools, materials, and documentation to complete tasks quickly and effectively.

• Work order monitoring: Follow up on work orders, validate the technical closure, and ensure that all required information is included (photos, reports, readings, etc.).

• Direct customer communication: Plan and coordinate field activities with the customer, ensuring that work can be carried out safely and within the agreed timelines.

• Maintenance contract planning and tracking: Verify that all related documentation is up to date and that maintenance activities are carried out in accordance with contractual requirements.

• Continuous improvement: Propose operational and procedural improvements based on field reality, and analyze the causes of rework and recurring incidents.

What you need to succeed
Experience & Technical Background

• Proven experience in field service supervision or coordination within an industrial environment (e.g. civil construction, hydraulic installations, industrial maintenance).

• Strong technical knowledge and diagnostic skills , with the ability to support and guide field technicians.

• Experience working with field service management tools , work orders, and technical reporting.

• Hands‑on exposure to on‑site customer environments , managing incidents, breakdowns, and maintenance activities.

Skills & Competencies

• Ability to work autonomously while coordinating and prioritizing activities of a distributed field team.

• Strong communication and customer‑oriented mindset , with proven experience dealing directly with customers on site.

• Structured and proactive approach, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.

• Problem‑solving mindset and continuous improvement orientation.

Languages & Mobility

• High level of English (able to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders and customers).

• Availability to travel across Iberia as required by field activities.

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant tickets

• Be part of an experienced, international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• Company car as a tool of trade

• Other fringe benefits

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sintesi del lavoro Il Coordinatore (Field) Service Sr. è responsabile del coordinamento delle attività di servizio sul campo, tra cui installazione, configurazione, calibrazione e riparazione di prodotti e sistemi tecnici nelle sedi dei clienti. Questo ruolo supporta la fornitura di servizi e può guidare altri personale di livello professionale in situazioni non routine. Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a personale di livello professionale che lavora autonomamente e può coordinare le attività di altri personale di livello professionale, soprattutto in situazioni non di routine. Il Field Service Supervisor svolge un ruolo chiave nel garantire che tutti i servizi siano eseguiti con qualità, efficienza e sicurezza. Questo ruolo funge da ponte tra il cliente e il team tecnico nazionale, lavorando a stretto contatto con il Direttore Operativo, il Backoffice Operativo e il Coordinatore Workshop. Il supervisore è responsabile della gestione end-to-end di tutte le attività sul campo (manutenzione, incidenti, guasti, messa in servizio e supervisione). Principali responsabilità
• Coordinamento tecnico del team: Assegnare compiti quotidiani ai tecnici di campo basati su priorità e carico di lavoro, garantendo un'esecuzione efficiente.
• Controllo dei materiali e delle risorse: Assicurarsi che i tecnici abbiano gli strumenti necessari, i materiali e la documentazione per completare i compiti in modo rapido ed efficace.
• Monitoraggio dell'ordine di lavoro: Seguire gli ordini di lavoro, convalidare la chiusura tecnica e garantire che tutte le informazioni richieste siano incluse (foto, report, letture, ecc.).
• Comunicazione diretta del cliente: pianificare e coordinare le attività sul campo con il cliente, assicurando che il lavoro possa essere effettuato in modo sicuro e entro i termini concordati.
• Pianificazione e tracciamento del contratto di manutenzione: verifica che tutta la documentazione relativa è aggiornata e che le attività di manutenzione sono svolte in conformità con i requisiti contrattuali.
• Miglioramento continuo: Proporre miglioramenti operativi e procedurali basati sulla realtà del campo, e analizzare le cause di rilavoro e incidenti ricorrenti. Cosa devi avere successo Esperienza & Sfondo tecnico
• Esperienza comprovata nella supervisione del servizio sul campo o nel coordinamento in un ambiente industriale (ad esempio costruzione civile, impianti idraulici, manutenzione industriale).
• Forte conoscenza tecnica e competenze diagnostiche, con la capacità di supportare e guidare i tecnici del campo.
• Esperienza di lavoro con strumenti di gestione dei servizi di campo , ordini di lavoro e reporting tecnico.
• Esposizione manuale agli ambienti dei clienti in loco, gestione di incidenti, guasti e attività di manutenzione. Competenze e competenze
• Capacità di lavorare autonomamente mentre coordina e privilegia le attività di un team di campo distribuito.
• Forte comunicazione e mentalità orientata al cliente , con esperienza comprovata che si occupa direttamente con i clienti in loco.
• Approccio strutturato e proattivo, con la capacità di gestire più compiti e priorità contemporaneamente.
• Mindset problem-solving e orientamento continuo miglioramento. Lingue e mobilità
• Alto livello di inglese (in grado di comunicare efficacemente con gli stakeholder interni e i clienti).
• Disponibilità per viaggiare attraverso Iberia come richiesto dalle attività sul campo. Cosa ti offriamo
• Un contratto permanente.
• Uno stipendio competitivo e la partecipazione al sistema di remunerazione variabile basato su obiettivi personali e finanziari.
• Biglietti del ristorante
• Fai parte di un team esperto e internazionale.
• Una buona atmosfera ambiente di lavoro.
• Auto aziendale come strumento di commercio
• Altri vantaggi Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda

Der Field Service Supervisor spielt eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Sicherstellung, dass alle Dienste mit Qualität, Effizienz und Sicherheit ausgeführt werden. Diese Rolle bildet eine Brücke zwischen dem Kunden und dem nationalen technischen Team und arbeitet eng mit dem Operations Director, dem Operations Backoffice und dem Workshop-Koordinator zusammen. Der Betreuer ist verantwortlich für das Ende-zu-Ende-Management aller Vor-Ort-Aktivitäten (Wartung, Vorfälle, Pannen, Inbetriebnahme und Aufsicht). Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten
• Koordination des technischen Teams: Weisen Sie den Außendiensttechnikern tägliche Aufgaben zu, die auf Prioritäten und Arbeitsbelastung basieren, um eine effiziente Ausführung zu gewährleisten.
• Material- und Ressourcenkontrolle: Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Techniker über die notwendigen Werkzeuge, Materialien und Dokumentationen verfügen, um Aufgaben schnell und effektiv abzuschließen.
• Auftragsüberwachung: Weiterverfolgung von Arbeitsaufträgen, Validierung des technischen Abschlusses und Sicherstellung, dass alle erforderlichen Informationen (Fotos, Berichte, Lesungen usw.) enthalten sind.
• Direkte Kundenkommunikation: Planen und koordinieren Sie die Aktivitäten vor Ort mit dem Kunden, um sicherzustellen, dass die Arbeiten sicher und innerhalb der vereinbarten Fristen durchgeführt werden können.
• Planung und Nachverfolgung von Wartungsverträgen: Vergewissern Sie sich, dass alle damit verbundenen Dokumentationen auf dem neuesten Stand sind und dass Wartungsarbeiten gemäß den vertraglichen Anforderungen durchgeführt werden.
• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Vorschlag für operative und prozedurale Verbesserungen basierend auf der Realität im Feld und Analyse der Ursachen von Nacharbeiten und wiederkehrenden Vorfällen. Was Sie brauchen, um erfolgreich zu sein Erfahrung & technischer Hintergrund
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Außendienstüberwachung oder -koordination in einem industriellen Umfeld (z. B. Bau im Tiefbau, hydraulische Anlagen, industrielle Wartung).
• Starke technische Kenntnisse und diagnostische Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, Außendiensttechniker zu unterstützen und zu führen.
• Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Field Service Management Tools, Arbeitsaufträgen und technischem Reporting.
• Hands-on-Exposition gegenüber Kundenumgebungen vor Ort, Management von Vorfällen, Pannen und Wartungsaktivitäten. Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen
• Fähigkeit, autonom zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig die Aktivitäten eines verteilten Feldteams zu koordinieren und zu priorisieren.
• Starke Kommunikation und kundenorientierte Denkweise, mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung im direkten Umgang mit Kunden vor Ort.
• Strukturierter und proaktiver Ansatz mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Aufgaben und Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu verwalten.
• Problemlösungsdenken und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsorientierung. Sprachen & Mobilität
• Hohes Englischniveau (in der Lage, effektiv mit internen Stakeholdern und Kunden zu kommunizieren).
• Verfügbarkeit, um durch Iberia zu reisen, wie es für Feldaktivitäten erforderlich ist. Was wir Ihnen bieten
• Ein unbefristeter Vertrag.
• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt sowie die Teilnahme am variablen Vergütungssystem basierend auf persönlichen und finanziellen Zielen.
• Restauranttickets

• Ein gutes Vibe Arbeitsumfeld.

Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Résumé de l'emploi Le coordonnateur des services (sur le terrain) est chargé de coordonner les activités des services sur le terrain, y compris l'installation, la configuration, l'étalonnage et la réparation des produits et systèmes techniques dans les lieux d'affectation des clients. Ce rôle appuie la prestation de services et peut guider d'autres professionnels dans des situations non courantes. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné au personnel de niveau professionnel qui travaille de manière autonome et peut coordonner les activités d'autres personnels de niveau professionnel, en particulier dans des situations non courantes. Le superviseur du Service mobile joue un rôle essentiel en veillant à ce que tous les services soient exécutés avec qualité, efficacité et sécurité. Ce rôle sert de pont entre le client et l'équipe technique nationale, travaillant en étroite collaboration avec le directeur des opérations, le backoffice des opérations et le coordonnateur de l'atelier. Le superviseur est responsable de la gestion de bout en bout de toutes les activités sur le terrain (entretien, incidents, pannes, mise en service et supervision). Principales responsabilités
• Coordination de l'équipe technique: Assigner des tâches quotidiennes aux techniciens de terrain en fonction des priorités et de la charge de travail, en assurant une exécution efficace.
• Contrôle du matériel et des ressources : S'assurer que les techniciens disposent des outils, du matériel et de la documentation nécessaires pour accomplir les tâches rapidement et efficacement.
• Suivi des ordres de travail: Suivi des ordres de travail, validation de la fermeture technique et garantie que toutes les informations requises sont incluses (photos, rapports, lectures, etc.).
• Communication directe avec le client: Planifiez et coordonnez les activités sur le terrain avec le client, en veillant à ce que le travail puisse être effectué en toute sécurité et dans les délais convenus.
• Planification et suivi des contrats d'entretien : Vérifier que tous les documents connexes sont à jour et que les activités d'entretien sont menées conformément aux exigences contractuelles.
• Amélioration continue : Proposer des améliorations opérationnelles et procédurales basées sur la réalité sur le terrain, et analyser les causes des retravaillés et des incidents récurrents. Ce dont vous avez besoin pour réussir Expérience et contexte technique
• Expérience éprouvée en matière de supervision ou de coordination des services sur le terrain dans un environnement industriel (p. ex. construction civile, installations hydrauliques, entretien industriel).
• De solides connaissances techniques et des compétences diagnostiques, avec la capacité de soutenir et de guider les techniciens de terrain.
• Expérience de travail avec les outils de gestion des services sur le terrain, les ordres de travail et les rapports techniques.
• Exposition directe aux environnements clients sur place, gestion des incidents, des pannes et des activités de maintenance. Compétences
• Capacité de travailler de manière autonome tout en coordonnant et en priorisant les activités d'une équipe de terrain distribuée.
• Une communication forte et une mentalité axée sur le client, avec une expérience éprouvée traitant directement avec les clients sur place.
• Approche structurée et proactive, capable de gérer simultanément plusieurs tâches et priorités.
• L'état d'esprit de résolution de problèmes et l'orientation de l'amélioration continue. Langues et mobilité
• Niveau élevé d'anglais (capacité de communiquer efficacement avec les intervenants internes et les clients).

• Support & coordinate with different teams of Project management, Operations, Purchase, Sales, Quality & Testing during the complete cycle of the order execution.

• Provide engineering support to Site commissioning team until successful operation of the equipment supplied.

• Proactively engage & support company initiatives designed to promote a culture of safe working, environmental protection and continual improvement

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering from reputed institute.

• 5-10 years of experience in Electrical Equipment design field mainly Motors and VFD drives.

• Independent and proactive with good communication & interpersonal skills.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Expert is responsible for leading the design, development, and optimization of mechanical systems and components. This role provides expert-level technical leadership in mechanical engineering, ensuring that products meet performance, reliability, and cost targets. The expert collaborates across departments to drive innovation and resolve complex engineering challenges.
This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Required to manage large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager. Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals. Position Summary:
Lead design, development, and testing and the implementation of innovative products and technologies. The roles is responsible for driving mechanical engineering solutions from product feasibility through implementation into production by collaborating with cross-functional teams. The position combines strong technical expertise, creativity, and project leadership skills to solve complex engineering challenges and deliver high quality products.

Principle Duties and Key Responsibilities:

• Lead mechanical design and development of new products and technologies.

• Lead mechanical design of product improvements for cost out or consolidation of similar technologies.

• Generate and evaluate engineering concepts, prototypes, and design alternatives.

• Performa engineering calculations, simulations, and tolerance analysis.

• Develop detailed #D CAD models, engineering drawings, and technical documentation.

• Conduct design verification, validation testing, and root cause analysis.

• Manage product development projects, schedules, budgets, and milestones.

• Review and check engineering documentation, specifications and change requests.

• Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, materials, and manufacturing processes.

• Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Skills & Qualifications
Education:
Required: BSME Bachelor of Science Mechanical Engineering or related discipline

Desirable: Master’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field.
Professional Engineer (PE) license

Experience:
Required:
8+ years of mechanical engineering in rotating equipment product development, R&D, or advanced engineering environments.
Proven experience leading complex engineering projects from feasibility through implementation.
Experience working with multidisciplinary teams in a development environment.
Knowledge of manufacturing processes such as machining, sheet metal fabrication, casting, and assembly.
Experience with engineering test methods, verification protocols, and data analysis.

Preferred: Project management within a Phase Gate process.
Product design of wastewater screening or treatment equipment.

Skills:
Technical

Required:
Advanced proficiency with CAD software, such as Inventor, SolidWorks, Creo, or NX.
Strong understanding of mechanical system design, material science and component selection.
Experience with FEA and other engineering simulation tools.
Knowledge of GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing) and tolerance stack up analysis.
Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office with excellent formula and engineering tool creation in Excel spreadsheets.
Microsoft PowerPoint knowledge and presentation creation.

Preferred: ERP software (Visual or SAP) understanding of BOM structures
AutoDesk Vault
Programming ability in VBA (Visual Basic for Applications).

Leadership & Business
Required:
Strong written and verbal communication in English.
Ability to lead technical discussions and influence engineering decisions.
Ability to mentor and coach other team members.

Preferred: Ex

jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Project Engineer will be responsible for the technical execution and successful delivery of pumping system projects, ensuring adherence to specifications, budget, and schedule.

Key Responsibilities

• Assist in developing project plans, schedules, estimates, and monitoring progress against milestones.

• Ensure compliance with quality, safety, and contractual requirements throughout project execution.

• Coordinate with vendors and suppliers while tracking deliverables, procurement activities, and material deliveries to site.

• Manage interdisciplinary coordination to achieve project objectives within schedule, budget, and required quality standards.

• Promote and coordinate the resolution of technical issues and provide recommendations to Project Management.

• Participate in technical meetings with customers and suppliers, including HAZOP, P&ID, and 3D Model Reviews, ensuring timely closure of actions.

• Coordinate the preparation and issuance of project documentation, including specifications, plans, requisitions, and other discipline deliverables.

• Review bid requisitions, technical evaluations, tabulations, and recommendations for equipment and material awards.

• Identify, control, and monitor project changes, ensuring proper processing of potential change orders and project impacts.

• Support Production activities, manage day-to-day interfaces with internal and external stakeholders, conduct weekly project reviews, and promote effective project management practices.

Qualifications / Requirements

• BSc or MSc in Engineering; Project Management specialization preferred.

• PMP Certification.

• Minimum 4 years of experience in the Energy & Infrastructure sector or related industries.

• Strong understanding of project management principles and planning tools.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

• Experience working with customers, suppliers, and multidisciplinary teams.

• Strong English communication and negotiation skills.

• Ability to work independently and support international assignments.

• Effective decision-making, teamwork, and coordination skills.

What we offer you

• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

• A great working environment.

• Work Location: Riyadh- Industrial Area 2

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: R2R Sr Accountant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The RTR Senior Accountant in the Center of Excellence (CoE) works in a RTR SWAT team assigned to multiple countries, supporting the Record to Report (RTR) teams for example with various ad hoc tasks, complex bookings, or the maintenance of the chart of accounts.
• Serve as a key member of the RTR SWAT team in the CoE , providing expert support on ad hoc topics and complex accounting issues

• Support with complicated financial booking activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations

• Manage complex clearing, including reconciliations and adjustments, to maintain accurate financial records

• Utilize advanced knowledge of ERP systems to streamline accounting processes and improve efficiency

• Support the Global Process Owner (GPO) with the definition of RTR processes and system implementation

• Maintain and update the chart of accounts and hierarchies, ensuring it reflects the current business structure and reporting requirements

• Collaborate closely with local Finance Teams in countries and Finance Shared Services teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider

• Coordinate with other departments and the Finance Shared Services teams to ensure all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger

• Support where required with the period end close, including closing the accounts receivable/payable subledger and reconcile with the general ledger; close general ledger, open new financial period, close Asset Accounting (AA)

• Support with the preparation of complex journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the RTR process, leveraging technology and best practices; maintain policies, procedures and templates

• Ensure financial internal controls are in place and followed for the processes performed by this role

• Do all technical Year End Closing activities such as balance carry forward, number range creations, close of AA

• Support Intercompany reconciliation process in Coprocess and Tagetik (fix variances)

Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 3-4 years of experience in Accounting with a strong focus on general ledger and financial reporting

• CPA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent certification preferred

Critical success factors

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and management skills

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and integrity in financial reporting

• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment

• Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to senior leadership

Technical & language skills

• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala ) and accounting software

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Experience with Tagetik, Coprocess and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Proficiency in English

What we offer you

• 12 days of vacation per year

• 50% vacation bonus

• Major medical expenses insurance for the employee

• 30 days Christmas bonus (aguinaldo)

• 8% savings fund

• Savings cooperative / savings bank

• Free cafeteria / free meals

• Seniority recognition every 5 years

• Pension plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Industrial Machinery Project Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As an Industrial Machinery Project Manager, you will lead moderately complex projects from initiation through completion, ensuring the project will be delivered safely, on time, within scope, and within budget. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers and stakeholders, while coordinating cross-functional teams to achieve high-quality outcomes and strong client satisfaction. Key Responsibilities

• Project Leadership
• Lead mid-sized projects, ensuring adherence to schedules, budgets, and quality standards.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout project execution.

• Drive accountability across teams to meet project milestones and deliverables.

• Project Planning & Coordination
• Develop and manage detailed project plans, including timelines, budgets, and resource allocation.

• Lead estimating efforts, including takeoffs and input into the quoting system.

• Assign tasks and coordinate activities across internal teams, contractors, and vendors.

• Communication & Reporting
• Provide clear, consistent updates on project status, performance, and risks.

• Maintain accurate project documentation, including schedules, reports, and risk logs.

• Escalate issues that may impact cost, schedule, or quality.

• Safety & Compliance
• Ensure compliance with OSHA, NEC, and company safety standards.

• Conduct site audits and address safety concerns proactively.

• Support the integration of environmentally responsible and sustainable practices.

• Risk Management
• Identify potential project risks and develop mitigation strategies.

• Monitor project performance and implement corrective actions when needed.

• Team Collaboration
• Collaborate with customers, engineers, field teams, and contractors to resolve challenges.

• Promote teamwork and maintain alignment on project goals.

• Continuous Improvement
• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, cost control, and project execution.

• Support the development and implementation of best practices.

• Additional Responsibilities
• Perform other duties as needed to support business objectives and project success.

• Pursuing ongoing learning and professional development opportunities

Qualifications & Competencies
Required:

• 2–4 years of experience in project management or project coordination

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management software

• Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings and specifications.

• Knowledge of NEC standards, OSHA regulations, and environmental compliance

• Experience with estimating, quoting, and takeoff processes.
Preferred:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, Project Management, or related field

• Experience working with cross-functional teams.

• PMP, CAPM, or similar project management certification

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Inhouse Consultant BI&Analytics
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Are you passionate about transforming data into business value? Do you enjoy working closely with senior stakeholders and influencing business decisions through analytics, insights, and emerging technologies?
At Sulzer, we're embarking on an exciting journey from traditional Business Intelligence towards Artificial Intelligence-powered solutions. We're looking for an experienced Inhouse Consultant BI & Analytics to join our Global IT BI & Analytics team in Madrid and help drive our data-driven transformation.
This is not a pure IT development role. We are looking for someone who can combine strong technical expertise with business consulting skills, building trusted relationships with senior leaders across the business while delivering innovative analytics solutions.

What You'll Be Doing

As part of our global BI & Analytics team, you will work closely with business stakeholders across Sulzer to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and deliver solutions that drive better decision-making.
Key responsibilities include:

• Partnering with business leaders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable analytics solutions

• Designing, developing and enhancing enterprise BI applications using Qlik Sense

• Delivering meaningful insights and dashboards that support strategic and operational decision-making

• Working with Snowflake and modern data platforms to create trusted, scalable data solutions

• Supporting Sulzer's "One Sulzer" harmonisation strategy through standardised reporting and analytics

• Driving self-service analytics and data literacy across the organisation

• Exploring and implementing emerging technologies including AI, Generative AI, Copilots and Agentic AI solutions

• Building intelligent applications and data products that connect to Sulzer's modern data platform

• Collaborating with Data Engineering teams to develop robust data models and scalable solutions

• Acting as a trusted advisor to both business and IT stakeholders globally

Essential Skills & Experience

• Minimum 5 years' experience in a Business Intelligence, Analytics or Inhouse Consulting role

• Strong hands-on experience with Qlik Sense

• Advanced SQL skills

• Experience working with senior business stakeholders

• Strong business consulting and stakeholder management skills

• Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into technical solutions

• Excellent communication and presentation skills

Highly Desirable

• Experience with Snowflake

• Knowledge of modern data warehousing concepts

• Experience with dbt

• Exposure to Power BI, Tableau or Looker

• Experience in AI, Generative AI, Copilots or emerging analytics technologies

• Experience working within an international or global organisation

The Opportunity
This is a unique opportunity for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of business, data, analytics and AI. You'll play a key role in helping Sulzer evolve from traditional reporting and dashboards towards intelligent, AI-enabled business solutions that create measurable value across the organisation.
If you're excited by modern analytics, emerging AI technologies, and partnering with senior business leaders to drive transformation, we'd love to hear from you.

What we offer you

• Permanent position within a globally recognised industrial technology leader

• Competitive salary

• Annual bonus scheme

• Meal vouchers

• Flexible benefits package including health insurance, transport and childcare options

• Opportunity to work with cutting-edge Data & AI technologies

• Be part of a highly experienced team

• International exposure working with stakeholders across multiple business domains

• Career growth opportunities within a global orga

descriptionByLocale.fr:

Sur le rôle

Êtes-vous passionné par la transformation des données en valeur opérationnelle? Vous aimez travailler en étroite collaboration avec des intervenants de haut niveau et influencer les décisions d'affaires par l'analyse, les idées et les technologies émergentes?

• Partenariat avec les chefs d'entreprise pour comprendre les exigences et les traduire en solutions analytiques évolutives

• Travailler avec Snowflake et des plateformes de données modernes pour créer des solutions de données fiables et évolutives

• Soutenir la stratégie d'harmonisation « One Sulzer » de Sulzer par des rapports et des analyses normalisés

• Diriger l'analyse en libre-service et la connaissance des données dans l'ensemble de l'organisation

• Explorer et mettre en œuvre les technologies émergentes, y compris l'IA, l'IA Generative, les copilotes et les solutions d'IA Agentic

• Construire des applications intelligentes et des produits de données qui se connectent à la plate-forme de données moderne de Sulzer

• Collaborer avec les équipes de Data Engineering pour développer des modèles de données robustes et des solutions évolutives

• Agir en tant que conseiller de confiance auprès des intervenants du monde des affaires et des TI

Compétences et expérience essentielles

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans un rôle de Business Intelligence, Analytics ou Inhouse Consulting

• Forte expérience pratique avec Qlik Sense

• Compétences avancées SQL

• Expérience de travail avec les principaux intervenants commerciaux

• Renforcement des compétences en conseil aux entreprises et en gestion des intervenants

• Expérience de collecte d'exigences commerciales et de traduction en solutions techniques

• Excellentes compétences en communication et présentation

Très désirable

• Expérience avec Snowflake

• Connaissance des concepts modernes d'entreposage des données

• Expérience avec dbt

• Exposition à Power BI, Tableau ou Looker

• Expérience dans l'IA, l'IA Generative, les copilotes ou les technologies d'analyse émergentes

• Expérience de travail au sein d'une organisation internationale ou mondiale

L'opportunité
C'est une occasion unique pour quelqu'un qui aime opérer à l'intersection des affaires, des données, de l'analyse et de l'IA. Vous jouerez un rôle clé en aidant Sulzer à évoluer de rapports traditionnels et tableaux de bord vers des solutions d'affaires intelligentes et adaptées à l'IA qui créent une valeur mesurable dans toute l'organisation.
Si vous êtes excité par l'analyse moderne, les technologies d'IA émergentes et le partenariat avec des chefs d'entreprise seniors pour stimuler la transformation, nous aimerions avoir de vos nouvelles.

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Position permanente au sein d'un leader mondial des technologies industrielles

• Salaire compétitif

• Régime annuel de primes

• Bons de repas

• Paquet de prestations flexibles comprenant l'assurance maladie, les transports et les options de garde d'enfants

• Possibilité de travailler avec les technologies de pointe de Data & AI

• Faites partie d'une équipe hautement expérimentée

• Exposition internationale en collaboration avec les parties prenantes dans plusieurs domaines d'activité

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join our Digital Marketing team and help us make Digital Marketing excellent.

We are seeking a Digital Marketing Manager who possesses a blend of strategic thinking, creativity, and technical expertise. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of digital marketing channels, marketing automation using Hubspot and the data-driven optimization of marketing activities.

Overall, we are looking for someone who can drive impactful digital initiatives, enhance brand visibility, and in particular contribute to business growth in a strong collaboration with the business.
You will do:

• Hands-on Awareness and Lead Generation Campaigns

• Setting up comprehensive multi-channel campaigns for awareness, lead generation and retargeting

• Creation of landing pages, paid ads (Google, Linkedin and others), webinars, newsletters

• Monitor and manage lead lifecycle, lead scoring, nurturing, contact segmentation, and data cleansing

• Development and execution of compelling lead nurture programs across target business segments and sales funnel stages

• Sales Enablement and Integration

• Educate, enable and encourage the sales teams regarding demand generation processes and tools to ensure leads generation and conversion to opportunities

• Ensure sound integration of marketing automation tools with CRM for end-to-end processing of leads

• Evaluate and support sales-initiated marketing activities

• Website Rehaul and Content Optimization

• Define new webpage components to optimize web page UI / UX

• Improve content based on keyword research, SEO / GEO / AEO aspects, consistent with Sulzer brand and style guidelines.

• Optimize website structure and technical basics to ensure all content is highly visible to users and AI

• Reporting and Metrics

• Report and develop relevant Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure business impact of digital marketing activities

You need to succeed:

• Hands-on knowledge in digital campaign set up & execution and performance tracking

• Proven work experience in website creation and maintenance, marketing automation, content marketing and social media marketing

• Excellent understanding Hubspot is a must ; good understanding of CRM system

• Minimum of 3- 5 years experience in lead management, marketing automation and digital marketing project management

• Excellent knowledge in website analytics (Google Analytics, Tag Manager) , Google Ads , SEO / GEO

• Able to effectively work and communicate at all levels within a matrix organization

• Analytical mindset

• High degree of independence and pragmatism

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package (e.g. health insurance, transport, childcare)

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A Good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.

• Offices location: Nuevos Ministerios

* Additional benefits may apply depending on the position and location.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Responsible for driving business development, product specialization, sales enablement, and strategic opportunity leadership to strengthen Sulzer’s position as the leading independent service provider for industrial steam turbines and process gas compressors. Serving as the regional focal point for Steam Turbines & Compressors (ST&C) across Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), the role implements the global Product Line strategy by translating strategic objectives into actionable regional go-to-market plans.

The position ensures alignment with Sulzer’s overall business strategy while adapting initiatives to local market dynamics, supporting growth, customer engagement, and sustainable market leadership. Business Development Manager & Product Specialist – Steam Turbine & Compressor Services (SSA)

Location: Johannesburg, South Africa
Region: Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA)
Division: Sulzer Services

Sulzer is a global leader in engineering and services, dedicated to delivering innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers. We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Business Development Manager & Product Specialist – Steam Turbine & Compressor Services to lead the growth of our Steam Turbine & Compressor (ST&C) business across Sub-Saharan Africa.

This is a strategic regional role combining business development, product specialization, sales enablement, and opportunity leadership to strengthen Sulzer's position as the leading independent service provider for industrial steam turbines and process gas compressors. Acting as the regional focal point for ST&C, you will translate global product line strategies into impactful regional growth initiatives while building long-term customer relationships and expanding Sulzer's market presence across Africa.

What You Will Be Doing

• Drive profitable growth of Sulzer's Turbine & Compressor Services portfolio across Sub-Saharan Africa.

• Develop and execute regional go-to-market strategies aligned with global ST&C objectives.

• Identify, qualify, and convert opportunities across diverse industrial sectors and multi-OEM installed bases.

• Support and enable sales teams through technical-commercial expertise and opportunity development.

• Lead strategic, high-value pursuits and coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver winning customer solutions.

• Build strong relationships with customers, asset owners, operators, EPCs, and business partners across the region.

• Promote Sulzer's "One Sulzer" approach by leveraging global engineering, service centre, field service, and technical expertise.

• Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and emerging opportunities to support sustainable growth.

•
What We're Looking For

• Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent qualification.

• Minimum of 8 years' experience within the industrial turbomachinery service industry.

• Demonstrated experience with industrial steam turbines and/or process gas compressors.

• Strong technical and commercial acumen with the ability to develop and deliver customer-focused solutions.

• Proven track record in business development, opportunity management, and sales leadership.

• Experience operating within matrix organizations and emerging markets will be advantageous.

• Excellent stakeholder engagement, influencing, and relationship-building skills.

This role requires regular travel throughout Sub-Saharan Africa (approximately 40–60%) and the ability to work effectively in diverse and emerging market environments.

• Revenue and order intake growth.

• Increased installed base penetration and market share.

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro

Responsabile per lo sviluppo aziendale, la specializzazione del prodotto, l'attivazione delle vendite e la leadership strategica di opportunità per rafforzare la posizione di Sulzer come fornitore di servizi indipendente leader per turbine a vapore industriali e compressori di gas di processo. Servendo come punto focale regionale per Steam Turbines & Compressors (ST&C) attraverso l'Africa subsahariana (SSA), il ruolo implementa la strategia globale della linea di prodotto traducendo obiettivi strategici in piani di go-to-market regionali attuabili.

La posizione garantisce l’allineamento con la strategia aziendale globale di Sulzer, adattando al contempo le iniziative alle dinamiche del mercato locale, sostenendo la crescita, l’impegno dei clienti e la leadership di mercato sostenibile. Business Development Manager & Product Specialist – Servizi di turbine e compressori di vapore (SSA)

Ubicazione: Johannesburg, Sudafrica
Regione: Africa subsahariana (SSA)
Divisione: Servizi Sulzer

Sulzer è leader globale nell'ingegneria e nei servizi, dedicato alla fornitura di soluzioni innovative e sostenibili per i nostri clienti. Siamo alla ricerca di un Business Development Manager & Product Specialist esperto e commercialmente guidato – Steam Turbine & Compressor Services per condurre la crescita del nostro business Steam Turbine & Compressor (ST&C) in tutta l'Africa subsahariana.

Si tratta di un ruolo strategico regionale che combina lo sviluppo aziendale, la specializzazione dei prodotti, il rendimento delle vendite e la leadership di opportunità per rafforzare la posizione di Sulzer come fornitore di servizi indipendente leader per turbine a vapore industriali e compressori di gas di processo. In qualità di punto focale regionale per ST&C, tradurrai strategie di linea di prodotti globali in iniziative di crescita regionale incisive, costruendo relazioni con i clienti a lungo termine e espandendo la presenza di mercato di Sulzer in tutta l'Africa.

Cosa farai

• Promuovere una crescita redditizia del portafoglio di Turbine & Compressor Services di Sulzer in tutta l'Africa subsahariana.

• Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie regionali di go-to-market allineate agli obiettivi globali di ST&C.

• Identificare, qualificare e convertire opportunità in diversi settori industriali e basi multi-OEM installate.

• Supporto e abilitare i team di vendita attraverso competenze tecnico-commerciali e lo sviluppo delle opportunità.

• Condurre inseguimenti strategici e di alto valore e coordinare team interfunzionali per fornire soluzioni clienti vincenti.

• Costruire relazioni forti con clienti, proprietari di asset, operatori, EPC e partner commerciali in tutta la regione.

• Promuovere l'approccio "One Sulzer" di Sulzer sfruttando l'ingegneria globale, il centro assistenza, il servizio sul campo e le competenze tecniche.

• Monitorare le tendenze del mercato, l'attività dei concorrenti e le opportunità emergenti per sostenere la crescita sostenibile.

•
Cosa stiamo cercando

• Laurea in ingegneria meccanica o qualifica equivalente.

• Esperienza minima di 8 anni nell'industria dei servizi turbomacchine industriali.

• Esperienza dimostrata con turbine a vapore industriali e/o compressori a gas di processo.

• Forte acume tecnico e commerciale con la capacità di sviluppare e fornire soluzioni orientate al cliente.

• Provato record di traccia in sviluppo aziendale, gestione delle opportunità e leadership di vendita.

• L'esperienza che opera all'interno di organizzazioni di matrice e mercati emergenti sarà vantaggiosa.

• Eccellente coinvolgimento delle parti interessate, influenzando e capacità di costruzione di relazioni.

•
Richiesta di viaggio
Questo ruolo richiede viaggi regolari in tutta l'Africa subsahariana (circa il 40-60%) e la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in ambienti di mercato diversi ed emergenti.

Che successo sembra
Il candidato di successo contribuirà a:

• Crescita delle entrate e dell'ordine.

• Aumentata penetrazione di base installata e quota di mercato.

• Opportunità strategica vince e ser a lungo termine

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un responsable du développement commercial et spécialiste des produits – Turbine à vapeur et compresseur Services pour diriger la croissance de notre entreprise de turbine à vapeur et compresseur (ST&C) dans toute l'Afrique subsaharienne.

Il s'agit d'un rôle stratégique régional combinant le développement des entreprises, la spécialisation des produits, la capacité de vente et le leadership d'opportunité pour renforcer la position de Sulzer en tant que premier fournisseur de services indépendant pour les turbines à vapeur industrielles et les compresseurs de gaz de procédé. En tant que point focal régional pour la ST&C, vous transformerez les stratégies globales de gamme de produits en initiatives de croissance régionale impactées tout en établissant des relations client à long terme et en élargissant la présence de Sulzer sur le marché en Afrique.

Ce que vous ferez

• Conduire une croissance rentable du portefeuille Turbine & Compresseur Services de Sulzer dans toute l'Afrique subsaharienne.

• Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies régionales de mise en marché conformes aux objectifs mondiaux en matière de ST&C.

• Identifier, qualifier et convertir les possibilités dans divers secteurs industriels et bases installées à plusieurs OEM.

• Soutenir et permettre aux équipes de vente par l'expertise technique et commerciale et le développement des opportunités.

• Diriger des activités stratégiques de grande valeur et coordonner des équipes interfonctionnelles pour offrir des solutions gagnantes aux clients.

• Établir des relations solides avec les clients, les propriétaires d'actifs, les exploitants, les EPC et les partenaires commerciaux de toute la région.

• Promouvoir l'approche « One Sulzer » de Sulzer en tirant parti de l'ingénierie mondiale, du centre de services, du service sur le terrain et de l'expertise technique.

• Surveiller les tendances du marché, l'activité des concurrents et les nouvelles possibilités de soutenir une croissance durable.

•
Ce que nous cherchons

• Baccalauréat en génie mécanique ou diplôme équivalent.

• Minimum de 8 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie des services de turbomachines.

• Expérience démontrée avec les turbines à vapeur industrielles et/ou les compresseurs de gaz de procédé.

• Forte adéquation technique et commerciale avec la capacité de développer et de fournir des solutions axées sur le client.

• Expérience éprouvée en développement commercial, gestion des opportunités et leadership commercial.

• L'expérience des organisations matricielles et des marchés émergents sera avantageuse.

• Excellent engagement des intervenants, influence et compétences en matière d'établissement de relations.

•
Frais de voyage
Ce rôle exige des déplacements réguliers dans toute l'Afrique subsaharienne (environ 40 à 60 %) et la capacité de travailler efficacement dans des environnements de marché divers et émergents.

À quoi ressemble le succès
La candidate reçue contribuera à :

• Croissance des recettes et des commandes.

• Augmentation de la pénétration de la base installée et de la part de marché.

• Les opportunités stratégiques et le service à long terme

jobs.title: Retrofit Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer RES Canada is seeking a technically strong and customer focused Retrofit Specialist to join our Ontario team. In this role, you will partner closely with Sales to identify, develop, and secure turnkey retrofit and upgrade opportunities for rotating equipment across Eastern Canada.
This position is ideal for an engineer who enjoys blending technical depth with customer engagement, and who thrives in a role that directly contributes to business growth. Strategic & Sales Support

• Support the Retrofits Supervisor – Canada in executing regional strategy, sales planning, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Develop territory‑specific plans to grow retrofit opportunities based on technical insight and customer needs.

• Serve as the primary technical resource for the Sales Team and customers on retrofit‑related inquiries.
Opportunity Identification & Customer Engagement

• Lead customer‑facing activities such as asset reviews, health checks, technical forums, and site visits to uncover retrofit opportunities.

• Build strong, trust‑based relationships that position Sulzer as the preferred provider for retrofit solutions.

• Intermittent travel requirements estimated at 30% based on business needs (success in this role depends on being present with customers).

• Use the CRM system (Salesforce) to track opportunities and support sales pipeline visibility.
Engineering Support

• Conduct technical assessments of rotating equipment to identify retrofit, upgrade, and rerate opportunities.

• Translate customer performance issues into clear scopes of work and retrofit concepts.

• Develop preliminary engineering calculations, hydraulic and equipment selections, and conceptual designs for proposals.

• Review historical equipment data and performance curves to recommend optimized solutions.

• Prepare technical documentation including specifications, design briefs, and engineering justifications.

• Collaborate with Service Center operations and engineering teams to validate feasibility and risk considerations.

• Provide technical clarification during proposal and negotiation phases.

• Stay current on emerging technologies and design practices relevant to rotating equipment retrofits.
Proposal Development & Technical Delivery

• Prepare clear, technically robust retrofit proposals that highlight Sulzer’s value proposition.

• Work with the Toronto Service Center to identify retrofit potential within incoming repair projects.

• Ensure accurate categorization and tracking of retrofit orders in company systems.

• Provide timely input toward the Rolling Forecast (RFC) process for the assigned territory.
Execution & Handover

• Support the full proposal lifecycle and orders review.

• Participate in handover meetings to ensure technical requirements and execution strategy are clearly communicated to execution teams.

• Ensure smooth transition from pre‑order to post‑order execution through effective documentation and communication.

• Participate in sales meetings and provide technical updates from the region.

Safety, Quality & Compliance

• Follow all safety, health, and environmental procedures in alignment with Sulzer’s EHS Management System.

• Contribute to company‑wide quality initiatives and continuous improvement efforts.

QUALIFICATIONS: What You Bring

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related discipline.

• Experience with rotating equipment (pumps, turbines, compressors, or similar).

• Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to translate technical issues into practical solutions.

• Excellent communication skills and comfort engaging directly with customers.

• Ability to work collaboratively with Sales, Engineering, and Service Center teams.

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sulzer RES Canada sta cercando un tecnico forte e il cliente si è concentrato Retrofit Specialist per unirsi al nostro team Ontario. In questo ruolo, si partner a stretto contatto con le vendite per identificare, sviluppare e garantire la retrofit chiavi in mano e le opportunità di aggiornamento per le attrezzature rotanti in tutto il Canada orientale.
Questa posizione è ideale per un ingegnere che ama fondere la profondità tecnica con l'impegno del cliente, e che prospera in un ruolo che contribuisce direttamente alla crescita aziendale. Supporto strategico e commerciale

• Sostenere il Retrofits Supervisor – Canada nell'esecuzione della strategia regionale, della pianificazione delle vendite e delle iniziative di miglioramento continuo.

• Sviluppare piani specifici per il territorio per aumentare le opportunità di retrofit in base alle informazioni tecniche e alle esigenze dei clienti.

• Servire come risorsa tecnica primaria per il Team Vendite e i clienti sulle richieste relative a retrofit.
Identificazione delle opportunità e coinvolgimento dei clienti

• Leader attività di customer-facing come le recensioni degli asset, i controlli sanitari, i forum tecnici e le visite dei siti per scoprire opportunità di retrofit.

• Costruire relazioni forti e basate sulla fiducia che posizionano Sulzer come fornitore preferito per soluzioni retrofit.

• Requisiti di viaggio intermittenti stimati al 30% in base alle esigenze aziendali (il successo in questo ruolo dipende dall'essere presenti con i clienti).

• Utilizzare il sistema CRM (Salesforce) per monitorare le opportunità e supportare la visibilità delle pipeline di vendita.
Supporto tecnico

• Condurre le valutazioni tecniche delle apparecchiature rotanti per identificare le opportunità di retrofit, aggiornamento e rivalutazione.

• Traduci i problemi delle prestazioni del cliente in ambiti chiari di lavoro e concetti di retrofit.

• Sviluppare calcoli di ingegneria preliminare, selezioni idrauliche e attrezzature e progetti concettuali per le proposte.

• Rivedere i dati e le curve di performance delle attrezzature storiche per consigliare soluzioni ottimizzate.

• Preparare la documentazione tecnica, comprese le specifiche, i brief di progettazione e le giustificazioni ingegneristiche.

• Collabora con le operazioni del Service Center e i team di ingegneria per convalidare la fattibilità e le considerazioni di rischio.

• Fornire chiarificazione tecnica durante le fasi di proposta e negoziazione.

• Resta aggiornato sulle tecnologie emergenti e sulle pratiche di progettazione rilevanti per i retrofit delle apparecchiature rotanti.
Sviluppo delle proposte e consegna tecnica

• Prepara proposte retrofit chiare e tecnicamente robuste che evidenziano la proposizione del valore di Sulzer.

• Lavorare con il Toronto Service Center per identificare il potenziale di retrofit all'interno di progetti di riparazione in arrivo.

• Assicurare la categorizzazione accurata e il monitoraggio degli ordini retrofit nei sistemi aziendali.

• Fornire input tempestivo verso il processo Rolling Forecast (RFC) per il territorio assegnato.
Esecuzione & Handover

• Sostenere l'intero ciclo di vita della proposta e la revisione degli ordini.

• Partecipare alle riunioni di consegna per garantire requisiti tecnici e la strategia di esecuzione sono chiaramente comunicati ai team di esecuzione.

• Assicurare un passaggio regolare dal pre-ordine all'esecuzione post-ordine attraverso una documentazione efficace e una comunicazione.

• Partecipare alle riunioni di vendita e fornire aggiornamenti tecnici dalla regione.

Sicurezza, qualità e conformità

• Seguire tutte le procedure di sicurezza, salute e ambiente in allineamento con il sistema di gestione EHS di Sulzer.

• Contribuisci a iniziative di qualità a livello aziendale e a continui sforzi di miglioramento.

QUALIFICA: Cosa porti

• Laurea in ingegneria meccanica o disciplina relativa.

• Esperienza con attrezzature rotanti (pompi, turbine, compressori o simili).

• Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving con la capacità di tradurre i problemi tecnici in soluzioni pratiche.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e comfort coinvolgendo direttamente con i clienti.

• Capacità di lavorare in collaborazione con i team Sales, Engineering e Service Center.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Sulzer RES Canada sucht einen technisch starken und kundenorientierten Retrofit-Spezialisten, der sich unserem Ontario-Team anschließt. In dieser Rolle arbeiten Sie eng mit Sales zusammen, um schlüsselfertige Nachrüst- und Upgrade-Möglichkeiten für rotierende Geräte in ganz Ostkanada zu identifizieren, zu entwickeln und zu sichern.
Diese Position ist ideal für einen Ingenieur, der technische Tiefe mit Kundenbindung verbindet und in einer Rolle gedeiht, die direkt zum Geschäftswachstum beiträgt. Strategische und Sales Support

• Unterstützen Sie den Retrofits Supervisor – Canada bei der Umsetzung der regionalen Strategie, der Verkaufsplanung und der Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung.

• Entwicklung von gebietsspezifischen Plänen, um Nachrüstungsmöglichkeiten basierend auf technischen Erkenntnissen und Kundenbedürfnissen zu erweitern.

• Dienen Sie als primäre technische Ressource für das Verkaufsteam und Kunden bei Anfragen im Zusammenhang mit der Nachrüstung.
Chancenidentifikation & Customer Engagement

• Führen Sie kundenorientierte Aktivitäten wie Asset Reviews, Gesundheitschecks, technische Foren und Besuche vor Ort durch, um Nachrüstmöglichkeiten aufzudecken.

• Bauen Sie starke, vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, die Sulzer als bevorzugten Anbieter für Nachrüstlösungen positionieren.

• Intermittierende Reiseanforderungen werden auf 30% basierend auf Geschäftsanforderungen geschätzt (der Erfolg in dieser Rolle hängt davon ab, bei den Kunden anwesend zu sein).

• Verwenden Sie das CRM-System (Salesforce), um Chancen zu verfolgen und die Sichtbarkeit der Verkaufspipeline zu unterstützen.
Engineering Support

• Führen Sie technische Bewertungen von rotierenden Geräten durch, um Nachrüst-, Upgrade- und Neubewertungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren.

• Übersetzen Sie Kundenperformance-Themen in klare Arbeits- und Nachrüstkonzepte.

• Entwickeln Sie vorläufige technische Berechnungen, hydraulische und Ausrüstungsauswahlen sowie konzeptionelle Entwürfe für Vorschläge.

• Überprüfen Sie historische Gerätedaten und Leistungskurven, um optimierte Lösungen zu empfehlen.

• Bereiten Sie technische Dokumentation einschließlich Spezifikationen, Design-Briefs und technische Begründungen vor.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Service Center Operations und Engineering-Teams zusammen, um Machbarkeits- und Risikoüberlegungen zu validieren.

• Technische Klärung während der Vorschlags- und Verhandlungsphase.

• Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden über neue Technologien und Designpraktiken, die für Nachrüstungen mit rotierenden Geräten relevant sind.
Projektentwicklung und technische Lieferung

• Bereiten Sie klare, technisch robuste Nachrüstvorschläge vor, die das Wertversprechen von Sulzer hervorheben.

• Arbeiten Sie mit dem Toronto Service Center zusammen, um Nachrüstpotenziale bei eingehenden Reparaturprojekten zu identifizieren.

• Sicherstellen einer genauen Kategorisierung und Nachverfolgung von Nachrüstaufträgen in Unternehmenssystemen.

• Geben Sie rechtzeitig Input für den Rolling Forecast (RFC) Prozess für das zugewiesene Gebiet.
Ausführung & Übergabe

• Unterstützen Sie die Überprüfung des vollständigen Vorschlagslebenszyklus und der Bestellungen.

• Nehmen Sie an Übergabebesprechungen teil, um sicherzustellen, dass die technischen Anforderungen und die Ausführungsstrategie den Ausführungsteams klar mitgeteilt werden.

• Gewährleistung eines reibungslosen Übergangs von der Vor- zur Nachbestellung durch effektive Dokumentation und Kommunikation.

• Nehmen Sie an Verkaufsgesprächen teil und stellen Sie technische Updates aus der Region bereit.

Sicherheit, Qualität & Compliance

• Befolgen Sie alle Sicherheits-, Gesundheits- und Umweltverfahren in Übereinstimmung mit dem EHS Management System von Sulzer.

• Beitrag zu unternehmensweiten Qualitätsinitiativen und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsbemühungen.

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Maschinenbau oder verwandte Disziplin.

• Erfahrung mit rotierenden Geräten (Pumpen, Turbinen, Kompressoren oder ähnliches).

• Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, technische Probleme in praktische Lösungen zu übersetzen.

Sulzer RES Canada est à la recherche d'un spécialiste de la rénovation techniquement solide et axé sur les clients pour rejoindre notre équipe ontarienne. Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec Sales afin d'identifier, de développer et de sécuriser les possibilités de modernisation et d'amélioration clés en main de l'équipement rotatif dans l'est du Canada.
Cette position est idéale pour un ingénieur qui aime allier profondeur technique et engagement client, et qui prospère dans un rôle qui contribue directement à la croissance des entreprises. Soutien stratégique et commercial

• Appuyer le superviseur des améliorations – Canada dans l'exécution de la stratégie régionale, de la planification des ventes et des initiatives d'amélioration continue.

• Élaborer des plans propres à chaque territoire pour accroître les possibilités de modernisation en fonction des connaissances techniques et des besoins des clients.

• Servir de principale ressource technique pour l'équipe des ventes et les clients pour les demandes de modernisation.

• Effectuer des évaluations techniques de l'équipement rotatif afin de déterminer les possibilités de modernisation, d'amélioration et de réévaluation.

• Restez au courant des nouvelles technologies et des pratiques de conception pertinentes pour la mise à niveau de l'équipement rotatif.
Élaboration de la proposition et prestation technique

• Préparer des propositions de modernisation claires et techniquement robustes qui mettent en évidence la proposition de valeur de Sulzer.

• Collaborer avec le Toronto Service Center pour déterminer le potentiel de rénovation dans les projets de réparation entrants.

• Assurer une catégorisation et un suivi précis des commandes de modernisation dans les systèmes d'entreprise.

• Fournir des commentaires en temps opportun sur le processus des prévisions glissantes (PMR) pour le territoire attribué.
Exécution & Remise

• Appuyer le cycle de vie complet de la proposition et l'examen des commandes.

• Participer aux réunions de transfert pour s'assurer que les exigences techniques et la stratégie d'exécution sont clairement communiquées aux équipes d'exécution.

• Assurer une transition sans heurt de l'exécution préalable à l'ordre par une documentation et une communication efficaces.

• Participer aux réunions de vente et fournir des mises à jour techniques de la région.

Sécurité, qualité et conformité

• Suivez toutes les procédures en matière de sécurité, de santé et d'environnement conformément au système de gestion EHS de Sulzer.

• Contribuer aux initiatives de qualité à l'échelle de l'entreprise et aux efforts d'amélioration continue.

• Baccalauréat en génie mécanique ou discipline connexe.

jobs.title: HR Intern
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Assist the HR team with end-to-end recruitment activities, including candidate sourcing, resume screening, interview coordination, maintaining recruitment records, job posting administration, and supporting onboarding processes to ensure an efficient hiring experience.
Key Responsibilities

• Assist in sourcing candidates through job portals, social media, and internal databases.

• Screen resumes and shortlist suitable candidates based on job requirements.

• Coordinate interview scheduling between candidates and hiring managers.

• Communicate with candidates regarding interview arrangements and application status.

• Maintain and update candidate records in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

• Support the recruitment team in posting job advertisements and monitoring applications.

• Prepare recruitment-related documents, reports, and interview materials.

• Conduct reference checks and assist with pre-employment documentation.

• Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.

• Provide administrative support for recruitment and onboarding activities.

What we offer you

.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
