jobs.title: Assembly Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer Leeds, we don't just manufacture pumps. We engineer some of the world's most advanced pumping solutions for critical applications across energy, water, infrastructure, industrial processing and emerging technologies.

Our Leeds facility is a global centre of excellence for the design, engineering and manufacture of highly specialised pumps and pumping systems. From bespoke, large-scale engineered solutions to complex rotodynamic technologies, our teams tackle some of the most demanding technical challenges in the industry.

As we continue to invest in our people, technology and capabilities, we are looking for talented individuals who want to make a real impact and build a rewarding career within a world-class engineering environment. Key Duties

• Assemble, build and fit complex centrifugal pump assemblies and associated equipment in line with engineering drawings, specifications and quality standards.

• Carry out mechanical fitting activities including bearing installation, shaft assembly, impeller fitting, seal installation and final pump build.

• Interpret engineering drawings, assembly instructions and technical documentation to ensure accurate assembly of components.

• Use precision measuring equipment to verify dimensions, tolerances and alignment

What We're Looking For

• Time-served Mechanical Fitter, Mechanical Assembly Technician, or equivalent mechanical engineering apprenticeship.

• Experience assembling rotating equipment such as pumps, compressors, gearboxes, turbines or similar precision-engineered machinery.

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.

• Skilled in the use of hand tools, mechanical assembly equipment and precision measuring instruments.

• Strong understanding of mechanical tolerances, fits, alignments and assembly techniques.

• Experience working within a manufacturing, engineering or heavy industrial environment.

• A proactive approach to problem-solving with excellent attention to detail.

What we offer you

We’ve recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds facility — creating a brighter, more efficient, and more advanced workspace designed to support high‑quality work and a great employee experience. Alongside our upgraded facilities, you’ll benefit from:

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• A company-wide bonus scheme

• Paid overtime opportunities

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (covering everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services)

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sur le rôle

Chez Sulzer Leeds, nous ne fabriquons pas seulement des pompes. Nous concevons certaines des solutions de pompage les plus avancées au monde pour des applications critiques dans les domaines de l'énergie, de l'eau, des infrastructures, du traitement industriel et des technologies émergentes.

Notre installation Leeds est un centre mondial d'excellence pour la conception, l'ingénierie et la fabrication de pompes et de systèmes de pompage hautement spécialisés. Des solutions conçues sur mesure et à grande échelle aux technologies rotodynamiques complexes, nos équipes s'attaquent à certains des défis techniques les plus exigeants de l'industrie.

Alors que nous continuons d'investir dans nos ressources humaines, notre technologie et nos capacités, nous cherchons des personnes talentueuses qui veulent avoir un impact réel et bâtir une carrière enrichissante dans un environnement d'ingénierie de calibre mondial. Principales fonctions

• Assemblez, construisez et adaptez des ensembles de pompes centrifuges complexes et des équipements associés conformément aux plans techniques, aux spécifications et aux normes de qualité.

• Effectuer des activités de montage mécanique, y compris l'installation du roulement, l'assemblage de l'arbre, le montage des roues, l'installation des joints et la construction finale de la pompe.

• Interpréter les dessins techniques, les instructions de montage et la documentation technique pour assurer le montage précis des composants.

• Utiliser un équipement de mesure de précision pour vérifier les dimensions, les tolérances et l'alignement

Ce que nous cherchons

• Atterrisseur mécanique, technicien d'assemblage mécanique ou apprentissage équivalent en génie mécanique.

• Capacité de lire et d'interpréter des dessins techniques et des spécifications techniques.

• Compétence dans l'utilisation d'outils à main, d'équipement de montage mécanique et d'instruments de mesure de précision.

• Une bonne compréhension des tolérances mécaniques, des ajustements, des alignements et des techniques de montage.

• Expérience de travail dans un environnement industriel lourd, industriel ou industriel.

• Une approche proactive de la résolution des problèmes avec une excellente attention aux détails.

Ce que nous vous offrons

Nous avons récemment investi considérablement dans la modernisation de notre installation Leeds, en créant un espace de travail plus lumineux, plus efficace et plus avancé, conçu pour soutenir un travail de haute qualité et une grande expérience des employés. En plus de nos installations améliorées, vous bénéficierez de:

Avantages de base

• Un régime de bonus à l'échelle de l'entreprise

• Possibilités d'heures supplémentaires payées

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting the sales process by providing technical expertise, assisting with product demonstrations, and preparing proposals. This role works closely with senior engineers and sales teams to ensure customer requirements are met.

jobs.title: MRP Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we are driving exciting transformation projects across our manufacturing operations. As part of our SAP implementation journey, we are looking for a motivated MRP Controller to join our Burgos site and support the development of our planning capabilities.
This is an excellent opportunity for a planning professional who wants to build expertise in production planning, ERP systems, and manufacturing operations while contributing to a key business transformation project.
Key Responsibilities

• Run the MRP system on a daily basis, ensuring that planned production orders and requisitions are aligned with the Master Production Plan.

• Perform capacity analysis by regularly assessing workload versus the plant’s installed capacity, identifying bottlenecks and recommending additional shifts or resource reallocation through the system when needed.

• Monitor production plan compliance by tracking actual manufacturing progress against the scheduled plan, analyzing deviations such as scrap, mechanical failures, absenteeism or delays, and promptly rescheduling the system to keep it updated.

• Update and manage key performance indicators (KPIs).

To succeed in this role, you will need

• Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.

• 1-3 years of experience in production planning, materials planning, supply chain, manufacturing operations, or similar environments.

• Experience working with ERP systems.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage priorities in a dynamic manufacturing environment.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

• Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel.

• Fluent Spanish and a good level of English.

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package (e.g. health insurance, transport, childcare)

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.

• Offices location: Burgos

* Additional benefits may apply depending on the position and location.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Führen Sie das MRP-System täglich aus und stellen Sie sicher, dass geplante Produktionsaufträge und -anforderungen mit dem Master-Produktionsplan übereinstimmen.

• Führen Sie eine Kapazitätsanalyse durch regelmäßige Bewertung der Arbeitsbelastung im Vergleich zur installierten Kapazität der Anlage durch, identifizieren Sie Engpässe und empfehlen Sie bei Bedarf zusätzliche Schichten oder Ressourcenumschichtungen durch das System.

• Überwachen Sie die Einhaltung des Produktionsplans, indem Sie den tatsächlichen Fertigungsfortschritt mit dem geplanten Plan verfolgen, Abweichungen wie Ausschuss, mechanische Ausfälle, Fehlzeiten oder Verzögerungen analysieren und das System umgehend neu planen, um es auf dem neuesten Stand zu halten.

• Aktualisieren und Verwalten von Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, müssen Sie

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Industrial Engineering, Maschinenbau, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing Engineering oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• 1-3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Produktionsplanung, Materialplanung, Lieferkette, Fertigung oder ähnlichen Umgebungen.

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit ERP-Systemen.

• Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten.

• Fähigkeit, Prioritäten in einer dynamischen Fertigungsumgebung zu verwalten.

• Starke Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit Fähigkeiten.

• Gute Kenntnisse von Microsoft Excel.

• fließend Spanisch und ein gutes Englischniveau.

Was wir Ihnen bieten

• Ein unbefristeter Vertrag.

• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt sowie die Teilnahme am variablen Vergütungssystem basierend auf persönlichen und finanziellen Zielen.

• Essensgutscheine.

• Zugang zu einem freiwilligen flexiblen Vergütungssystem, das es den Mitarbeitern ermöglicht, ihr Gehaltspaket zu optimieren (z. B. Krankenversicherung, Transport, Kinderbetreuung)

• Werden Sie Teil eines erfahrenen und internationalen Teams.

• Ein gutes Vibe Arbeitsumfeld.

• Die Möglichkeit, Ihre Karriere in einem soliden und gut etablierten internationalen Unternehmen auszubauen.

• Seien Sie Teil einer dynamischen Organisation, die sich einer kontinuierlichen Transformation und Verbesserung unterzieht.

• Bürostandort: Burgos

* Zusätzliche Vorteile können je nach Position und Standort gelten.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Chez Sulzer, nous menons des projets de transformation passionnants dans nos activités de fabrication. Dans le cadre de notre parcours de mise en œuvre SAP, nous recherchons un contrôleur MRP motivé pour rejoindre notre site Burgos et soutenir le développement de nos capacités de planification.
C'est une excellente occasion pour un professionnel de la planification qui veut acquérir une expertise dans la planification de la production, les systèmes ERP et les opérations de fabrication tout en contribuant à un projet clé de transformation opérationnelle.
Principales responsabilités

• Exécuter quotidiennement le système MRP, en veillant à ce que les commandes et les demandes de production prévues soient conformes au plan directeur de production.

• Effectuer une analyse de la capacité en évaluant régulièrement la charge de travail par rapport à la capacité installée de l'usine, en identifiant les goulets d'étranglement et en recommandant des changements supplémentaires ou une réaffectation des ressources par l'intermédiaire du système, au besoin.

• Surveiller la conformité du plan de production en suivant les progrès réels de la fabrication par rapport au plan prévu, en analysant les écarts tels que la ferraille, les défaillances mécaniques, l'absentéisme ou les retards, et en rééchelonnant rapidement le système pour le tenir à jour.

• Mettre à jour et gérer les indicateurs de rendement clés (ICP).

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous aurez besoin

• Baccalauréat en génie industriel, génie mécanique, gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, génie manufacturier ou un domaine connexe.

• 1-3 ans d'expérience dans la planification de la production, la planification des matériaux, la chaîne d'approvisionnement, les opérations de fabrication ou des environnements semblables.

• Expérience de travail avec les systèmes ERP.

• Forte capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.

• Capacité de gérer les priorités dans un environnement manufacturier dynamique.

• Fortes compétences en communication et en collaboration.

• Bonne connaissance de Microsoft Excel.

• L'espagnol et un bon niveau d'anglais.

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Un contrat permanent.

• Un salaire compétitif ainsi que la participation au système de rémunération variable fondé sur des objectifs personnels et financiers.

• Des bons de repas.

• Accès à un système volontaire de rémunération flexible permettant aux salariés d'optimiser leur salaire (par exemple assurance maladie, transport, garde d'enfants)

• Faites partie d'une équipe expérimentée et internationale.

• Un bon environnement de travail.

• L'occasion de développer votre carrière au sein d'une entreprise internationale solide et bien établie.

• Faites partie d'une organisation dynamique en constante transformation et amélioration.

• Lieu des bureaux: Burgos

* Des avantages supplémentaires peuvent s'appliquer selon le poste et l'emplacement.

Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif.

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.title: Pricing and Data Science Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is a global industrial leader with a worldwide network of over 100 service centres offering state-of-the-art spare parts, maintenance and service solutions for pumps, turbines, compressors, motors and generators. In our Global Parts Pricing & Projects Team we are building pricing as a strategic commercial capability — and we are looking for exceptional analytical talent to accelerate that journey.

The Role
This is not a typical pricing or analytics position. You will sit at the intersection of data science, commercial strategy and digital transformation — shaping pricing decisions across a ~ CHF 1.4B+ Services portfolio spanning 45 countries and 100+ service centres worldwide. You will work directly with the Global Pricing Head and regional leadership to close pricing gaps, build visibility infrastructure and drive measurable commercial impact at scale.
If you have a premier engineering foundation, a consulting mindset and the ambition to build something that matters globally — this role is designed for you.

Your
• Responsibilities

Pricing Strategy & Analytics
● Design and optimize a global pricing strategy for Sulzer's aftermarket — covering OEM spares, repair pricing and VBP models across all product lines
● Build and deploy data-driven pricing models that close the CHF 1.4B+ coverage gap — identifying where margin is left on the table and quantifying the full financial impact
● Develop pricing tools and frameworks enabling consistent, market-responsive pricing decisions across all regions, product lines and customer segments
● Lead profitability analyses, and contract price governance — turning data into clear, executive-ready action plans
● Build pricing dashboards giving leadership real-time visibility into hit rate, end-to-end GP and price increase impact across the full
Services portfolio
Data Science & Artificial Intelligence
● Apply machine learning and AI techniques to pricing optimisation, hit rate analysis and customer segmentation — using Python, R and modern AI tooling
● Design and build pricing APIs and data pipelines that connect pricing logic to operational systems including SAP, Qlik and ZEST across the global service network
● Develop AI-assisted price recommendation engines and automated escalation logic that reduce manual intervention and improve decision speed
● Create Qlik dashboards and data visualisations that bring key pricing KPIs — hit rate, GP, contract prices and price increase impact — to life for business users globally
● Serve as the internal centre of excellence for data science — run workshops, train business teams and build the data infrastructure that makes pricing a proactive commercial engine
Global Projects & Digital Transformation
● Lead and contribute to digitalisation projects across Sulzer's global Service Centre network — from scoping and business case through to implementation and adoption
● Translate complex business problems into structured analytical solutions — develop the idea, build the business case, secure stakeholder buy-in and drive delivery
● Drive commercial excellence initiatives including urgency pricing, customer multiplier models and estimated margin capability — building the pricing infrastructure for 2027 and beyond

Your
• Profile
The ideal candidate combines outstanding quantitative and analytical capability with a consulting-grade ability to structure problems, communicate insights and drive business change. Premier engineering foundations and hands-on data science expertise are the core of what we are looking for.

Academic & Professional Background
● B.Tech / M.Tech from IIT, NIT, BITS Pilani, or equivalent — strong quantitative foundations are non-negotiable; MBA from Tier 1 college is an advantage while not mand

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sulzer è un leader industriale globale con una rete mondiale di oltre 100 centri di servizio che offrono pezzi di ricambio all'avanguardia, soluzioni di manutenzione e assistenza per pompe, turbine, compressori, motori e generatori. Nel nostro Global Parts Pricing & Projects Team stiamo costruendo prezzi come una capacità commerciale strategica - e stiamo cercando un talento analitico eccezionale per accelerare questo viaggio.

Il ruolo
Questa non è una tipica posizione di prezzi o analisi. Ti siederai all'intersezione della scienza dei dati, della strategia commerciale e della trasformazione digitale — modellando le decisioni sui prezzi in un ~ CHF 1.4B+ Portafoglio di servizi con 45 paesi e 100+ centri di assistenza in tutto il mondo. Potrai lavorare direttamente con il Global Pricing Head e la leadership regionale per chiudere le lacune dei prezzi, costruire infrastrutture di visibilità e guidare un impatto commerciale misurabile su scala.
Se avete una fondazione di ingegneria premier, una mentalità di consulenza e l'ambizione di costruire qualcosa che conta a livello globale - questo ruolo è progettato per voi.

Il tuo
• responsabilità

Strategia e analisi dei prezzi
● Progettare e ottimizzare una strategia globale dei prezzi per l'aftermarket di Sulzer — coprendo ricambi OEM, prezzi di riparazione e modelli VBP in tutte le linee di prodotto
● Costruire e distribuire modelli di prezzi basati sui dati che chiudono il divario di copertura di CHF 1.4B+: identificare dove il margine viene lasciato sulla tabella e quantificare l'impatto finanziario completo
● Sviluppare strumenti e framework di prezzi che consentono decisioni di prezzi coerenti e rispondenti al mercato in tutte le regioni, linee di prodotti e segmenti dei clienti
● Analisi della redditività del piombo e governance dei prezzi del contratto — trasformando i dati in piani d'azione chiari e pronti per l'esecutivo
● Costruire cruscotti di prezzi che danno visibilità in tempo reale di leadership nel tasso di successo, GP end-to-end e l'impatto di aumento di prezzo attraverso il pieno
Portafoglio servizi
Scienza dei dati e intelligenza artificiale
● Applicare tecniche di machine learning e AI per l'ottimizzazione dei prezzi, l'analisi dei tassi di successo e la segmentazione dei clienti - utilizzando Python, R e moderni strumenti AI
● Progettazione e costruzione di API di prezzi e datadotti che collegano la logica dei prezzi ai sistemi operativi, tra cui SAP, Qlik e ZEST attraverso la rete di servizi globale
● Sviluppare motori di raccomandazione dei prezzi assistiti da AI e logica di escalation automatizzata che riduce l'intervento manuale e migliora la velocità delle decisioni
● Crea dashboard e visualizzazioni di dati Qlik che portano i KPI di prezzi chiave — tasso di successo, GP, prezzi contrattuali e impatto aumento dei prezzi — alla vita per gli utenti di affari a livello globale
● Servire come centro interno di eccellenza per la scienza dei dati — eseguire workshop, formare i team aziendali e costruire l'infrastruttura dei dati che rende i prezzi un motore commerciale proattivo
Progetti globali e trasformazione digitale
● Condurre e contribuire a progetti di digitalizzazione in tutta la rete globale del Service Centre di Sulzer, dalla ricerca e dal business case fino all'implementazione e all'adozione
● Tradurre complessi problemi di business in soluzioni analitiche strutturate — sviluppare l'idea, costruire il caso di business, sicuro stakeholder buy-in e la consegna del drive
● Guidare iniziative di eccellenza commerciale, tra cui prezzi urgenti, modelli di moltiplicatore clienti e capacità di margine stimata — costruzione dell'infrastruttura dei prezzi per 2027 e oltre

Il tuo
• Profilo
Il candidato ideale combina eccezionale capacità quantitativa e analitica con una capacità di consulenza di strutturare i problemi, comunicare intuizioni e guidare il cambiamento di business. Le prime basi ingegneristiche e le competenze pratiche di data science sono il nucleo di ciò che stiamo cercando.

Sfondo accademico e professionale
● B.Tech / M.Tech da IIT, NIT, BITS Pilani, o equivalente — solide basi quantitative non negoziabili; MBA da Tier 1 college è un vantaggio mentre non mand

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Sulzer est un leader industriel mondial avec un réseau mondial de plus de 100 centres de services offrant des solutions de rechange, d'entretien et de service de pointe pour les pompes, turbines, compresseurs, moteurs et générateurs. Dans notre équipe Global Parts Pricing & Projects, nous construisons la tarification comme une capacité commerciale stratégique — et nous recherchons un talent analytique exceptionnel pour accélérer ce voyage.

Le rôle
Ce n'est pas une position typique en matière de prix ou d'analyse. Vous serez à l'intersection de la science des données, de la stratégie commerciale et de la transformation numérique — façonnant les décisions de tarification à travers un ~ CHF 1.4B+ Portefeuille de services couvrant 45 pays et 100 centres de services dans le monde entier. Vous travaillerez directement avec le responsable des prix mondiaux et les dirigeants régionaux pour combler les écarts de prix, construire une infrastructure de visibilité et générer un impact commercial mesurable à l'échelle.
Si vous avez une fondation d'ingénierie de premier plan, un état d'esprit-conseil et l'ambition de construire quelque chose qui compte au niveau mondial, ce rôle est conçu pour vous.

Votre
• Responsabilités

Stratégie de tarification et d'analyse
● Concevoir et optimiser une stratégie de tarification mondiale pour le marché de l'après-vente de Sulzer — couvrant les pièces détachées d'OEM, les prix de réparation et les modèles VBP pour toutes les gammes de produits
● Élaborer et mettre en place des modèles de tarification fondés sur les données qui comblent l'écart de couverture de CHF 1.4B+, en identifiant où la marge reste sur le tableau et en quantifiant l'impact financier complet
● Élaborer des outils et des cadres de tarification qui permettent de prendre des décisions de tarification cohérentes et adaptées au marché dans toutes les régions, les gammes de produits et les segments de clients
● Analyses de rentabilité et gouvernance des prix contractuels - transformation des données en plans d'action clairs et prêts à l'exécution
● Construire des tableaux de bord des prix donnant une visibilité en temps réel au leadership dans le taux de succès, le GP de bout en bout et l'impact de la hausse des prix
Portefeuille des services
Science des données et intelligence artificielle
● Appliquer les techniques d'apprentissage automatique et d'IA à l'optimisation des prix, à l'analyse des taux de frappe et à la segmentation des clients — en utilisant Python, R et les outils modernes d'IA
● Concevoir et construire des API de tarification et des pipelines de données qui relient la logique de tarification aux systèmes opérationnels, y compris SAP, Qlik et ZEST, à travers le réseau mondial de services
● Développer des moteurs de recommandation de prix assistés par l'IA et une logique d'escalade automatisée qui réduisent l'intervention manuelle et améliorent la vitesse de décision
● Créer des tableaux de bord et des visualisations de données de Qlik qui apportent aux utilisateurs d'affaires à l'échelle mondiale des prix clés des KPI (taux de succès, prix de vente, prix contractuels et impact sur la hausse des prix)
● Servir de centre d'excellence interne pour la science des données — organiser des ateliers, former des équipes d'affaires et construire l'infrastructure de données qui fait de la tarification un moteur commercial proactif
Projets mondiaux et transformation numérique
● Diriger et contribuer à des projets de numérisation dans l'ensemble du réseau mondial des centres de services de Sulzer, depuis la cadrage et l'analyse de rentabilisation jusqu'à la mise en œuvre et l'adoption
● Traduire des problèmes d'affaires complexes en solutions analytiques structurées — développer l'idée, construire l'analyse de rentabilisation, sécuriser l'adhésion des parties prenantes et conduire la livraison
● Encourager les initiatives d'excellence commerciale, y compris les prix d'urgence, les modèles multiplicateurs de clients et la capacité de marge estimée, en renforçant l'infrastructure de tarification pour 2027 et au-delà

Votre
• Profil
Le candidat idéal combine une capacité quantitative et analytique exceptionnelle avec une capacité de conseil pour structurer les problèmes, communiquer des idées et stimuler le changement d'entreprise. Les fondations d'ingénierie de premier plan et l'expertise pratique en sciences des données sont au cœur de ce que nous cherchons.

Contexte académique et professionnel
● B.Tech / M.Tech de l'IIT, NIT, BITS Pilani, ou l'équivalent — de solides fondations quantitatives ne sont pas négociables; MBA du collège de niveau 1 est un avantage sans mandat

Sulzer GT Aero Services is a leading provider of gas turbine maintenance, repair and parts support services, serving customers across the power generation, oil & gas, and industrial sectors. With decades of engineering expertise, we help customers maximise turbine performance, reliability and operational uptime through specialist repair, overhaul and technical support solutions.

About the role

Sulzer GT Aero Services is a leading provider of gas turbine maintenance, repair and parts support services, serving customers across the power generation, oil & gas, and industrial sectors. With decades of engineering expertise, we help customers maximise turbine performance, reliability and operational uptime through specialist repair, overhaul and technical support solutions.

Our facility is home to one of the largest gas turbine spare parts inventories in the industry, enabling us to provide rapid support and exceptional service to customers around the world. As our business grows, we are seeking a highly organised and motivated Kitting Stores Person to join our team. Key Responsibilities

• Pick and assemble kits of components in line with workshop and customer requirements.

• Ensure all kits are accurate, complete and delivered to production on schedule.

• Receive, inspect and book materials into stock using the company's ERP system.

• Store and manage inventory in designated locations whilst maintaining full traceability.

• Issue parts and consumables to workshop personnel.

• Carry out routine cycle counts and stock audits to ensure inventory accuracy.

• Investigate and resolve stock discrepancies.

• Support packing, shipping and dispatch activities for customer orders.

Skills & Experience

• Previous experience within a stores, warehouse, inventory control or kitting environment.

• Experience within engineering, manufacturing, power generation, industrial or gas turbine sectors would be advantageous.

• Understanding of stock control processes and inventory management principles.

• Experience using ERP/MRP systems.

• Strong attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and quality.

• Good organisational and prioritisation skills.

• Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office applications.

• Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

• Forklift Truck licence would be beneficial but is not essential.

• A proactive approach with a willingness to support colleagues and learn new skills.

• 9-Day Fortnight Working Pattern – Enjoy an additional day off every two weeks, giving you a regular long weekend while maintaining your full-time hours.

• Company-wide bonus scheme

titleByLocale.fr: Machiniste manuel - atelier de réparation de turbines

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Junior Manual Machinist is responsible for learning how to machine and refurbish turbine and rotating‑equipment components using conventional machine tools. You will be paired with a mentor to learn how to use manual lathes, HBM, VTL, 4‑jaw chuck setups, precision measuring tools, and consistently hold tight tolerances on critical turbine parts. Key Responsibilities

• Set up and operate manual lathes, mills, horizontal boring mills (HBM), vertical turret lathes (VTL), and related machining equipment.

• Perform advanced 4‑jaw chuck setups, indicating, and alignment of irregular, heavy, and split components.

• Machine turbine components including IGVs, diaphragms, rings, shafts, sleeves, and split casings.

• Achieve and verify tight machining tolerances (typically ±0.001" or as specified by drawings and procedures).

• Conduct dimensional inspections using micrometers, dial indicators, calipers, bore gauges, and other precision instruments.

• Read and interpret blueprints, repair drawings, travelers, and work instructions.

• Select correct tooling, speeds, feeds, and machining methods for each job.

• Safely handle large and heavy components using overhead cranes, lifts, and rigging equipment.

Required Qualifications

• Ability to work a 12‑day, 10‑hour minimum schedule with 12‑day, 12‑hour schedules during outage seasons .

• 1+ year of experience operating manual lathes, mills, and conventional machining equipment OR Machinist Training Program from a Technical College .

• Skilled in the use of precision measuring instruments (micrometers, indicators, bore gauges, etc.).

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and repair procedures.

Competencies

• Passionate about becoming a Senior Machinist

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Effective communication and problem‑solving skills.

• Strong commitment to safety and proper machining practices.

What we offer you

Country-specific benefits

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Position Summary
A professional in maintenance who is responsible for cleaning and performing basic maintenance on Sulzer’s buildings and properties. Responsibilities

• Assist the Big Bay Division in any way that is required to ensure productivity, quality and safety.

• Keep the shop clean, safe and organized.

• Transport parts by forklift to various locations on the property as needed.

• Clean parts according to environmental and safety regulations established by the company.

• Observe all company safety and quality policies.

• Practice lean principles in daily work and participate in Big Bay LEAN events.

• Proactively engage and support company initiatives designed to promote a culture of safe working, environmental protection and continual improvement.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Description Summary
Machinist is responsible for machining and refurbishing turbine and rotating‑equipment components using conventional machine tools. This role requires hands‑on experience with manual lathes, HBM, VTL, 4‑jaw chuck setups, precision measuring tools, and the ability to consistently hold tight tolerances on critical turbine parts. Key Responsibilities

• Set up and operate manual lathes, mills, horizontal boring mills (HBM), vertical turret lathes (VTL), and related machining equipment.

• Perform advanced 4‑jaw chuck setups, indicating, and alignment of irregular, heavy, and split components.

• Machine turbine components including IGVs, diaphragms, rings, shafts, sleeves, and split casings.

• Achieve and verify tight machining tolerances (typically ±0.001" or as specified by drawings and procedures).

• Conduct dimensional inspections using micrometers, dial indicators, calipers, bore gauges, and other precision instruments.

• Read and interpret blueprints, repair drawings, travelers, and work instructions.

• Select correct tooling, speeds, feeds, and machining methods for each job.

• Safely handle large and heavy components using overhead cranes, lifts, and rigging
equipment.

Required Qualifications

• Ability to work a 12‑day, 10‑hour minimum schedule with 12‑day, 12‑hour schedules during outage seasons .

• 3–5+ years of experience operating manual lathes, mills, and conventional machining equipment.

• Strong proficiency with 4‑jaw chuck setups and precision indicating.

• Skilled in the use of precision measuring instruments (micrometers, indicators, bore gauges, etc.).

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and repair procedures.

• Must supply basic personal hand tools.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in turbine repair, power generation, or heavy‑industrial machining.

• Knowledge of machining tolerances, fits, and GD&T.

• Experience operating overhead cranes and/or forklifts.

• Ability to machine large, heavy, and split turbine components.

Competencies

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.

• Effective communication and problem‑solving skills.

• Strong commitment to safety and proper machining practices.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Composants de turbine de machines, y compris les IGV, les diaphragmes, les anneaux, les arbres, les manchons et les douilles.

matériel.

.

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Employee 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.

jobs.title: Industrial Welder / Fabricator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Position Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled Fabricator/Welder to join our manufacturing team. The successful candidate will be proficient in MIG and TIG welding, with extensive experience welding stainless steel and fabricating complex assemblies. This role requires strong blueprint-reading skills, the ability to troubleshoot and resolve fabrication challenges, and a commitment to producing high-quality work while maintaining a safe work environment. Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Perform high-quality MIG and TIG welding on stainless steel components and assemblies in accordance with engineering drawings, weld procedures, and work instructions.

• Read, interpret, and work from blueprints, fabrication drawings, specifications, and welding process requirements.

• Lay out, measure, mark, cut, fit, and form materials to meet dimensional and quality specifications.

• Fabricate, assemble, and repair metal components and equipment using appropriate welding and fabrication techniques.

• Troubleshoot complex fabrication and assembly issues, utilizing technical expertise and sound judgment to develop effective solutions.

• Perform self-inspections throughout the fabrication process to ensure parts and assemblies conform to print requirements, tolerances, and quality standards.

• Set up and adjust welding equipment, tooling, and welding parameters according to work specifications.

• Perform routine inspections, calibration verification, cleaning, and basic maintenance of welding equipment, machines, torches, cables, and related tools.

• Identify equipment defects and coordinate or perform minor repairs as appropriate to maintain safe and efficient operation.

• Safely operate overhead cranes, forklifts, and other material handling equipment to move, position, and secure materials.

• Repair worn or damaged metal components by welding and rebuilding surfaces as required.

• Assist with the maintenance and repair of welding, brazing, and soldering equipment.

• Complete required production, quality, and maintenance documentation accurately and timely.

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area, including equipment, tools, materials, and workstations.

• Follow all company safety policies and procedures, including machine safety requirements, environmental regulations, and applicable federal, state, and local health and safety standards.

• Actively participate in company safety initiatives, hazard identification activities, and continuous improvement programs.

• Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.
Required Qualifications

• Minimum 3 years of fabrication and welding experience in a manufacturing environment.

• Demonstrated proficiency in MIG and TIG welding, with a strong emphasis on stainless steel.

• Ability to read and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and fabrication specifications.

• Strong fabrication skills including material layout, cutting, fitting, forming, and assembly.

• Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex build and fabrication challenges.

• Experience safely operating overhead cranes; forklift experience preferred.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
Physical Requirements

• Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday.

• Ability to frequently bend, kneel, reach, push, pull, and lift materials up to 50 pounds.

• Ability to work safely around welding equipment, cranes, and industrial machinery while wearing required PPE.

• Ability to work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to noise, heat, sparks, and welding fumes.
Preferred Qualifications

• AWS welding certification o

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Posizione Sommario
Stiamo cercando un Fabricator/Welder altamente qualificato per unirsi al nostro team di produzione. Il candidato di successo sarà abile nella saldatura MIG e TIG, con una vasta esperienza di saldatura in acciaio inossidabile e assemblaggi complessi. Questo ruolo richiede forti competenze di lettura della stampa, la capacità di risolvere e risolvere le sfide di fabbricazione, e un impegno a produrre lavoro di alta qualità, mantenendo un ambiente di lavoro sicuro. Duità e responsabilità essenziali

• Eseguire la saldatura MIG e TIG di alta qualità su componenti e assemblaggi in acciaio inossidabile in conformità con disegni di ingegneria, procedure di saldatura e istruzioni di lavoro.

• Leggere, interpretare e lavorare da progetti, disegni di fabbricazione, specifiche e requisiti di processo di saldatura.

• Allacciare, misurare, marcare, tagliare, adattare e formare materiali per soddisfare le specifiche dimensionali e di qualità.

• Realizzare, assemblare e riparare componenti e attrezzature metalliche utilizzando tecniche di saldatura e fabbricazione appropriate.

• Risoluzione problemi complessi problemi di fabbricazione e montaggio, utilizzando competenze tecniche e giudizio sonoro per sviluppare soluzioni efficaci.

• Eseguire le auto-ispezione durante tutto il processo di fabbricazione per garantire parti e assemblaggi conformi a requisiti di stampa, tolleranze e standard di qualità.

• Impostare e regolare le attrezzature di saldatura, utensili e parametri di saldatura secondo le specifiche di lavoro.

• Eseguire ispezioni di routine, verifica della calibrazione, pulizia e manutenzione di base di attrezzature di saldatura, macchine, torce, cavi e strumenti correlati.

• Identificare i difetti dell'apparecchiatura e coordinare o eseguire riparazioni minori nel modo appropriato per mantenere un funzionamento sicuro ed efficiente.

• Azionare in modo sicuro gru a testa alta, carrelli elevatori e altri dispositivi di manipolazione del materiale per spostare, posizionare e proteggere i materiali.

• Riparare i componenti metallici usurati o danneggiati, saldando e ricostruendo le superfici come richiesto.

• Assistere con la manutenzione e la riparazione di saldatura, brasatura e attrezzature di saldatura.

• Completa la documentazione di produzione, qualità e manutenzione richiesta con precisione e tempestiva.

• Mantenere una zona di lavoro pulita, organizzata e sicura, tra cui attrezzature, strumenti, materiali e postazioni di lavoro.

• Seguire tutte le politiche e le procedure di sicurezza dell'azienda, compresi i requisiti di sicurezza della macchina, le normative ambientali e gli standard federali, statali e locali per la salute e la sicurezza.

• Partecipa attivamente a iniziative di sicurezza aziendale, attività di identificazione dei rischi e programmi di miglioramento continuo.

• Eseguire altri compiti e progetti speciali assegnati.
Qualificazioni richieste

• Minimo 3 anni di esperienza di fabbricazione e saldatura in un ambiente di produzione.

• Dimostrata competenza nella saldatura MIG e TIG, con una forte enfasi sull'acciaio inossidabile.

• Capacità di leggere e interpretare i progetti, disegni tecnici e specifiche di fabbricazione.

• Forti capacità di fabbricazione tra cui layout di materiale, taglio, montaggio, formazione e assemblaggio.

• Capacità di risolvere e risolvere complesse sfide di costruzione e di fabbricazione.

• Esperienza di funzionamento sicuro gru a soffitto; esperienza carrello elevatore preferito.

• Forte attenzione al dettaglio e all'impegno nella lavorazione della qualità.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di un team in un ambiente di produzione veloce.
Requisiti fisici

• Capacità di stare e camminare per lunghi periodi durante la giornata di lavoro.

• Capacità di piegare, ginocchiare, raggiungere, spingere, tirare e sollevare materiali fino a 50 libbre.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo sicuro intorno alle apparecchiature di saldatura, gru e macchinari industriali durante l'usura del PPE richiesto.

• Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente di produzione con esposizione a rumore, calore, scintille e fumi di saldatura.
Qualificazioni predestinate

• Certificazione di saldatura AWS o

Über die Rolle

Positionsübersicht
Wir suchen einen hochqualifizierten Hersteller/Welder, der unserem Produktionsteam beitritt. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird das MIG- und WIG-Schweißen beherrschen, mit umfangreicher Erfahrung beim Schweißen von Edelstahl und der Herstellung komplexer Baugruppen. Diese Rolle erfordert starke Blueprint-Lesefähigkeiten, die Fähigkeit zur Fehlersuche und Lösung von Fertigungsherausforderungen sowie die Verpflichtung, qualitativ hochwertige Arbeiten zu produzieren und gleichzeitig eine sichere Arbeitsumgebung zu gewährleisten. Wesentliche Pflichten und Verantwortlichkeiten

• Führen Sie hochwertiges MIG- und TIG-Schweißen auf Edelstahlkomponenten und -baugruppen gemäß technischen Zeichnungen, Schweißverfahren und Arbeitsanweisungen durch.

• Lesen, Interpretieren und Arbeiten von Blaupausen, Fertigungszeichnungen, Spezifikationen und Schweißprozessanforderungen.

• Legen, messen, markieren, schneiden, passen und formen Sie Materialien, um Dimensions- und Qualitätsspezifikationen zu erfüllen.

• Herstellung, Montage und Reparatur von Metallkomponenten und -geräten unter Verwendung geeigneter Schweiß- und Fertigungstechniken.

• Beheben Sie komplexe Herstellungs- und Montageprobleme, indem Sie technisches Fachwissen und fundiertes Urteilsvermögen nutzen, um effektive Lösungen zu entwickeln.

• Führen Sie während des gesamten Herstellungsprozesses Selbstinspektionen durch, um sicherzustellen, dass Teile und Baugruppen den Druckanforderungen, Toleranzen und Qualitätsstandards entsprechen.

• Einrichten und Anpassen von Schweißgeräten, Werkzeugen und Schweißparametern gemäß Arbeitsspezifikationen.

• Führen Sie Routineinspektionen, Kalibrierungsprüfung, Reinigung und grundlegende Wartung von Schweißgeräten, Maschinen, Brennern, Kabeln und verwandten Werkzeugen durch.

• Identifizieren Sie Gerätefehler und koordinieren oder führen Sie kleinere Reparaturen durch, um einen sicheren und effizienten Betrieb aufrechtzuerhalten.

• Betreiben Sie sicher Overhead-Krane, Gabelstapler und andere Materialfördergeräte, um Materialien zu bewegen, zu positionieren und zu sichern.

• Reparieren Sie verschlissene oder beschädigte Metallteile durch Schweißen und Rekonstruktion von Oberflächen nach Bedarf.

• Unterstützung bei der Wartung und Reparatur von Schweiß-, Löt- und Lötgeräten.

• Vervollständigen Sie die erforderliche Produktions-, Qualitäts- und Wartungsdokumentation genau und zeitnah.

• Pflegen Sie einen sauberen, organisierten und sicheren Arbeitsbereich, einschließlich Ausrüstung, Werkzeuge, Materialien und Arbeitsstationen.

• Befolgen Sie alle Sicherheitsrichtlinien und -verfahren des Unternehmens, einschließlich der Anforderungen an die Maschinensicherheit, der Umweltvorschriften und der geltenden Bundes-, Landes- und lokalen Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsstandards.

• Beteiligen Sie sich aktiv an Sicherheitsinitiativen des Unternehmens, Aktivitäten zur Gefahrenidentifizierung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprogrammen.

• Führen Sie andere Aufgaben und spezielle Projekte wie zugewiesen durch.
Benötigte Qualifikationen

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Fertigungs- und Schweißerfahrung in einer Fertigungsumgebung.

• Nachgewiesene Kenntnisse in MIG und TIG Schweißen, mit einem starken Schwerpunkt auf Edelstahl.

• Fähigkeit, Blaupausen, technische Zeichnungen und Fertigungsspezifikationen zu lesen und zu interpretieren.

• Starke Fertigungsfähigkeiten einschließlich Materiallayout, Schneiden, Passen, Formen und Montage.

• Fähigkeit, komplexe Build- und Fertigungsherausforderungen zu beheben und zu beheben.

• Erleben Sie sicher arbeitende Overhead-Krane; Gabelstapler Erfahrung bevorzugt.

• Starke Liebe zum Detail und Engagement für hochwertige Verarbeitung.

• Fähigkeit, unabhängig und als Teil eines Teams in einer schnelllebigen Fertigungsumgebung zu arbeiten.
Physikalische Anforderungen

• Fähigkeit, während des Arbeitstages längere Zeit zu stehen und zu gehen.

• Fähigkeit, sich häufig zu beugen, zu knien, zu erreichen, zu schieben, zu ziehen und Materialien bis zu 50 Pfund zu heben.

• Die Fähigkeit, sicher um Schweißgeräte, Kräne und Industriemaschinen zu arbeiten, während das Tragen erfordert PSA.

• Fähigkeit, in einer Fertigungsumgebung mit Lärm, Hitze, Funken und Schweißdämpfen zu arbeiten.
Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

• AWS Schweißzertifizierung

Nous recherchons un fabricant/soudeur hautement qualifié pour rejoindre notre équipe de fabrication. Fonctions et responsabilités essentielles

• Effectuez un soudage MIG et TIG de haute qualité sur des composants et des assemblages en acier inoxydable conformément aux plans techniques, aux procédures de soudage et aux instructions de travail.

• Lire, interpréter et travailler à partir de plans, de dessins de fabrication, de spécifications et de procédés de soudage.

• Disposer, mesurer, marquer, couper, monter et former des matériaux pour répondre aux spécifications dimensionnelles et de qualité.

• Fabrication, montage et réparation de composants et d'équipements métalliques à l'aide de techniques appropriées de soudage et de fabrication.

• Dépanner les problèmes complexes de fabrication et d'assemblage, en utilisant l'expertise technique et le jugement solide pour développer des solutions efficaces.

• Effectuer des auto-inspections tout au long du processus de fabrication pour s'assurer que les pièces et les assemblages sont conformes aux exigences d'impression, aux tolérances et aux normes de qualité.

• Mettre en place et ajuster l'équipement de soudage, l'outillage et les paramètres de soudage selon les spécifications de travail.

• Effectuer des inspections de routine, la vérification de l'étalonnage, le nettoyage et l'entretien de base des équipements de soudage, des machines, des torches, des câbles et des outils connexes.

• Identifier les défauts de l'équipement et coordonner ou effectuer des réparations mineures, selon le cas, pour assurer un fonctionnement sûr et efficace.

• Utilisez en toute sécurité des grues, des chariots élévateurs et d'autres équipements de manutention des matériaux pour déplacer, positionner et sécuriser les matériaux.

• Réparation des composants métalliques usés ou endommagés par soudage et reconstruction des surfaces au besoin.

• Aider à l'entretien et à la réparation du matériel de soudage, de brasage et de soudure.

• Remplir la documentation requise sur la production, la qualité et la maintenance avec exactitude et en temps opportun.

• Maintenir une zone de travail propre, organisée et sécuritaire, y compris l'équipement, les outils, les matériaux et les postes de travail.

• Suivez toutes les politiques et procédures de sécurité de l'entreprise, y compris les exigences de sécurité des machines, les règlements environnementaux et les normes de santé et de sécurité fédérales, étatiques et locales applicables.

• Participer activement aux initiatives de sécurité de l'entreprise, aux activités d'identification des dangers et aux programmes d'amélioration continue.

• Exécuter d'autres tâches et des projets spéciaux selon les affectations.
Qualifications requises

• Minimum 3 ans d'expérience de fabrication et de soudage dans un environnement de fabrication.

• Compétence démontrée en matière de soudage MIG et TIG, avec un accent particulier sur l'acier inoxydable.

• Capacité de lire et d'interpréter des plans, des dessins techniques et des spécifications de fabrication.

• Fortes compétences en fabrication, y compris la disposition des matériaux, la coupe, le montage, le formage et l'assemblage.

• Capacité de résoudre les problèmes complexes de construction et de fabrication.

• Expérimentez des grues aériennes en toute sécurité; expérience de chariot élévateur préféré.

• Pleine attention aux détails et à l'engagement en faveur d'un travail de qualité.

• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et en équipe dans un environnement de fabrication rapide.
Exigences physiques

• Capacité de se tenir debout et de marcher pendant de longues périodes tout au long de la journée de travail.

• Aptitude à plier, agenouiller, atteindre, pousser, tirer et soulever des matériaux jusqu'à 50 livres.

• Capacité de travailler en toute sécurité autour des équipements de soudage, des grues et des machines industrielles tout en portant l'EPI nécessaire.

• Capacité de travailler dans un environnement de fabrication avec exposition au bruit, à la chaleur, aux étincelles et aux vapeurs de soudage.
Qualifications privilégiées

• Certification de soudage AWS

jobs.title: Project Engineer Nuclear
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Project Engineer is responsible for supporting technical project planning, execution, and monitoring. The role involves working independently with general supervision and contributing to project success through technical and analytical support.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. SUMMARY:
The project engineering position verifies that components and assemblies meet all applicable design requirements, engineering standards, customer specifications, and applicable ASME codes and standards. This role performs calculations, technical evaluations, and detailed drawing reviews to confirm compliance with engineering standards, design documentation, and ASME Codes. The engineer contributes to ensuring that the parts, materials, and assemblies selected satisfy the functional and regulatory requirements of the nuclear application.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Verifies that replacement parts, new equipment, retrofit pumps, and refurbished pumps are designed & constructed in accordance with customer design specifications, applicable codes & standards, and Sulzer-internal Engineering standards.

• Generates, reviews, and maintains the design Bill of Materials and Drawings while adhering to Engineering Specifications, detailed documentation of design requirements, and ASME standards.

• Perform technical evaluations and justifications to resolve non-conformance reports, supplier deviations, and design changes.

• Perform design, material, and seismic reconciliations and/or reports for nuclear-safety-related components and ASME Code Components.

• Reviews and verifies cross-sectional and general arrangement drawings.

• Reviews component drawings to ensure adherence to Engineering Standards, design requirements, ASME Code requirements, and GD&T standards.

• Review and maintenance of special processes to ensure adherence to Engineering Standards and design requirements.
SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and Environmental Safety & Health (ESH) Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Supports and cooperates in company-wide Quality Management effort.

• Performs other duties as assigned.
SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None
QUALIFICATIONS:

• Requires a minimum of three (3), in mechanical engineering of rotating equipment design experience preferred but not required.

• Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent Engineering degree.

• Basic understanding of engineering principles, calculations, and design software.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word) and CAD tools.

• FE Certification is desirable but not mandatory.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to balance multiple tasks

• Eagerness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.

• Must be a U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, or Lawful Permanent Resident

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in B

• Genera, valuta e mantiene il disegno Bill of Materials and Drawings, aderendo a specifiche ingegneristiche, documentazione dettagliata dei requisiti di progettazione e standard ASME.

• Eseguire valutazioni tecniche e giustificazioni per risolvere report non conformi, deviazioni dei fornitori e cambiamenti di progettazione.

• Eseguire la progettazione, le conciliazioni materiali e sismiche e/o le relazioni per i componenti relativi alla sicurezza nucleare e i componenti del codice ASME.

• Recensioni e verifica i disegni di disposizione trasversali e generali.

• Recensioni disegni dei componenti per garantire l'adesione a Engineering Standards, requisiti di progettazione, requisiti di codice ASME e standard GD&T.

• Revisione e manutenzione di processi speciali per garantire l'adesione a Engineering Standards e requisiti di progettazione.
RISPOSTE SECONDARI:

• Aderisce a politiche, procedure e standard aziendali e dipartimentali

• Supporta, collabora e partecipa al sistema di gestione LEAN e Environmental Safety & Health (ESH) di livello aziendale che comprende le seguenti politiche e procedure di sicurezza, salute e ambiente. Supporta e collabora nello sforzo aziendale di Gestione della Qualità.

• Esegui altri compiti come assegnato.
RISPOSTE SUPERVISORIA: Nessuno
QUALIFICA:

• Richiede un minimo di tre (3), in ingegneria meccanica dell'esperienza di progettazione di attrezzature rotanti preferita ma non richiesto.

• Laurea in ingegneria meccanica o equivalente grado di ingegneria.

• La comprensione di base dei principi di ingegneria, calcoli e software di progettazione.

• Forte capacità analitiche, di problem solving e di comunicazione.

• La competenza in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word) e strumenti CAD.

• La certificazione FE è desiderabile ma non obbligatoria.

• Forte capacità organizzative e di gestione del tempo, con la capacità di bilanciare più compiti

• La voglia di imparare e la capacità di lavorare in un ambiente di squadra.

• Deve essere un cittadino degli Stati Uniti, nazionale degli Stati Uniti, o residente permanente legale

Cosa ti offriamo

• 15 giorni di tempo libero e 12 giorni festivi

• 401k piano con una partita del 6%

• Piano sanitario completo tra cui medico, dentale, visione, vita, disabilità a breve e a lungo termine

11. Wissen über Markt- und Branchentrends, Wettbewerber und führende Kundenstrategien, insbesondere in Bezug auf das internationale Geschäft

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer, is a global leader in the design, manufacture, and servicing of pumps and fluid handling systems. We supply utilities and industrial clients with advanced pump technology and aftermarket services. Our solutions deliver reliability, performance, and peace of mind, from clean water to wastewater, energy to chemicals.

We’re looking for a Senior Tendering Engineer to play a key role in our front-end operations, delivering both high-volume quotes and complex, high-value tenders that shape the future of our commercial success.
Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Prepare and deliver a high volume of quick-turnaround quotes as well as detailed, multi-disciplinary bids for complex projects.

• Collaborate with engineering, hydraulics, costing, and sales teams to optimise technical and commercial solutions.

• Lead pricing strategy and commercial terms for UK tenders, ensuring competitive and profitable offers.

• Support contract negotiations with confidence and precision, protecting Sulzer’s interests.

• Drive process improvements to increase efficiency and win rates.

• Champion best practices in tendering, quoting, and customer service.

What You Bring

• Experience in the pump industry or a closely related engineering field.

• Proven ability to manage both high-volume quoting and complex, high-value tenders.

• Strong technical and commercial acumen, with a deep understanding of pricing strategies, contract terms, and margin protection.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Ability to act independently, manage multiple priorities, and make sound decisions under pressure.

What we offer you

• Competitive basic salary

• Car or car allowance – EV options available

• Annual bonus scheme, based on company and personal performance

• Private Medical Insurance

• The flexibility to balance your time between home and the office

• 33 days annual leave

• Defined contribution pension scheme

• Confidential Employee Assistance Programmes

• Wide range of retail and lifestyle discounts

• Discounted personal car leasing

• Long Service Awards

• Continuous learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we’re known globally for engineering excellence – but here in Leeds, we’re especially proud of the people who make it happen. With a team of around 350 highly skilled colleagues on site, we specialise in advanced engineering, precision manufacturing and high quality pump services that support critical sectors across the UK and worldwide. About the Role

We’re looking for a proactive, organised and people focused Administrator who loves variety and isn’t afraid to take the initiative. As the first point of contact for visitors, customers and colleagues, you’ll be a friendly, confident presence who enjoys building rapport and interacting with people at all levels of the business.
This is a hands on, fast paced role for someone who naturally spots what needs doing and gets on with it. You’ll take ownership of tasks, solve problems as they arise and help keep everything running smoothly behind the scenes. Working as part of a supportive Administration team, you’ll collaborate closely with departments across the business, providing practical support, coordination and ideas to help teams work efficiently and effectively.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Strong interpersonal and customer service skills

• Great organisational ability and a high level of attention to detail

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Head of Operations – PPR will be responsible for leading all manufacturing and operational activities within the Advanced Manufacturing Centre.

The successful candidate will ensure the safe, efficient, and profitable execution of pump spares manufacturing, duplicate pump production, and engineered retrofit solutions while delivering exceptional customer service and achieving business objectives
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Head of Operations – PPR to lead our Advanced Manufacturing Centre in Johannesburg and drive operational performance across our Pumps Parts & Retrofit business.

Key Responsibilities

• Providing strategic leadership to ensure safe, efficient, and profitable manufacturing and operational performance.

• Driving operational excellence through effective planning, resource optimization, continuous improvement, and implementation of Lean and Six Sigma methodologies.

• Championing a strong Health, Safety, Environment, and Quality culture while ensuring compliance with legal, regulatory, and company standards.

• Delivering exceptional customer service through the timely execution of projects, repairs, and manufacturing commitments.

• Managing operational budgets, financial performance, forecasting, cost control, and key business performance indicators.

• Leading end-to-end supply chain, procurement, inventory, logistics, and supplier performance management activities.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Global Business Process Analyst will drive the optimization, harmonization, and digital enablement of commercial processes across Sulzer’s three divisions Flow, Services and Chemtech. This role supports strategic initiatives within the Sulzer 2028 Strategy, enabling agile, data-driven decision-making and scalable process improvements across global sales and commercial operations.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead a newly established global function to optimise end‑to‑end commercial processes—spanning lead‑to‑order, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management—using LEAN and Six Sigma principles.

• Design and govern enterprise‑wide commercial process standards, facilitating workshops to define challenges, capture requirements, and map global “as‑is” and “to‑be” processes.

• Act as the strategic link between business and IT, partnering across Commercial Excellence, Finance, Operations, and IT to shape solutions, support Salesforce CRM/CPQ initiatives, and manage UAT and deployment.

• Strengthen global commercial systems and data governance, overseeing Salesforce CRM, CPQ, master data, and champion networks across all business units.

• Drive change, adoption, and governance by delivering training, documentation, and stakeholder engagement while promoting compliance, accountability, and ethical business practices.

Your Profile

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or related field

• 4–7 years of experience in business process analysis, preferably in B2B commercial environments

• Strong understanding of sales and service workflows across multiple business units

• Proficiency in process mapping and continuous improvement methodologies

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce, SAP SD, CPQ, and BI tools

• Any Salesforce Certification (Administration, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud or CPQ specialist) will be preferred.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in a global context

• Fluent in English; additional languages (e.g., German, French) are a plus

What we offer you

• Strategic role in shaping Sulzer’s global commercial transformation

• Exposure to diverse functions, cultures, and business units

• Opportunities for professional growth and innovation

• Competitive compensation and benefits

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Kenntnisse in Process Mapping und Methoden zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung

• Jede Salesforce-Zertifizierung (Administration, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud oder CPQ-Spezialist) wird bevorzugt.

• Hervorragende Kommunikation und Stakeholder Management Fähigkeiten in einem globalen Kontext

• fließend Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen (z.B. Deutsch, Französisch) sind ein Plus

Was wir Ihnen bieten

• Strategische Rolle bei der Gestaltung der globalen kommerziellen Transformation von Sulzer

jobs.title: Sales engineer/Ingénieur technico-commercial
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction.
This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Résumé du poste

Nous recherchons un Ingénieur Technico-Commercial passionné pour rejoindre notre équipe chez Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU. Le titulaire du poste sera responsable de la promotion et de la vente de nos solutions techniques, ainsi que du développement et de l'entretien des relations clients sur un territoire défini.

Responsabilités du poste

* Développer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de vente pour atteindre les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires et de marge.
* Identifier et prospecter de nouveaux clients potentiels dans les secteurs d'activité ciblés par Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU.
* Comprendre les besoins techniques des clients et proposer des solutions adaptées parmi notre gamme de produits et services (pompes, agitateurs, etc.).
* Préparer et présenter des propositions techniques et commerciales détaillées.
* Négocier les contrats et les conditions de vente avec les clients.
* Assurer un suivi régulier des clients existants pour garantir leur satisfaction et identifier de nouvelles opportunités.
* Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes techniques et de production pour s'assurer que les solutions proposées sont réalisables et conformes aux attentes du client.
* Participer à des salons professionnels et des événements de l'industrie.
* Réaliser des rapports d'activité commerciale et des prévisions de vente.
* Veiller à la conformité avec les politiques et procédures de l'entreprise.

Qualifications requises

* Diplôme d'ingénieur (BAC+5) en mécanique, électromécanique, génie des procédés ou domaine technique équivalent.
* Expérience significative (minimum 3-5 ans) dans un rôle d'ingénieur technico-commercial, idéalement dans le secteur des équipements industriels, des pompes ou des machines tournantes.
* Solides compétences techniques et compréhension des principes de fonctionnement des équipements industriels.
* Excellentes compétences en communication, négociation et présentation.
* Capacité à établir et entretenir des relations professionnelles solides.
* Autonomie, proactivité et orientation résultats.
* Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (écrit et oral).
* Permis de conduire valide et disponibilité pour des déplacements fréquents.
* Maîtrise des outils informatiques (CRM, Pack Office).

What we offer you

.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Il Sales Engineering Specialist supporta il processo di vendita fornendo competenze tecniche e aiutando i clienti a capire come i prodotti soddisfano le loro esigenze. Questo ruolo colma il divario tra ingegneria e vendita, garantendo precisione tecnica e soddisfazione del cliente.

Stiamo cercando un appassionato Technico-Commercial Engineer per unirsi al nostro team di Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU. * Laurea in ingegneria (BAC+5) in meccanica, elettromeccanica, ingegneria di processo o campo tecnico equivalente.

* Ottima capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e presentazione.

Wir suchen einen leidenschaftlichen Technico-Commercial Engineer, der unser Team bei Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU unterstützt. * Erstellen und Einreichen detaillierter technischer und kommerzieller Vorschläge.
* Verhandeln Sie Verträge und Verkaufsbedingungen mit Kunden.

* Besuchen Sie Fachmessen und Branchenveranstaltungen.
* Führen Sie Geschäftstätigkeitsberichte und Verkaufsprognosen durch.
* Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der Unternehmensrichtlinien und -verfahren.

Qualifikationen erforderlich

* Abschluss in Ingenieurwesen (BAC+5) in Mechanik, Elektromechanik, Verfahrenstechnik oder einem gleichwertigen technischen Bereich.
* Bedeutende Erfahrung (mindestens 3-5 Jahre) in einer technisch-kommerziellen Ingenieurrolle, idealerweise in Industrieanlagen, Pumpen oder rotierenden Maschinen.
* Starke technische Fähigkeiten und Verständnis der Betriebsprinzipien von Industrieanlagen.
* Hervorragende Kommunikation, Verhandlungs- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten.
* Fähigkeit, starke berufliche Beziehungen aufzubauen und aufrechtzuerhalten.
* Autonomie, Proaktivität und Orientierungsergebnisse.
* Beherrschung von Französisch und Englisch (schriftlich und mündlich).

jobs.title: Procurement Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and purchasing instrumentation, electrical, and general components required for pump manufacturing. The role ensures timely material availability, cost competitiveness, and compliance with technical and quality requirements.

Key Responsibilities

• Identify and select qualified suppliers for instrumentation, electrical, general components and Class C materials, negotiating contracts and pricing.

• Review and assess technical specifications to ensure compliance with project /department’s needs.

• Manage procurement budgets, monitor costs, and implement cost-saving strategies for electrical items and general components.

• Coordinate with internal departments, suppliers and project teams to ensure timely delivery and avoid project delays.

• Ensure all products meet Sulzer quality standards and regulatory requirements.

• Identify procurement risks, maintain documentation, and implement mitigation strategies for supply chain issues.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, or a related field. Professional certifications such as CIPS or CPSM are preferred.

• Minimum 3 years of experience in procurement of high-volume materials for large-scale oil and gas projects.

• Solid understanding of procurement best practices, sourcing strategies, and industry trends.

• Strong working knowledge of SAP, Microsoft Office Suit

• Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

• Proficient in both Arabic and English.

What we offer you

• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

• A great working environment.

• Work Location: Riyadh- Industrial Area 2

Responsable de l'exécution réussie, de la gouvernance, du rendement commercial et de la réalisation de plusieurs projets au sein de l'organisation.

Gestion d'équipe

• Diriger, coacher et superviser une équipe d'ingénieurs de projet et de gestionnaires de projet.

• Superviser l'exécution de plusieurs projets EPC, Énergie, Infrastructure ou Industriel.
