• Veiller à ce que les plans, les calendriers, les plans de rétablissement et les stratégies d'exécution demeurent à jour et réalisables.

• Favoriser l'identification proactive et l'atténuation des risques du projet.

Gestion commerciale et contractuelle

• Diriger la gestion des obligations contractuelles et des expositions commerciales.

• Examiner et traiter les risques liés aux dommages liquidés et élaborer des stratégies d'atténuation.

• Gérer les ordres de modification de contrat, les demandes de modification, les demandes de prorogation de délai et les négociations commerciales.

• Appuyer les activités d'évitement et de règlement des différends.

• Assurer la conformité contractuelle avec les clients, les partenaires et les fournisseurs.

• Participer aux négociations commerciales avec les clients et les sous-traitants au besoin.

• Veiller à ce que les décisions de gestion soient mises en oeuvre et suivies efficacement.

• Veiller à ce que les listes de perforations, la documentation finale et les exigences de transfert soient remplies.

• Saisir et institutionnaliser les enseignements tirés et les pratiques exemplaires.

• Agir comme interface principale entre les clients et les intervenants internes.

• Maintenir des relations solides avec les clients, les consultants, les fournisseurs et les sous-traitants.

• Coordonner les activités entre le génie, l'approvisionnement, la production, la planification, l'AQ/CQ, le HSE et les finances.

• Veiller à ce que les préoccupations des clients soient traitées rapidement et professionnellement.

The Sr. Machine Operator is responsible for operating and maintaining production machinery, ensuring efficient and safe operations. This role performs advanced machine setup, monitors production quality, and may assist in training junior operators.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Manual Machinist

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Work closely and clearly communicate with the other departments, Machine personnel, Supervisor, and Lead

• Capable of operating all machines in the shop (including large mills, lathes, stripping machine, peening machine, tool post grinders, and other equipment)

• Planning –Work with Department Supervisor to develop a machine plan:

• Determine what tools will be required prior to starting the machine process

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Must have manual machining experience

• Experience working with turbo machinery is a plus

• Must have the required tools to perform their expected tasks or ability to acquire.

• Must be able to work overtime as needed

• Must be able to use precision measuring instruments

About the role

Job Summary

Sets up and operates machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Project Engineer is responsible for supporting technical project planning, execution, and monitoring. The role involves working independently with general supervision and contributing to project success through technical and analytical support.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. About Us

At Sulzer, you are empowered to deliver superior results. As a pioneer in industry, we have a proud heritage of innovation and continue to evolve for the future. Join our story and create your own impact by developing your expertise and building solutions that help make our lives safer, smarter and more sustainable.
Sulzer is a global leader in fluid engineering. We specialize in pumping, agitation, mixing, separation and purification technologies for fluids of all types. Our customers benefit from our commitment to innovation, performance and quality and from our responsive network of 180 world-class manufacturing facilities and service centres across the globe. Sulzer has been headquartered in Winterthur, Switzerland, since 1834.
Join our APAC team within the Flow division in Australia as a Project Engineer.

What will you be doing?

As a Project Engineer, your responsibilities day to day will include:

• Manage and coordinate customer projects from order intake through to delivery, ensuring scope, quality, budget, and schedule requirements are achieved.

• Provide technical engineering support, including equipment configuration (SAP), data sheets design review against customer specification, and preparation of project documentation and reporting

• Act as the primary interface between customers, sales, engineering, manufacturing, and suppliers to ensure successful project execution.

• supporting the sales team to achieve divisional growth and financial objectives.

• Promote and maintain Sulzer's commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement across all project activities.

What you will bring to Sulzer

To be a successful Project Engineer, you will ideally have:

• A Bachelor of Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.

• Demonstrated experience with technical report writing / technical documentation

• Exposure and experience to SAP, D365 ERP, Project Control software such as ACONEX, etc

• Project execution responsibility (scheduling, cost control, documentation and invoicing timely reporting.)

• Strong communication skills.

• Ability to engage and work with others.

• Experience in taking responsibility for order delivery and maintaining stakeholder relationships

What we offer you

• Annual bonus scheme.

• Employee Assistance Program.

• On-site car parking.

• Work for a global organisation that values innovation, excellence and a commitment to the most important part of our business - our people and our customers.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

A Sulzer, siete autorizzati a fornire risultati superiori. Come pioniere nell'industria, abbiamo un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione e continuiamo a evolversi per il futuro. Cosa porterai a Sulzer

Per essere un ingegnere di progetto di successo, si avrà idealmente:

• Una laurea in ingegneria meccanica o equivalente.

• Esperienza dimostrata con la scrittura di report tecnici / documentazione tecnica

• Esposizione ed esperienza a SAP, D365 ERP, software di Project Control come ACONEX, ecc

• Responsabilità di esecuzione del progetto (programmazione, controllo dei costi, documentazione e fatturazione report tempestivo.)

• Forte capacità di comunicazione.

• Capacità di impegnarsi e lavorare con gli altri.

The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction.
This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. We are looking for a Sales Engineer - Western Area End User to join our Flow Division team in Australia .

• Planning, support and follow-up of sales activities in line with the sales strategy and defined processes.

• Identify new markets and business opportunities.

• Preparation of technical and commercial proposals in co-operation with the Tendering Team.

• Negotiating tender and contract terms with key accounts, to meet both client and company needs.

• Establishing new, and maintaining existing, long-term relationships with customers.

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers and suppliers in order to reduce commercial risk and to maximize future business opportunities.

• Maintain and monitor up to date knowledge of competitor products and activities.

• Meeting regular sales targets

• Providing pre-sales technical assistance and product education

• Solving client challenges

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The HR Administration & Payroll Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing all HR administrative processes and end-to-end payroll operations for Switzerland. This role ensures full compliance with Swiss labor law, social security regulations, tax obligations, and internal policies. The position acts as the primary point of contact for HR operations, employee lifecycle administration, payroll accuracy, and HR system integrity. The role needs hands-on execution, ensuring efficient HR processes and high-quality service delivery to employees and managers.
Your main tasks and responsibilities

Payroll Management (Swiss Payroll)

• Oversee and execute monthly payroll for all Swiss employees, including variable pay, allowances, deductions, and absences.

• Manage payroll controls, reconciliations, audits, and reporting activities.

• Ensure correct calculation of taxes, social security contributions, pension fund deductions, and insurance premiums.

• Act as key contact for employees on payroll, benefits, and time management topics.

• Collaborate with Finance on payroll accounting, salary provision, and audit requirements.

• Manage year‑end activities (salary certificates, Withholding Tax year closing, social security reporting)

HR Administration & Employee Lifecycle Management

• Act as a trusted HR advisor to managers and senior leaders based in Switzerland

• Manage and oversee all administrative HR processes for the entire employee lifecycle (hire to retire).

• Prepare employment contracts, amendments, reference letters, and other legal documents in accordance with Swiss law.

• Ensure accurate maintenance of employee records and digital personnel files.

• Manage onboarding and offboarding processes, including work permits (L, B, C) and liaison with authorities.

• Ensure timely registration and reporting to social security institutions (AHV/ALV/IV/EO), pension funds (BVG/LPP), accident insurance (UVG), KTG and family allowance offices.

• Support annual performance and compensation cycles from an administrative standpoint.

• Ensure compliance with internal policies, GDPR, and Swiss data protection regulations.

HR Systems & Process Optimization

• Maintain and optimize HRIS and time‑tracking systems (e.g., SAP, Workday, Abacus, or similar).

• Ensure data accuracy and reliability for reporting and analytics.

• Drive process improvements and standardization across HR administration and payroll.

• Support implementation of new tools and digital HR solutions.

• Compliance, Policies & Governance.

• Ensure full compliance with Swiss labour law, collective labour agreements (if applicable), and company policies.

• Maintain HR governance frameworks and support HR audits.

• Keep up to date with regulatory changes and translate them into operational processes.

To succeed in this role, you will need

• Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Several years of experience in HR administration and Swiss payroll (mandatory).

• Strong understanding of Swiss labour law, social security system, taxes, and employment compliance.

• Experience in multinational environments is an asset.

• Strong MS Office and HRIS proficiency; payroll system expertise required.

• Fluent in German and English.

• Working time: 80 - 100 %.

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Do you have a question about the role?

Reach out to Alexi Donadoni at alexi.donadoni@sulzer.com.

What we offer you

• 25 days holidays (exclusive of bank holidays) + service days

• Defined contribution pension scheme

• Employee Assistance Program/health care

• On-site car parking/public transport allowance

• Access to a wide range of discounts

Informazioni sul ruolo

L'Amministrazione delle risorse umane & Payroll Manager è responsabile di guidare e supervisionare tutti i processi amministrativi delle risorse umane e le operazioni di payroll end-to-end per la Svizzera. Questo ruolo garantisce il pieno rispetto del diritto del lavoro svizzero, delle norme di sicurezza sociale, degli obblighi fiscali e delle politiche interne. La posizione funge da punto di contatto primario per le operazioni HR, l'amministrazione del ciclo di vita dei dipendenti, l'accuratezza del libro paga e l'integrità del sistema HR. Il ruolo ha bisogno di esecuzione pratica, garantendo processi HR efficienti e consegna di servizi di alta qualità a dipendenti e manager.
I vostri compiti principali e responsabilità

Gestione dei pagamenti (Swiss Payroll)

• Controllare ed eseguire il libro paga mensile per tutti i dipendenti svizzeri, tra cui retribuzione variabile, indennità, detrazioni e assenze.

• Gestisci controlli payroll, conciliazioni, audit e attività di reporting.

• Assicurare il corretto calcolo delle imposte, dei contributi sociali, delle deduzioni dei fondi pensione e dei premi assicurativi.

• Agire come contatto chiave per i dipendenti sui temi payroll, benefici e gestione del tempo.

• Collaborare con la finanza sulla contabilità del libro paga, la fornitura di stipendio e i requisiti di audit.

• Gestire attività di fine anno (certificati di sala, Mantenere la chiusura dell'anno fiscale, reporting di sicurezza sociale)

Amministrazione HR e gestione del ciclo di vita dei dipendenti

• Agire come consulente HR affidabile per manager e leader senior con sede in Svizzera

• Gestire e supervisionare tutti i processi amministrativi delle risorse umane per l'intero ciclo di vita dei dipendenti (andare in pensione).

• Preparare contratti di lavoro, modifiche, lettere di riferimento e altri documenti legali in conformità con la legge svizzera.

• Assicurare la manutenzione accurata dei registri dei dipendenti e dei file del personale digitale.

• Gestisci i processi di bordo e di fuoribordo, inclusi i permessi di lavoro (L, B, C) e il collegamento con le autorità.

• Assicurare la registrazione tempestiva e la segnalazione alle istituzioni di sicurezza sociale (AHV/ALV/IV/EO), fondi pensione (BVG/LPP), assicurazione contro gli infortuni (UVG), KTG e uffici di assegni familiari.

• Supporta cicli di rendimento e compensazione annuali da un punto di vista amministrativo.

• Assicurare il rispetto delle politiche interne, del GDPR e delle normative sulla protezione dei dati svizzere.

Sistemi HR e ottimizzazione dei processi

• Mantenere e ottimizzare i sistemi HRIS e time-tracking (ad esempio, SAP, Workday, Abacus, o simili).

• Assicurare l'accuratezza e l'affidabilità dei dati per la segnalazione e l'analisi.

• Miglioramento del processo di guida e standardizzazione attraverso l'amministrazione HR e payroll.

• Supporta l'implementazione di nuovi strumenti e soluzioni HR digitali.

• Compliance, Politiche e Governance.

• Assicurare il pieno rispetto del diritto del lavoro svizzero, degli accordi collettivi di lavoro (se applicabili) e delle politiche aziendali.

• Mantenere i quadri di governance delle risorse umane e sostenere gli audit delle risorse umane.

• Tenere aggiornato con i cambiamenti normativi e tradurli in processi operativi.

Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno

• Laurea in Risorse umane, Business Administration, o un campo relativo.

• Diversi anni di esperienza nell'amministrazione delle risorse umane e nel libro paga svizzero (obbligatorio).

• Forte comprensione del diritto del lavoro svizzero, del sistema di sicurezza sociale, delle imposte e del rispetto dell'occupazione.

• L'esperienza in ambienti multinazionali è una risorsa.

• Forte competenza MS Office e HRIS; competenze del sistema payroll richiesto.

• Fluente in tedesco e inglese.

• Tempo di lavoro: 80 - 100 %.

Nessun visto o permesso di lavoro può essere fornito per questo ruolo.

Hai una domanda sul ruolo?

Raggiungi Alexi Donadoni all'indirizzo alexi.donadoni@sulzer.com.

Cosa ti offriamo

• 25 giorni festivi (esclusi i giorni festivi) + giorni di servizio

• regime pensionistico contributivo

• Programma di assistenza dei dipendenti/assistenza sanitaria

• Parcheggio in loco/indennità di trasporto pubblico

• Accesso a una vasta gamma di sconti

Sur le rôle

Le gestionnaire de l'administration des RH et de la paie est chargé de diriger et de superviser tous les processus administratifs des RH et les opérations de paye de bout en bout pour la Suisse. Ce rôle assure le plein respect du droit du travail suisse, des règlements de sécurité sociale, des obligations fiscales et des politiques internes. Le poste est le principal point de contact pour les opérations des RH, l'administration du cycle de vie des employés, l'exactitude de la paye et l'intégrité du système des RH. Le rôle doit être exécuté de façon pratique, en assurant des processus de RH efficaces et une prestation de services de haute qualité aux employés et aux gestionnaires.
Vos principales tâches et responsabilités

Gestion de la paie (Swiss Payroll)

• Surveiller et exécuter la paie mensuelle de tous les employés suisses, y compris la rémunération variable, les indemnités, les retenues et les absences.

• Gérer les contrôles des états de paie, les rapprochements, les vérifications et les activités de rapport.

• Assurer le calcul correct des impôts, des cotisations de sécurité sociale, des déductions des fonds de pension et des primes d'assurance.

• Agir en tant que contact clé pour les employés sur la paye, les avantages sociaux et la gestion du temps.

• Collaborer avec les Finances sur la comptabilité de la paie, la provision salariale et les exigences de vérification.

• Gérer les activités de fin d'année (certificats de salaire, clôture de l'année fiscale de retenue, déclaration de sécurité sociale)

Administration des RH et gestion du cycle de vie des employés

• Agir en tant que conseiller en RH de confiance auprès des gestionnaires et des dirigeants basés en Suisse

• Gérer et superviser tous les processus administratifs des RH pour l'ensemble du cycle de vie des employés (embauche à la retraite).

• Préparer des contrats de travail, des amendements, des lettres de référence et d'autres documents juridiques conformément au droit suisse.

• Assurer la maintenance exacte des dossiers des employés et des dossiers personnels numériques.

• Gérer les processus d'embarquement et de débarquement, y compris les permis de travail (L, B, C) et la liaison avec les autorités.

• Veiller à ce que les institutions de sécurité sociale (AHV/ALV/IV/EO), les caisses de retraite (BVG/LPP), l'assurance accidents (UVG), le KTG et les bureaux d'allocations familiales soient enregistrés en temps voulu et informés.

• Soutenir les cycles annuels de rendement et de rémunération du point de vue administratif.

jobs.title: HR Director Mexico
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is seeking an experienced HR Director –Mexico to lead the HR function for our Mexico operations and serve as a strategic business partner to senior and operational leadership.

This role requires a leader who can combine strategic thinking with hands-on HR leadership in a manufacturing environment . The HR Director will lead organizational transformation, workforce planning, culture and talent initiatives while maintaining strong oversight of labor relations, employee relations and HR operations.

The successful candidate will bring strong business acumen, executive presence and a demonstrated ability to translate people strategies into practical actions and measurable business results.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as a strategic HR partner to senior and operational leadership, aligning people strategies with business priorities and performance.

• Lead organizational change and transformation initiatives, including organizational design, communication strategies, stakeholder alignment and management of resistance to change.

• Strengthen organizational culture, leadership capability, employee engagement and accountability.

• Lead strategic workforce planning, including labor forecasting, succession planning, talent pipelines, retention and critical skill development.

• Lead employee and labor relations, including collective bargaining, union relationships, conflict resolution and complex employee matters.

• Use HR, operational and financial metrics to identify workforce challenges and demonstrate HR’s impact on productivity, performance and profitability.

• Ensure strong HR governance, compliance, ethics and adherence to Mexican labor requirements.

• Drive continuous improvement of HR processes, systems and service delivery, including opportunities for automation and digitalization.

• Build and develop a high-performing HR team capable of balancing strategic priorities with the operational needs of the business.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field.

• Progressive HR career experience with demonstrated growth across multiple HR disciplines and increasing leadership responsibility.

• Manufacturing and/or automotive HR experience is required.

• Demonstrated experience supporting plant operations and both hourly and salaried employee populations.

• Proven experience personally leading organizational change, transformation and/or organizational design initiatives.

• Strong strategic workforce planning, succession planning and talent management experience.

• Significant employee and labor relations experience, including union and collective bargaining environments.

• Strong business acumen with the ability to connect HR strategies and metrics to operational and financial performance.

• Demonstrated ability to influence and partner with senior business leaders.

• Strong knowledge of Mexican labor practices, compliance and employee relations.

• Fluent Spanish and strong professional English communication skills.

Preferred

• Multi-site or regional HR leadership experience.

• Experience within a multinational or matrixed organization.

• Experience leading HR digitalization, automation or continuous-improvement initiatives.

What We’re Looking For
We are seeking a hands-on, strategic HR leader who is equally comfortable partnering with senior leadership and understanding the realities of the manufacturing floor. The ideal candidate has personally led meaningful change, built stronger organizational cultures, managed complex labor environments and can demonstrate how their HR leadership has contributed to measurable business results.

What we offer you

• Benefits Over law

• Saving found

• Training

• Christmas bon

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sulzer sta cercando un esperto Direttore HR – Messico per guidare la funzione HR per le nostre operazioni in Messico e servire come partner strategico di business per la leadership senior e operativa.

Questo ruolo richiede un leader che può combinare il pensiero strategico con la leadership HR hands-on in un ambiente di produzione. Il Direttore delle Risorse Umane guiderà la trasformazione organizzativa, la pianificazione della forza lavoro, la cultura e le iniziative di talento pur mantenendo una forte supervisione delle relazioni di lavoro, delle relazioni con i dipendenti e delle operazioni HR.

Il candidato di successo porterà forte acume aziendale, presenza esecutiva e una capacità dimostrata di tradurre le strategie delle persone in azioni pratiche e risultati aziendali misurabili.

Principali responsabilità

• Servire come partner strategico delle risorse umane per la leadership senior e operativa, allineare le strategie delle persone con priorità aziendali e prestazioni.

• Leader iniziative di cambiamento organizzativo e di trasformazione, tra cui progettazione organizzativa, strategie di comunicazione, allineamento degli stakeholder e gestione della resistenza al cambiamento.

• Rafforzare la cultura organizzativa, la capacità di leadership, l'impegno dei dipendenti e la responsabilità.

• Guida pianificazione strategica della forza lavoro, tra cui previsioni del lavoro, pianificazione di successione, pipeline di talento, ritenzione e sviluppo di abilità critiche.

• Lead dipendente e rapporti di lavoro, tra cui contrattazione collettiva, relazioni sindacali, risoluzione di conflitti e questioni complesse dei dipendenti.

• Utilizza metriche operative e finanziarie per identificare le sfide della forza lavoro e dimostrare l’impatto delle risorse umane sulla produttività, sulle prestazioni e sulla redditività.

• Assicurare una forte governance delle risorse umane, conformità, etica e adesione ai requisiti del lavoro messicano.

• Miglioramento continuo dei processi HR, dei sistemi e della fornitura di servizi, comprese le opportunità di automazione e digitalizzazione.

• Costruire e sviluppare un team HR altamente performante in grado di bilanciare le priorità strategiche con le esigenze operative del business.

Qualificazioni richieste

• Laurea in Risorse umane, Business Administration o un campo relativo.

• Avanzata esperienza di carriera HR con una crescita dimostrata in più discipline HR e crescente responsabilità di leadership.

• È richiesta un'esperienza HR per la produzione e/o l'automotive.

• Esperienza dimostrata che supporta le operazioni degli impianti e le popolazioni dipendenti orali e salariate.

• Esperienza comprovata personalmente principali iniziative di cambiamento organizzativo, trasformazione e/o progettazione organizzativa.

• Forte pianificazione strategica della forza lavoro, pianificazione della successione e esperienza di gestione del talento.

• Esperienza significativa dei rapporti tra i dipendenti e il lavoro, compresi gli ambienti di contrattazione collettiva e sindacali.

• Forte acume aziendale con la capacità di collegare le strategie HR e metriche alle prestazioni operative e finanziarie.

• Dimostrata capacità di influenzare e collaborare con i dirigenti aziendali senior.

• Forte conoscenza delle pratiche del lavoro messicano, della conformità e delle relazioni con i dipendenti.

• Fluente spagnolo e forte capacità di comunicazione professionale inglese.

Preferito

• Esperienza di leadership HR multi-sito o regionale.

• Esperienza all'interno di un'organizzazione multinazionale o matrice.

• Esperienza leader HR digitalizzazione, automazione o iniziative di miglioramento continuo.

Cosa stiamo cercando
Siamo alla ricerca di un leader di risorse umane strategiche, che è altrettanto confortevole con la leadership senior e la comprensione delle realtà del piano di produzione. Il candidato ideale ha personalmente portato cambiamenti significativi, ha costruito culture organizzative più forti, gestito ambienti di lavoro complessi e può dimostrare come la loro leadership HR ha contribuito a risultati aziendali misurabili.

• Dienen Sie als strategischer HR-Partner für leitende und operative Führungskräfte und richten Sie die Strategien der Mitarbeiter an den Geschäftsprioritäten und der Leistung aus.

• Führen Sie organisatorische Veränderungen und Transformationsinitiativen, einschließlich Organisationsdesign, Kommunikationsstrategien, Ausrichtung der Stakeholder und Management von Widerstand gegen Veränderungen.

• Stärkung der Organisationskultur, der Führungsfähigkeit, des Mitarbeiterengagements und der Rechenschaftspflicht.

• Führen Sie die strategische Personalplanung, einschließlich Arbeitsprognosen, Nachfolgeplanung, Talentpipelines, Bindung und Entwicklung kritischer Fähigkeiten.

• Führen Sie Mitarbeiter- und Arbeitsbeziehungen, einschließlich Tarifverhandlungen, Gewerkschaftsbeziehungen, Konfliktlösung und komplexe Mitarbeiterangelegenheiten.

• Verwenden Sie Personal-, Betriebs- und Finanzkennzahlen, um die Herausforderungen der Belegschaft zu identifizieren und die Auswirkungen der Personalabteilung auf Produktivität, Leistung und Rentabilität zu demonstrieren.

• Gewährleistung einer starken HR-Governance, Compliance, Ethik und Einhaltung der mexikanischen Arbeitsanforderungen.

• Förderung der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der HR-Prozesse, -Systeme und der Servicebereitstellung, einschließlich der Möglichkeiten zur Automatisierung und Digitalisierung.

Benötigte Qualifikationen

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Human Resources, Business Administration oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Unterstützung des Betriebs von Werken und sowohl stündlich als auch angestellt.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der persönlichen Leitung organisatorischer Veränderungs-, Transformations- und/oder Organisationsdesign-Initiativen.

Sur le rôle

Sulzer cherche un directeur des RH expérimenté – Mexique pour diriger la fonction RH pour nos opérations au Mexique et servir de partenaire stratégique pour le leadership supérieur et opérationnel.

Ce rôle exige un leader capable de combiner la pensée stratégique et le leadership pratique en RH dans un environnement manufacturier. Le directeur des RH dirigera les initiatives de transformation organisationnelle, de planification de la main-d'oeuvre, de culture et de talent tout en maintenant une surveillance rigoureuse des relations de travail, des relations avec les employés et des opérations des RH.

Le candidat retenu apportera une forte acuité en affaires, une présence de cadres supérieurs et une capacité démontrée de traduire les stratégies de personnel en mesures pratiques et en résultats opérationnels mesurables.

Principales responsabilités

• Servir de partenaire stratégique des RH au leadership supérieur et opérationnel, en harmonisant les stratégies en matière de ressources humaines avec les priorités opérationnelles et le rendement.

• Diriger les initiatives de changement organisationnel et de transformation, y compris la conception organisationnelle, les stratégies de communication, l'alignement des intervenants et la gestion de la résistance au changement.

• Renforcer la culture organisationnelle, la capacité de leadership, l'engagement des employés et la responsabilisation.

• Diriger les relations entre les employés et les travailleurs, y compris les négociations collectives, les relations syndicales, la résolution des conflits et les questions complexes concernant les employés.

• Utiliser des paramètres RH, opérationnels et financiers pour cerner les défis de la main-d'oeuvre et démontrer l'impact des RH sur la productivité, le rendement et la rentabilité.

• Assurer une bonne gouvernance des RH, la conformité, l'éthique et le respect des exigences du travail mexicain.

• Favoriser l'amélioration continue des processus, des systèmes et de la prestation des services des RH, y compris les possibilités d'automatisation et de numérisation.

• Créer et mettre sur pied une équipe de RH hautement performante capable d'équilibrer les priorités stratégiques avec les besoins opérationnels de l'entreprise.

Qualifications requises

• Baccalauréat en ressources humaines, administration des affaires ou un domaine connexe.

• Expérience de carrière en RH progressive avec une croissance démontrée dans plusieurs disciplines en RH et une responsabilité accrue en leadership.

• L'expérience en RH de la fabrication et/ou de l'automobile est requise.

• Expérience démontrée appuyant l'exploitation des installations et les effectifs horaires et salariés.

• Expérience éprouvée menant personnellement des initiatives de changement organisationnel, de transformation ou de conception organisationnelle.

• Forte expérience en planification stratégique des effectifs, en planification de la relève et en gestion des talents.

• Expérience importante des employés et des relations de travail, y compris les environnements de négociation syndicale et collective.

• Forte concentration des activités avec la capacité de relier les stratégies et les paramètres des RH au rendement opérationnel et financier.

• Capacité démontrée d'influencer les chefs d'entreprise et de s'associer avec eux.

• Forte connaissance des pratiques de travail mexicaines, de la conformité et des relations avec les employés.

• Compétences de communication espagnoles et professionnelles.

Préféré

• Expérience de leadership en RH multisite ou régionale.

• Expérience au sein d'une organisation multinationale ou matricielle.

• Expérience des initiatives de numérisation, d'automatisation ou d'amélioration continue des RH.

Ce que nous cherchons
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un leader pratique et stratégique des RH, qui est tout aussi à l'aise avec les cadres supérieurs et comprend les réalités du plancher de fabrication. Le candidat idéal a personnellement mené un changement significatif, construit des cultures organisationnelles plus solides, géré des environnements de travail complexes et peut démontrer comment son leadership en RH a contribué à des résultats opérationnels mesurables.

jobs.title: Machine Tool Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Sulzer Turbo Services is seeking a skilled Machine Tool Technician to support maintenance, repair, and operation of precision machining equipment used in the repair and servicing of turbomachinery components. This role is responsible for ensuring machine tools operate safely, efficiently, and within required tolerances to support high-quality manufacturing and repair operations. Key Responsibilities

• Perform maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of machine tools including manual lathes, surface grinders, milling machines, CNC equipment, and horizontal and vertical machining centers.

• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.

• Perform machine alignments, calibrations, and precision adjustments.

• Install, test, and commission new or rebuilt equipment.

• Maintain preventive maintenance schedules for shop equipment.

• Read and interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and technical manuals.

• Support production teams to minimize downtime.

• Ensure compliance with safety policies and OSHA standards.

• Maintain accurate maintenance records and documentation.

• Assist with equipment upgrades and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Observe Company Safety Policy and Procedures; follow and support all STS Safety Policies and ISO Procedures.

• Complete and properly document all tasks assigned by the Maintenance Supervisor.

• Report any mechanical issues identified during inspections to the Maintenance Supervisor.

• Work closely and maintain clear communication with other departments, mechanical personnel, Leadman, and Supervisors.

• Complete all company-required training programs.
Required Qualifications

• High School Diploma or GED required.

• Technical or vocational training in machining, industrial maintenance, or related field preferred.

• 7–10 years’ experience maintaining machine tools or industrial equipment.

• Strong knowledge of machining operations and precision measurement tools.

• Experience with CNC troubleshooting preferred.

• Ability to read schematics and technical drawings.

• Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work independently and within a team environment.
Preferred Skills

• Experience in turbomachinery, rotating equipment, or heavy industrial repair.

• Familiarity with vibration analysis or alignment practices.

• PLC troubleshooting experience is a plus.

• Forklift or overhead crane experience preferred.
Physical Requirements

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.

• Standing, bending, and working in an industrial shop environment.

• Ability to work around rotating machinery and heavy equipment.
Work Environment

• Industrial repair and machine shop setting.

• Exposure to noise, moving equipment, oils, and machining materials.

• PPE required at all times.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer Pumps (Canada) Inc. - Flow Equipment, is a division of Sulzer Ltd, and is a global leader in the development and supply of pumping solutions and related equipment to its key markets oil and gas, power, general industries (mining, metals, food, CPI & fertilizers) and water. We provide a challenging and rewarding work environment where diversity is valued as a key driver for success.

Job Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Area Sales Manager to join our team in the sales and services (parts and repairs) of Sulzer Pumps / Water & Industrial Business Unit products (pumps, mixers, agitators, compressors etc.). In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for cultivating and expanding client relationships, driving revenue growth through strategic account management and business development initiatives. Your energetic approach and excellent communication skills will empower you to negotiate effectively, identify new sales opportunities, and deliver tailored solutions that meet our clients’ needs. This position offers an exciting opportunity to lead with enthusiasm, influence market growth, and contribute to our company’s ongoing success. Our successful candidate will primarily work independently with occasional guidance from the National Sales Manager PPI.

How You will Contribute:

• Develop growth in new and existing customer base.

• Negotiate orders including all technical, commercial and legal details.

• Call on prospective customers; maintain contracts with customers.

• Travel to customer locations to insure close and regular face-to-face contact.

• Secure and renew orders; arrange delivery dates and other peripherals integral to selling.

• Customer meetings during and outside normal business hours on a regular basis consistent with expense budgets and good business practices.

Other Essential Functions/ Responsibilities:

• Manage sales programs within the assigned territory, maintaining accurate records and providing activity reports as required.

• Follow up on overdue customer invoices in a professional and timely manner.

• Support alliance customers and ensure their needs are met effectively.

• Stay informed on new products, services, and relevant information to better support customers.

• Escalate customer concerns to the appropriate department and follow through to ensure satisfactory resolution.

• Comply with policies regarding safety, including but not limited to proper use of required PPE at all times.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

To succeed in this role, the ideal candidate will have:

• An Engineering degree or 5+ years of experience in pumps, hydraulics, or a related field.

• Proven experience marketing and selling industrial equipment, including pumps and motors.

• Strong written, verbal, negotiation, and interpersonal communication skills.

• Ability to work independently and effectively with minimal supervision.

• Resilience, professionalism, and a positive attitude in overcoming challenges and objections.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications; SAP experience is preferred.

• Strong technical and analytical problem-solving abilities, with the ability to address internal and external customer concerns.

• Willingness to travel regularly, including overnight travel by vehicle and air, as required within the assigned territory.

• Valid driver's license with a satisfactory driving record.

Eligibility to Apply: This position requires legal authorization to work in Canada at time of application.

Location: Remote (Work from home within Western Canada)

What we offer you

• Company pension

• Dental care

• Disability insurance

• Employee assistance program

• Extended health care

• Life insurance

• Paid time off

• Vision care

•

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sulzer Pumps (Canada) Inc. - Flow Equipment, è una divisione di Sulzer Ltd, ed è un leader globale nello sviluppo e nella fornitura di soluzioni di pompaggio e relative attrezzature ai suoi mercati chiave petrolio e gas, potenza, industrie generali (mining, metalli, cibo, fertilizzanti CPI e acqua. Forniamo un ambiente di lavoro impegnativo e gratificante dove la diversità è apprezzata come un driver chiave per il successo.

Panoramica del lavoro:
Stiamo cercando un Area Sales Manager dinamico e guidato dai risultati per unire il nostro team nelle vendite e servizi (parti e riparazioni) dei prodotti Sulzer Pumps / Water & Industrial Business Unit (pompi, miscelatori, agitatori, compressori ecc.). In questo ruolo fondamentale, sarai responsabile della coltivazione e dell'espansione delle relazioni con i clienti, della crescita dei ricavi attraverso iniziative strategiche di gestione del conto e sviluppo aziendale. Il vostro approccio energetico e le eccellenti capacità di comunicazione vi permetterà di negoziare in modo efficace, identificare nuove opportunità di vendita, e fornire soluzioni su misura che soddisfano le esigenze dei nostri clienti. Questa posizione offre un'emozionante opportunità per portare con entusiasmo, influenzare la crescita del mercato e contribuire al successo costante della nostra azienda. Il nostro candidato di successo lavorerà principalmente indipendentemente con una guida occasionale dal National Sales Manager PPI.

Come Contribuirai:

• Sviluppare la crescita della base clienti nuova e esistente.

• Negoziare ordini, compresi tutti i dettagli tecnici, commerciali e legali.

• Chiamare i potenziali clienti; mantenere i contratti con i clienti.

• Viaggia nelle sedi dei clienti per assicurare un contatto faccia a faccia stretto e regolare.

• Ordine sicuro e rinnovare; organizzare le date di consegna e altre periferiche integrali alla vendita.

• Riunioni dei clienti durante e fuori normali ore di lavoro su base regolare coerente con i bilanci di spesa e buone pratiche commerciali.

Altre funzioni essenziali / responsabilità:

• Gestisci i programmi di vendita all'interno del territorio assegnato, mantenendo registri accurati e fornendo rapporti di attività come richiesto.

• Seguire le fatture dei clienti in ritardo in modo professionale e tempestivo.

• Sostenere i clienti dell'alleanza e garantire le loro esigenze sono soddisfatte in modo efficace.

• Rimani informato su nuovi prodotti, servizi e informazioni pertinenti per supportare meglio i clienti.

• Aumentare le preoccupazioni dei clienti per il reparto appropriato e seguire per garantire una risoluzione soddisfacente.

• Complimenti alle politiche in materia di sicurezza, compreso ma non limitato al corretto uso del DPI richiesto in ogni momento.

• Eseguire altri compiti come assegnato.

Per avere successo in questo ruolo, il candidato ideale avrà:

• Una laurea in ingegneria o 5+ anni di esperienza in pompe, idraulica, o un campo correlato.

• Prove esperienze di marketing e vendita di attrezzature industriali, tra cui pompe e motori.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione scritte, verbali, negoziali e interpersonali.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente ed efficace con una minima supervisione.

• Resilienza, professionalità e atteggiamento positivo nel superare le sfide e le obiezioni.

• La competenza con applicazioni Microsoft Office; l'esperienza SAP è preferita.

• Forte capacità tecniche e analitiche di problem solving, con la capacità di affrontare le preoccupazioni interne ed esterne del cliente.

• Volontà di viaggiare regolarmente, compreso il viaggio notturno per veicolo e aria, come richiesto all'interno del territorio assegnato.

• Patente di guida valida con un record di guida soddisfacente.

Sulzer Pumps (Canada) Inc. - Flow Equipment, is a division of Sulzer Ltd, and is a global leader in the development and supply of pumping solutions and related equipment to its key markets oil and gas, power, general industries (mining, metals, food, CPI & fertilizers) and water. jobs.title: Senior Payroll Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is a global leader in fluid engineering, specialising in pumping, mixing, separation and application technologies that help customers operate more efficiently and sustainably. With over 13,500 employees across approximately 160 sites worldwide and annual sales of around CHF 3.6 billion, Sulzer supports customers across industries including water, energy and industrial markets.

This opportunity sits within our HR Shared Services team in Leeds, supporting payroll operations across multiple UK legal entities. It's an exciting time to join the team as we continue to evolve, improve processes and deliver significant business change. In addition to ensuring the accurate and timely delivery of monthly and weekly payroll activities, you will play a key role in supporting and driving HR Shared Services transformation initiatives, helping to improve efficiency, enhance the employee experience and support the ongoing development of our payroll and HR operations

As a growing and evolving function, this role offers the chance to make a genuine impact, contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and support a business that is investing heavily in its people, systems and processes. Your Main Tasks and Responsibilities:

• You will play a key role in ensuring payroll accuracy for approximately 1,250 UK employees, supporting 8 monthly payrolls and 1 weekly payroll across multiple UK legal entities

• Process payroll changes including starters, leavers, absences and contractual amendments.

• Ensure accurate calculation and processing of overtime, shift premiums and other variable payments.

• Validate payroll data received from multiple sources, including integrated systems and manual submissions.

• Reconcile payroll information and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner.

• Ensure payrolls are processed accurately and in line with legislative and company requirements.

• Respond to payroll-related queries from employees and stakeholders.

• Support payroll reporting and audit requirements.

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and payroll process optimisation.

To Succeed in This Role, You Will Need:

• Proven experience in end-to-end payroll processing.

• Strong understanding of payroll legislation and payroll best practice.

• Experience processing variable pay elements such as overtime, shift allowances and absence-related payments.

• Comfortable working with payroll and HR systems and managing data from multiple sources.

• Excellent attention to detail and a highly organised approach.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Able to build effective relationships with internal stakeholders and employees.

• Experience of iTrent, Workday or payroll implementation projects would be advantageous but is not essential

What we offer you

We’ve recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds facility - creating a brighter, more efficient, and more advanced workspace designed to support high‑quality work and a great employee experience. Alongside our upgraded facilities, you’ll benefit from:

Core Benefits

• A competitive base salary

• Annual bonus linked to business and individual performance, paid as a single annual payment.

• Private Medical Insurance – Individual private medical cover provided through Aviva

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (covering everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services)

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sulzer è un leader globale nell'ingegneria dei fluidi, specializzato in tecnologie di pompaggio, miscelazione, separazione e applicazione che aiutano i clienti a operare in modo più efficiente e sostenibile. Con oltre 13.500 dipendenti in circa 160 siti in tutto il mondo e vendite annuali di circa 3,6 miliardi di franchi, Sulzer supporta i clienti in settori quali acqua, energia e mercati industriali.

Questa opportunità si trova all'interno del nostro team HR Shared Services di Leeds, supportando le operazioni di payroll in più enti legali del Regno Unito. E 'un momento emozionante per unirsi al team come continuiamo a evolvere, migliorare i processi e fornire un cambiamento di business significativo. Oltre a gestire le attività di payroll giorno per giorno, svolgerai un ruolo chiave in due importanti programmi di trasformazione, supportando l'implementazione della Workday in corso e la futura migrazione da iTrent a Strada, aiutando a plasmare il futuro della consegna payroll all'interno di Sulzer.

Come funzione crescente ed evolutiva, questo ruolo offre la possibilità di avere un impatto reale, contribuire a iniziative di miglioramento continuo e sostenere un'impresa che sta investendo pesantemente nella sua gente, sistemi e processi. Le vostre attività e responsabilità principali:

• Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel garantire l'accuratezza del libro paga per circa 1.250 dipendenti del Regno Unito, supportando 8 registri mensili e 1 libro paga settimanale attraverso più enti legali del Regno Unito

• Cambiamenti del libro paga del processo, inclusi starter, lieviti, assenze e modifiche contrattuali.

• Assicurare il calcolo accurato e l'elaborazione di straordinari, premi a turni e altri pagamenti variabili.

• Convalida i dati payroll ricevuti da più fonti, compresi i sistemi integrati e le presentazioni manuali.

• Reconcile payroll informazioni e risolvere discrepanze in modo tempestivo.

• Assicurarsi che i salari siano elaborati con precisione e in linea con i requisiti legislativi e aziendali.

• Risponde a domande relative ai registri da dipendenti e stakeholder.

• Supporta i requisiti di rendicontazione e di audit del libro paga.

• Contribuire a iniziative di miglioramento continuo e l'ottimizzazione del processo payroll.

Per vincere in questo ruolo, si avrà bisogno di:

• Esperienza comprovata nell'elaborazione di payroll end-to-end.

• Forte comprensione della legislazione sul libro paga e la migliore pratica del libro paga.

• Elementi di retribuzione variabili di elaborazione dell'esperienza quali gli straordinari, gli assegni di turno e i pagamenti relativi all'assenza.

• Confortevole lavoro con sistemi payroll e HR e gestione dei dati da più fonti.

• Ottima attenzione ai dettagli e un approccio altamente organizzato.

• Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving.

• In grado di costruire relazioni efficaci con gli stakeholder interni e i dipendenti.

• L'esperienza di iTrent, Workday o payroll progetti di attuazione sarebbe vantaggiosa ma non è essenziale

Cosa ti offriamo

Recentemente abbiamo investito in modo significativo nella modernizzazione della nostra struttura Leeds - creando uno spazio di lavoro più luminoso, più efficiente e più avanzato progettato per supportare il lavoro di alta qualità e una grande esperienza dei dipendenti. Accanto alle nostre strutture aggiornate, potrete beneficiare di:

Vantaggi del nucleo

• Uno stipendio base competitivo

• Bonus annuale legato alle prestazioni aziendali e individuali, pagato come unico pagamento annuale.

• Assicurazione medica privata – Copertura medica privata individuale fornita tramite Aviva

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (copertura delle spese sanitarie quotidiane come i servizi dentali, ottici e GP)

• 33 giorni di vacanza

• Contributo pensionistico

• Programmi di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Sconti su shopping, intrattenimento e stile di vita

• Opzione di abbonamento Costco

• Noleggio auto personali scontati per te, famiglia e amici

• Premi di servizio lungo

• Apprendimento in corso attraverso Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Supporto delle Forze Armate – In qualità di titolare del Premio d'Argento del programma di riconoscimento dei datori di lavoro MoD Defence, supponiamo attivamente

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Sulzer ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen in der Fluidtechnik und spezialisiert auf Pumpen, Mischen, Trennen und Anwendungstechnologien, die Kunden helfen, effizienter und nachhaltiger zu arbeiten. Mit über 13.500 Mitarbeitern an rund 160 Standorten weltweit und einem Jahresumsatz von rund CHF 3.6 Milliarden unterstützt Sulzer Kunden in allen Branchen, einschließlich Wasser, Energie und Industrie.

Diese Gelegenheit liegt in unserem HR Shared Services-Team in Leeds und unterstützt Lohnabrechnungen in mehreren britischen Rechtsträgern. Es ist eine aufregende Zeit, dem Team beizutreten, während wir uns weiterentwickeln, Prozesse verbessern und bedeutende Geschäftsveränderungen bewirken. Neben der Verwaltung der täglichen Gehaltsabrechnungsaktivitäten spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle in zwei wichtigen Transformationsprogrammen, die die laufende Workday-Implementierung und die zukünftige Migration von iTrent zu Strada unterstützen und die Zukunft der Lohnabrechnungslieferung bei Sulzer mitgestalten.

Als wachsende und sich entwickelnde Funktion bietet diese Rolle die Möglichkeit, eine echte Wirkung zu erzielen, zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen beizutragen und ein Unternehmen zu unterstützen, das stark in seine Mitarbeiter, Systeme und Prozesse investiert. Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Sie spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Sicherstellung der Gehaltsabrechnungsgenauigkeit für rund 1.250 britische Mitarbeiter und unterstützen 8 monatliche Gehaltsabrechnungen und 1 wöchentliche Gehaltsabrechnung in mehreren britischen Rechtsträgern.

• Gehaltsabrechnungsänderungen einschließlich Starter, Abgänger, Abwesenheiten und Vertragsänderungen.

• Gewährleistung einer genauen Berechnung und Verarbeitung von Überstunden, Schichtprämien und anderen variablen Zahlungen.

• Validierung von Gehaltsabrechnungsdaten aus verschiedenen Quellen, einschließlich integrierter Systeme und manueller Einreichungen.

• Vergleichen Sie die Gehaltsabrechnungsinformationen und beheben Sie Diskrepanzen rechtzeitig.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Gehaltsabrechnungen korrekt und in Übereinstimmung mit den gesetzlichen und betrieblichen Anforderungen verarbeitet werden.

• Reagieren Sie auf Payroll-bezogene Anfragen von Mitarbeitern und Stakeholdern.

• Unterstützen Sie die Berichts- und Auditanforderungen für Lohnabrechnungen.

• Beitrag zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen und zur Optimierung des Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnungsprozesses.

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, benötigen Sie:

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der End-to-End-Gehaltsabrechnungsverarbeitung.

• Ein starkes Verständnis der Lohnabrechnungsgesetzgebung und der Best Practice der Lohnabrechnung.

• Erfahrung in der Verarbeitung von variablen Vergütungselementen wie Überstunden, Schichtzulagen und abwesenden Zahlungen.

• Komfortables Arbeiten mit Payroll- und HR-Systemen und die Verwaltung von Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen.

• Ausgezeichnete Liebe zum Detail und ein hoch organisierter Ansatz.

• Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten.

• Kann effektive Beziehungen zu internen Stakeholdern und Mitarbeitern aufbauen.

• Erfahrungen mit iTrent-, Workday- oder Payroll-Implementierungsprojekten wären vorteilhaft, aber nicht unbedingt erforderlich

Sulzer est une société d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Sulzer est un leader mondial de l'ingénierie des fluides, spécialisé dans les technologies de pompage, de mélange, de séparation et d'application qui aident les clients à fonctionner plus efficacement et durablement. Avec plus de 13 500 employés répartis sur environ 160 sites dans le monde et un chiffre d'affaires annuel d'environ 3,6 milliards de francs suisses, Sulzer soutient ses clients dans les secteurs de l'eau, de l'énergie et des marchés industriels.

Cette opportunité fait partie de notre équipe de services partagés RH à Leeds, soutenant les opérations de paye dans plusieurs entités juridiques britanniques. C'est un moment passionnant de nous joindre à l'équipe alors que nous continuons d'évoluer, d'améliorer les processus et de réaliser des changements importants dans nos activités. En plus de gérer les activités courantes de la paye, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans deux grands programmes de transformation, soutenant la mise en oeuvre de la journée de travail et la migration future d'iTrent à Strada, contribuant ainsi à façonner l'avenir de l'exécution de la paye au sein de Sulzer.

En tant que fonction croissante et évolutive, ce rôle offre la possibilité d'avoir un impact réel, de contribuer à des initiatives d'amélioration continue et de soutenir une entreprise qui investit fortement dans ses ressources humaines, ses systèmes et ses processus. Vos principales tâches et responsabilités :

• Répondre aux questions relatives à la paye des employés et des intervenants.

• Contribuer aux initiatives d'amélioration continue et à l'optimisation du processus de paye.

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous aurez besoin :

• Expérience éprouvée dans le traitement des états de paie de bout en bout.

• Connaissance approfondie de la législation sur la paie et des pratiques exemplaires en matière de paye.

• Expérience du traitement d'éléments de rémunération variables comme les heures supplémentaires, les indemnités de poste et les paiements liés à l'absence.

• Travailler confortablement avec les systèmes de paye et de RH et gérer les données provenant de sources multiples.

• Excellente attention aux détails et à une approche très organisée.

• Fortes compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes.

• Capacité d'établir des relations efficaces avec les intervenants et les employés internes.

En plus de nos installations améliorées, vous bénéficierez:

jobs.title: Operations Controlling Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Serve as the strategic finance business partner to Operations by driving financial performance through product costing, inventory governance, cost management, forecasting, reporting, and operational decision support. The role supports Operations leadership with actionable financial insights, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring financial discipline and business performance optimization. Key Responsibilities

• Act as the finance business partner to Operations leadership.

• Provide monthly reporting, variance analysis, and business performance commentary.

• Support budgeting, forecasting, and operational planning processes.

• Monitor operational KPIs and translate operational results into financial impact.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and financial governance processes.

• Analyze manufacturing costs and operating expenses and identify improvement opportunities.

• Monitor cost center performance and support productivity initiatives.

• Maintain product costing structures and support standard cost updates.

• Analyze material, labor, and overhead variances and recommend corrective actions.

• Support pricing, profitability, and margin analysis.

• Oversee inventory valuation, accuracy, and inventory-related KPIs.

• Support cycle count, physical inventory, reserve analysis, and working capital initiatives.

• Develop and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and financial controls.

• Monitor CAPEX spending against approved budgets and provide variance analysis and reporting

• Ensure sustainability and financial accuracy of reported savings initiatives.

• Analyze open order intake, backlog, and shipment performance to support forecast accuracy and period-end reporting.

• Monitor inventory, receivables, and operational working capital performance. Partner with functional leaders to identify opportunities for cash flow improvement
Qualifications & Skills

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in manufacturing controlling and/or cost accounting

• Experience with ERP systems (SAP preferred if applicable)

• Advanced Excel

• Drive accountability for financial performance.

• Ability to identify root causes and drive corrective actions.

• Data-driven decision making.

• Strong analytical, communication, and business partnering skills.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Capacità di identificare le cause della radice e guidare azioni correttive.

• Surveiller les ICR opérationnels et traduire les résultats opérationnels en incidences financières.

• Mener des initiatives d'amélioration continue et des processus de gouvernance financière.

• Compte du cycle de soutien, inventaire physique, analyse des réserves et initiatives de fonds de roulement.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Regional Head of Sales, AME is responsible for leading the commercial strategy and driving profitable growth across the Americas region for the Mass Transfer Components & Services (MTCS) business. This role owns regional sales performance, strategic account development, and channel partner effectiveness while building strong customer relationships and collaborating cross-functionally to deliver sustainable business growth. What You'll Do

• Develop and execute the regional sales strategy to achieve revenue, order intake, profitability, and market share objectives.

• Lead strategic customer engagement and cultivate executive-level relationships with key accounts to drive long-term growth.

• Manage and optimize the performance of agents, distributors, representatives, and other channel partners across the Americas.

• Drive sales forecasting, pipeline management, territory planning, pricing strategy, and commercial negotiations.

• Partner with Operations, Engineering, Product Management, Supply Chain, Service, and Finance to ensure successful project execution and customer satisfaction.

• Foster a high-performance commercial culture focused on collaboration, compliance, continuous improvement, and commercial excellence.

Qualifications & Criteria

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or a related discipline; MBA preferred.

• 10+ years of progressive commercial leadership experience within industrial manufacturing, engineered equipment, or process industries.

• Proven success leading regional sales organizations with responsibility for revenue growth, profitability, and strategic account management.

• Demonstrated experience managing indirect sales channels, distributors, agents, and commercial partnerships.

• Strong business acumen with experience in forecasting, contract negotiations, pricing strategy, and CRM-driven sales management.

• Excellent leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to influence executive stakeholders.

• Preference for bilingual in Spanish and English.

Travel Expectations
25%-30% travel to our Mexico City site - opportunity to office in our Energy Corridor or Humble locations.

What we offer you

• PTO and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401K plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

Über die Rolle

Der Regional Head of Sales, AME, ist verantwortlich für die Leitung der Geschäftsstrategie und das profitable Wachstum in der Region Amerika für das Mass Transfer Components & Services (MTCS)-Geschäft. Diese Rolle besitzt regionale Vertriebsleistung, strategische Kontoentwicklung und Channel-Partner-Effektivität, während sie starke Kundenbeziehungen aufbaut und funktionsübergreifend zusammenarbeitet, um nachhaltiges Geschäftswachstum zu erzielen. • Förderung von Umsatzprognosen, Pipeline-Management, Gebietsplanung, Preisstrategie und kommerziellen Verhandlungen.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Operations, Engineering, Produktmanagement, Supply Chain, Service und Finanzen, um eine erfolgreiche Projektabwicklung und Kundenzufriedenheit zu gewährleisten.

• Pflegen Sie eine leistungsstarke kommerzielle Kultur, die sich auf Zusammenarbeit, Compliance, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und kommerzielle Exzellenz konzentriert.

Qualifikationen und Kriterien

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Business, Engineering oder einer verwandten Disziplin; MBA bevorzugt.

• 10+ Jahre fortschrittliche kaufmännische Führungserfahrung in der industriellen Fertigung, in technischen Anlagen oder in der Prozessindustrie.

• Nachgewiesener Erfolg führende regionale Vertriebsorganisationen mit Verantwortung für Umsatzwachstum, Rentabilität und strategisches Account Management.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Management indirekter Vertriebskanäle, Distributoren, Agenten und kommerzieller Partnerschaften.

• Hervorragende Führungs-, Kommunikations- und funktionsübergreifende Kollaborationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Führungskräfte zu beeinflussen.

• Präferenz für zweisprachig in Spanisch und Englisch.

25%-30% reisen zu unserem Standort in Mexiko-Stadt - Gelegenheit, in unserem Energiekorridor oder Humble-Standort zu arbeiten.

Le chef régional des ventes, AME, est responsable de la direction de la stratégie commerciale et de la croissance rentable dans l'ensemble de la région des Amériques pour les activités des composantes et services de transfert de masse (MTCS). jobs.title: Applications Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Applications Engineer is responsible for evaluating customer requirements and developing technical and commercial proposals for clean water/municipal equipment solutions. This role serves as a critical link between customers, sales teams, and internal engineering/manufacturing to ensure accurate, timely, and competitive responses to inquiries. This position operates in a fast-paced, high-volume environment supporting distributors, OEMs, EPCs, and end users across a wide range of applications. Key Responsibilities:
Proposal & Technical Evaluation

• Review customer RFQs, specifications, and datasheets to determine appropriate product selection

• Perform pumping equipment sizing, selection, and configuration

• Generate detailed quotations including scope, pricing, and lead time
Customer & Sales Support

• Serve as a technical resource for internal sales teams and external customers

• Support distribution network with product selection, troubleshooting, and application guidance

• Participate in distributor and customer calls, visits, and training as needed
Cross-Functional Coordination

• Work closely with the Project Management team to define documentation packages, testing requirements, and customer deliverables early in the quotation phase to ensure accurate scope, compliance, and execution readiness.

• Collaborate with operations and supply chain to confirm feasibility, lead times, and costing

• Ensure alignment between customer expectations and internal capabilities
Quote and Opportunity Management

• Manage multiple RFQs simultaneously in a high-volume environment

• Maintain accurate records of opportunities, quotes, and communications in Salesforce (CRM system)
Continuous Improvement & Team Support

• Identify opportunities to improve quoting efficiency, accuracy, and standardization

• Support development of tools, templates, and documentation

• Assist in training new team members and sharing application knowledge

Secondary Responsibilities:

• Perform other duties as assigned.

• Some travel may be required (<10%)

Supervisory Responsibilities:

• None

Qualifications:

• Required
• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, or related field.

• 0-5 years of related engineering experience (industrial, applications, pumps & hydraulics preferred)

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines

• Excellent communication skills (both written and verbal)

• Willingness to travel as needed

• Preferred
• Experience with pumps, fluid systems, or rotating equipment

• Exposure to reading specifications and technical drawings

• Familiarity with CRM systems (Salesforce) and/or ERP systems (SAP)

• Experience working with distributors or in a customer-facing role

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

Gestione delle quote e delle opportunità

Miglioramento continuo e supporto del team

• Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving

• Capacità di gestire più priorità con scadenze strette

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione (sia scritta che verbale)

• Volontà di viaggiare come necessario

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Repair various kinds of electro-mechanical equipment. Pasadena, Texas

DUTIES

• Read job cards to determine; job status, work authorization/limitations, estimate, description of problems and/or expected serviceability.

• Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).

• Disassemble electro-mechanical equipment noting parts identifications, configuration and condition.

• Clean electro-mechanical equipment assemblies as needed using various methods and steps, including but not limited to: parts washer/steamers, caustic tanks, glass beaders, etc.

• Measure for or note proper replacement parts. Correctly requisition needed items from storekeeper, as approved by supervisor.

• Replace or repair worn or defective mechanical or electro-mechanical assemblies, including but not limited to: bearings, brushes, brush holders, motors leads gears seals, impellers, mechanical switches, brakes clutches, clutch rotors, tachs, fans, end shield,, etc.

• Retest reassembled electro-mechanical equipment for proper output and operation.

• Complete required paperwork for each job accurately and on a timely basis.

• Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed

• Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).

• Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.

• Keep work area neat and clean as directed by supervisor.

• Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.

• Perform other skilled or not-skilled duties as directed by supervisor

QUALIFICATIONS

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Basic mechanical aptitude

• Ability to understand, perform and retain various skill related training and operational and safety procedures demonstrated by supervisor.

• 401K plan with up to a 6% company match (additional benefits are available after 1 year of employment)

• Comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, vision, life, short- and long-term disability

• Health savings account with employer matching

• 4 weeks of paid parental leave

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

jobs.description:

This role supports the production of high-precision components by developing efficient machining strategies, improving cycle times, reducing tooling costs, and ensuring compliance with quality standards. The ideal candidate possesses a minimum of five (5) years of dedicated experience programming 5-axis milling machines and demonstrated expertise using Mastercam 2024 or later versions , which is a required qualification for this position. jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Legal / Compliance Sr. Specialist is responsible for applying advanced legal and compliance knowledge to manage projects independently, ensuring the organization’s adherence to laws and internal policies. This role also supports junior professionals through coaching and review. This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level experts. Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Patent and Trademark Pros ecution: Manage and assess IP disclosures. Assist Business Units in the decision as to whether to seek patent protection. Responsible for drafting and filing patent and trademark registration applications internally, while also managing and supervising related applications handled by outside counsel, incl. related costs. Responsibility for local priority applications

• IP Operational Management: Effectively manag e the entire IP lifecycle by leveraging internal systems and tools.

• Intellectual Property Right Searching: Manage and control the process for searching patent information databases for patentability, validity, IP landscape, freedom to operate and infringement assessment purposes

• Infringement Opinions: Procure and provide infringement, validity, freedom-to-operate (FTO) and trademark availability clearance opinions, either internally or with the use of outside counsel/IP search service provider

• Third Party IP Conflicts: Contribute to the process for resolving conflicts with third parties concerning own or third-party IP rights or misappropriated own IP, in particular via third party observations, oppositions, C&D letters and negotiated settlement agreements

• Contract Advice: Provide advice on IP aspects for confidentiality agreements and contribute to setting up licensing agreements and IP conflict settlement agreements

• Prepare and deliver IP education in the form of seminars or presentations for engineers, sales and marketing managers and senior business leaders and provide guidance and support for all IP-related questions of the business

Qualifications:

• University-level education in chemistry, chemical or process engineering and Patent bar qualification

• At least 5 years working experience in IP, preferably in the chemistry or chemical/process engineering domain

• Experienced in patent prosecution and FTO

• Previous exposure to trademark and/or trade secret is a plus

• Highly organized professional with the ability to effectively manage multiple tasks and priorities

• Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in all aspects of work

• Demonstrated ability to negotiate and draft IP agreements

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills to build and maintain professional relationships

• A strategic mindset

• Fluency in English

• Flexibility to travel on demand

target bonus: 18.33% of annual income
