About the role

The Operations FP&A Manager serves as the primary finance business partner to Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Operations, Procurement, and Project Management teams. This role provides financial leadership and analytical support to drive operational performance, improve forecasting accuracy, optimize inventory and working capital, and enhance profitability. The position focuses on inventory management, raw materials oversight, WIP reporting, operational forecasting, manufacturing KPI reporting, project financial tracking, and decision support. Primary Responsibilities

• Lead operational forecasting for production volumes, labor, material consumption, manufacturing costs, inventory and working capital.

• Partner with Operations leadership to identify financial risks and opportunities.

• Analyze raw material, WIP and finished goods inventories and drive inventory turn improvements.

• Monitor inventory aging, excess inventory and obsolescence exposure.

• Establish and maintain robust WIP reporting and forecasting processes.

• Track project costs, margins, labor utilization and forecasted outcomes.

• Develop and maintain manufacturing KPI dashboards and performance analytics.

• Perform variance analysis, root-cause analysis and profitability assessments.

• Support capital investment evaluations and operational improvement initiatives.

• Serve as a trusted business partner to Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Project leaders.

• Production Volumes

• Capacity Utilization

• Labor Efficiency

• Scrap and Rework Costs

• Yield Performance

• Gross Margin

• WIP Aging

• Working Capital

The Accounting Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and contribute to delivering high-quality financial services that support a prosperous and more sustainable society.

Join our Finance team in Madrid as an Invoicing & Collection Clerk . In this role, you will be responsible for managing invoicing and accounts receivable activities, ensuring timely collections, maintaining accurate financial records, and supporting efficient accounting operations across the organization. • Experience working with SAP FI/CO as a user.

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including formulas, functions, and pivot tables.

• Professional English communication skills (B2/C1 level). German would be a plus.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to work independently while maintaining a collaborative and team-oriented mindset.

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Der Rechnungsführer ist verantwortlich für die Unterstützung von Buchhaltungsvorgängen, einschließlich Dateneingabe, Abstimmungen und Unterstützung bei der Finanzberichterstattung. Diese Rolle gewährleistet die Genauigkeit der Finanzunterlagen und unterstützt die Einhaltung der Rechnungslegungsstandards. Dieses Stellenprofil richtet sich an Berufseinsteiger, die ein breites theoretisches Wissen anwenden und die Fähigkeit benötigen, Probleme zu untersuchen und zu analysieren. Lösungen werden in der Regel mit einem älteren Mitglied diskutiert / verifiziert. Über die Rolle

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und dazu beizutragen, qualitativ hochwertige Finanzdienstleistungen zu liefern, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft unterstützen.

Treten Sie unserem Finanzteam in Madrid als Invoicing & Collection Clerk bei. In dieser Rolle sind Sie für die Verwaltung von Rechnungsstellungs- und Debitorenaktivitäten, die Gewährleistung zeitnaher Inkassos, die Pflege genauer Finanzaufzeichnungen und die Unterstützung effizienter Buchhaltungsvorgänge im gesamten Unternehmen verantwortlich. Sie arbeiten eng mit internen Stakeholdern, externen Anbietern und Sulzer-Unternehmen weltweit zusammen, um reibungslose und effektive Finanzprozesse zu gewährleisten.

Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten

• Verwalten Sie den Debitorenprozess und gewährleisten Sie eine zeitnahe und genaue Kundenrechnung.

• Beobachten Sie eingehende Zahlungen und verfolgen Sie proaktiv überfällige Konten.

• Führen Sie Inkassoaktivitäten durch und unterstützen Sie die Abwicklung ausstehender Forderungen.

• Vergleichen Sie Kundenkonten und untersuchen Sie Unstimmigkeiten oder Abrechnungsprobleme.

• Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Finanzberichten im Zusammenhang mit Forderungen und Sammlungen.

• Pflegen und aktualisieren Sie Kunden- und Finanzstammdaten.

• Unterstützen Sie unternehmensübergreifende Rechnungsabgleichsaktivitäten während des Monatsabschlusses.

• Arbeiten Sie mit internen Abteilungen zusammen, um Möglichkeiten für Prozessverbesserungen und höhere Effizienz zu identifizieren.

• Koordination mit dem externen Dienstleister, der für OTC- und RTR-Aktivitäten verantwortlich ist.

• Aufbau starker Beziehungen zu wichtigen Stakeholdern, darunter Group FP&A, Treasury, Tax & RE und Sulzer-Tochtergesellschaften.

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, müssen Sie

• Abschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Idealerweise 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Accounts Receivable, Fakturierung oder Inkassomanagement.

• Gutes Verständnis der Rechnungslegungsgrundsätze und Finanzprozesse.

• Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit SAP FI/CO als Anwender.

• Gute Kenntnisse von Microsoft Excel, einschließlich Formeln, Funktionen und Pivot-Tabellen.

• Professionelle englische Kommunikationsfähigkeiten (B2/C1-Niveau). Deutsch wäre ein Plus.

• Starke Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten.

• Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten, während eine kollaborative und teamorientierte Denkweise beibehalten wird.

• Kundenorientierter Ansatz mit starken organisatorischen Fähigkeiten und Liebe zum Detail.

• Resilienz, Anpassungsfähigkeit und eine proaktive Haltung gegenüber Veränderungen und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.

Was wir Ihnen bieten

• Festanstellung in einem weltweit anerkannten Industrietechnologieführer.

• Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt.

• Jährliche Bonusregelung.

• Essensgutscheine.

• Flexibles Leistungspaket einschließlich Krankenversicherung, Transport und Kinderbetreuungsmöglichkeiten.

• Möglichkeit, mit innovativen Daten- und KI-Technologien zu arbeiten.

• Werden Sie Teil eines sehr erfahrenen Teams.

• Internationales Engagement bei der Arbeit mit Stakeholdern in verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen.

• Karrierewachstumsmöglichkeiten innerhalb einer globalen Organisation.

• Moderne Büros in Nuevos Ministerios, Madrid.

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top-Arbeitgeber 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, Chin anerkannt zu werden

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Le comptable est chargé d'appuyer les opérations comptables, y compris la saisie des données, les rapprochements et l'établissement de rapports financiers. Ce rôle assure l'exactitude des documents financiers et appuie la conformité aux normes comptables. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels en début de carrière qui appliquent de vastes connaissances théoriques et qui ont besoin de la capacité d'étudier et d'analyser les problèmes. Les solutions sont généralement discutées/vérifiées avec un membre plus âgé. À propos du rôle

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et contribuer à la prestation de services financiers de haute qualité qui soutiennent une société prospère et plus durable.

Rejoignez notre équipe des finances à Madrid en tant que commis à la facturation et à la collecte. Dans ce rôle, vous serez chargé de gérer les activités de facturation et les comptes débiteurs, d'assurer le recouvrement en temps opportun, de tenir des dossiers financiers exacts et de soutenir des opérations comptables efficaces dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. • Coordonner avec le fournisseur de services externe responsable des activités du CTO et du RTR.

• Établir des relations solides avec les principaux intervenants, notamment le groupe FP&A, le Trésor, les fonctions fiscales et RE et les filiales de Sulzer.

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous aurez besoin

• Diplôme en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou un domaine connexe.

• Idéalement, 3 ans d'expérience dans la gestion des comptes débiteurs, de la facturation ou de la perception.

• Bonne compréhension des principes comptables et des processus financiers.

• Expérience de travail avec SAP FI/CO en tant qu'utilisateur.

• Compétences en communication en anglais professionnel (niveau B2/C1). L'allemand serait un plus.

• Bonne communication et aptitudes interpersonnelles.

• Approche axée sur le client avec de solides compétences organisationnelles et une attention aux détails.

• Résilience, adaptabilité et attitude proactive envers le changement et l'amélioration continue.

jobs.title: Retrofit Proposal Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Retrofits Proposal Engineer is responsible for the preparation and delivery of technical and commercial solution proposals for retrofit and upgrade projects, supporting front end sales and the retrofit specialist team in respect of customers’ enquiries. Key Responsibilities:

• Reviewing project requirement with Retrofit Specialist (RS) – Key account manager (KAM) and to define bid strategy

• Preparation and submission of technical and commercial proposals in line with customer requirements, ensuring that proposals meet Sulzer commercial guidelines and have the necessary sign off in accordance with the Delegation of Authority

• Obtain the quotes from sub-vendors for Mechanical Seal / Motors / Instruments and all other equipment / services.

• Performs application engineering duties in preparation of complete proposals, contacting appropriate service centers, parts manufacturing cells, sub-vendors and other Sulzer entities as required while clarifying specifications and other typical application duties.

• Work closely with Sales, Engineering and Operations to provide cost effective, competitive solutions in line with Sulzer financial objectives

• Routing the requirement of costing to the best solution available within Sulzer global portfolio and optimizing the costs for highest chance of award of the project

• Support cross Regions requirements

• Preparation of Lost Bid Analysis for issued proposals

• Proactively engage and support company initiatives designed to promote a culture of safe working, environmental protection, and continual improvement.

• Work together with Order Processing to ensure smooth and efficient handover of proposals/orders

Skills & Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Hydraulic Engineering, or a related Engineering discipline.

• Minimum of 7 years of experience in Sales, Tendering, Applications Engineering, or a combination of technical and commercial roles within an industrial environment.

• Demonstrated expertise in mechanical and/or hydraulic engineering principles, products, and applications.

• Strong understanding of project management methodologies; PMP certification preferred.

• Proficiency with SAP and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook).

• Proven experience supervising, coaching, and developing teams to achieve business objectives.

• Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and influencing skills with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels.

• Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

• Ability to travel as required within the assigned region.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Quality Control Inspector (Goods In)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Key
• Responsibilities

Perform inspection of incoming gas turbine components, materials, and assemblies to ensure compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, purchase orders, OEM requirements, and customer standards.
Conduct dimensional, visual, and documentation inspections using appropriate measuring equipment and inspection techniques.
Review and verify material certificates, certificates of conformity, inspection reports, and supplier documentation to ensure compliance and traceability requirements are met.
Inspect turbine rotors, casings, shafts, blades, vanes, bearings, fasteners, and associated components for conformity prior to release into production.
Identify, document, and support the resolution of non-conforming materials through established quality management processes.
Maintain accurate inspection records and support internal, customer, and third-party quality audits.
Support the implementation and continuous improvement of QA/QC procedures, standards, and inspection practices.
Monitor and provide feedback on supplier quality performance and incoming product quality trends.
Liaise with the Inspection Supervisor, Engineering, Procurement, Project Engineers, and Production teams to resolve quality-related issues and minimise disruption to repair and overhaul activities.
Ensure all inspection activities are performed in accordance with Sulzer quality procedures, customer requirements, and applicable industry standards.

Required Skills:

Experience in a Quality Control, QA/QC, or Inspection role within an engineering or manufacturing environment.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, technical documentation, and manufacturing standards.
Experience using precision measuring equipment such as verniers, micrometres, bore gauges, height gauges.
Understanding of material certification, traceability, and quality documentation requirements.
Knowledge of dimensional inspection techniques and engineering tolerances.
Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to inspection activities.
Good communication and documentation skills.
Familiarity with supplier quality management, non-conformance reporting, and root cause investigations.
Competent in Microsoft Office applications.

Desirable Skills

Experience inspecting gas turbine, steam turbine, compressor, pump, or other rotating equipment components.
Understanding of OEM quality requirements and repair documentation.
Knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management systems.
Experience using quality management systems.

What we offer you

Competitive base salary
Inclusion in a company-wide bonus program
Attractive overtime pay scheme
33 days of annual leave
Private medical insurance
On-site parking
Access to various discounts on everyday shopping, entertainment, and lifestyle
An Employee Assistance Programme offering confidential support services, including counselling and resources to help manage personal and work-related issues, enhancing overall well-being and productivity
Continuous learning and development opportunities through on-the-job training and Sulzer Learning Pathways, our dedicated online platform for professional growth

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Municipal Water

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de comptes clés - Eau municipale

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We’re looking for a high-impact Key Account Manager to take ownership of one of our most significant long-term utility partnerships – a major regional water provider serving millions of customers across the North West of England.

This is a commercially critical role where you will own the account strategy end-to-end—driving growth across capital projects (pump packages and related equipment) and aftermarket services, while shaping the future of a well-established, high-value relationship. Your main responsibilities:

• Own the P&L and growth strategy for a utility account, with clear accountability for revenue and margin performance

• Drive the narrative with the customer—positioning us as a trusted, strategic partner across both capital investment and lifecycle services

• Lead and coordinate a multi-disciplinary account team, ensuring alignment across sales, service, engineering and delivery

• Build and deepen senior stakeholder relationships, influencing decision-making at operational and strategic levels

• Develop and execute a long-term account development plan, aligned to the customer’s AMP cycles and investment priorities

• Provide accurate forecasting, pipeline management and reporting

• Act as the voice of the customer internally, ensuring continuous improvement and delivery excellence

What We’re Looking For

• Whilst this is a remote role, we have a preference for candidates based in the North West of England. Regular customer visits and face-to-face engagement are essential to building relationships, providing effective support, and maintaining a strong presence across the region.

• Proven experience in a Key Account Management or Strategic Account role within engineering, industrial or utilities environments

• Strong commercial acumen with experience owning revenue targets and driving growth

• Background in pumps, rotating equipment, or fluid handling systems is highly desirable. Alternatively, direct experience working closely with a UK -based water utility provider is a strong advantage

• Demonstrated ability to build and manage high-value, long-term customer relationships

• Experience leading or influencing cross-functional teams without direct line management

• Confident communicator, capable of engaging at both technical and executive levels

• Strategic mindset with the ability to translate customer needs into tangible commercial outcomes

What we offer you

• A fully remote home based role with travel across regions.

• A competitive basic salary

• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance

• Private Medical Insurance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Product Quality Control Inspector is responsible for ensuring that product quality specifications are in compliance with corporate and customer standards. This includes supporting the implementation of QA/QC policies, conducting inspections, and assisting in vendor evaluations.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Key Responsibilities
Inspect products to ensure compliance with quality specifications and standards.
Support the implementation of QA/QC policies and procedures.
Assist in evaluating vendor quality and performance.
Document inspection results and report deviations.
Collaborate with QA/QC teams and vendors to enforce quality standards.
Skills & Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role.

Required Skills:

Basic understanding of quality control procedures and tools.
Attention to detail and accuracy in inspection tasks.
Ability to follow established procedures and report findings.
Familiarity with product specifications and documentation.
Willingness to learn and support quality assurance initiatives.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

jobs.title: Quality & Continuous Improvement Lead
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Step into a leadership role where you can drive quality, compliance, and continuous improvement at Sulzer’s Leeds Service Centre — a key facility specialising in the repair, overhaul, and maintenance of rotating equipment for customers across power generation, oil & gas, water, and other heavy industries. Known for its technical capability and fast‑turnaround support, the centre plays a vital role in helping customers minimise downtime and maximise performance.

In this position, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by strengthening quality standards, shaping improvement initiatives, and supporting a high‑performing, customer‑focused operation.
Your main responsibilities:

• Investigate and resolve quality issues using structured root‑cause analysis, ensuring robust corrective and preventive actions

• Lead and champion continuous improvement initiatives using LEAN methodology, working closely with the local management team

• Oversee the internal audit programme and support successful outcomes in customer and third‑party audits

• Monitor supplier performance and collaborate with procurement to enhance quality, conformance, and reliability

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• A recognised qualification in mechanical engineering or significant experience in a relevant service or repair environment

• Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001 and experience maintaining or managing quality management systems

• Proven success in leading LEAN or continuous improvement projects, with strong structured problem‑solving abilities

• Excellent communication, leadership, and influencing skills

• An understanding of repair processes, rotating equipment, and supplier quality standards

What we offer you

We’ve recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds Service Centre — creating a brighter, more efficient, and more advanced workspace designed to support high‑quality work and a great employee experience.

Alongside our upgraded facilities, you’ll benefit from:
Core Benefits

• Competitive salary & annual bonus scheme

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

Community & Wellbeing

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

- Una qualifica riconosciuta in ingegneria meccanica o significativa

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Step into a leadership role where you can drive quality, compliance, and continuous improvement at Sulzer’s Leeds Service Centre — a key facility specialising in the repair, overhaul, and maintenance of rotating equipment for customers across power generation, oil & gas, water, and other heavy industries. Known for its technical capability and fast‑turnaround support, the centre plays a vital role in helping customers minimise downtime and maximise performance.

In this position, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by strengthening quality standards, shaping improvement initiatives, and supporting a high‑performing, customer‑focused operation.
Your main responsibilities:

• Investigate and resolve quality issues using structured root‑cause analysis, ensuring robust corrective and preventive actions

• Lead and champion continuous improvement initiatives using LEAN methodology, working closely with the local management team

• Oversee the internal audit programme and support successful outcomes in customer and third‑party audits

• Monitor supplier performance and collaborate with procurement to enhance quality, conformance, and reliability

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• A recognised qualification in mechanical engineering or significant experience in a relevant service or repair environment

• Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001 and experience maintaining or managing quality management systems

• Proven success in leading LEAN or continuous improvement projects, with strong structured problem‑solving abilities

• Excellent communication, leadership, and influencing skills

• An understanding of repair processes, rotating equipment, and supplier quality standards

We’ve recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds Service Centre — creating a brighter, more efficient, and more advanced workspace designed to support high‑quality work and a great employee experience.

About the role

Job Summary
The Project Assistant is responsible for planning, directing, and coordinating activities related to Aero. Responsibilities

• Working with operations and sales teams to coordinate field service aero-derivative gas turbine repair and/or overhaul projects from inception to completion.

• Ensuring that all jobs meet planned delivery dates and customer expectations.

• Communicating regularly and promptly with clients and internal stakeholders regarding ongoing work.

• Strong MS Office skills (Excel, MS Project, etc.)

• Strong customer service skills and high motivation

• General knowledge of aero-derivative gas turbines and/or rotating equipment preferred, but not required

• PMP certification preferred, but not required

jobs.title: Industrial Application Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
This position will work closely with JWC Sales team to facilitate the continued growth of the Industrial Division. The Application Engineer will act as primary liaison between JWC sales, engineering & operations teams to recommend best-in-class equipment solutions. Responsibilities include customer needs-analysis, process understanding, application intricacies, team collaboration and development of equipment solutions in a time sensitive environment. Finished products of the Application Engineer will include CAD drawings, product recommendations combined with technical capabilities of JWC equipment specific to the customer’s application. Position will require customer communication during various stages of the sales cycle. Some post-sales support may be needed to facilitate complete customer satisfaction. Other responsibilities may include enhancing CAD library, support of the equipment rentals program and helping facilitate grind-test demonstrations. Principle Duties and Responsibilities:

• Understand customer requirements to deliver best-in-class JWC product recommendations

• Responsible for creating CAD drawings and equipment specifications in timely fashion

• Produce drawings that demonstrate JWC equipment placement within customer’s processes

• Establish & support sales to deliver a high level of customer satisfaction during pre-sales activities

• Work closely with JWC engineers and operational teams to facilitate successful post-sales activities

• Demonstrate excellent organizational, communication and problem solving skills

• Exhibit proficient knowledge and use of company systems and software

• Build exceptional internal relationships with all JWC departments and divisions

• Maintains a professional image as a representative of the Company.

• Performs other duties and special projects as assigned.

• Adhere to Company Values with excellent communication and collaboration

Skills & Qualifications

• Required: Associate’s Degree in Engineering or equivalent experience

• Desirable: Bachelor’s Degree

• Fluent in AutoCAD, Solidworks, Inventor or other 3D drawing programs

• Knowledge or working experience of industrial processes and process machinery. Experience in food and beverage, manufacturing, marine, waste & recycling industries will be a plus

• 2-3 years of experience in a customer-facing role, ideally working alongside sales or customer service teams

• Industrial design experience or schooling a plus

• Team player, goal oriented, excellent communicator with good mechanical aptitude

• Enjoys fast-paced working environment with constant team communication

• Ability to work independently when required

• Creative mind and can-do attitude

Salary: $85K - $90K

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Questa posizione lavorerà a stretto contatto con il team JWC Sales per facilitare la continua crescita della Divisione Industriale. L'Ingegnere di Applicazione fungerà da collegamento primario tra i team di vendita JWC, di ingegneria e di operazioni per consigliare soluzioni di attrezzature migliori in classe. Le responsabilità includono l'analisi delle esigenze del cliente, la comprensione dei processi, le complessità delle applicazioni, la collaborazione di team e lo sviluppo delle soluzioni di apparecchiatura in un ambiente sensibile al tempo. I prodotti finiti dell'Ingegnere di Applicazione comprenderanno disegni CAD, raccomandazioni di prodotto combinate con capacità tecniche di apparecchiature JWC specifiche per l'applicazione del cliente. La posizione richiederà la comunicazione del cliente durante varie fasi del ciclo di vendita. Potrebbe essere necessario un supporto post-vendita per facilitare la completa soddisfazione del cliente. Altre responsabilità possono includere migliorare la biblioteca CAD, il supporto del programma di noleggio attrezzature e contribuire a facilitare le dimostrazioni di grind-test. Duties e responsabilità del principio:

• Capire i requisiti del cliente per fornire raccomandazioni di prodotto JWC di classe migliore

• Responsabile per la creazione di disegni CAD e specifiche attrezzature in modo tempestivo

• Produrre disegni che dimostrano il posizionamento delle attrezzature JWC all'interno dei processi del cliente

• Stabilire e sostenere le vendite per fornire un alto livello di soddisfazione del cliente durante le attività pre-vendita

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri JWC e i team operativi per facilitare le attività post-vendita di successo

• Dimostrare eccellenti capacità organizzative, di comunicazione e di problem solving

• Conoscenza e utilizzo di sistemi e software aziendali

• Costruire relazioni interne eccezionali con tutti i dipartimenti e le divisioni JWC

• Mantiene un'immagine professionale come rappresentante della Società.

• Esegui altri compiti e progetti speciali assegnati.

• Affidati ai Valori Aziendali con ottima comunicazione e collaborazione

Competenze & Qualifiche

• Richiesto: Associate’s Degree in Ingegneria o equivalente esperienza

• Discesa: Corso di laurea

• Fluente in AutoCAD, Solidworks, Inventor o altri programmi di disegno 3D

• Conoscenza o esperienza lavorativa dei processi industriali e dei macchinari di processo. L'esperienza nelle industrie alimentari e delle bevande, manifatturiere, marine, rifiuti e riciclo sarà un plus

• 2-3 anni di esperienza in un ruolo orientato al cliente, lavorando idealmente insieme a team di vendita o assistenza clienti

• Esperienza di progettazione industriale o la scuola di un plus

• Team player, obiettivo orientato, ottimo comunicatore con buona attitudine meccanica

• Gode di un ambiente di lavoro veloce con una comunicazione costante del team

• Capacità di lavorare indipendentemente quando richiesto

• mente creativa e atteggiamento can-do

Salario: $85K - $90K

Cosa ti offriamo

• 15 giorni di tempo libero e 12 giorni festivi

• 401k piano con una partita del 6%

• Piano sanitario completo tra cui medico, dentale, visione, vita, disabilità a breve e a lungo termine

• Conto di risparmio sanitario corrispondente

• Programma benessere stimolante

• Programma di assistenza dei dipendenti

• congedo paterna pagato

• Rimborso palestra

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

• Unterstützung der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Wartungspraktiken.

• Starke mechanische Eignung und Fehlersuche Fähigkeiten.

• Erfahrung mit Industriemaschinen und Werkzeugen.

• Fähigkeit, technische Handbücher und Schaltpläne zu lesen.

• Führungs- und Koordinationsfähigkeiten.

• Kenntnis der Sicherheits- und Wartungsstandards.

Was wir Ihnen bieten

• 15 Tage bezahlte Freizeit und 12 bezahlte Firmenferien

• 401k Plan mit einem 6% Match

• Matching des Sparkontos

• Motivierendes Wellnessprogramm

• Mitarbeiterunterstützungsprogramm

• Bezahlter Vaterschaftsurlaub

• Gymnastikerstattung

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lead Strategic Account Manager is responsible for managing and growing relationships with key clients. This role ensures that client needs are met, identifies new business opportunities, and coordinates with internal teams to deliver tailored solutions that drive long-term value.
This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Required to manage large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager. Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals. Summary: Assigned accounts, with strategic importance to the company, specifically for the chemical process industry (CPI) and fertilizers segments in Western USA. Accounts may be local, national, international or have other important factors that classifies it as a strategic account. Also, promotes the sales and service of Sulzer products and accessories (new equipment & after-market: spare parts, repairs & field service) to established and new customers by providing technical and commercial proposals in response to inquiries, and interfacing between customers and company facilities, following written policies and procedures. Assigned territory and segments would be covered by a mix of direct accounts and distribution (indirect).

Essential Functions:
 Develops account strategy and account planning
 Reviews sales history and forecasts future business
 Evaluates competitor offerings
 Develops relationships based on trust and performance
 Works on regional and national agreements as required by Sales Management
 Finds and develops new customers within existing territories
 Negotiates orders including all technical, commercial, and legal details to the mutual satisfaction of customers and the Company
 Calls on prospective customers and maintains contracts with customers in relation to their requirements
 Secures and renews orders, arranges delivery dates and other peripherals integral to selling
 Travels to customer locations to insure close and regular face-to-face contacts.
 Safety obligations:
* All employees follow current Sulzer safety programs.
* All employees have "the right and duty to intervene" in the event a safety concern becomes evident. In addition, acceptance of an intervention should be accepted in a positive manner as it could have prevented an accident.
 All employees are required to comply with all work instructions, policies, and posted signs or instructions regarding safety, including but not limited to proper use of required PPE at all times.

Secondary Responsibilities:
 Performs other duties as assigned.
 Provides sales support to distributors and end users as needed.
 Provides application and technical support to distributors and end-users, as needed.

Supervisory Responsibilities:
 None

Qualifications:
 Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, marketing, or other technical related experience
 Thorough knowledge of Sulzer products and services as well as competitor’s products and services
 Experience in appropriate market segments
 In-dept knowledge of sales and marketing techniques
 Knowledge of Microsoft office products
 Good written and verbal communication skills

Physical Requirements:
 Lifting up to 25 pounds

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Il Lead Strategic Account Manager è responsabile della gestione e della crescita delle relazioni con i clienti chiave. Questo ruolo assicura che le esigenze del cliente siano soddisfatte, identifica nuove opportunità di business e coordina con i team interni per fornire soluzioni su misura che guidano il valore a lungo termine.
Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a esperti di materia tema riconosciuta in una zona di lavoro. Richiesto di gestire grandi progetti o processi con supervisione limitata dal gestore. Allenatori, recensioni e delegati lavorano per professionisti di livello inferiore. Riepilogo: Conti assegnati, con importanza strategica per l'azienda, specificamente per il settore dei processi chimici (CPI) e dei segmenti dei fertilizzanti negli Stati Uniti occidentali. I conti possono essere locali, nazionali, internazionali o hanno altri fattori importanti che la classificano come un conto strategico. Inoltre, promuove le vendite e il servizio di prodotti e accessori Sulzer (nuove attrezzature e post-mercato: ricambi, riparazioni e servizi sul campo) a clienti affermati e nuovi, fornendo proposte tecniche e commerciali in risposta alle richieste, e interfacciandosi tra clienti e strutture aziendali, seguendo politiche e procedure scritte. territorio e segmenti assegnati sarebbero coperti da un mix di conti diretti e distribuzione (indiretto).

Funzioni essenziali:
 Sviluppa la strategia del conto e la pianificazione del conto
 Recensioni storia delle vendite e previsioni futuro business
 Valuta le offerte concorrenti
 Sviluppa relazioni basate sulla fiducia e sulle prestazioni
 Lavora sugli accordi regionali e nazionali come richiesto dalla Direzione vendite
 Trova e sviluppa nuovi clienti all'interno dei territori esistenti
 Negozia ordini tra cui tutti i dettagli tecnici, commerciali e legali per la reciproca soddisfazione dei clienti e della Società
 Chiama i potenziali clienti e mantiene i contratti con i clienti in relazione alle loro esigenze
 Protegge e rinnova gli ordini, organizza le date di consegna e altre periferiche integrali alla vendita
 Viaggia nelle sedi dei clienti per assicurare contatti faccia a faccia stretti e regolari.
 Obblighi di sicurezza:
* Tutti i dipendenti seguono i programmi attuali di sicurezza Sulzer.
* Tutti i dipendenti hanno "il diritto e il dovere di intervenire" nel caso in cui una preoccupazione di sicurezza diventa evidente. Inoltre, l'accettazione di un intervento dovrebbe essere accettata in modo positivo in quanto avrebbe potuto evitare un incidente.
 Tutti i dipendenti sono tenuti a rispettare tutte le istruzioni di lavoro, le politiche e i segni o le istruzioni postate per quanto riguarda la sicurezza, compreso ma non limitato al corretto uso del DPI richiesto in ogni momento.

Responsabilità secondarie:
 Esegue altri compiti come assegnato.
 Fornisce il supporto di vendita ai distributori e agli utenti finali come necessario.
 Fornisce applicazione e supporto tecnico ai distributori e agli utenti finali, come necessario.

Responsabilità di vigilanza:
 Nessuno

Qualifiche:
 Corso di laurea in ingegneria, business, marketing o altre esperienze tecniche correlate
 Conoscenza approfondita dei prodotti e dei servizi di Sulzer e dei prodotti e servizi dei concorrenti
 Esperienza nei segmenti di mercato appropriati
 Conoscenza in-dept delle tecniche di vendita e marketing
 Conoscenza dei prodotti per uffici Microsoft
 Buone capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali

Requisiti fisici:
 Sollevamento fino a 25 sterline

• Tempo a pagamento competitivo

• 12 Azienda Pagamenti all'anno

• Programma bonus annuale

• Vantaggio completo medico, dentale e visione

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Der Lead Strategic Account Manager ist für die Verwaltung und den Ausbau der Beziehungen zu wichtigen Kunden verantwortlich. Diese Rolle stellt sicher, dass die Kundenbedürfnisse erfüllt werden, identifiziert neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und koordiniert sich mit internen Teams, um maßgeschneiderte Lösungen zu liefern, die langfristig Wert schaffen.
Dieses Stellenprofil richtet sich an anerkannte Fachexperten in einem Stellenbereich. Erforderlich zur Verwaltung großer Projekte oder Prozesse mit begrenzter Aufsicht durch den Manager. Coaches, Rezensionen und Delegierte arbeiten mit Fachleuten auf niedrigerer Ebene. Zusammenfassung: Zugeordnete Konten, mit strategischer Bedeutung für das Unternehmen, speziell für die Chemieprozessindustrie (CPI) und Düngemittelsegmente in den westlichen USA. Konten können lokal, national, international sein oder andere wichtige Faktoren haben, die es als strategisches Konto klassifizieren. Fördert auch den Verkauf und Service von Sulzer-Produkten und -Zubehör (neue Geräte und After-Market: Ersatzteile, Reparaturen und Außendienst) für etablierte und neue Kunden, indem technische und kommerzielle Vorschläge als Reaktion auf Anfragen bereitgestellt und die Verbindung zwischen Kunden und Unternehmenseinrichtungen nach schriftlichen Richtlinien und Verfahren hergestellt wird. Die zugewiesenen Gebiete und Segmente würden durch eine Mischung aus direkten Konten und Verteilung (indirekt) abgedeckt.

Wesentliche Funktionen:
Entwickelt Kontostrategie und Kontoplanung
Rezensionen der Verkaufshistorie und Prognosen des zukünftigen Geschäfts
Bewertet Angebote von Wettbewerbern
Entwickelt Beziehungen, die auf Vertrauen und Leistung basieren
Arbeitet an regionalen und nationalen Vereinbarungen, wie vom Sales Management gefordert
Findet und entwickelt neue Kunden in bestehenden Gebieten
Verhandelt Aufträge einschließlich aller technischen, kommerziellen und rechtlichen Details zur gegenseitigen Zufriedenheit der Kunden und des Unternehmens
Ruft potenzielle Kunden an und unterhält Verträge mit Kunden in Bezug auf ihre Anforderungen
Sichert und erneuert Bestellungen, arrangiert Liefertermine und andere Peripheriegeräte, die für den Verkauf unerlässlich sind
Reisen zu Kundenstandorten, um enge und regelmäßige persönliche Kontakte zu gewährleisten.
Sicherheitsverpflichtungen:
* Alle Mitarbeiter folgen den aktuellen Sulzer-Sicherheitsprogrammen.
* Alle Mitarbeiter haben "das Recht und die Pflicht einzugreifen", falls ein Sicherheitsbedenken offensichtlich wird. Darüber hinaus sollte die Akzeptanz einer Intervention positiv akzeptiert werden, da sie einen Unfall hätte verhindern können.
Alle Mitarbeiter sind verpflichtet, alle Arbeitsanweisungen, Richtlinien und veröffentlichten Schilder oder Anweisungen in Bezug auf die Sicherheit einzuhalten, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf die jederzeitige ordnungsgemäße Verwendung der erforderlichen PSA.

Sekundäre Zuständigkeiten:
Führt andere Aufgaben wie zugewiesen aus.
Bietet Vertriebsunterstützung für Distributoren und Endverbraucher nach Bedarf.
Bietet Anwendung und technische Unterstützung für Distributoren und Endbenutzer, je nach Bedarf.

Aufsichtsaufgaben:
Keine

Qualifikationen:
Bachelor-Abschluss in Engineering, Business, Marketing oder anderen technischen verwandten Erfahrungen
Grundlegende Kenntnisse der Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Sulzer sowie der Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Wettbewerbern
Erfahrung in geeigneten Marktsegmenten
In-dept Wissen über Verkaufs- und Marketingtechniken
Kenntnisse über Microsoft Office Produkte
Gute schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

Sur le rôle

Le gestionnaire de compte stratégique principal est responsable de la gestion et de l'accroissement des relations avec les clients clés. Ce rôle permet de répondre aux besoins des clients, d'identifier de nouvelles possibilités d'affaires et de coordonner les activités avec les équipes internes afin de fournir des solutions adaptées qui favorisent la valeur à long terme.

Le territoire et les segments attribués seraient couverts par une combinaison de comptes directs et de distribution (indirecte).

Élaborer une stratégie de comptabilité et une planification des comptes
